A factorized Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer attends along the time and filter-bank axes separately, a learned gate fuses the spectral branch with a CNN-BiLSTM, and horizon-specific gates emit one, three, five, and ten day forecasts in a single pass. We evaluate seven equity indices and gold under a common expanding-window protocol and an untouched one-year hold-out, against nine learned baselines and a random-walk persistence benchmark. Under MAE and MAPE, persistence is the strongest of the ten fixed competitors in 29 of the 32 series-horizon cells and DSTNet is the only model below it in every cell, by 0.7 to 0.9 percent at one day and 3.4 to 4.5 percent at ten days. At one day, paired testing favours DSTNet against the weaker learned baselines but is inconclusive against persistence and the strongest learned forecasters. A downstream allocation diagnostic does not support an equity-timing advantage on any of the seven indices.

AI.tldr: DSTNet提出了一种基于因果动态谱轨迹(DST)的双分支多步金融预测架构,通过严格因果的单边Morlet滤波器组保留近期谱演化,使用分解的尺度-时间谱Transformer(STST)降低注意力复杂度,并通过垂直注意力融合和水平自适应解码器实现单次前向传播输出1/3/5/10日预测。在八个数据集(七个股指+黄金)上,DSTNet在MAE和MAPE指标下是唯一在所有32个序列-时间跨度组合中均低于随机游走持久性基准的模型,但配对统计检验在1日期对持久性基准不显著,三种子稳定性测试中种子平均胜率降至25-26/32,且股票配置诊断不支持择时能力。
AI.motivation: 现有小波金融预测器存在三个问题:1) 小波变换仅用于去噪,丢弃显式频谱信息;2) 卷积通常为双边滤波,会读取预测起点之后的数据,造成未来信息泄漏;3) 静态谱快照仅保留预测起点处的单一谱状态,丢弃了谱结构在观察窗口内的演化路径。本文旨在同时解决因果性保证与谱过程保留这两个问题。
AI.method: 核心方法包含四个组件: (1) 因果Symlet-4残差去噪器对OHLCV进行因果FIR去噪; (2) 单边Morlet复FIR滤波器组(8个尺度,ω₀=6)实现严格因果的时频分解,通过Proposition 1证明无未来泄漏,并通过Corollary 1推导192样本的burn-in排除; (3) 动态谱轨迹(DST)张量D∈R^(20×8×7),保留整个20日回看窗口内的滤波器组幅值演化; (4) 分解的尺度-时间谱Transformer(STST)将联合注意力(wS=160 tokens)分解为时间流(20 tokens × 56维)和尺度流(8 tokens × 140维),Theorem 1证明注意力核心复杂度从O((wS)²d)降至O(w²dA + S²dB),等宽理论比约55.2倍; (5) CNN-BiLSTM时间分支与STST谱分支通过两token垂直注意力融合门(VAF)组合,再由水平自适应解码器(HAD)通过独立tanh门控同时输出1/3/5/10日预测。
AI.result: 在7个股票指数(KOSPI、Nikkei 225、S&P 500、DJI、DAX、NASDAQ、NYSE)和黄金(GC=F)上,采用扩展窗口协议(2010-2023)和未触及的一年保留期(2023-06至2024-05)评估,对比9个学习基线和持久性基准。主要结果: (1) MAE/MAPE下,持久性在32个序列-时间跨度组合中的29个为最低,所有9个学习基线在1/3/5日均无法超越随机游走; (2) DSTNet是唯一在所有32个MAE/MAPE单元中低于持久性的模型,1日期低0.7-0.9%、10日期低3.4-4.5%; (3) Diebold-Mariano test在1日期对LSTM/BiLSTM/XGBoost显著(p<0.01),但对持久性不显著(统计量0.16-0.24); (4) 三种子(42/101/202)重跑后,种子均值胜率降至25-26/32而非32/32,最大CV达9.7-10.6%; (5) 消融实验显示No-DST(静态快照)退化最大(+5.79% MAE),Joint STST与分解版本差异极小(+0.05%),No-VAF退化+2.94%,无burn-in退化+0.92%; (6) 下游配置诊断对7个股票指数不支持择时优势,6个指数的规则在开盘交易后不再触发,仅黄金长仓策略在1.99 vs 1.74 Sharpe上描述性地改善,但单一保留期无配对推断。
AI.conclusion: DSTNet的因果动态谱轨迹表示在MAE/MAPE上系统性地低于随机游走持久性基准,但这种优势具有以下边界条件:1日期配对检验对持久性不显著,种子稳定性将32/32的全胜结果降低至25-26/32,股票资产的配置诊断为阴性结果。论文将随机游走视为日内股票预测的有效基准,而非学习的弱基线。Regime诊断表明,校准后的股票方向信号几乎没有条件区分能力,这解释了其配置失败的原因。黄金是唯一在Sharpe上描述性改善的资产,但仅限于单一保留期。未来工作包括扩展至更长期限的DM比较、滚动起点多资产评估、种子化基线重跑以及现实期货实现的进一步配置研究。

title: Gauss-Newton Accuracy and Indefinite Hessians: Uniform Coexistence in Low-Cost Sets
summary: We study the accuracy of Gauss-Newton curvature in ridge-regularized nonlinear least squares. Under local regularity and persistence of level-set curvature magnitude along an exact-fit section, we prove uniform coexistence of two curvature regimes. Global minimizers exist, and every global minimizer has relative Hessian error below $(1+\sqrt2)/8$, while the same low-cost set contains a point with an indefinite Hessian and relative error at least $15/8$. One positive ridge cap works for all independent center and label perturbations in fixed neighborhoods and every positive ridge weight up to the cap. These neighborhoods do not shrink as the ridge weight tends to zero. A pointwise certificate based on the current prediction level set controls the normal, mixed, and tangent parts of the Hessian correction. We prove a sharp relative-error bound over the stated pointwise class when the prediction map and ridge vary. Analytic examples describe the roles of output alignment, curvature orientation, and persistence. A separate structural result gives full Jacobian row rank throughout low-cost sets and exact interpolation near a rank-deficient reference.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了带岭正则化的非线性最小二乘问题中Gauss-Newton曲率近似的精度。核心结果表明，在满足局部正则性和曲率持续性条件下，低成本集合中可以同时存在两种曲率状态：所有全局极小解处的相对Hessian误差严格小于(1+√2)/8，而同一集合中存在使Hessian不定且相对误差至少为15/8的点。论文还给出了基于当前预测水平集的逐点精度证书，并证明了相对误差界的最优性。此外，在秩亏参考附近，论文给出了保持满Jacobian秩和精确插值的结构性结果。
AI.motivation: Gauss-Newton近似广泛用于非线性最小二乘和神经网络的无Hessian优化中。已有结果通常仅给出Hessian与Gauss-Newton矩阵的逐点比较或局部正定性保证，但缺乏对低成本集合内整体行为的统一刻画。当残差较小时，残差加权的二阶项可能相对于岭正则项仍很大，导致Gauss-Newton近似在某些方向上失效。论文旨在回答：在何种统一条件下，低成本集合中全局极小解处的曲率近似精度与存在不定Hessian点可以共存？
AI.method: 1. 定义相对曲率误差ρ(θ)=‖P^{-1/2}(H-P)P^{-1/2}‖_2。2. 通过精确拟合截面(沿法向截面的精确插值点)构造锚点，结合曲率大小持续性假设和局部C^{2,1}正则性建立定理1（统一共存定理）。3. 定理2给出逐点曲率证书：利用成本、秩、导数界和当前预测水平集曲率B（第二基本形式范数），通过法向、混合、切向三部分的分析证明H⪰λI/2，进而通过推论3得到(1-c*)P≺H≺(1+c*)P，其中c*=(1+√2)/8。4. 定理9（相对包络定理）证明在绝对切向包络下常数c*关于所述逐点类是最优的。5. 第7节通过弱jet条件和逆函数稳定性方法建立结构性桥接（引理7），证明秩亏参考附近的满Jacobian秩和精确插值。6. 解析例子（命题5两输出映射、命题6负残差例子、命题12乘积二次型）说明输出对齐、曲率方向和成本-梯度门控的作用。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 定理1：对于每个允许的独立中心-标签扰动对和每个0<λ≤W，存在全局极小解z_λ满足ρ(z_λ)<(1+√2)/8，且同一低成本集合中存在不定Hessian点x_λ满足ρ(x_λ)≥15/8。邻域半径不随λ→0而缩小。(2) 定理2+推论3：逐点证书给出c*=(1+√2)/8的相对误差界，且该常数关于变映射逐点类是最优的。(3) 推论8：在弱jet条件下，低成本集合内全空间Jacobian保持满行秩，每个允许元组存在严格低于成本上界的精确插值点，且Hessian特征值具有分带结构（λ阶、ε²阶、ε⁰阶）。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在岭正则化非线性最小二乘中，低成本集合可以同时包含曲率近似精确的全局极小解和具有不定Hessian的点，且这一共存对独立中心-标签扰动在固定邻域内对所有充分小的λ均成立。关键工具是：基于当前预测水平集第二基本形式的切向门控、块分解下法向-混合-切向的统一处理、绝对切向包络下的相对谱控制定理，以及秩亏参考附近的逆函数稳定性结构性结果。分析例子表明聚合导数界会丢失输出对齐信息，而局部光滑性本身不足以固定归一化标签邻域。

title: Pretraining Shapes Spectral Structure: Architecture- and Strategy-Conditional Prediction of OOD Robustness in Foundation Models
summary: Can we determine whether a foundation model will generalize out-of-distribution (OOD) before any target data is available? Existing diagnostics require source or target data, which rules them out before a target domain exists. Those that use the weights alone apply one statistic to every architecture, and do not separate robust models from fragile ones. We show the answer is encoded in the spectral structure of pretrained weights. Two forces shape that structure. Architecture determines how information is stored in weight matrices. Pretraining strategy determines what is rewarded. Together they set a spectral geometry that governs OOD robustness. We prove that the OOD accuracy gap is bounded by how tightly the source representations concentrate. A statistic computed from the pretrained weights alone serves as a proxy for that concentration. The direction of that proxy reverses between architecture families. We operationalize it: the direction is stable within one (architecture X strategy) combination, the finest grouping we test, which we call a cell. Pooled over 116 models spanning 7 modalities, a single statistic ranks OOD robustness weakly, because cells of opposite direction cancel. Within a cell, the statistic selected for it orders 92% of model pairs by OOD robustness in-sample. The selection does not leak the target: for each model family outside the matrix we logged the cell, metric and sign before running its OOD evaluation, and the predicted direction held in every case: EEG, genomic and protein. Acting on spectral concentration narrows the OOD gap by 24% at 87.5% ID retention. The diagnostic operates on released weights alone, so OOD robustness becomes checkable at model-selection time, before data or compute is committed to a target domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需目标数据即可预测基础模型 OOD 鲁棒性的权重谱诊断方法。该方法通过在(架构 × 预训练策略)单元内选取特定谱统计量来预测 OOD 性能,在 116 个跨 7 种模态的模型上验证,并成功迁移到 EEG、基因组和蛋白质等新领域。
AI.motivation: 现有的 OOD 诊断方法要么需要源域/目标域数据,要么对所有架构使用统一的统计量,无法区分鲁棒与脆弱的模型。本文试图回答:在没有任何目标数据的情况下,能否仅从预训练权重判断一个基础模型的 OOD 泛化能力。
AI.method: 核心方法是将预训练权重的谱结构作为 OOD 鲁棒性的代理指标。关键步骤包括:(1) 定义(架构 × 预训练策略)单元(cell),因为架构决定信息存储方式,预训练策略决定奖励什么;(2) 在每个单元内选择特定的谱统计量(如 log-sr、PR-mean、MP-energy、CV(log-Frob)等)作为 log-sr_feat 的代理;(4) Theorem 1 证明 OOD 精度差距受源表示集中度的约束,Lemma 2 通过残差模型建立权重到特征的传递桥梁;(3) 通过 WeightWatcher 计算权重统计量,无需任何目标数据即可对模型进行 OOD 鲁棒性排序。
AI.result: 在 116 个跨 7 种模态的基础模型上,按(架构 × 策略)分组的单元内相关性从全局池化的 0.245 提升到 0.824,所有 15 个单元达到 |ρ_LOO| ≥ 0.700,92% 的模型对能被正确排序。在 EEG、基因组、蛋白质三个新领域的前瞻性验证中,预测方向全部成立。诊断指导的干预使 OOD 差距缩小 24%(保留 87.5% 的 ID 精度)。该方法在 9/10 NLP 模型上优于随机目标层选择。
AI.conclusion: 预训练在权重矩阵上留下了可被读取的几何指纹,该指纹在(架构 × 策略)单元内决定 OOD 鲁棒性。无需目标数据、前向传播或标注样本,仅从释放的权重即可在模型选择阶段评估 OOD 脆弱性,为模型发布分诊、跨模态部署和提前审计提供了实用工具。

title: EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching
summary: We introduce EC-EarthFlow, a generative flow matching model that emulates simulations from the physical climate model EC-Earth3. The model is trained on transient simulations from EC-Earth3 (1950-2166, SSP2-4.5) to predict the day ahead temperature field from the previous days temperature as well as annual mean temperature. Predictions are made auto-regressively with rollout periods of between a month and an extended season. Using only this variable of interest, we are able to reproduce the daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle and long-term trend from EC-Earth3 at a substantially lower computational cost than the physical model. We demonstrate that EC-EarthFlow is stable for long inference periods, and that it can learn the physical relationships as simulated in EC-Earth3.

AI.tldr: EC-EarthFlow是一个基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的生成式深度学习模型，用于模拟物理气候模型EC-Earth3的瞬态（transient）日尺度全球近地表温度场，仅以单一变量（2m温度）为输入即可重现日变率、空间格局、年循环和长期升温趋势，且计算成本远低于物理模型。
AI.motivation: 全球气候模型（GCM）的大集合模拟对研究气候变率和极端事件至关重要，但计算成本极高。现有深度学习方法多针对平稳气候或天气预报场景，尚无方法能在日尺度上模拟包含长期强迫趋势的瞬态未来气候投影。
AI.method: 采用条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching, CFM）结合最优传输（OT）概率路径，学习给定上下文（过去5天温度+年平均温度）条件下下一日温度场的条件分布；使用PDE-Transformer架构参数化向量场，采用纬度加权的MSE损失进行训练；推理时通过自回归方式生成多月乃至延长季节的预测，通过对不同噪声采样生成集合预报。
AI.result: 模型成功再现了EC-Earth3的日变率、空间格局、年循环和长期升温趋势（包括1950–2166年期间约2.5°C的升温）；长时次自回归推理（最长约8个月）保持稳定无发散；集合离散度合理但略偏不足；模型能从单一变量学到大气动力学约束（如欧洲上空的阻塞/波列结构）；主要缺陷在于极地冬季存在暖偏差，可能与规则经纬度网格在极区的处理方式有关。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证表明，生成式流匹配模型可在日尺度上以远低于物理GCM的计算成本模拟非平稳、含强迫趋势的气候场，且能从单一变量隐式学习大尺度大气动力学；未来工作将扩展至多变量、更高分辨率、更长推理周期，并探索更优的网格投影（如HEALPix）、SDE采样、一致性模型加速以及观测同化等技术。

title: SoftSEEPS improves ML-based precipitation forecasting
summary: In this paper we have developed a differentiable approximation of the well-known SEEPS score, which we name SoftSEEPS. This allows the training of a Machine Learning model to forecast precipitation directly. We test SoftSEEPS on the IMERG dataset (0.1 degree resolution) by training a decoder for precipitation on the latent space of a pre-trained low-resolution forecasting model. Combining SoftSEEPS and RMSE in a joint objective is possible with marginal trade-offs in either metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoftSEEPS——SEEPS评分（一种常用于降水预报评估的分类指标）的可微sigmoid松弛近似，使其能够作为机器学习模型的训练损失函数直接优化。该方法在高分辨率（0.1°）GPM IMERG降水预报任务上得到验证，并证明SoftSEEPS与log-RMSE联合优化可在两者间取得近乎帕累托最优的权衡。
AI.motivation: SEEPS评分基于干/轻/大降水三类分类及气候学依赖的惩罚矩阵，是降水预报（尤其是防灾预警系统）广泛认可的评价指标。但由于其分段常数分类操作不可微，现有ML降水模型仅能以RMSE等替代损失训练，无法直接针对SEEPS优化。这构成了气候影响层面的方法论缺口。
AI.method: 核心方法SoftSEEPS：用sigmoid松弛函数替代SEEPS的硬分类指示器，构建软分类概率向量c(x,τ)，并通过Frobenius内积c(x,τ)ᵀSc(y)与位置/日序依赖的惩罚矩阵S结合，得到全可微评分s(x,y,τ)。温度参数τ采用基于验证集离散SEEPS的plateau调度器自动退火。模型层面，在预训练冻结的ArchesWeather-M（1.5° ERA5）骨干网络潜空间上，训练一个卷积上采样解码器IMERGDecoder（54.3M参数），通过×2/×3/×5三次双线性上采样将384×60×120潜变量映射至0.1° IMERG网格（1×1800×3600），目标为提前24小时的逐日累积降水。
AI.result: 在1998–2018训练、2019验证、2020测试的IMERG数据集上，三组对比实验（MSE-only、SoftSEEPS-only、MSE+λ×SoftSEEPS）显示：SoftSEEPS-only将离散SEEPS从MSE基线的0.481降至0.375（最佳），代价为RMSE升高；联合损失（MSE+1.75×SoftSEEPS）则以极小的RMSE代价（5.316→5.334 mm/day）将SEEPS降至0.381。λ扫描表明两者构成近似帕累托前沿，SEEPS最多降低18.51%而RMSE几乎无损。空间分析显示SEEPS改善在全球范围内较为均匀，而RMSE则呈区域分化模式。所有解码器配置均优于持久性、气候学及ERA5双三次插值基线。
AI.conclusion: SoftSEEPS可作为ML降水预报模型的有效直接优化目标，使模型在干/轻/重分类上获得更优性能，与早期预警和灾害响应系统的实际决策需求一致。与MSE联合使用时仅产生边际权衡。未来应在更大规模模型和训练预算下进一步推广此方法。

title: EntroPrefill: Renyi-Guided Context Pruning with Conditional Stability Guarantees for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 16 pages, 0 figures. Theoretical framework and conditional stability guarantees for context pruning; no empirical evaluation or benchmarks are included
summary: Mid-prefill pruning can reduce the sequence processed by deeper transformer layers, but attention concentration alone does not certify that discarded context is dispensable. We formulate EntroPrefill as a Renyi-guided proposal mechanism coupled to explicit constraints on discarded attention mass. Sink-isolated, regularized head pooling respects grouped-query attention while exposing a quantitative trade-off between specialization and worst-head coverage. We derive a mixture-to-head deletion envelope, a computable upper bound on feasible token removal, and a finite-sample observer guarantee that remains valid when the pruning layer is selected adaptively. We then establish a conditional transformer perturbation bound with explicit sufficient Lipschitz constants and a first-token decision-margin corollary. A counterexample shows why shallow observations alone cannot imply an unconditional future-output guarantee. The systems analysis distinguishes query-head unions, physical page allocation, and KV-transfer payload, and gives an arithmetic break-even condition for pruning. This manuscript is theoretical in scope: it defines the procedure, its assumptions, and its formal limits, but does not report measured acceleration or task-accuracy preservation. Experiments are reserved for subsequent validation of the assumptions, approximation tightness, and end-to-end resource trade-offs.

AI.tldr: EntroPrefill提出了一种用于检索增强生成（RAG）的中间填充（mid-prefill）上下文剪枝理论框架，通过Rényi熵引导的提议机制配合显式约束、独立的自适应层审计以及条件输出稳定性保证来形式化描述token移除过程。论文完全是理论性的，不报告实测加速或任务精度保留结果。
AI.motivation: RAG场景下文档片段相关性差异巨大，逐一处理所有token造成不必要的计算开销。现有的注意力引导剪枝方法虽多，但仅凭注意力集中度无法证明被丢弃的上下文是真正可丢弃的——缺乏对删除约束、统计审计和输出扰动的统一条件性分析框架。
AI.method: 方法体系包含四个核心模块：(1) Sink-隔离的Rényi头池化（Sink-Isolated Rényi Pooling），使用Rényi二阶熵相关的碰撞统计量（collision statistic）作为头权重，并加入正则化下界ζ防止头被完全抑制，同时兼容分组查询注意力（GQA）结构；(2) 混合到行的删除包络（Mixture-to-row deletion envelope），推导从池化注意力质量到单行注意力质量的可计算上界，并利用χ²散度控制池化损失；(3) 独立审计与自适应层选择（Independent Auditing and Adaptive Layer Selection），通过Hoeffding不等式和联合界在多个监控层上提供同时成立的有限样本观察者保证；(4) 条件Transformer输出扰动界（Conditional Transformer Perturbation Bound），基于Lipschitz常数推导首token对数边际（first-token logit margin）推论，并构造反例证明浅层注意力集中不能给出无条件输出保证。此外系统分析区分查询头并集、KV传输负载和物理页分配，并给出算术收支平衡条件。
AI.result: 主要理论结果包括：熵分离与下界性质（Proposition 3.1）、空校准块优先级有界性（Proposition 3.2）、混合到行删除包络（Theorem 4.1）、固定行删除锐界（Lemma 4.2）、双证书可行性界（Theorem 4.3）、同时观察者保证（Theorem 5.1）、无浅层注意力均匀输出界的反例（Proposition 6.1）、条件首token扰动界（Theorem 6.2）、决策边际推论（Corollary 6.3）以及竞争页保留命题（Proposition 7.1）。具体数值示例：L=32层、l*=4层、ξ=1/2的理想算术节省端点为43.75%到65.625%。
AI.conclusion: EntroPrefill构建了耦合显式删除约束、自适应审计和条件输出保证的统一理论框架，明确界定了注意力集中作为可丢弃性证据的局限——通过反例证明浅层证据不能保证无条件输出正确性，输出界必须依赖额外的支撑转移假设（support-transfer assumption）。论文明确声明这是纯理论工作，未报告实测加速或精度结果；实验验证留给后续工作来检验假设的合理性、近似紧度以及端到端资源权衡。结构局限包括：注意力集中可能选择错误事实、桥接相关性仅在深层出现、审计对短查询可能过保守、Lipschitz乘积可能导致全模型界空洞化、不可逆删除限制长生成恢复。

title: Leaner Transformers Can Easily Learn to Cluster
summary: Transformers have in-context learning capabilities, where some known learning algorithms can be executed in the forward pass through the model. Recent work shows that transformers can exactly perform Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering with $n$ points in $d$ dimensions with an embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = d+k$ (thus, requiring attention projection matrices of size $(d+k)^2$). In this work, we build upon this result in the following ways: First, we present an equally expressive but smaller transformer that executes Lloyd's algorithm with embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = (d + \lceil \log_2 k \rceil)$. Next, we train these transformers to learn the clustering algorithms given a distribution of clustering tasks, and theoretically characterize and empirically validate the factors affecting the convergence and in-distribution generalization of learning algorithms based on stochastic gradients. Finally, we probe the general clustering abilities of these learned algorithms (in the form of transformers), and try to understand situations where they succeed and fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种更精简的Transformer架构，能以d+⌈log₂k⌉的嵌入维度精确执行Lloyd的k-means算法（相比之前d+k的方案，参数减少最高达75%），并理论分析了影响学习收敛和泛化的因素，实验证明学到的算法在多步迭代和分布外泛化中能显著超越单步Lloyd算法。
AI.motivation: 现有的Transformer架构能用d+k的嵌入维度精确执行Lloyd算法，但参数随k二次增长，计算成本高。本文旨在用更紧凑的二进制嵌入减少参数规模，并深入理解学习聚类算法的收敛性和泛化能力。
AI.method: 1）提出二进制（BN）嵌入方案，用⌈log₂k⌉维替代k维表示聚类索引，证明其表达能力等价于原one-hot（OH）方案；2）用基于负平方欧氏距离的softmax注意力构建单层Transformer；3）通过随机梯度下降在聚类任务分布上端到端训练，使用NE正则化（softmax）或L2正则化（sparsemax）的min函数平滑k-means目标；4）理论分析Lipschitz常数及SGD收敛/泛化界与嵌入维度、聚类数、正则化惩罚τ等的关系。
AI.result: 1）BN嵌入相比OH在k≫d时实现最高12倍前向/9倍反向加速及近70%显存降低；2）学习到的Transformer在单步聚类上能显著超越单步Lloyd，且通过重新嵌入迭代可逐步改进聚类质量；3）OH收敛更快但两者最终性能相近，差距随d增大消失；4）L2正则化（sparsemax）比NE正则化（softmax）提供更紧的上界、泛化更好；5）除cauchy分布外，模型能泛化到不同权重/各向异性/尺度的分布及不同分布族。
AI.conclusion: 更精简的二进制嵌入Transformer能精确表达Lloyd k-means算法，且通过梯度下降学习的聚类算法可推广至训练分布之外的任务；但当前架构需为特定(d,k)训练，且对cauchy分布任务的学习和泛化能力有限。

title: Fluctuations of Nonlinear Observables in Mean Field Neural Network Training
summary: Mean field limits describe the training dynamics of wide neural networks through the evolution of the empirical distribution of their parameters. Although functional central limit theorems characterize the asymptotic fluctuations of this distribution, quantities of practical interest are typically nonlinear observables of the parameter distribution rather than the distribution itself. In this work, we show how these mean field fluctuations propagate to finite dimensional nonlinear observables for shallow neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent. Working in the weighted Sobolev space in which the limiting fluctuation process is constructed, we apply a functional Delta method under ordinary Fr{é}chet differentiability, without requiring Lions derivatives with respect to the measure variable. We obtain a central limit theorem for the observables and, under a suitable representation of their differentials, an explicit covariance formula inherited from the underlying mean field fluctuation theory. We also study whether prescribed quantities of interest can be recovered from the selected observations. Under a constant rank assumption, we prove that a quantity of interest factors locally through the observation functional if and only if, throughout a neighborhood, the kernel of the differential of the observation is contained in that of the quantity of interest. Thus, a differential condition expressed directly in the ambient Sobolev space yields an exact nonlinear local factorization. These results provide a framework both for quantifying finite-width uncertainty on observable, statistically or physically meaningful quantities and for assessing whether the chosen observations contain the information required to identify them.

AI.tldr: 本文针对浅层神经网络随机梯度下降训练的均值场（mean field）极限，推导了有限维非线性泛函的中心极限定理，并给出了可观测量的局部因子分解条件，为有限宽度网络的统计不确定性量化与可观测量辨识提供了理论框架。
AI.motivation: 在宽神经网络均值场极限下，参数的经验分布的渐近波动已有函数型中心极限定理刻画，但实际感兴趣的是参数分布的非线性泛函（如统计量或物理量）而非分布本身。需要一套理论将均值场的波动传播到有限维非线性可观测量，并判断可观测量是否包含所需信息。
AI.method: 1. 在构造极限波动过程所用的加权 Sobolev 空间中，利用普通 Fréchet 可微性施加 functional Delta 方法，无需 Lions 导数。2. 推导可观测量中心极限定理及协方差显式公式。3. 在常秩假设下，给出可观测量微分核包含关系刻画"可观测量局部是否因子化地通过观测泛函传递目标量"的充要条件。
AI.result: 1. 证明了浅层网络 SGD 训练下有限维非线性泛函的中心极限定理。2. 在合适微分表示下给出协方差的显式公式，继承自底层均值场波动理论。3. 在常秩邻域内，目标量可被观测泛函局部因子化恢复，当且仅当观测泛函微分的核包含于目标量微分的核；该判定完全在 Sobolev 空间中表述。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了统一框架：既能定量评估有限宽度对统计/物理可观测量的不确定性，又能在 Sobolev 微分层面精确判断所选观测是否足以辨识目标量；Fréchet 可微的 Delta 方法比 Lions 导数框架更简洁，适用于更广泛的非线性泛函。

title: AdaPS-LiNGAM: Adaptive Predecessor Selection for Linear Non-Gaussian Acyclic Models under Small-Sample Settings
summary: Causal discovery becomes particularly challenging when the available sample size is small relative to the number of variables. This challenge also arises in the linear non-Gaussian acyclic model (LiNGAM), an identifiable framework for causal discovery from observational data. DirectLiNGAM estimates a causal order, which arranges variables so that causes precede their effects, by sequentially identifying an exogenous variable and removing its linear effect from the remaining variables. We establish a structural limitation of this procedure: when the number of variables exceeds the sample size, repeated residualization necessarily becomes degenerate before the full causal order can be determined. Our analysis further reveals that each residual can be reconstructed using only a graph-determined subset of variables already placed earlier in the causal order, termed the active boundary. This result motivates AdaPS-LiNGAM (Adaptive Predecessor Selection LiNGAM), which reconstructs each residual directly from the original observations using an adaptively chosen sparse subset of those earlier variables. The same subset-selection principle is also applied to the final pruning step for edge estimation. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that AdaPS-LiNGAM provides accurate causal-structure recovery in sample-limited settings and degrades more gradually as the sample size decreases.

AI.tldr: 本文针对小样本（n<p）下线性非高斯有向无环模型（LiNGAM）的因果发现问题，指出DirectLiNGAM的累积残差化过程在有限样本下会发生结构性退化（残差向量在排序完成前归零），并提出AdaPS-LiNGAM方法：通过"活跃边界"（active boundary）概念识别重构成残差所需的最小预测变量子集，并利用自适应最优子集选择（ABESS算法）从原始观测数据中直接重建残差，从而避免累积残差化带来的退化问题。
AI.motivation: 因果发现中样本量相对于变量数有限是一个核心挑战。在LiNGAM框架下，DirectLiNGAM采用累积残差化策略——每一步都对剩余变量关于已排序变量做线性回归并取残差。作者发现当n<p时，这一过程在排序完成前残差必然退化为零（因为居中后样本空间维数至多为n-1），这不是统计误差问题，而是结构性退化。
AI.method: 作者提出AdaPS-LiNGAM（Adaptive Predecessor Selection LiNGAM）：1）理论上定义"活跃边界"——即前缀集合中效应能进入剩余集合并到达目标节点而不经过另一已选节点的那些变量，并在局部非抵消条件下证明该集合恰好等于归约式回归系数的支撑集；2）证明活跃边界是重构成残差所需的唯一最小预测变量集合，且重构成的残差保持DirectLiNGAM的下一步根选择准则；3）给出活跃边界稀疏度smax(π)≤n-2的有限样本可行性充分条件；4）算法上，每步排序时使用ABESS算法在原始数据上做自适应最优子集选择来重构成残差，修剪阶段也采用同样策略。可选用GIC或EBIC信息准则。
AI.result: 在合成数据实验中（100次随机重复），固定n=100、p从10增至200时，AdaPS-LiNGAM（EBIC）在因果排序（TOD）和边恢复（F1、SHD）方面显著优于DirectLiNGAM和HighDimDirectLiNGAM。例如p=200、均匀噪声下ER2图上F1得分0.905 vs 0.315（SHD 34.39 vs 430.20）。固定p=100、n从100增至2000时，AdaPS-LiNGAM性能下降更平缓（ER2上F1从0.914到0.997，仅下降0.083；而DirectLiNGAM下降0.711）。EBIC变体在精确率-召回率平衡上优于GIC。HighDimDirectLiNGAM在排序上有时具竞争力但边恢复明显较差。计算上AdaPS-LiNGAM与DirectLiNGAM相当（约576秒 vs 685秒，p=200），但慢于HighDimDirectLiNGAM（约40秒）。
AI.conclusion: AdaPS-LiNGAM通过活跃边界概念和自适应稀疏残差重建，有效避免了DirectLiNGAM在n<p时的结构性退化问题。理论分析建立了活跃边界作为最小预测变量集合的表征与有限样本可行性条件。实验验证了该方法在小样本设置下的有效性和随样本量减少时的渐进退化特性。未来工作包括建立有限样本统计保证、分析根选择准则的小样本行为、以及将活跃边界稀疏度条件发展为更实用的假设。

title: A Proof-of-Concept Study of Weakly Supervised Labeling of Fine-Grained EEG Components for Artifact Attenuation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is highly susceptible to electromyographic (EMG) artifacts, whose temporal heterogeneity and spatial-spectral overlap with neural activity can leave mixed sources after blind source separation. Existing artifact-removal methods are further limited by scarce reliable component-level ground truth: expert annotations are costly and subjective, while no established method provides realistic simulation-based ground truth for EMG contamination in multichannel scalp EEG. To address these limitations, we propose a framework combining a frequency-aware high-dimensional representation with Multi-Instance Learning. The representation unfolds separated components into frequency-resolved intra-components, creating a space in which mixed neural and muscular activity becomes more separable, while the weakly supervised learning formulation enables artifact-likelihood scores for individual intra-components to be learned from epoch-level labels without finer-grained ground truth. The resulting intra-component classifier supports fine-grained EMG artifact detection and score-guided attenuation. Experiments on held-out subjects show that the framework learns informative intra-component scores and reduces artifact-related spectral deviations most clearly for jaw tension, with moderate effects for raising eyebrows and limited effects for frowning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合频率感知高维表征与多示例学习（MIL）的弱监督框架，用于EEG中EMG伪迹的细粒度检测与衰减，无需组件级或组件内级标注。该方法将ICA分离后的组件沿频率维度展开为"频率分辨内部组件"，仅利用epoch级标签即可学习内部组件的伪迹似然分数，并在独立被试上验证了其对咬肌紧张伪迹的显著衰减效果。
AI.motivation: EEG信号易受肌电（EMG）伪迹干扰，且EMG与神经活动在时空频谱上高度重叠，盲源分离后仍可能残留混合源；现有伪迹去除方法受限于组件级真值缺失（专家标注成本高且主观，仿真生成的真实多通道EEG-EMG混合数据缺乏可靠方法）。因此亟需一种无需精细标注即可实现细粒度伪迹衰减的方法。
AI.method: 1) 采用ILRMA对每个epoch的连续小波时频表示（6.9–403.5 Hz）进行源分离，得到24个源；2) 将每个源沿频率轴展开为"内部组件"（frequency×component对），通过乘以混合矩阵得到四维张量Y*；3) 提取每个内部组件的空间拓扑图特征（3通道32×32）和66维手工时域特征；4) 构建弱监督MIL模型：每个epoch视为包，内部组件视为实例，使用top-k（k=2%）池化聚合，训练目标结合BCE损失与稀疏性、排序、频率平滑正则项；5) 训练后丢弃池化层，对内部组件打分（τ=0.5阈值），并通过零化高得分内部组件实现分数引导的衰减与重建。
AI.result: 在122名被试（训练98，测试24）的25导联EEG数据上：epoch级分类在阈值0.5下平衡准确率0.91、F1=0.88；ROC AUC=0.98，AP=0.96。分数引导衰减方面：咬肌紧张（JT）在额、额颞、中央通道改善最显著（最高F8=144.94、F10=141.23、C4=124.30）；抬眉（RE）改善中等（Fp2=17.97、F4=10.03）；皱眉（Fr）几乎无改善。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明弱监督epoch级标签可在频率分辨内部组件空间中诱导出有意义的伪迹似然分数，为缺乏精细标注情况下的细粒度EEG伪迹衰减提供了概念验证路径。但结果存在伪迹类型依赖性（对JT效果最佳，Fr几乎无效），且因弱标签由实验条件定义，可能混入任务相关神经/行为信号。未来需引入组件级MIL对照、消融实验、跨数据集泛化性测试及下游任务（如BCI分类）评估。

title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning is now central to eliciting reasoning in large language models, while in the popular algorithm Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) every token in a rollout receives the same advantage. We ask how to make process supervision efficient: accelerating convergence and improving final quality without the cost of value networks. We propose Bag-of-Tokens Group Relative Policy Optimization (BoT-GRPO), which extends GRPO to token-level reward models through a length-invariant "bag of tokens" aggregation: it collects all token-level rewards across rollouts, weights each by the inverse of its source sequence length, and computes per-token advantages relative to weighted group statistics. BoT-GRPO is critic-free, and is a drop-in replacement wherever GRPO is used when token-level reward is available. On React front-end code generation, BoT-GRPO reaches $80\%$ compile rate up to $1.9\times$ faster than GRPO and converges faster than modern GRPO variants (GSPO, DAPO, PURE) while reaching higher final compile and VLM-judged win rates. On a second task, AIME mathematical reasoning, BoT-GRPO delivers absolute Pass@$k$ gains up to $8.1\%$ over GRPO in half the steps. For both tasks we compare the algorithm's performance on reasoning vs. non-reasoning base-model families (Qwen2.5-3B, SmolLM3-3B, Phi-4-mini-reasoning). Our experiments also yield a practical recipe for the reward model itself: reward stability matters more than richness: clean, bounded, stable fine-grained signals consistently accelerate learning where noisier alternatives stall.

AI.tldr: BoT-GRPO 是一种无需 critic 的 GRPO 扩展方法，通过长度不变的"词袋"聚合将 token 级奖励转化为 per-token 优势，在前端代码生成和 AIME 数学推理任务上实现了更快收敛和更高最终质量。
AI.motivation: 标准 GRPO 对同一 rollout 内所有 token 施加相同的序列级优势信号，导致：(1) 信用分配过于粗糙，梯度在长思维链上被均匀浪费；(2) 序列级目标存在响应长度偏差，使长序列主导基线计算；(3) 尽管过程奖励模型 (PRM) 能提供更密集的细粒度信号，但传统 PRM 方法要么引入价值网络、要么需要额外训练、要么成本过高，难以在单卡可复现规模下提升训练效率。
AI.method: BoT-GRPO 将所有 rollout 的 token 级奖励汇集到统一的"词袋"中，按 1/L_k（源序列长度的倒数）加权后计算加权均值和方差，再据此计算 per-token 优势；该加权使每个序列对群体统计的贡献归一化为 1，修正了长度偏差且无需引入 critic。token 级奖励采用通用形式 r_t^(k) = w_g·G_k + w_s·S_t^(k)，其中全局奖励 G_k（如编译是否通过）为主，有界局部信号 S_t^(k) 作为辅助稠密反馈。在 React 任务中通过编译器诊断、ESLint、LLM 代码法官的逐行归因（带线性空间衰减 w=3）构建；在 AIME 任务中通过对带 ⟨step i⟩ 标签的结构化解进行 Claude Sonnet 4 逐步评估，并采用 error propagation 策略（首个错误步骤之后所有步骤 e_s=0）。算法可作为 GRPO 的 drop-in 替代品，计算开销仅为 O(∑L_k)。
AI.result: 在 React 代码生成（Qwen2.5-3B，64 采样/步）上：BoT-GRPO 比 GRPO 快达 1.9× 达到 80% 编译率，且比 GSPO、DAPO、PURE 收敛更快、最终编译率与 VLM-judged 胜率更高；PURE 因无界过程奖励聚合在 step 70 后从 ~84% 退化至 61%。在 AIME（Qwen2.5-3B）上：Pass@1 9.6% vs 6.6%（+3.0）、Pass@2 16.8% vs 8.7%（+8.1）、Pass@4 20.6% vs 15.1%（+5.5），仅用约一半训练步数。在 SmolLM3-3B 与 Phi-4-mini-reasoning 上同样保持优势，但 Phi-4-mini-reasoning 因已具备强推理风格，绝对提升较小。奖励消融显示：仅编译器+ESLint 信号会引发奖励作弊（编译率 ~74% 但渲染空白页）；LLM 代码法官是必要信号；VLM 视觉法官为可选且需谨慎引入，1-turn 全权重 VLM 局部信号导致 peak-to-final 编译率下降 0.236，2-turn 去偏协议可降至 0.020。AIME 上的局部策略、权重 w_s∈{0.1,0.5,1.0}、窗口大小消融均表明 BoT-GRPO 对超参稳健，验证了"稳定性胜过丰富性"的主题。
AI.conclusion: BoT-GRPO 是 GRPO 的 critic-free、drop-in 扩展，通过长度不变的"词袋"聚合将外部 token 级奖励转化为收敛加速杠杆，同时修正 GRPO 的响应长度偏差；其在 React 代码生成与 AIME 数学推理两个差异显著的领域、跨推理与非推理三类基座模型均取得更快收敛与更高最终质量，且仅引入 O(∑L_k) 开销，适用于资源受限的训练场景。核心实践启示为：奖励信号的稳定性（清洁、有界、稳定）比丰富性更重要，LLM 代码法官在代码生成中不可或缺，而 VLM 视觉法官为可选项且需通过去偏协议谨慎引入。主要局限在于：分析为有界扰动论证而非最优性保证；仅覆盖两个领域；AIME 题目可能与预训练数据有重叠；实验大多为单 seed，限制了统计结论的强度。

title: Homogenization in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) leverage interactions between agents to perform complex tasks. Despite their success, we show that these interactions can also lead to homogenization, i.e., agents converging to similar behaviors. Homogenization in MAS can reduce agent diversity and reinforce shared failures. In this paper, we operationalize homogenization using three metrics: conformity to the majority, polarization towards extremes, and growing inertia against changes over subsequent interactions. We evaluate homogenization in MAS for code generation, hiring, and scientific peer review. Across these tasks, we show that homogenization translates to concrete downstream risks: in code generation, it hides and amplifies correlated errors which can create systemic vulnerabilities; in hiring, it allows the influence of biased agents to persist long after their removal; and in peer review, it creates uneven evaluation standards across research areas. Our results establish homogenization as a failure mode of MAS, demonstrating that MAS evaluations must move beyond aggregate performance to carefully analyze interaction dynamics. Finally, we show that simple approaches to increase diversity---leveraging sampling stochasticity and mixed-models MAS---fail to reduce homogenization risks, highlighting the need for strategies to effectively leverage agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统研究了多智能体系统（MAS）中的"同质化"（homogenization）失败模式，将其操作化为三个度量指标（从众、极化、惯性），并在代码生成、招聘、同行评审三个真实场景中验证了其下游风险，同时证明简单的多样性增强策略（采样随机性、混合模型配置）无法缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）虽通过智能体交互提升任务表现，但交互过程可能导致智能体丧失独立判断、趋向相似行为（即同质化），从而减少多样性并放大共享失败。现有研究多将模型视为独立决策者，缺乏对MAS交互动态引发的同质化风险的深入分析。
AI.method: 1. 提出编排驱动的MAS形式化定义（Definition 3.1），包含工作者智能体、编排器、有界评分量表和交互轮数。2. 将同质化操作化为三个独立度量：（a）从众性（conformity）：智能体分数方差跨轮递减；（b）极化性（polarization）：平均分数趋向刻度两端；（c）惯性（inertia）：平均分数变化率跨轮递减。3. 在三个应用中评估：代码生成（CodeLMSec数据集，CodeQL检测漏洞）、招聘（合成反事实简历数据集，注入对抗性偏见）、同行评审（ICLR 2025抽样1950篇论文）。4. 使用9个LLM（含7-9个单模型和16个混合模型配置），每组T=5轮、M=10次独立试验。5. 评估两种缓解策略：采样随机性和混合模型配置。
AI.result: 1. 同质化在所有三个应用和所有模型中均成立：从众性（方差降至约0.5倍以下）、极化性（某些设置下偏移0.5分）、惯性（末轮变化小于首轮0.2倍）。2. 下游风险：（a）代码生成中MAS虽降低总体漏洞率，但相关错误被放大，产生系统性安全盲点；（b）招聘中单个偏见智能体的偏见传播至其他智能体，且移除后残余偏见持久存在；（c）同行评审中偏好趋同，对特定研究领域产生系统性偏好或偏见。3. Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507表现最强同质化趋势；惯性趋势最强，极化趋势最弱（招聘中）。4. 缓解策略均失败：采样随机性仅产生表面方差（行为差异）但不改变底层共识动态；混合模型配置因跨家族同质化（共享盲点）仍出现相同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 同质化是MAS的一种新型失败模式，源于智能体交互动力学，在代码生成、招聘、同行评审中产生系统性安全漏洞、持久偏见和领域间不公平等具体下游风险。简单干预（采样随机性、混合模型）无法解决问题，根源在于当前LLM景观中的跨家族同质化。MAS评估必须超越聚合性能指标，需开发针对性干预措施有效利用智能体多样性。研究的局限性包括仅关注编排驱动架构、同质化度量仅基于数值分数（未覆盖自然语言输出）。

title: Dual-QK: Sharp Queries and Flat Keys for Prunable 2-bit KV Caches
summary: Long inputs and extended generation increase the storage and access costs of the key-value (KV) cache. Low-bit quantization reduces storage and memory traffic, while query-channel pruning can further reduce key-cache reads. Rotation-based quantization redistributes the energy of key outliers across channels. To maintain computational invariance, the same orthogonal transform must be applied to queries, preserving query-key dot products. However, this rotation can disperse query energy, weakening the separation between a few large components to retain and many small ones to prune. We introduce Dual-QK, which uses paired non-orthogonal query and key transforms to address this conflict. Using calibrated query and key statistics, Dual-QK combines partial key whitening with a query-aligned basis to balance key scales for INT2 quantization and concentrate query energy for dynamic channel pruning. Channel-0 protection and bucket-relative RoPE support low-bit accuracy over long contexts. Experiments on four models across five generative benchmarks and long-context retrieval tasks show improved accuracy over OSCAR on most tasks at 40% query-channel sparsity. At a 128K context, Dual-QK provides $6.8\times$ KV-cache compression and an estimated $8.3\times$ reduction in KV read volume relative to unpruned BF16. Under the evaluated configurations, our SGLang implementation achieves up to $3.75\times$ the decoding throughput of unpruned BF16.

AI.tldr: Dual-QK 提出了一种配对的非正交查询-键变换，通过部分键白化和查询对齐基，同时实现 INT2 KV 缓存量化和动态查询通道剪枝，以在长上下文 LLM 推理中兼顾键量化的平坦分布需求和查询剪枝的尖锐分布需求。
AI.motivation: 低比特 KV 量化（如旋转量化）需要平坦的键分布以容纳异常值并提高量化分辨率，而查询通道剪枝则需要尖锐的查询分布以有效区分重要与不重要通道。传统的共享正交旋转无法同时满足这两种冲突的分布需求，限制了在长上下文场景下同时实现高压缩比和高效稀疏注意力的能力。
AI.method: Dual-QK 使用配对的非正交查询-键变换 $A = G^{\alpha/2}U$ 和 $B = G^{-\alpha/2}U$，通过 $(QA)(KB)^T = QK^T$ 保持压缩前的注意力分数。其中部分键白化（参数 $\alpha \in [0,1]$）平衡键尺度用于 INT2 量化，查询对齐基 $U$ 集中查询能量用于通道剪枝。此外还引入了通道 0 保护（BF16 存储）和桶相对 RoPE（$w=2048$），并通过离线校准的第二矩统计和可选的对角尺度优化 $D$ 进一步优化。推理时基于当前查询的 GQA 组 L2 范数动态选择通道。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507、Qwen3-8B 和 Ministral-3-14B-Reasoning-2512 四个模型上的实验表明：在 40% 查询通道稀疏度下，Dual-QK 在多数生成基准（GPQA-Diamond、HumanEval、LCB v6、MATH-500、AIME25）和 RULER NIAH 长上下文检索任务上优于 OSCAR、KIVI 和 TurboQuant；在 128K 上下文下实现 6.8× KV 缓存压缩和 8.3× KV 读取量减少；在 SGLang 实现上解码吞吐量最高达 BF16 的 3.75×。LongBench 上 40% 稀疏度下 Dual-QK 较 OSCAR 在 Llama 和 Qwen3-8B 上分别提升 10.08 和 3.12 平均分。
AI.conclusion: Dual-QK 证明了通过联合设计查询和键坐标来同时支持低比特量化和通道剪枝的可行性，在长上下文推理中实现了显著的压缩比和加速效果，同时保持接近 BF16 的准确率。然而在极长上下文下与 BF16 仍存在准确率差距，且查询相对于旧桶的位置偏移可能超出校准窗口，未来工作需要更广泛的校准位置范围。

title: For Those Who Believe in Faithfulness: Optimizing the Area Under Insertion and Deletion Curves for Ranking Relative Feature Importance
summary: The adoption of machine learning for socially relevant tasks requires effective explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods to better understand the behavior of machine learning models. Attribution methods are a popular XAI approach in which input-output relationships are characterized by heat maps that reflect the relative importance of input features for a particular prediction. The quality of such maps is often assessed by measuring faithfulness based on the area under insertion and deletion curves, which measures changes in the model output as features are added and removed. In this study, we derive an objective function from this notion of faithfulness and a way to approximate its gradient. We establish the connection between insertion curves and top-$k$ feature selection, which leads to a loss function measuring the quality of attributions. Randomization of the loss allows us to efficiently approximate its gradient. To show the effectiveness of the general approach, we combine the loss function with the neural explanation mask framework. The resulting method, termed Ra-NEM, can be used with any differentiable model without affecting the model's performance. Experiments demonstrate that Ra-NEM provides accurate attributions robustly and efficiently. Compared to other algorithms, the attributions have not only higher faithfulness but also perform well in terms of other XAI metrics. The high inference speed of Ra-NEM makes the method suitable for online applications. The code is available online: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的可解释AI（XAI）归因方法Ra-NEM，通过直接优化插入/删除曲线下面积（AUC）来生成特征重要性排序。具体地，作者建立了插入曲线与top-k特征选择之间的理论联系，推导了Monte Carlo近似的样本复杂度，并利用Gumbel top-k trick实现了可微的优化。将该损失函数与Neural Explanation Mask（NEM）框架结合，得到Ra-NEM方法，可与任意可微模型配合使用，不影响原始模型性能。实验在ImageNet上使用四种深度学习架构（ResNet50、ConvNeXt、VGG16、ViT）评估，结果表明Ra-NEM在忠实性、鲁棒性和推理速度方面均达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有的归因方法（如基于梯度或遮挡的方法）虽然在评估时常用插入/删除曲线下的面积（AUC）来衡量忠实性，但没有方法直接以该AUC作为优化目标。此外，现有NEM框架只能产生特征集合的子集，无法对所有特征进行排序。因此需要一个原则性的方法来直接优化忠实性度量。
AI.method: 1. 理论建立：证明了在单调性假设下，优化插入曲线的AUC等价于对所有子集大小n的top-n特征选择。2. Monte Carlo近似：用随机采样子集大小近似AUC，并推导了样本复杂度边界（无需δ_Φ有界）。3. 可微近似：利用Gumbel top-k trick实现无需替换的有序采样，将top-k选择转化为可微操作。4. 算法实现：将上述损失函数与NEM-U架构（U-Net解码器）结合，形成Ra-NEM方法，采用三种扰动策略（零填充、噪声、高斯模糊）随机训练，k值在批次中随机采样。
AI.result: 在ImageNet（1000张验证图像）上评估了九种XAI方法与四种模型：Ra-NEM在平均忠实性上排名第一（0.494），在鲁棒性（Average Sensitivity 0.152）上也最佳，且推理速度最快（0.004秒）。在ResNet50、ConvNeXt和ViT三个模型上均获得最高忠实性，仅在VGG16上排名第五。Ra-NEM通过了MPRT随机化测试（得分0.051接近0），并在最小删除集指标上表现最优。统计检验（Wilcoxon秩和检验，p<0.001）证实了显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论上将插入/删除曲线的AUC优化与top-k特征选择联系起来，提出了首个直接优化该指标的XAI方法Ra-NEM。该方法兼具高忠实性、强鲁棒性和低延迟，适用于实时应用，且无需调整复杂度-准确性权衡的超参数。其二值掩码设计使其可扩展到文本、图等离散模态。

title: MUNITE: Unified Multimodal Latent Inference for Any-to-Any Multimodal Generation
summary: We introduce MUNITE, a latent-variable framework for flexible any-to-any multimodal generation that treats encoding and latent generation as the same inference problem under different amounts of observed evidence. Given any subset of modalities, MUNITE models the conditional distribution over the latent representation associated with the complete observation. Full observation recovers deterministic encoding, no observation recovers the latent marginal, and intermediate subsets define conditional latent inference, all within a single conditional flow model. A shared latent sample captures variation that must remain consistent across generated targets, while modality-specific generative decoders model the remaining uncertainty independently. To learn these conditional distributions from incomplete training examples, we extend conditional flow matching through self-distillation: predictions conditioned on richer available observations supervise the same model conditioned on smaller subsets at the same intermediate latent state. When the richer-evidence trajectory follows the exact conditional flow, this provides the same expected learning signal as full-target denoising. Across PolyMNIST-D-Q, FFHQ64, and image-text-audio, MUNITE achieves competitive or better generation quality and source-target alignment, with higher joint-generation coherence. In particular, it attains the highest coherence in all one-to-many and unconditional image-text-audio comparisons, showing the effectiveness of unified latent inference across diverse multimodal settings.

AI.tldr: MUNITE是一个统一的潜在变量框架，将多模态编码和潜在生成为同一推理问题，通过条件流匹配处理任意子集的观测模态，实现灵活的any-to-any多模态生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态生成模型通常将编码和生成视为独立组件，且许多依赖大型语言模型作为主干。本文旨在开发不依赖LLM的专业化any-to-any多模态生成模型，统一编码与生成过程，并解决部分观测数据下的训练问题。
AI.method: 1. 单一条件流模型ℰ，对任意观测子集S建模完整观测潜在表示的条件分布Q_ℰ(·|x^S)；2. 模态特定生成解码器，从共享潜在独立生成各模态；3. 自蒸馏扩展条件流匹配，利用丰富观测的预测监督较少观测的预测（基于Proposition 1的梯度等价性）；4. 目标解耦自重建防止目标私有信息泄漏到潜在空间；5. 辅助InfoNCE对比损失增强跨子集语义对齐。
AI.result: 在PolyMNIST-D-Q上，FFHQ（最低RGB FID 29.918，所有条件生成路径上的最高一致性）和图像-文本-音频基准测试（所有一对多和无条件生成的最高一致性）上，MUNITE在one-to-one/many-to-one任务上保持竞争力，同时在one-to-many和无条件co-generation上一致性显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: MUNITE将编码和any-to-any生成统一为完整观测潜在上的推理，自蒸馏使部分观测数据能直接学习条件分布。实验证明单一条件潜在推理模型可支持任意观测范围，提升联合一致性同时保持模态特定解码器的优势。未来方向是多模态世界建模，将紧凑潜在作为共享世界状态表征。

title: Layerwise Error Attribution for Fast and Robust Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization
summary: Mixed-precision post-training quantization is a network compression method that assigns bits layer by layer, under a global memory budget using a small calibration set. The main difficulties are to overcome the combinatorial nature of the allocation problem and to manage the sensitivity to small, potentially corrupted databases. Hence, an efficient allocation method should be fast to compute and preserve model quality when calibration data are corrupted. To design such a method, we derive a layerwise probabilistic analysis of the quantization error that separates propagated error from the local perturbation introduced at a given layer. We use this local term to build a separable score for a simple allocation algorithm, that requires no external solver. The probabilistic nature of our approach brings robustness to corrupted data. On denoising tasks with DRUNet, with an average budget of 4 bits per weight, our method matches or improves state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines under clean calibration, and is more robust to corrupted calibration, with PSNR gains of up to 7.5 dB under the tested corruptions. Experiments show bit-allocation speed-ups from 28x to 2,570x over the studied baselines. For quantized diffusion models, our experiments show that a direct application of our framework also improves the state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率分析的混合精度训练后量化(PTQ)位宽分配方法。该方法通过分层概率分析将量化误差分离为传播误差和局部扰动，并利用局部项构建可分离的分配分数，无需外部求解器即可实现快速分配，同时对损坏的校准数据具有鲁棒性。在去噪任务和扩散模型量化中，相比现有方法在速度和鲁棒性上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 1. 混合精度PTQ面临两大挑战：位宽分配的组合优化复杂性，以及对小规模（可能被损坏的）校准数据的敏感性。2. 现有方法依赖外部求解器且计算成本高，对损坏校准数据鲁棒性不足。3. 需要一种快速、鲁棒且无需外部求解器的位宽分配方法。
AI.method: 1. 对量化误差进行分层概率分析，分离传播误差与各层局部扰动。2. 基于局部扰动项构建可分离的层敏感度分数。3. 设计简单分配算法（无需外部优化求解器）根据分数在全局内存预算下逐层分配位宽。4. 利用概率框架本身对校准数据损坏提供鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1. 在DRUNet去噪任务上，平均4比特/权重预算下：干净校准时匹配或超越现有最佳基线；在损坏校准时PSNR增益最高达7.5 dB。2. 位宽分配速度比基线快28倍至2,570倍。3. 直接应用于扩散模型量化同样提升当前最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出的基于概率误差分析的混合精度PTQ方法在计算效率、分配质量和数据鲁棒性三方面均优于现有方法，为资源受限场景下的网络压缩提供了一种高效实用的解决方案，并可推广至扩散模型等其他任务。

title: Identifiability of a dissipative knowledge-dynamics model: exact recovery under designed excitation, degeneration on observational data
summary: Human learning is a dissipative dynamical process: mastery accumulates through practice, decays through forgetting, and propagates across interdependent concepts. We model it as a nonlinear dissipative system of ordinary differential equations whose parameters are mechanistically meaningful (a concept-transfer matrix encoding prerequisite coupling, per-concept forgetting rates, and a saturating practice-response gain), and we study when those parameters can actually be recovered from data. We prove a structural identifiability theorem for the associated inverse problem under explicit excitation conditions, with constructive closed-form recovery for the two-concept case, together with monotonicity, robustness and L-stability results. We derive a semi-implicit L-stable scheme for the dissipative subsystem and a batched solver numerically equivalent to the per-trajectory formulation (bit-exact predictions, gradients to $10^{-10}$) yet two orders of magnitude faster, making estimation feasible on cohorts of $10^5$ learners. The empirical study is two-sided. Under the theorem's excitation conditions, synthetic recovery is exact: parameters to machine precision, prerequisite structure at $F_1 = 1.0$. On large observational benchmarks it is not. An apparently strong recovery, with forgetting rates correlating with topic difficulty at Spearman $\rho = 0.83$, is refuted by four independent controls: it survives destroying the temporal order of the data, is matched by a classical Bayesian baseline, and is unaffected by removing real timestamps. We trace this to the stationary structure of the model and show that it is the degeneration the theorem predicts in the absence of designed excitation. The result delineates a sharp boundary between identifiable and unidentifiable regimes and yields a validation protocol for interpretability claims.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了人类学习的耗散动力学模型（一个非线性常微分方程组），其参数（先决关系转移矩阵、各概念的遗忘率、饱和练习响应增益）具有明确机理意义。作者证明了在特定"激励条件"（练习时间表包含休息间隔和每个概念的孤立、非常量练习块）下，参数具有结构可辨识性，并对两概念情形给出了构造性闭式恢复公式，同时建立了单调性、鲁棒性和L-稳定性结果。在合成数据上参数恢复到机器精度（F₁=1.0），但在大型观测性基准上恢复退化——看似强的恢复（遗忘率与主题难度Spearman ρ=0.83）被四个独立对照实验（时序打乱、经典BKT基线、真实时间、时间消融）所反驳，其根源是模型的稳态结构使Λ_j被迫吸收每主题的响应频率。论文划清了同一动力系统可辨识与不可辨识两种状态之间的清晰边界，并提出了验证参数可解释性主张的最小协议。
AI.motivation: 知识追踪领域广泛使用深度模型（DKT等），预测准确但学习者状态为不可解释的潜在向量；近年出现试图用机理模型（如带遗忘项的耗散ODE）替代黑箱的研究，但这些工作直接赋予参数以"遗忘率"等物理解释，却鲜有研究这些参数在何种条件下才是真正可辨识的。给一个参数起名为"遗忘率"并不能让它真正代表遗忘——这取决于参数是否被观测唯一确定，而这种可辨识性取决于系统在被观测时如何被激励。本文将该问题作为研究主题。
AI.method: 1. 模型：耗散ODE学习动力学，状态𝒌(t)∈[0,1]^K，由获取项Aϕ(p)⊙(1−𝒌)、耗散项−Λ⊙𝒌和可选随机项组成；转移矩阵A= D^{1/2}(Q_prior⊙B)D^{1/2}，B=softplus(UVᵀ)+diag(δ)以保证非负性；观测通过项目反应模型Pr(y=1|k)=σ(β(𝒌̄−1/2)−δ)。2. 理论：在激励条件(R)休息区间、(S1)(S2)每个概念的孤立非常量练习下，证明两概念情形的结构可辨识定理，给出闭式重建；建立Lipschitz（两种鲁棒性）线性误差界；导出半隐式L-stable格式及批量求解器（与逐轨迹解数值等价，加速约245倍）。3. 实验：合成数据上精确恢复；四个公开基准（ASSISTments-2009/2015/2017、Junyi-2015）上应用四个对照（C1打乱、C2 BKT基线、C3真实时间、C4时间消融）检验恢复。
AI.result: 合成数据：K=2时参数相对误差10⁻¹⁵（机器精度）；K=5时先决图恢复F₁=1.0，AUC=0.717（oracle上界0.9720）。基准：AUC低于DKT和BKT（预测精度非本文目标）。Junyi上恢复遗忘率与主题难度Spearman ρ=0.83±0.01，但C1显示打乱后仍ρ=0.829，C2显示BKT滑参数也可达ρ=0.795，C3显示与经验遗忘斜率相关仅0.49，C4显示时间移除不降低相关；结构恢复edge-AUC=0.570±0.026（接近随机）。结论：观测数据上的恢复退化为每主题答题频率的再均化，是定理预测的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 同一耗散系统在两种数据下呈现截然不同行为：满足激励条件时参数可精确恢复，不满足时（标准观测日志）恢复退化为再均化频率。规模不能替代观测设计。可解释性主张应配套至少打乱对照与基线对照两个最低验证协议。结构可辨识定理在实践中区分了同一系统的可辨识与不可辨识区域，将教育数据挖掘中反复出现的不稳定参数估计问题重新定位为实验设计问题。

title: NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression
summary: Lossless compression can reduce the storage and movement of model weights without changing their floating-point values, but repeated statistical analysis and code construction add computational overhead. We study whether the statistical structure of exponents can be prepared once and reused. For this, we introduce NeuralZip, which groups chunks with similar exponent distributions, shares Huffman codes, and selectively represents recurring exponent tuples using packed exponents, thereby achieving additional moderate compression ratios. A setup chooses these representations before subsequent encodings, while every encoding still processes the current tensor values. In floating-point model checkpoints, post-setup compression is 1.81-21.33$\times$ faster than the baselines and achieves exact bit-to-bit reconstruction. We show that this setup can be precomputed and transferred from another compatible architecture, preserving similar compression ratios and avoiding the need to amortize setup costs. Therefore, compression adaptation is transferable and reusable. Training checkpoints demonstrate continued reuse as the weights evolve. Finally, GPU experiments reduce active memory usage by up to 27.5$\%$ while reproducing the logits exactly.

AI.tldr: NeuralZip 是一种针对浮点模型权重的无损压缩方法，通过对具有相似指数分布的块进行分组、共享 Huffman 码以及对重复出现的指数元组进行打包表示，在压缩前一次性预计算并可复用其统计结构（setup），从而显著降低后续编码开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的无损压缩方法在每次压缩时都需要重复进行统计分析和 Huffman 码构造，计算开销大；论文旨在探索能否将指数的统计结构一次性准备并复用，从而提升训练检查点等场景下的压缩效率。
AI.method: 提出 NeuralZip 方法：1) 将权重张量分块，按指数分布相似度对块进行分组；2) 在组内共享 Huffman 码；3) 对重复出现的指数元组使用 packed exponents 选择性表示；4) 该统计结构（setup）可在压缩前预计算，并且可以从一个兼容架构迁移到另一个架构。
AI.result: 在浮点模型检查点上，post-setup 压缩速度比基线快 1.81–21.33 倍，且实现精确的 bit-to-bit 重建；setup 可在兼容架构间迁移并复用，保持相近压缩比；训练检查点中随权重演化仍可持续复用；GPU 实验中可将活跃内存使用减少高达 27.5%，同时精确复现 logits。
AI.conclusion: 压缩适配（adaptation）具有可迁移和可复用的特性，NeuralZip 通过一次性准备指数统计结构并跨架构/训练步骤复用，显著加速无损压缩，适用于模型存储、检查点保存及 GPU 内存节省等场景。

title: Eigenvalues of the Hessian in Deep Learning: The Origin of Symmetry and Its Breaking
summary: Hessian spectra at trained models in deep learning exhibit a persistent pattern: eigenvalues organize into distinct clusters, including a large bulk near zero and a few isolated outliers. This paper shows that a natural account of these spectral phenomena emerges when the original setting is understood as a departure from a nearby, otherwise hidden, highly symmetric reference. Modifications, including changes to the architecture, data distribution, or parameter metric, expose a nearby reference configuration whose Hessian exhibits rich invariances-ones not accounted for by weight symmetries. There, symmetry enables a precise description of the spectra, forcing high-dimensional kernels and eigenvalues of large multiplicity. Returning to the original configuration breaks the Hessian symmetry and thereby produces the observed hierarchy of clusters and outliers. The framework is developed in some generality, with a detailed analysis of three-layer ReLU networks and applications to convolutional, graph, and transformer models, as well as to the NTK. The same mechanism is further shown to yield analogous spectral structures in layerwise Hessians and the Gauss-Newton matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对称性及其破缺"作为深度学习Hessian谱结构（如零附近大块体和少量离群值）的统一解释框架。通过构建具有丰富不变性的对称参考配置（通过修改架构、数据分布或参数度量），利用结构对称性与分布对称性的复合作用推导Hessian不变性，并通过局部与非局部对称破缺机制将参考谱的简并分裂为观测到的聚类与离群值。
AI.motivation: 经验观察到的Hessian谱结构（零附近大块体+少量离群值）缺乏统一理论解释，现有方法（随机矩阵理论、Gauss-Newton分解、权重对称性）均存在显著缺陷：(1) 权重对称性在大多数训练点处平凡失效；(2) 无法解释精细谱聚类结构；(3) 局限于高维渐近假设；(4) 依赖样本量的秩论证不适用于大样本及期望损失情形。本文旨在填补这些理论空白。
AI.method: 核心方法论包括：(1) 复合对称性论证：将网络微分形式结构对称性与数据分布对称性结合，产生Hessian不变性；(2) 对称参考配置构造：通过缩减架构改变设置，暴露隐藏的丰富不变性群；(3) 表示论约束：利用正交群作用的同型分解强制特征值大重数；(4) 广义函数框架：处理ReLU网络非光滑性，识别Hessian中由激活界面贡献的奇异测度项；(5) 局部与非局部对称破缺：通过Cauchy交错定理和摄动理论控制简并分裂。详细分析三层ReLU网络，并应用于CNN、GNN、Transformer、NTK及无约束特征模型。
AI.result: 主要理论成果：(1) 在两层高斯混合上获得显式多重数结构（Θ(1)、Θ(k)、Θ(k²)阶），离群值数量与类别数匹配的机制；(2) 对学习问题2，证明Hessian核维度为Ω(h²)，与训练无关；(3) 在随机初始化下，证明平均Hessian在B子空间有界λ_B ≤ O(1/h)，从而以高概率产生零附近块体；(4) 对AlexNet完成D₄等型分解，给出参数商上谱的渐近结构（Θ(1)、Θ(d²)、Θ(d⁴)三尺度）；(5) 提出"神经配准"现象解释训练网络中隐藏特征-标签律涌现的近似对称性。所有结果均通过数值实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 对称性及其破缺为深度学习Hessian谱结构提供了统一解释原则。框架成功解释了：(1) 大Hessian核（轨道方向贡献O(h)，横向方向贡献Ω(h²)）；(2) 类别数与离群值数量的标度关系；(3) 不同架构和数据集下谱结构的普遍性；(4) 层wise谱与Gauss-Newton矩阵的类似结构。理论框架还自然延伸到优化（守恒律、梯度下降低维子空间现象）、等变网络和神经塌缩等现象。详细扩展在准备中的独立出版物中给出。

title: Expected Sample Complexity in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: Sample complexity is a widely used metric in sequential decision-making problems, defined as the number of suboptimal decisions during the interaction between the agent and an environment. We study the sample complexity of stochastic multi-armed bandit problems and introduce the expected sample complexity performance measure, analyzing it in a novel framework called approximately correct in expectation (ACE). We show that ACE guarantees imply almost sure convergence to the optimal expected reward, in contrast to high-probability guarantees found in other frameworks, and also show how to convert ACE guarantees into explicit expected regret bounds. We further show that, in contrast to existing measures, deterministic algorithms cannot obtain favorable ACE bounds, and analyze stochastic algorithms in two settings: when the allowed suboptimality level $\epsilon$ is known to the algorithm and when it is unknown. In the former, we devise an explore-then-$\epsilon$-greedy algorithm, and in the latter, we analyze the expected sample complexity of Thompson sampling. Finally, we establish nearly matching lower bounds for both settings, showing that the algorithms are tight in $\epsilon$ and proving a performance separation between the two regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机多臂老虎机问题中的期望样本复杂度，提出了一种名为"近似正确期望"（ACE）的新型分析框架。该框架通过分析策略本身（而非实际执行的动作）来衡量无限时间范围内的期望次优轮数。主要贡献包括：证明了U-ACE保证意味着几乎处处收敛到最优期望奖励；将ACE保证转化为显式期望遗憾界；证明确定性算法无法获得有利的ACE界；分别在已知和未知次优水平ε两种情况下分析了随机算法（前者使用SETε-G算法，后者使用Thompson采样）；建立了两种情况下的近乎匹配的下界，证明了算法在ε上是紧的，并展示了这两种设定之间的性能分离。
AI.motivation: 现有的样本复杂度分析框架（如PAC、U-PAC和ULI）存在两个主要缺陷：(1) 算法针对特定的次优水平ε定制，导致对更小的ε可能产生次优性能甚至无穷样本复杂度；(2) 以恒定概率δ的失败保证意味着灾难性失败（无穷次优轮数）可能以恒定概率发生。本文旨在通过引入ACE框架同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 本文引入"期望样本复杂度"度量，定义为无限时间范围内策略次优轮数的期望值，并提出了ACE框架。通过定义ε-ACE和U-ACE来形式化这一框架。证明了：(1) ACE保证蕴含策略间隙的几乎处处有界性（通过Borel-Cantelli引理）；(2) U-ACE保证蕴含次线性期望遗憾界；(3) 确定性策略在伯努利老虎机上无法实现U-ACE。对于非均匀设定（已知ε），设计了SETε-G算法（结合逐次消除和ε-贪心）；对于均匀设定（未知ε），分析了Thompson采样的期望样本复杂度。技术关键点包括：使用策略间隙而非实现间隙来定义样本复杂度；为Thompson采样的无限时间分析设计了与最优臂数量无关的事件。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 理论性质：Proposition 1证明ε-ACE蕴含limsup策略间隙≤ε几乎处处成立；Corollary 1证明U-ACE蕴含策略间隙几乎处处收敛到0；Claim 2建立U-ACE界与期望遗憾界之间的转化关系；Claim 3证明确定性算法不能对所有伯努利老虎机实例实现U-ACE。(2) 上界：Theorem 1证明SETε-G算法的期望样本复杂度为O(∑(Δa>3ε/4) 1/Δa² · ln(K/ε²))；Theorem 2证明Thompson采样（N）的期望样本复杂度为O(K/ε · ∑(Δa≥ε/K) 1/Δa · ln(3KΔa/ε))，与实例无关的界为O(K³/ε²)。(3) 下界：Proposition 2证明非均匀设定的下界为Ω(K/max{δ,ε}²)；Proposition 3证明一致的U-ACE算法有limsup ε·E[Nε] ≥ ∑3/(8Δa)；Proposition 4证明U-ACE算法有limsup ε^α·E[Nε] = ∞对任意α∈(0,1)，展示了已知ε和未知ε设定之间的基本分离。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功引入了期望样本复杂度和ACE框架作为分析随机多臂老虎机的有力工具。U-ACE保证比现有PAC框架提供了更强的理论保证（包括几乎处处收敛和次线性期望遗憾）。研究表明确定性算法不足以实现U-ACE，必须使用随机算法。此外，本文首次在样本复杂度文献中证明了已知ε和未知ε两种设定之间的性能分离。未来的工作方向包括将期望样本复杂度扩展到表格强化学习和线性老虎机等更一般的序贯决策问题中。

title: Learning Traffic Flow Dynamics with Stochastic Physics-Informed Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Traffic flow modeling is essential for understanding and predicting the collective dynamics of vehicles on road networks. Cellular automata provide a simple, interpretable yet powerful framework for representing these dynamics via local interaction rules, while retaining the ability to reproduce complex macroscopic traffic phenomena. However, learning local transition rules from data while preserving physically meaningful constraints remains challenging, particularly for stochastic models. In this work, we propose a physics-informed neural cellular automaton (PI-NCA) for data-driven traffic flow modeling. Building on the standard neural cellular automaton (NCA), we design a neural architecture that is physically consistent with the road topology and guarantees conservation of the total number of vehicles, thereby constraining the learned transition rules to physically admissible dynamics. We further extend this framework to stochastic dynamics by parameterizing probabilistic transition rules while preserving the same physics-informed constraints. We evaluate the proposed models on multiple traffic scenarios generated by the well-established Nagel-Schreckenberg and Kerner-Klenov-Wolf cellular automata. The results demonstrate that the PI-NCA successfully learns the dynamics of both traffic models and consistently outperforms a standard NCA, while the stochastic extension captures probabilistic transition rules without compromising the imposed physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理信息神经网络元胞自动机（PI-NCA），通过一维CNN学习交通流的局部转移规则。PI-NCA预测车辆速度并通过显式位移更新保证车辆守恒，并扩展为随机版本以捕捉概率性转移规则。在Nagel-Schreckenberg和Kerner-Klenov-Wolf交通CA上的实验表明，PI-NCA在预测精度、车辆守恒和泛化能力上均优于标准NCA，并能再现基本图特征。
AI.motivation: 从数据中学习交通流的局部转移规则同时保持物理可解释性约束（如车辆守恒）是一个核心挑战，尤其对于随机模型。现有数据驱动方法（LSTM、CNN、GNN）虽能预测交通流，但要么直接做黑箱预测，要么只学习CA的局部组件，鲜有工作直接从状态轨迹中学习完整的局部转移规则并用于自主回归模拟。此外，已有CA与神经网络结合的工作主要用CA生成数据训练预测/分类模型，而非学习规则本身。
AI.method: 提出三种基于一维CNN的NCA变体：1）NCA：直接预测下一时刻完整交通状态；2）PI-NCA：预测被占用格点的速度，通过显式位移操作（M算子）构建下一状态，保证车辆数守恒，使用掩码MSE训练；3）随机PI-NCA：将速度输出替换为对 v_max+1 个速度类别的logits，经Softmax得到类别分布，使用分类交叉熵训练，推理时从分布中采样速度并执行相同显式位移。架构首层使用尺寸为 2v_max+1 的圆形卷积核提取局部特征，后续层为逐点卷积（核大小1），采用ReLU激活与循环边界条件。在KKW-1上增大卷积核以适应更复杂的同步交互。
AI.result: 在NaSch数据集上，PI-NCA的MAE（0.00006±0.00011）和守恒误差（0.00018±0.00040）均显著低于NCA（MAE=0.0022, CE=0.0071）；在更复杂的KKW-1上优势更明显，PI-NCA的MAE=0.0179 vs NCA=0.1949，且PI-NCA的守恒误差接近零。在道路长度（L=50,150）和车辆数（N=8,12,17）的分布外泛化测试中，PI-NCA均保持高精度和零守恒误差。随机PI-NCA能准确捕捉NaSch的速度类别分布（不同p下TV距离均较小），并在局部和全局基本图上重现参考模型的自由流-拥堵转变、初始条件依赖性等特征。全局流量曲线相对误差：NaSch约1.45-1.61%，KKW-1约4.70-5.16%。
AI.conclusion: PI-NCA通过将速度预测与显式位移更新解耦，引入物理归纳偏置，在交通流建模中比直接状态预测的NCA更准确、更鲁棒，且天然保证车辆守恒。该框架可扩展至随机动力学，在保持物理约束的同时学习概率性转移规则。未来工作应扩展到更高/连续速度、开边界、多车道和异质交通等更真实场景。

title: Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens
summary: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究深度诱导的秩崩溃（depth-induced rank collapse）能否通过在损失函数中添加额外项来修复。作者通过弱化跳跃连接使小型 Transformer 发生崩溃，然后测试了不同损失项的修复效果。结果显示：尽管具有"有界修正力"的损失项（如 hinge 损失）施加了约为任务梯度十分之一的力，但没有任何附加损失项能修复崩溃。原因是梯度无法通过反向传播到达需要改变的权重（query 和 key 权重）。仅通过恢复跳跃连接（不改变任何权重）即可重新打开梯度路径，使秩得以恢复，但需要在远高于崩溃起始点的尺度上才有效。论文区分了"力"（梯度的大小）和"传输"（梯度实际到达权重的能力）两个概念。
AI.motivation: 动机源于一个实际问题：Transformer 训练中可能发生秩崩溃（所有 token 表示指向同一方向，学习停滞）。现有防御措施主要作用于架构或优化器层面的预先修改。当崩溃已经发生且架构固定时，最经济的干预手段是在损失函数中增加额外项。然而，对于注意力熵崩溃，已有研究表明具有有界力的损失项可以修复；但对于秩崩溃，答案并不明确。本文旨在系统地测试损失项能否修复已建立的秩崩溃，并探究决定修复成败的关键因素。
AI.method: 1. **崩溃产生方法**：训练小型语言模型（深度 12 和 24，约 9-11M 参数），将跳跃连接的缩放因子 α 从 1 线性衰减到 0.02（步骤 1500-3000），驱动网络进入秩崩溃状态。当最后一块的稳定秩低于 1.5 时判定为崩溃。2. **两种损失项对比**：设计了仅在力是否消失上有区别的两个损失项——惩罚项（pen，力在崩溃时消失）和铰链项（hinge，力保持有界大小约 1/σ₁）。3. **块级梯度测量**：在保存的崩溃网络上逐块测量任务梯度和附加梯度到达注意力权重的程度。4. **预注册测试**：在主实验运行前将预测和评估脚本提交到代码库，对路径测量作为恢复预测因子的能力进行两次注册测试。5. **多种处理方式**：包括惩罚项（1× 和 4×）、铰链项（1× 和 4×）、余弦项、未处理对照、反向斜坡（恢复跳跃连接）等。
AI.result: **主要结果**：1. 无附加损失项能修复崩溃（惩罚项 0/8、铰链项 0/8、4× 惩罚项 0/8、4× 铰链项 0/8、余弦项 0/8）。2. 力的大小并非问题：铰链项的力约为任务梯度的 0.0887（4× 时为 0.3071），约比惩罚项大 28 倍。3. 梯度传输失败：任务梯度在崩溃网络中从输出端附近的 5×10⁻³ 衰减到输入端附近的 2×10⁻¹¹，query 和 key 权重几乎接收不到梯度。4. 恢复跳跃连接成功恢复秩（8/8），但仅在 α 远高于崩溃起始值时（深度 12 在 0.25-0.97，深度 24 在 1.00）。5. 存在磁滞现象：相同处理在不同时间施加，恢复效果不同（深度 24 延迟分支无一恢复）。6. 注册测试：路径测量在新网络上能排名恢复时间（Spearman -0.67），但阈值不能跨崩溃原因转移（学习率爆发情况下）。7. 秩的恢复不等于功能恢复：所有恢复的网络损失仍高于健康网络 0.21-1.04 nats。
AI.conclusion: 结论明确：**已崩溃的网络能否被修复取决于梯度是否仍能到达必须改变的权重，而非损失项施加的力有多大**。对于秩崩溃而言，决定性约束是梯度传输而非力的大小。本文引入并区分了两个关键概念——"力"（梯度的大小）和"传输/路径"（梯度到达权重的程度）——并通过实验证明在秩崩溃中后者才是限制因素。实践意义在于：任何添加到损失的项都通过反向传播作用于权重；如果该路径不通，再大的力也无济于事。论文还指出，仅靠秩的恢复不能保证功能的恢复，损失仍可能高于健康网络，因此应通过继续训练并测量损失来判断真正的恢复。

title: TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TR-PTQ提出了一种统一的纯整数Transformer训练后量化框架，基于Taylor Region (TR)指数和对数原语，将SoftMax、GELU和LayerNorm中的除法、平方根等运算完全在log域中通过整数算术实现，无需浮点硬件回退。配合针对LayerNorm尺度参数γ的免校准离群感知优化，在视觉和语言基准测试中实现了低于1.5%的绝对精度下降。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer后训练量化方法将精度损失归因于非线性层数值精度不足，通常需要浮点回退、复杂校准或混合精度。作者挑战这一假设，揭示精度退化源于特定的结构性误差源：归一化层中学习到的尺度参数γ的重尾分布问题，以及GELU中的近似叠加效应。SoftMax实际上对激进量化具有固有鲁棒性。这促使作者设计一种无需浮点硬件、免校准的统一整数方案。
AI.method: 方法核心包括三个部分：(1) TR-exp：基于Taylor级数的整数指数近似，将输入拆分为符号位、评估点(evp)和残差(frac)字段，通过小型LUT和低阶Taylor展开在整数域实现exp运算；(2) TR-ln：基于分段线性近似的整数对数运算，利用前导1位确定区间，通过移位加操作实现乘法，避免了完整乘法器需求；(3) 统一应用TR原语实现TR-SoftMax（通过S⁻¹=exp(-lnS)在log域完成归一化）、TR-GELU（区域依赖的α参数化，替代全局标量因子）和TR-Norm（将1/√(σ²+ε)转化为exp(-½·ln(σ²+ε))）。此外，提出针对γ参数的方差归一化RMSE目标的轻量级线搜索优化，解决重尾分布下的量化退化问题。量化配置为：线性层8-bit，SoftMax/GELU 8-bit，LayerNorm 12-bit。
AI.result: 在DeiT-T/S/B和Swin-T/S/B等Vision Transformer上，TR-PTQ在ImageNet-1k上的Top-1精度下降控制在0.40-0.82个百分点（中位数0.52），优于FQ-ViT、SOLE、QUARK和Zhang等人方法。在GLUE基准测试中，相比FP32基线，精度下降通常保持在2-3%以内。消融研究表明：(1) SoftMax对量化噪声天然鲁棒，精度退化主要源于max减法步骤而非指数近似本身；(2) GELU采用分段α参数化相比全局α=1.702可恢复约1%的精度；(3) γ参数优化是关键步骤——未经优化的4-bit LayerNorm会导致灾难性精度崩溃（如CoLA从53.38%降至2.95%），而经优化后恢复至53.18%。TR-Div相比SOLE等移位除法方案在多个数值范围内表现出更低的除法噪声。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明Transformer关键非线性组件可通过逐张量量化在低比特精度下高效实现，同时保持高准确率。核心洞见是精度退化由少量敏感操作驱动，而非整体数值精度不足。Taylor Region框架提供了一种硬件友好的统一整数实现路径，将除法、平方根和指数运算简化为移位和加法。选择性精度分配策略为高效低精度推理提供了重要设计指导。

title: A Drosophila Whole-Connectome Network Can Learn Human-Designed Cognitive Tasks
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Can a biological wiring diagram serve as a useful computational substrate beyond the behaviors for which it evolved? We use the publicly released MaleCNS v1.0 connectome, reconstructed from a single adult male Drosophila specimen, as the fixed recurrent topology of an artificial network. We train separate models for bounded addition and for a controlled grounded relational language task built from a fixed 100-word lexicon. In both models, one scalar is learned per anatomical edge. The anatomical graph reaches 92.77% mean accuracy on held-out addition, compared with 67.93% for directed degree-preserving rewires. On the strict paired language endpoint, which matches original and order-reversed scenes to their corresponding descriptions, it reaches 61.59% across four fixed interfaces, compared with 44.17% for matched rewires. At the canonical interface, it ranks first in a fixed 21-graph comparison. On the matched 48-group intervention subset, shuffling task-defined sensory features reduces its score from 60.94% to 19.27%. Together, these results show that higher-order MaleCNS wiring provides a reusable inductive bias for bounded addition and grounded relational language.

AI.tldr: 该研究将果蝇雄性中枢神经系统（MaleCNS v1.0）的完整连接组作为循环神经网络的固定拓扑结构，通过仅学习每条解剖边上的标量权重，在有界加法和受控的接地关系语言两项人造认知任务上进行训练。结果显示，解剖图在两项任务上均显著优于保度随机重连控制，表明高阶MaleCNS布线可作为可复用的归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 神经科学已获得接近完整规模的突触级连接组（如成年果蝇脑及雄性CNS），但其作为人工网络计算架构的价值尚未明确。已有研究在生物任务预测上结论不一，且关于拓扑本身（而非权重）是否提供有用结构信息存在争议。本文旨在探究：一个生物布线图，在重新学习连接强度后，是否能服务于超出其进化用途的认知任务，并检验其优势是否在严格控制下依然稳健。
AI.method: 使用MaleCNS v1.0连接组（166,700个神经元，25,582,938条有向边，1.24亿突触接触）作为稀疏循环掩码，仅优化每条边上的标量权重θ。循环更新采用漏积分形式，权重按入度归一化。控制组通过定向双边交换生成保度（保入度和出度）随机重连图。在两项任务上分别拟合独立模型：(1) 有界加法任务（a+b≤100，47通道编码，64步循环），采用交叉熵加有序CDF损失；(2) 受控接地关系语言任务（100词词库，128维正交编码，24个感觉通道对应腿部传入神经元），采用严格配对评估端点（原始场景与逆序场景均需正确匹配其对应描述，机会基线1/6）。
AI.result: 有界加法：解剖图在4次优化运行中平均测试准确率92.77%，8次重连控制为67.93%，差异24.84个百分点；进位子集（和<100）解剖图为92.96%，重连为69.09%。接地关系语言：跨4个输入输出接口，解剖图严格配对得分61.59%，4个匹配重连为44.17%，差异17.42个百分点（95%交叉自举区间[11.39, 24.90]pp）；在标准接口I1的21图比较中，解剖图以71.35%排名第一（20个重连均值46.56%，SD 6.99pp），有限总体秩分数为1/21。感觉特征洗牌将解剖图得分从60.94%降至19.27%。配对保留反事实评估中，解剖图在强度和持续时间维度上显著优于控制，速度下参数匹配。参数匹配密集控制仅获8.72%。无感觉控制得0%。
AI.conclusion: MaleCNS v1.0连接组的高阶结构为有界加法和接地关系语言提供了可复用的归纳偏置，且该优势在控制接口位置、图采样和优化运行后依然稳健。优势不能仅由定向度或可达性解释，因为重连保留了巨大强连通核心和令牌到输出的最短距离，但显著降低了互惠性和感觉到输出路径长度。感觉信息的对应关系对语言性能至关重要。这为将连接组视为架构先验提供了证据，并激励进一步分离具体贡献高阶结构属性的研究。

title: Oscillatory Neural Dynamics over Sheaves
summary: Effective long-range propagation remains a central challenge in graph neural networks, as increasing a model's propagation depth does not guarantee that distant nodes effectively influence each other. Sheaf neural networks enrich graph propagation through matrix-valued transport between stalks; still, this expressivity alone does not automatically imply effective long-range communication. We introduce ONDA, a long-range graph learning framework based on operator-valued information waves. Stalk-valued representations evolve through second-order dynamics governed by learned sheaf transport operators, combining wave-like propagation with expressive local geometry. We characterize long-range influence through a stalk-wise sensitivity analysis and show that the cross-influence never vanishes. Across long-range propagation, severe graph bottlenecks, graph transfer, and heterophilic benchmarks, ONDA consistently improves over scalar wave propagation, diffusive sheaf baselines, and state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the benefit of coupling wave dynamics with matrix-valued transport.

AI.tldr: ONDA是一个基于二阶振荡动力学的图神经网络框架，将波动传播与细胞丛（cellular sheaf）上的矩阵值传输相结合，实现有效的长程信息传播。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络中远距离节点间有效通信是一个核心挑战。现有方法存在过平滑、过压缩等问题；细胞丛神经网络虽能提供更丰富的局部传输，但本身无法保证长程通信的有效性。论文旨在将波动力学引入丛神经网络，同时解决长程传播和丰富局部几何传输两大问题。
AI.method: ONDA将节点特征建模为丛上stalk值的表示，通过二阶微分方程X¨(t) = -L_F (I⊗W_1) X(t) W_2 - R_θ(X)⊙X˙(t) + F_θ(X(t))进行演化。其中L_F为学习到的丛拉普拉斯算子，R_θ和F_θ分别为状态依赖的耗散项和外部驱动力。通过有限差分进行离散化，并堆叠多个传播块（含MLP变换）。提出了stalk-wise敏感性分析框架，通过余弦算子C_F(t)和正弦算子S_F(t)给出闭式解。
AI.result: 在ECHO长程传播基准测试中，ONDA在SSSP和eccentricity任务上达到最低MAE（0.085和0.885）。在Barbell瓶颈测试中，ONDA在N=10和N=20时几乎完美解决任务，且是N=50时唯一达到求解标准的方法。在Graph Transfer任务中，ONDA在几乎所有距离上均获得最低MSE。在异亲性基准测试中平均排名第三。理论证明：对于自伴半正定丛拉普拉斯，源到目标响应在ℓ→∞时不会趋于零。
AI.conclusion: ONDA通过耦合波动力学与矩阵值丛传输，有效解决了图神经网络中的长程传播问题。理论分析证明了节点间影响永不消失的特性，在长程传播、严重瓶颈、图迁移和异亲性基准测试上一致优于标量波传播、扩散性丛基线和当前最优模型，同时保持了与局部消息传递架构兼容的稀疏线性图规模扩展性。

title: Matching of signal, noise and hardware timescales for filtering and forecasting of correlated noise signals
summary: Physical reservoir computing exploits the nonlinear dynamics of physical systems to process time-dependent data with greater energy efficiency than conventional machine learning approaches. However, physical reservoirs have fixed intrinsic response timescales, whereas real-world signals combine deterministic and stochastic components across multiple timescales. Here we show, using a nanoporous niobium oxide reservoir, synthetic noisy signals and cryptocurrency-price volatility, that the relationship among noise correlation time, reservoir memory and forecast horizon determines whether correlated noise is filtered or predicted. Noise varying faster than the relevant reservoir memory and forecast horizon is averaged by the reservoir, whereas the temporal structure of slower-varying noise is sufficient for algorithmic forecasting. We introduce the reservoir memory horizon and forecasting regime index to distinguish these operating regimes. These contributions demonstrate that timescale matching can guide the encoding of input time series and development of physical reservoir architectures that filter, analyse and predict stochastic signal components across distinct temporal scales.

AI.tldr: 本文利用纳米孔氧化铌（Nb₂O₅）物理储层计算系统，研究了噪声在不同时间尺度下对物理储层预测性能的影响，提出了"储层记忆视野"和"预测机制指数"来区分滤波与预测两种工作模式。
AI.motivation: 物理储层计算（physical reservoir computing）虽然具有能效优势，但其固有的响应时间尺度固定，难以处理现实世界中跨多时间尺度的随机信号（噪声）。研究者希望理解噪声特性与储层记忆之间的关系，以指导针对不同时间尺度随机信号的处理与预测。
AI.method: 采用纳米孔氧化铌作为物理储层，结合合成含噪信号和加密货币价格波动数据进行实验分析。通过引入两个关键指标：储层记忆视野（reservoir memory horizon）和预测机制指数（forecasting regime index），来定量刻画噪声相关时间、储层记忆与预测视野之间的匹配关系。
AI.result: 研究表明：1）变化快于储层记忆和预测视野的噪声会被储层平均化（滤波）；2）慢变噪声的时间结构可被算法化预测。储层记忆视野和预测机制指数能有效区分这两种工作状态。
AI.conclusion: 时间尺度匹配（timescale matching）原则可指导输入时间序列的编码方式以及物理储层架构的设计，使其能够对不同时间尺度的随机信号分量进行滤波、分析与预测。

title: WxFM-XL: Adapting Univariate Foundation Models to Multi-Station Weather Forecasting
summary: With the rise of univariate time series foundation models (e.g., Sundial, Timer), initial efforts have been made to extend them to multivariate settings. However, these models mainly focus on modeling correlations among variables. When they are applied to multi-station weather forecasting, two important factors are often overlooked: (1) the spatial information of stations, and (2) different error priors of different stations relative to the foundation model. In this paper, we propose WxFM-XL, a model for adapting univariate time series foundation models to multi-station weather forecasting. WxFM-XL introduces a cross-station error correlation prior graph to capture stationwise error priors with respect to the foundation model. Building on this, we further propose a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively integrates a spatial correlation graph with the error correlation prior graph. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms state of the art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WxFM-XL框架，通过引入跨站点误差相关性先验图和动态融合机制，将单变量时间序列基础模型（如Timer、Sundial）适配到多站点天气预报任务中，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有单变量时间序列基础模型（如Timer、Sundial）在多站点天气预报中存在两个关键局限：(1) 将各站点视为变量而忽略了站点的空间地理信息；(2) 未建模不同站点相对于基础模型的不同误差先验，导致通用的多元扩展方法（如AdaPTS、Timer-XL）难以捕捉站点间的非局部误差依赖。
AI.method: WxFM-XL包含两个核心组件：(1) 动态融合机制——通过频域分解（DFT/IDFT）将基础模型预测分解为低/中/高频分量，为每个频段构建基于Pearson相关的误差相关先验图，再与基于高斯核的静态空间相关图通过可学习门控系数α融合；(2) 图残差适配器——采用多尺度时间patch嵌入（patch尺寸{6,12,24}）、基于融合图的图归一化与传播、Time Attention+MLP的时序精炼，以及可学习的尺度权重和频段因子β生成残差修正。训练时冻结基础模型参数，使用MSE损失与频段能量归一化RMSE的组合优化目标。
AI.result: 在湖南（3,570站）、法国（234站）和全球（3,850站）三个数据集上，WxFM-XL在16个数据集-变量-预测时长设置中均达到最佳MSE（Timer变体9项最优，Sundial变体7项最优）。在法国风速预测4项设置中，WxFM-XL比最强任务特定基线MSE降低8.3%–12.6%。消融实验验证了频域分解、误差相关先验图、多尺度时序模块的各自贡献。可视化分析显示误差图与空间图的结构相关性从低频0.60降至高频0.24，证明频段相关的动态融合设计合理。复杂度分析表明在线计算和激活内存均关于站点数N线性增长，可扩展至数千站点。
AI.conclusion: WxFM-XL通过频段感知的误差先验与静态空间关系的动态融合，有效将单变量基础模型适配到多站点天气预报，在区域和全球数据集上均一致优于现有基线。复杂度随站点数线性增长，适用于大规模部署。未来工作将进一步引入气象变量间的依赖关系以实现联合多元与多站点预测。

title: Efficient Provably Private Classification with a Tabular Foundation Model
summary: Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces dataset fitting time by 10,000 times, requiring only a single forward pass. By combining formal privacy, speed, and easy of use, PrivTab brings recent advances in AI to applications where sensitive individual-level data have limited their adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrivTab，一种将差分隐私机制内嵌于架构的表格基础模型，通过上下文学习将有敏感性的行压缩为可证明隐私的紧凑摘要，实现在中强隐私下的高准确性、极低的成员推断泄露、以及拟合速度提升约10,000倍的差分隐私分类。
AI.motivation: 敏感表格数据的分类需要在保护个体隐私的同时保持预测效用。传统差分隐私学习方法需要针对每个数据集进行缓慢的私有化训练，在强隐私下效用损失大且易出错；现有表格基础模型虽支持快速适配，但缺乏形式化隐私保证且易受成员推断攻击。
AI.method: PrivTab在模型架构中嵌入差分隐私多头交叉注意力机制（DP-MHCA），通过tanh有界激活函数和校准的高斯噪声生成紧凑的私有摘要。其核心是基于潜瓶颈注意力神经过程（LBANP）的Perceiver式架构，包含128个可学习伪token、3层DP-MHCA和2层后处理自注意力。在模拟任务上进行噪声感知预训练，使模型学会在隐私噪声下预测，并通过Lean 4形式化验证敏感度界限。
AI.result: 在33个TabArena数据集上的6个隐私水平评估显示，PrivTab在中强隐私（μ<0.6）下优于差分隐私逻辑回归（DP-LR）和差分隐私多层感知机（DP-MLP）；拟合时间约10毫秒，比基线快约10,000倍；成员推断泄露接近完美隐私（50%），而非私有TabPFN v3和TabICL v2接近100%。在私有预处理案例研究中，PrivTab在ELO评分中达到1161.5，优于DP-MLP（1117.5）和DP-LR（1000）。
AI.conclusion: PrivTab证明了可以在基础模型架构中原生构建形式化、可审计的差分隐私保护，而非在每个下游训练流程中事后添加隐私机制。通过结合形式化隐私、计算效率和易用性，PrivTab为敏感表格数据场景提供了实用的人工智能解决方案。

title: Multi-Agent Coordination via Support-Preserving Distillation
summary: Offline MARL increasingly relies on generative policies to model multimodal joint behavior, typically by distilling a centralized teacher into decentralized one-step actors under the CTDE. We identify a failure mode at the teacher training stage: standard flow-based teachers pair noise with replay targets independently, so nearby noise samples can be routed toward conflicting coordination modes. The teacher then produces samples between valid modes, and because the distillation loss regresses each local actor onto the conditional mean of the teacher's output given local input, this error is not absorbed but propagated to the student. To remove this teacher-side artifact, we propose Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT), which summarizes multimodal replay into a finite mode support with prescribed capacities and uses conditional semi-discrete optimal transport to assign each noise sample to a single mode before teacher training. We additionally study a shared-randomness variant that uses a shared noise component at execution to expose the residual gap intrinsic to strict-product execution. On controlled diagnostics and offline MARL benchmarks, MoSDOT improves endpoint quality and routing consistency, particularly on datasets exhibiting multimodal joint behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoSDOT方法，通过半离散最优传输在教师训练阶段将噪声空间按模式支持对齐，解决离线多智能体强化学习中集中式flow教师独立配对噪声-目标导致的路由伪影问题，并分析严格乘积执行的残差间隙。
AI.motivation: 在离线多智能体强化学习(CTDE框架)中，常用集中式flow教师蒸馏为去中心化单步执行器。但标准flow教师在多模态数据上独立配对噪声与回放目标，使邻近噪声被路由到冲突的协调模式，产生支持外"扇形"质量；由于ℓ₂蒸馏损失将局部执行器回归至教师输出的条件均值，此教师侧错误不会被吸收而是传播给学生。
AI.method: 提出MoSDOT(Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport)：将多模态回放汇总为有限模式支持(每个模式带预设容量)，通过条件半离散最优传输将噪声空间划分为与各模式容量匹配的Laguerre单元，使每个噪声样本在教师训练前被分配到单一模式。还研究共享随机变体，使用执行时共享信号关联局部噪声，以暴露严格乘积执行的内在间隙。
AI.result: 在控制诊断(landmark、XOR)上，MoSDOT显著改善端点质量与路由一致性(端点有效性95.0%→91.7%经蒸馏后保留，IMLE则从97.3%崩溃至47.1%)，且不引入跨噪声依赖。在SMACv1/v2离散动作基准上达到最优平均回报(16.7)，在MPE Simple Spread连续动作基准上平均82.6(优于MAC-Flow的65.8)，在多模态数据集上优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: MoSDOT通过在教师训练阶段上游对齐源噪声与模式支持，分离了教师侧路由伪影与严格乘积执行的残差间隙。核心局限是严格乘积约束本身——独立局部采样无法表示任意相关联合支持，共享随机变体虽能闭合间隙却需公共协调通道。未来方向包括：量化残差间隙、将模式支持路由扩展到长视野与价值重加权设置、以及研究共享执行信号的可接受性条件。

title: CAFE+FNO: Fourier Kernel Generation via Multiplicative Feature Composition
summary: The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs) through Fourier-space kernel parameterization, but frequency truncation can limit the learning of high-frequency variations. AM-FNO and SirenFNO generate kernels for all grid modes from spectral coordinates using shared networks, making coordinate encoding and generator design important. Recent work on implicit neural representations (INRs) has proposed constructing frequency interactions through explicit feature composition rather than relying on subsequent MLPs to form them implicitly. Building on this approach, we propose CAFE+FNO, which incorporates Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) into Fourier kernel generation. CAFE+ combines Fourier--Chebyshev features through parallel affine branches and a Hadamard product, forming interactions within and across the two feature families. A kernel MLP maps the resulting representation of each normalized spectral coordinate to a complex channel-mixing matrix. Each layer shares its generator across all stored modes, making the number of trainable parameters independent of the number of modes for a fixed architecture. We compare CAFE+FNO with existing FNO variants on five PDE benchmarks and conduct ablation studies on basis configuration, multiplicative composition, and bandwidth learnability. Code and experimental configurations are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CAFE+FNO提出在傅里叶核生成中引入CAFE+乘性特征组合,将Fourier与Chebyshev特征通过并行仿射分支与Hadamard积融合,生成全频谱模式核。在5个PDE基准测试中4个取得最优,相对SirenFNO误差降低18.4–60.2%。
AI.motivation: 标准FNO因频率截断限制了高频学习;AM-FNO和SirenFNO通过共享网络从谱坐标生成全频核,但其编码与生成器设计影响性能。INR研究表明显式特征组合比依赖后续MLP隐式形成频率交互更有效,因此本文将显式乘性特征组合引入傅里叶核生成。
AI.method: 核心方法CAFE+FNO:(1)对归一化谱坐标ξ_k,通过固定高斯矩阵G_l生成随机傅里叶特征RFF,频带由ρ_l控制;(2)沿各坐标轴计算n个Chebyshev基函数T_j;(3)将RFF与Chebyshev特征拼接,送入N_b个并行仿射分支,经Hadamard积形成z_l(ξ_k),从而在编码阶段显式构造频率和差ω_i±ω_j与Chebyshev乘积项;(4)实值MLP f_l将z_l映射为2d_v²维向量,拆分重塑为d_v×d_v复值通道混合核R̃_l(k),并施加Hermitian投影;(5)谱卷积为v̂(k)←R̃_l(k)·v̂(k),后接残差+FFN。推导表明Hadamard积通过积化和差恒等式生成新基频(ω_i+ω_j, ω_i-ω_j),且Chebyshev乘积构成更高阶多项式项,两族交叉产生多项式调幅正弦项。生成器在每层共享于所有存储模式,参数数量与模式数独立。还扩展了CP、TT、Tucker张量分解变体。
AI.result: 在Darcy、NS、Burgers、Airfoil、ReacDiff五个基准上(5个随机种子,500轮训练),密集CAFE+FNO在四个基准上取得最低平均相对L2误差,相比SirenFNO分别降低43.7%(Darcy)、60.2%(NS)、29.5%(Burgers)、18.4%(Airfoil),仅在ReacDiff上SirenFNO更优(2.36 vs 3.80 ×10⁻³)。消融显示Fourier-Chebyshev联合编码优于单一基;CAFE+组合块在匹配MLP输入维度下优于直接特征;可学习带宽ρ_l在NS和ReacDiff上略优,Darcy/Burgers上略差。CP/TT/Tucker变体参数减少68.7–86.1%,但准确性有所下降(Tucker在ReacDiff上例外)。
AI.conclusion: CAFE+FNO证明了在傅里叶核生成中进行显式、可学习特征组合的有效性:Fourier-Chebyshev编码经并行仿射分支与Hadamard积在编码阶段构造跨族交互,核MLP据此生成复值通道混合核。该方法在五个PDE基准中的四个上达到最优,消融实验支持组合编码与乘法合成优于直接特征输入。张量分解变体以更少参数实现压缩,但伴随基数量与MLP维度的减少,未能单独分离张量分解效应。未来工作将扩展到更广泛PDE问题与更高维空间。

title: YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL ; Model: this https URL
summary: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.

AI.tldr: YANchor-4B 是一个4B参数的通用循环模型，通过"锚点"显式记忆机制在 O(N) 生成时间和 O(1) 历史状态内存下实现有效的长程推理，在数学竞赛和通用任务上大幅超越同规模及更大的线性时间常数状态基线模型，并在 H100 上实现数倍于 Transformer 的批量长序列生成吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 长程推理需要持续访问早期信息。完整历史注意力机制的存储和计算成本随长度增长；纯循环压缩会丢失精确细节；固定窗口注意力使远距离信息最终离开窗口。因此需要一个能在固定状态预算内保留并检索关键早期信息的方案。
AI.method: 基于 Qwen3.5-4B 骨干，将其 8 个注意力层替换为本地滑窗注意力（SWA，窗口1024）并行独立记忆模块，每个序列混合器为 [GDN, GDN, GDN, SWA∥Memory]×8。记忆模块由独立写入器生成 K/V 表达，使用小型入网（admission network）为4个 KV 组各打一个分数，每组保留得分最高的1024条记录作为"锚点"。检索时采用分组查询注意力，查询经门控调制后输出。训练分四阶段：M0（记忆适应）、R（联合适应）、S（监督后训练）、RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）。
AI.result: 在 AIME 2024-2026 上取得 82.93% 平均 pass@1，HMMT 2026 上 63.64%，大幅领先包括 13.3B RWKV-7 G1j（18.89%/12.12%）在内的线性时间常数状态基线；24项基准平均分 78.64，超过最强基线 56.29 达 22.35 分。H100 单卡上：128K+128K 单序列解码速度 212.98 tokens/s；批量 512 时吞吐达 ~12,854 tokens/s，是 Qwen3.5-4B 的 4-6 倍；64K 上下文峰值显存 67 GiB，可驻留 512 条独立历史，而基线在 4K-8K 即开始抢占。消融实验显示关闭记忆路径使长记忆任务准确率从 94.14% 降至 0.39%。
AI.conclusion: YANchor-4B 通过独立的写入、入网与检索机制，将关键记忆显式锚定在固定容量状态中，从而在保持 O(N) 生成时间与 O(1) 历史状态内存的同时，显著提升长程推理能力。其在数学竞赛、代码、知识、指令跟随及视觉语言任务上全面领先常数状态基线，并在长序列批量吞吐上实现对 Transformer 的数倍加速，证明困难任务可在不随长度增长的状态预算下有效求解。

title: What Can a Gaussian Process Design Test
summary: A Gaussian process (GP) model can agree with the data for two reasons: its assumptions are right, or the chosen inputs could never have shown that they are wrong. The distinction can be checked from the design before any responses are observed. Every model implies relations that its noiseless responses must satisfy at the chosen inputs, such as the middle value lies on the line through its two neighbours. For GPs built from finitely many features, these relations are exactly the null space of the kernel matrix. Gale duality gives them a geometric interpretation, in which each observation has a vector and the smallest groups of observations that can expose an error are the circuits. For other kernels the relations become soft: response patterns may be improbable under the prior rather than algebraically impossible. A standard test then combines two kinds of evidence. Structural evidence comes from a violated relation and grows without limit as the noise falls. Prior-based evidence only says that a departure is improbable under the prior. With all inputs at the two ends of an interval, for example, a GP can reject a straight line against a large curvature, but only because the implied intercept is improbable, never because curvature was seen. In simulations the predicted power matched the observed rejection rates. Choosing the next input by predicted power raised the power against a localised discrepancy from 0.48 to 0.72, against 0.51 when choosing by predictive variance, and a grid in two dimensions contained exact tests of additivity that a Latin hypercube lacked. The test itself is classical. The contribution is the prospective reading of that test: before observing the responses, the design already determines what kind of contradiction it can produce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯过程(GP)模型的"先验性"假设检验框架：通过分析设计矩阵(输入点)的核矩阵零空间，可在观测响应前判断该实验设计能否暴露模型假设的错误。利用Gale对偶性将核矩阵零空间中的代数关系(称为"环路/circuits")解释为检验约束，并区分硬约束(有限特征核)与软约束(其他核下的先验不可能性)。仿真显示预测检验效能与实际拒绝率吻合，并证明按"预测效能"选点优于按预测方差选点。
AI.motivation: 传统GP模型可能因数据"无法反驳假设"而看似与数据吻合，作者希望从实验设计阶段就量化GP模型能产生何种类型的矛盾(contradiction)，即在观测响应前评估设计的检验能力(model falsifiability)。
