AI.method: 1. 利用核矩阵零空间刻画无噪声响应必须满足的代数关系(circuits，由Gale对偶给出几何解释)；2. 对有限特征核，这些关系是硬约束(代数不可能)；对其他核为软约束(先验下统计不可能)；3. 检验统计量结合结构证据(违反关系，随噪声减小发散)与先验证据(偏离先验的程度)；4. 提出"预测检验效能(predicted power)"作为选点准则，仿真验证其与经验拒绝率的一致性。
AI.result: 1. 仿真中预测效能准确匹配观测拒绝率；2. 基于预测效能选点可将局部偏离的检验功效从0.48提升至0.72，优于按预测方差选点(0.51)；3. 二维网格设计可对可加性进行精确检验，而拉丁超立方设计不能。
AI.conclusion: 检验本身是经典的(F检验)，本文贡献在于其"前瞻性解读"：在观测响应前，设计已决定了能产生何种矛盾。这为实验者提供了在数据采集前评估GP模型可证伪性的工具，并给出了更优的自适应选点策略。

title: m-Set Adversarial Bandits with Winner Feedback
summary: We show upper and lower bounds on the regret of $m$-set adversarial bandits for different utilities (winner reward or sum of rewards) and feedback models (winner index, winner reward, sum of rewards, and their combinations). By comparing to standard bounds for combinatorial and MNL bandits, our results reveal how subtle changes in the setting can have a dramatic impact on the learning rates. Our main technical contributions are the information-theoretic lower bounds on the regret. Experiments on synthetic data confirm our theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究m-集对抗性老虎机问题，提出了介于组合老虎机与MNL老虎机之间的FB+WF（完整老虎机反馈+赢家反馈）模型，证明了其极小极大遗憾界为Θ̃(m√KT)，介于纯完整反馈的m^(3/2)√KT和半老虎机反馈的√(mKT)之间。论文还研究了若干变体模型（如随机臂反馈、赢家奖励效用等）的上下界，并通过实验验证了理论分析。
AI.motivation: 组合老虎机和MNL老虎机在效用函数和反馈结构上存在差异。现有工作分别对完整老虎机反馈（m^(3/2)√KT）和半老虎机反馈（√(mKT)）建立了匹配的下界，但介于二者之间的反馈模型——特别是同时包含集合总奖励和Plackett-Luce赢家索引的模型——尚未被研究。这种设置在板岩推荐系统中有自然应用，平台观察到汇总性能指标和用户选择的商品，但不能获得各展示商品的个体奖励。作者试图精确刻画这种中间设置的统计复杂度。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 算法设计：提出OSMA-W（在线随机镜像上升含赢家反馈），基于负熵正则化的镜像上升框架，通过结合完整老虎机反馈和赢家索引构造基臂奖励的无偏估计量（公式4），利用强制探索保证估计量有界。(2) 遗憾上界分析：将Audibert等人(2014)关于半老虎机反馈的OSMD分析适配到最大化版本，利用奖励估计量方差增加m因子的性质，得到O(m√(KT log(K/m)))上界。(3) 信息论下界：改编Ito等人(2019)的多任务老虎机下界证明，通过构造难度实例对（有名义模型和替代模型，后者删去一个好臂），利用KL散度上界处理赢家索引泄露的额外信息，证明Ω(m√KT)下界。对变体模型（仅赢家索引+奖励反馈、随机臂反馈、MNL型赢家奖励效用等）也分别建立上下界。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) FB+WF模型：上界O(m√(KT log(K/m)))，下界Ω(m√KT)，二者匹配至对数因子（定理1和2）。(2) 无总奖励反馈时：即使有赢家索引和奖励，任何算法也有线性遗憾（定理3）。(3) 随机臂反馈（Alatur等人2020的多玩家老虎机）：下界Ω(m√KT)，与上界O(m√(KT log K))匹配（定理4）。(4) MNL型效用（赢家期望奖励）+ FB+WF反馈：线性遗憾（定理5）。(5) MNL型效用+赢家索引与奖励反馈：上界O(√((eK/m)^m T))，下界Ω(√((K/2m)^m T))（定理6），与Han等人(2021)结果一致但有2^(m/2)差距。实验部分在合成数据上验证了不同算法（OSMA-W、OSMA、K-Metaplayer、EXP2）在各种奖励实例（相关均匀、Bernoulli、时变）下遗憾排序与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: FB+WF反馈模型在m-集对抗性老虎机中具有Θ̃(m√KT)的极小极大遗憾率，恰好位于完整老虎机反馈（m^(3/2)√KT）和半老虎机反馈（√(mKT)）之间，表明赢家索引使完整老虎机问题变易但未达到半老虎机的容易程度。论文建立了细致的反馈-效用组合分类表：总奖励效用必须观察总奖励；MNL型效用即使有赢家奖励反馈也只能获得关于m指数级的遗憾率。算法OSMA-W的对数因子可能通过非负熵以外的正则化器消除，但INF正则化因非负性要求而不可直接使用。开放问题包括：约束动作集的处理、计算高效的算法设计、"输家反馈"模型、非线性吸引力参数、无购买选项的影响等。

title: A Unified Information-Theoretic Approach to Constrained Multi-Fidelity Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization often involves multiple objectives, constraints, and fidelity levels. We address the challenge of jointly selecting where and at which fidelity to evaluate to identify the highest-fidelity feasible Pareto frontier in this combined setting. From a unified information-theoretic perspective, we measure query utility by the information gain about this frontier, provided by an observation. Since this mutual information is intractable, we derive a variational lower bound using a mixture of under- and over-truncated approximations to the Pareto-consistent region. Multi-fidelity surrogate models propagate the information to arbitrary fidelities, yielding a cost-aware acquisition function without separate heuristics for fidelity selection or constraint handling. Experiments on synthetic, benchmark, and real-world problems demonstrate effectiveness across diverse objective, constraint, and fidelity settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMF-PFEV，一种基于信息论的统一方法，用于解决约束多保真度多目标贝叶斯优化（C-MF-MO）问题。该方法将多目标、约束和多保真度选择统一在一个互信息准则下，通过变分下界和过/欠截断的Pareto一致性区域近似，实现对目标保真度可行Pareto前沿的信息增益估计。
AI.motivation: 现有的约束多保真度多目标BO方法（如MFMO-SEGO、MF-CMOBO）采用分立启发式机制分别处理目标、约束和保真度选择；而MF-JESMOC虽统一但依赖计算昂贵的多保真度深度GP。本文旨在以统一的信息论框架且基于标准GP推理实现C-MF-MO优化。
AI.method: 核心思想：将查询效用定义为观测对目标保真度可行Pareto前沿的互信息MI(r_x^(m); F*)。由于该MI难以解析求解，采用变分下界：1）定义"局部Pareto一致性"事件，即目标保真度输出h_x^(M)属于由前沿确定的可行域A^{F*}；2）使用过截断(O)和欠截断(U)区域构造混合变分分布q_λ；3）通过多保真度GP的跨保真度协方差将任意保真度的观测条件化到目标保真度；4）采集函数计算化为观测前后Pareto一致性事件的高斯区域概率之比；5）通过蒙特卡洛近似求解期望，并按单位评估成本归一化实现成本感知的查询选择。
AI.result: 在GP生成的合成函数、约束多目标基准函数（C2-DTLZ2、Tanaka）以及LightGBM超参数优化（Waveform-5000、Dry Bean、Covertype）上的实验表明，CMF-PFEV在多种目标数、约束数和输入维度设置下均优于现有方法MF-OSEMO-PoF、MF-HVKG-PoF、MFMO-SEGO、MF-CMOBO和MF-JESMOC。计算时间分析：CMF-PFEV约为103秒，远快于MF-JESMOC的3354秒，但慢于启发式方法。
AI.conclusion: CMF-PFEV成功地将约束、多目标和多保真度三个复杂性统一在一个基于Pareto一致性事件的互信息准则下，无需分立启发式机制，并基于标准跨保真度GP条件化完成计算。局限性：信息增益的近似误差理论上仍有待进一步研究。

title: Pre-training of Bayesian Optimization Algorithm through Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used as a standard approach for expensive black-box optimization. However, BO algorithms often involve parameters that must be specified in advance, and their performance can strongly depend on these choices. We propose a framework for optimizing such parameters using sample paths drawn from a Gaussian process (GP) inferred from the information available at the start of BO. We use cumulative regret as the performance metric for a BO algorithm. By running the BO algorithm on the generated sample paths, we obtain an empirical estimate of its expected cumulative regret for a given parameter configuration. Optimizing this estimate allows us to identify parameter configurations that, given the currently available information, are expected to achieve low cumulative regret. Since this parameter optimization is itself a black-box optimization problem, we employ another BO procedure to solve it, which we refer to as outer BO. Through experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively select parameter configurations that achieve strong performance among a range of candidate configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“预训练贝叶斯优化”（Pretrained BO）：利用初始GP后验生成函数样本路径，在样本上运行候选BO并以累积遗憾评估参数配置，再用外层BO搜索低遗憾配置；实验表明该方法能有效挑选高性能配置。
AI.motivation: BO通常包含探索—开发权衡、信赖域调度、潜空间维度与正则化权重等算法参数，但这些参数不同于GP超参数，不能通过边际似然直接估计，通常依赖启发式设定并显著影响有限预算下的性能。论文希望利用当前已有的目标函数分布，直接选择在有限评估周期内预期累积遗憾较低的配置。
AI.method: 框架包含三个层次。首先由初始数据构造目标函数的后验分布（GP后验或预训练GP先验），从中采样N条函数路径。其次，将配置参数θ输入内层BO，在每条路径上运行T步，并以累积遗憾R_T的样本均值估计Bayes累积遗憾BR_T(θ)=E[R_T|D_0]。最后，以该估计作为外层BO的黑盒目标，优化θ；外层BO的每次评估需要重复运行N次内层BO。论文进一步将较短的T_low作为低保真评估，并用多保真BO降低外层搜索成本；对多阶段配置，用低、高保真之间的输入维度差异构造自回归协同GP。理论上，在核连续、域紧且GP正则性等条件下，MC遗憾估计误差为O_p(T/√N)；有限候选配置集合下，所选配置相对最优配置的期望遗憾差具有同阶保证。
AI.result: 在TuRBO配置实验中，Pretrained BO在Sphere、Rosenbrock和Levy等GP样本函数上，通常能选出明显优于随机配置的高性能参数，并在多个场景优于标准EI BO和MetaBO；多阶段版本在部分设置进一步提升。LSBO与Fashion-MNIST图像生成实验也表明，该方法能识别具有较高优化性能的潜空间VAE配置。外层BO通常比随机搜索更高效，多保真BO在部分设置进一步改善搜索效率。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，关于目标函数的先验知识不仅可用于代理模型预测，也可用于配置BO算法本身。Pretrained BO在不学习全新优化器或采集策略的情况下，保留既有BO结构并适配目标函数分布，具有较强的通用性。主要局限是GP后验或先验设定错误可能导致次优参数选择；连续参数空间下，论文只给出点态MC收敛，尚未建立完整的选择一致性理论。

title: Robust Decentralized Fairness Auditing
summary: Emerging legislation requires large language models (LLMs) to be audited for compliance with regulatory standards, particularly fairness. Such black-box audits typically assume a single auditor with access to a large, representative set of queries. In practice, it can be difficult for an auditor to obtain such a query set, but multiple auditors can together cover the relevant demographic groups by auditing the LLM collaboratively with their individual query sets. However, relying on multiple auditors raises a fundamental trust problem, as they may act on behalf of the LLM provider to portray a misleading appearance of fairness, i.e., fairwashing. We propose Auditopus, a novel approach for robust decentralized fairness auditing. In Auditopus, auditing proceeds in rounds without a central server. In each round, every auditor issues a fixed number of queries to the LLM, and sends only cumulative statistics vectors of its query results to other auditors instead of sensitive queries in clear. The fairness of the audited LLM is then estimated by aggregating all the vectors. We show theoretically and empirically that even a single adversarial auditor in the network can steer this estimate by fabricating the vectors it sends, making an unfair LLM appear fair. To address this threat, Auditopus has each honest auditor locally down-weight any auditor whose cumulative statistics vectors are statistically inconsistent with previous ones. We implement Auditopus and compare it to robust aggregation baselines on two datasets with two pre-trained LLMs. Against an attacker that optimizes the vectors it sends to make the LLM appear fair, Auditopus reduces audit error by up to 78% on average relative to no defense and at least 62% relative to the robust aggregation baselines. Even when 49% of the auditors are adversarial, Auditopus never lets a very unfair or moderately unfair LLM pass as fair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Auditopus，一种用于黑箱大语言模型公平性审计的鲁棒去中心化协议。该协议以多轮方式运行，审计员通过交换局部聚合统计（LAS）向量而非原始查询来协作评估人口统计均等（DP），并通过本地基于历史的统计一致性检测对可疑的LAS向量增量进行降权，从而抵御与LLM提供商勾结的审计员发起的"公平洗白"攻击。实验证明，即使49%的审计员为对抗性，Auditopus仍能有效阻止不公平LLM通过审计。
AI.motivation: 新兴法规（如欧盟AI法案）要求对大语言模型进行公平性审计。传统黑箱审计依赖单一审计员持有大规模且具有代表性的查询集，但在实践中单个审计员难以同时满足这两个条件。多审计员协作可以扩大查询覆盖范围与代表性，但协作会引入信任问题：与LLM提供商勾结的审计员可能通过伪造统计量使不公平模型看起来公平（即"公平洗白"）。此外，审计员持有的查询集在规模和群体组成上存在异质性，使得传统鲁棒聚合方法（中位数、截尾均值）在丢弃异常值的同时也会丢弃使审计具有代表性的诚实但"非典型"的审计员数据。
AI.method:
1. **去中心化多轮协议**：在同步轮次中，每个审计员每轮向LLM发起固定预算n=300的查询，并将累积的LAS向量（包含每组查询数与正例数）通过静态连通图与邻居交换；通过签名防止伪造与重写。
2. **基于GAS向量的精确聚合**：将所有LAS向量求和得到GAS向量（全局聚合统计），并以此计算DP（人口统计均等），等价于所有查询集并集的DP估计，天然处理异质性问题。
3. **强自适应对抗者模型**：攻击者不查询LLM，每轮基于其对GAS向量的视图，在可行增量集合𝒳ₙ上求解最优化问题δ⋆ ∈ argmin |DP(C+δ)|，通过搜索预算在两组间的最优分配来使估计逼近零。
4. **基于历史一致性的本地防御**：每个诚实审计员对每个源的LAS向量增量计算怀疑分数——基于增量与该源自身历史统计的三个二项分布z分数（群体比例、A组正例率、B组正例率），采用Krichevsky-Trofimov估计，取最大值并限制在z_max=8以内；增量权重w=(1+S)⁻²，权重一旦确定即锁定不可修改。
5. **最终裁决**：每位诚实审计员基于加权LAS向量计算本地估计，全局裁决取所有审计员（含攻击者，攻击者发送0）估计的中位数。
AI.result: 在Bias in Bios与Civil Comments两个数据集上，针对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct两个预训练LLM，测试非常不公平、中度不公平与接近公平三种情况：Bias in Bios上攻击成功率（ASR）从无防御97%降至3%，平均DP估计误差从0.158降至0.034（降低78%），相对中位数与截尾均值基线至少降低62%；在Civil Comments上将ASR从97%降至26%，误差从0.156降至0.034。即使49%的审计员为对抗者，Auditopus在非常不公平与中度不公平LLM上从未让错误裁决通过；其DP估计误差在不同诚实审计员数量（N=10/20/30）与异质性水平（α=0.2至100）下保持在0.019–0.045之间，而中位数与截尾均值在异质数据下误差可达0.25。理论分析（定理2与推论7）刻画了单个攻击者成功公平洗白的充要条件。
AI.conclusion: Auditopus是一种有效的鲁棒去中心化公平审计协议，通过基于历史统计一致性的本地降权机制，在不依赖可信第三方、不惩罚诚实但持有非典型查询集的审计员的前提下抵御自适应公平洗白攻击。实验验证了在多达49%对抗审计员场景下仍能可靠识别非常不公平与中度不公平的LLM。该方法将每个审计员与其自身历史比对而非与其他审计员比对，成功解决了异质查询集场景下传统鲁棒聚合方法失效的核心难题。

title: How to train your model organism
summary: Model organisms of alignment-relevant behaviors (e.g., backdoors, sycophancy, spurious correlations) have emerged as a key tool for evaluating whitebox interpretability techniques. We argue that the prevailing practice of training model organisms to a single objective of installing the target behavior is insufficient and propose validating model organisms with respect to three objectives with associated metrics: target-behavior installation, general-capability preservation (i.e., parametric knowledge, chat quality), and output naturalness (i.e., CoT and activations). We re-visit two publicly released organism suites using this validation framework and show that (1) chat quality and CoT naturalness degrade substantially across training recipes, and (2) validation metrics predict how well interpretability methods recover the installed behavior, e.g., a logit lens readout covaries with an organism's general capabilities. We introduce a multi-objective training approach based on model merging to train more realistic model organisms. Finally, on a new suite of model organisms targeting demographic biases in clinical reasoning, we compare training recipes and find that DPO training stays closer to the base model than supervised finetuning, and the proposed model optimization approach better preserves capabilities and naturalness. Auditing this suite with an investigator agent, we again observe validation metrics tracking bias recovery. In sum, training methods shape the interpretability conclusions an organism supports, and we argue that one should consider multiple objectives to draw generalizable conclusions about interpretability methods using (realistic) model organisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对可解释性研究中"模型生物"（model organisms）训练方法的局限性，提出多目标验证框架与基于模型融合的多目标训练方法，论证训练方式显著影响可解释性结论，并构建了一个面向临床推理人口统计偏差的新模型生物套件进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有模型生物构建通常仅以"安装目标行为"为单一优化目标，忽视了对通用能力（聊天质量、参数化知识）和输出自然性（CoT与激活）的损害，导致其作为可解释性评估测试床的代表性和结论可推广性存疑——受损的生物可能产生误导性结论。
AI.method: 提出三维验证框架：(1)目标行为安装（行为率+反事实条件率）；(2)通用能力保留（MMLU/MT-Bench/领域准确率）；(3)输出自然性（CoT可分类性与激活可检测性）。训练方面，对比SFT与DPO、是否混入聊天数据，并提出基于SACPO框架的模型融合策略：将训练好的LoRA权重按比例q在目标检查点与基模型之间线性插值。临床生物在Llama-3.1-8b-it上注入性别、年龄、种族三类人口统计偏差；使用白箱工具（Jacobian lens、SAE、诚实引导）与黑箱CoT进行审计代理评估。
AI.result: 对Pando和Lottery两个公开套件的回溯分析显示：DPO重训显著恢复MT-Bench与CoT自然性；logit-lens的规则恢复准确率与MMLU/MT-Bench正相关（ρ高达+0.76）。临床生物套件（N=163）：DPO较SFT更贴近基模型（领域准确率提升0.097–0.169）；混入聊天数据在所有6组对比中均损害CoT自然性（0.028–0.157）；DPO+Merge取得三类偏差上的最高综合得分（年龄.970、种族.987、性别.983）。验证指标与审计成功率呈现偏差相关的一致相关性。
AI.conclusion: 训练方法显著影响模型生物所支持的可解释性结论；推荐使用DPO而非SFT、不轻易混入聊天数据、并通过向基模型融合来保留能力与自然性。多目标框架应成为构建现实可信模型生物的标准实践，以得出更具推广性的结论。

title: OrthoGen: A Generative Orthogonal Learner for Time-Varying Treatments
summary: Estimating conditional distributional potential outcomes (CDPOs) over time is important in medicine (e.g., to estimate patient-specific risks under different treatment sequences). However, this task is challenging because of time-varying confounding, yet existing adjustment strategies for this task are limited. In this paper, we aim to learn CDPOs under time-varying treatments using flexible generative models. Our contributions are two-fold. (1) We introduce a tailored adjustment strategy for our setting, namely, generative recursive g-computation. Our adjustment strategy recursively propagates full conditional outcome distributions rather than conditional means, modeling the variables of interest directly rather than full trajectories. Building on our adjustment strategy, we formulate simple generative learners for CDPO estimation. However, these learners can be sensitive to nuisance estimation errors, which motivates an orthogonal learner. (2) We thus introduce OrthoGen, a Neyman-orthogonal and doubly robust generative learner. Importantly, we show that OrthoGen further achieves rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency under suitable conditions. Our learners are flexible and can be instantiated with different generative backbones (e.g., normalizing flows and diffusion models). Across experiments with synthetic, semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, we find that OrthoGen is highly effective. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to propose a generative orthogonal learner for estimating CDPOs under time-varying treatments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OrthoGen，一种用于时变治疗下条件分布潜在结果（CDPO）估计的生成式正交学习器。其核心贡献包括：(1) 提出"生成式递归g-计算"调整策略，递归传播完整条件结果分布而非条件均值；(2) 设计了具有Neyman正交性和双重鲁棒性的OrthoGen方法，理论上可达到速率双重鲁棒性和准oracle效率；(3) 基于标准化流和扩散模型等灵活骨干网络，在合成、半合成和真实数据集（MIMIC-III）上的实验验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 时变治疗下估计患者特异性风险（如不同治疗序列下肿瘤大小、低血糖等的概率分布）在医学领域至关重要。然而，时变混杂给因果推断带来挑战：预测起点之后出现的混杂因素同时影响后续治疗决策和最终结果。现有针对CDPO的调整策略有限——仅IPTW可用，但IPTW在重叠不足时权重不稳定、方差高，尤其在长治疗时域下问题突出。因此，亟需开发具有理论保证（如双重鲁棒性和正交性）且能学习完整分布的生成式方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) **生成式递归g-计算**：定义"延续密度"ξ_{t+δ}^{ā}，从终末阶段向后递归传播——终末阶段直接拟合观测结果，早期阶段从冻结的后继密度中采样伪结果来拟合。(2) **简单学习器**：插件学习器（PI）直接使用ξ̂_t^{ā}估计CDPO；回归调整学习器（RA）将其作为生成目标风险的估计量。(3) **OrthoGen**：结合生成式递归g-计算与基于倾向得分的调整，构建目标函数 L̂_OrthoGen^{ā} = ℙ_n[R̂·ℓ + Σ R̂·(1-r̂)·m̂]，具有Neyman正交性和双重鲁棒性。可与标准化流（通过KL散度投影）或扩散模型（通过ELBO）等多种生成骨干网络结合。序列编码器固定采用Transformer架构。
AI.result: 在合成数据（τ=1~5）：OrthoGen在使用扩散模型时表现最佳，在较长时域（τ>1）下优于PI学习者。在半合成MIMIC-III数据：OrthoGen在所有时域和两种骨干网络下均取得最低Wasserstein成本（如τ=5时NFs下1.23±0.45 vs IPTW的2.06±0.87），优势随时域增大而扩大。在真实MIMIC-III数据：NFs下OrthoGen在所有时域获得最低CRPS。整体上OrthoGen的收益随治疗时域延长而增大，符合其双重鲁棒性和正交性的理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了OrthoGen——首个用于时变治疗下CDPO估计的双重鲁棒且Neyman正交的生成式学习器。理论上证明其具有速率双重鲁棒性和准oracle效率，实验上在多种数据集和生成骨干网络下均有效。生成式递归g-计算策略避免了完整协变量轨迹模拟，提高了纵向设置下的效率。该方法为医学领域中患者特异性风险估计（如不同治疗方案下的肿瘤进展、毒性反应概率分布）提供了更可靠的因果推断工具。

title: Edge Accuracy Is Not Enough: Why Dynamics-Learned Structure Fails to Transfer to Inverse Problems
comment: 13 pages, 8 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: A natural strategy for inverse problems with scarce labelled data is to transfer relational structure learned from abundant forward-simulation data. We show this strategy fails systematically, even when it satisfies the standard theoretical justification for why structure should help. We prove that approximate structure provides estimation-error benefits whenever the edge error satisfies $\Delta < n^2 - kn$, reducing sample complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(kn+\Delta)$. Structure learned via Neural Relational Inference (NRI) from dynamics prediction satisfies this condition, yet on a source-localisation task across 180 CFD-simulated hydrogen-leak scenarios and 180 acoustic scenarios, it degrades performance by 116% and 201% relative to a flexible, task-optimised attention baseline, while a physics-based prior (Green's function) degrades by only 69-72%. Four independent lines of evidence show this is not a tuning failure: NRI improves only 0.5% when given 18x more training data (versus 16.6% for the task-optimised baseline, $p<0.001$); performance is insensitive to the NRI edge threshold across a wide range; the dynamics-learned graph overlaps the task-optimal graph on only 6% of edges; and two further dynamics-derived structure estimators (correlation- and mutual-information-based) show no measurable benefit over a structure-free baseline, with the correlation-based estimator performing markedly worse. We formalise this gap as a statement about approximation error that the edge-accuracy condition cannot control, and we provide a lightweight transferability test (Jaccard similarity against a partially-observed target-task graph) that separates successful from failed transfer in all four domain/structure pairs we evaluate, using under an hour of computation and 15-20% of target-domain data; we present this as a heuristic calibrated on few cases, not a validated general threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：从正向动力学（如NRI）学习的关系结构在迁移到数据稀缺的反向问题（源定位）时，即使满足边准确度条件Δ<n²−kn也会系统性地失败，因为该条件仅控制估计误差而不控制逼近误差，并提出基于Jaccard相似度的轻量级可迁移性测试。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中常利用丰富的正向仿真数据学习关系结构（如分子属性预测、基因调控网络）以缓解反向任务标签不足的问题。本文旨在检验这一策略在源定位（特别是氢气泄漏检测）中的有效性。
AI.method: 理论证明（定理1-3，基于Rademacher复杂度界）+ 经验实验：180个CFD氢气泄漏场景和180个声学场景，比较四种定位器（MLP、Green函数、Learned Attention、NRI-Graph），并进行数据扩展、阈值消融、结构重叠分析，以及引入相关性和互信息两种额外结构估计器作为架构独立性检验。
AI.result: 满足定理3条件的NRI学习结构在CFD和声学任务中分别使性能退化116%和201%，而基于物理的Green函数先验仅退化69-72%，任务优化注意力基线最优。四条独立证据（数据扩展仅改善0.5% vs 16.6%；阈值不敏感；与任务最优图Jaccard重叠仅6%；相关/互信息图无显著益处）排除了调参失败解释。基于Jaccard≥0.30的可迁移性启发式能正确预测所有四个评估对的迁移成败。
AI.conclusion: 边准确度不足以保证结构迁移成功，因为该条件仅控制估计误差，逼近误差在前向与反向任务目标不对齐时占主导。实践建议：数据有限且有可靠物理知识时使用物理基础结构；>10个场景/传感器时使用任务优化学习；仅当候选结构与部分观测目标图Jaccard≥0.30时才尝试结构迁移（该阈值基于少量案例校准，非普适规则）。

title: Finite-Sample Approximation of Hessian-Guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: Wasserstein gradient flow extends gradient descent to probability measures. Its Hessian-guided perturbed variant (PWGF) adds Gaussian perturbations to escape saddle points in nonconvex problems. We investigate when its approximation by finitely many interacting particles remains accurate over growing time horizons. Our analysis retains the curvature accumulated along the population-driven reference path: negative curvature can amplify approximation errors, while subsequent positive curvature can damp their influence. This captures favorable scenarios in which temporary instability is compatible with accurate tracking over growing horizons. Under regularity assumptions and a prescribed common perturbation schedule, we prove particle and objective-value tracking bounds on a high-probability event for reference paths satisfying explicit conditions on accumulated curvature. To handle state-dependent Gaussian jumps, we construct a population-first coupling that preserves the reference particles' conditional independence and reduces jump errors to covariance comparison. We verify the conditions in a variance-plus-cosine model, where curvature recovery yields a growing-horizon tracking guarantee. We also establish local attraction, transverse descent, and positive second variation in two regions of a regularized matrix-factorization model, motivating a positive-negative-positive curvature pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Wasserstein梯度流的有限粒子逼近，给出了Hessian引导的扰动梯度流(PWGF)在增长时间区间上的高精度跟踪与目标值跟踪界。核心是构造了“种群优先”的Gaussian跳跃耦合，使参考粒子保持条件独立，从而将跳跃误差归结为协方差比较；并通过曲率响应因子$G_\kappa^Y(t,s)=\exp(-\int_s^t \kappa_u^{Y,N}du)$显式地保留沿路径积累的曲率，正曲率衰减早期误差、负曲率放大但允许随后正曲率衰减。在方差加余弦模型上实现了$T=N^{1/8}$的增长区间跟踪界$\sup[r_t+|F(\hat\rho_t^N)-F(\mu_t)|]\le C_\varepsilon N^{-3/16+\varepsilon}$。附带证明了矩阵分解模型在球面上的局部吸引、横向下降与正二阶变分，刻画正-负-正曲率模式以匹配有限样本结论的曲率结构。
AI.motivation: 扰动Wasserstein梯度流能逃离非凸问题的鞍点，但已有结果只关注种群路径，未量化粒子系统对种群的有限样本逼近误差。标准独立的Hoeffding型界不适用于依赖的粒子轨迹，且在整个时间区间内若忽略累积曲率会得到指数发散的误差上界。需要：(i)在共同预定跳跃时间表下建立含曲率响应的非渐近跟踪界；(ii)处理状态依赖Gaussian跳跃在耦合粒子对之间的传播；(iii)验证非凸几何(矩阵分解)允许增长时间区间跟踪，避免最坏情况负曲率。
AI.method: 种群优先耦合：在每次跳跃处基于种群场构造有限维标准高斯向量，保持参考粒子的条件i.i.d.并将经验跳跃差归结为协方差矩阵核差。曲率响应因子：定义采样Hessian最小特征值$\kappa_t^{Y,N}$及$G_\kappa^Y(t,s)$，沿路径用Gronwall型递推在ODE区间内连续吸收残差、在跳跃处累积放大。确定性比较引理：在$E_{\rm pop}\cap E_{T,D}\cap E_{T,\rm sp}$上将ODE误差$c_D r_t^2+\Gamma_t^N(1+r_t)$和跳跃误差$a_\ell(\sqrt{\Gamma^N}+\sqrt{\tilde\Gamma^N})$分别用$\mathfrak{C}_t^Y$与$\mathfrak{J}_t^Y$聚合，得到最终跟踪界。方差加余弦模型：显式求解耦合跳跃后的均值动力学，给出$\kappa_t^{Y,N}=\min\{a,-b\cos(\pi m_t)\}$及恢复时间$t_N=\tau+b^{-1}\log(2/\rho_N)$，证明$T=N^{1/8}$下$\sup(\mathfrak{C}_t^Y+\mathfrak{J}_t^Y)\le CN^{1/16}$。矩阵分解球面模型：用Hermite张量展开将数据拟合项写成$\|\Delta\mathcal{M}_p\|_{\rm HS}^2$，证明在反对称分支上有极点收缩、距离耗散和球面正二阶变分；在$s_\star$对称分支附近估计非负拟合曲率并结合度量正则项的$\kappa_{\rm cap}\zeta_{\min}^{\delta_W}$严格正下界。
AI.result:
主要定理3.1：对预设共同跳跃日程、规则性条件及控制曲率路径条件下，给出同时对粒子与目标值的非渐近跟踪界
$$r_t\vee|F(\hat\rho_{\mathbf X_t})-F(\mu_t)|\le C_\varepsilon\Xi^\varepsilon[(N^{-1/2}+T/N)(1+\mathfrak C_t^Y)+(N^{-1/4}+\sqrt{T/N})\mathfrak J_t^Y]$$
其中$\Xi=8N(e+T)(L_{\rm jump}+1)(1+B)/p$，满足$T(\delta_{N,T,p}+c_DR)\le 1/4$的非线性稳定事件；非自适路径失败概率$p$。在$v+\zeta<1/4$与$T\le N^{1/4-v-\zeta}$下增长区间跟踪律。例3.1(方差加余弦)：在$T=N^{1/8}$及一次高斯跳跃下，$\sup_{0\le t\le T}[r_t+|F(\hat\rho_{\mathbf X_t})-F(\mu_t)|]\le C_\varepsilon N^{-3/16+\varepsilon}$；晚于$C\log N$后$F(\hat\rho_{\mathbf X_t})+\beta\le C_\varepsilon N^{-1/2+\varepsilon}$。局部几何(命题4.1)：(i)反对称分支上$2<p_W<3$时到$\mu^\dagger$的局部吸引，(ii)固定分配小曲率环境下球面正二阶变分，(iii)反极点处存在同密度方向使$F(\mu_h)=F(\mu^\dagger)-h^2\gamma_{\rm esc}+o(h^2)$，度量正则项仅贡献$o(h^2)$。数值附录C：在$32\times2$矩阵模型上验证非尖峰条件$s_t\le 1.017$，并展示自主触发条件下粒子与种群路径的跟踪行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过种群优先Gaussian耦合与曲率响应因子，建立了Hessian引导扰动Wasserstein梯度流的有限粒子跟踪理论：只要相应预定统一时间表与控制曲率路径条件成立，粒子在N^{-1/2}-N^{-1/4}尺度上同时跟踪位置与目标值，且曲率响应因子使界在临时不稳定后能恢复。方差加余弦模型证明增长时间区间$N^{1/8}$下$N^{-3/16+\varepsilon}$跟踪律；矩阵分解模型提供了与之匹配的正-负-正曲率模式，从而证明该几何允许而非阻碍增长区间跟踪。开放方向：从模型原语导出控制曲率路径条件与非尖峰性，以及同步自适应跳跃时间。

title: Evaluating Sequence Assembly Strategies for Differentially Private Synthetic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Differentially private time-series generators commonly produce fixed-length synthetic windows, whereas downstream forecasting models often require long continuous training sequences. How these windows are assembled after generation can therefore alter the effective synthetic data presented to a forecaster, even when the trained generator remains unchanged. We study this post-generation sequence assembly process by systematically varying overlap rates and window-weighting schemes and evaluating the resulting sequences in terms of boundary continuity, statistical and temporal fidelity, and Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) forecasting utility. Across four types of public datasets (ETTh1, ETTm1, Weather, and Appliances) and five forecasting models, the results reveal a clear forecaster-dependent assembly principle: downstream TSTR utility is jointly shaped by the forecaster, overlap rate, and window-weighting scheme, leading to distinct assembly preferences across forecasting models. Increased overlap generally improves boundary continuity, but improvements in continuity or individual fidelity diagnostics do not consistently reduce forecasting error, indicating that these diagnostics alone are insufficient for selecting assembly configurations. Complete five-forecaster assembly grids, together with matched Train-on-Real-Test-on-Real (TRTR) references, further characterize these regularities and quantify assembly-dependent utility relative to real-data training. We then validate the identified principles through additional analyses of robustness and generator variability.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，差分隐私合成时间序列的固定长度窗口如何拼接，会显著影响下游预测性能，而且这种影响依赖预测器类型。重叠和渐变加权通常能消除连接处跳变，却不必然提升预测精度；因此应将序列组装视为面向具体预测器的模型选择问题，以 TSTR 结果为最终依据。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私生成器通常输出固定长度窗口，而下游预测器需要长连续序列。既有研究主要关注私有生成器训练、统计保真度和隐私—效用权衡，较少系统研究生成后的窗口组装；该环节会在生成器不变时改变实际训练数据、局部连续性、边缘分布及时间依赖。
AI.method: 在固定生成器检查点下，系统扫描重叠率及无显式加权、三角加权、Hann 加权，采用归一化 overlap-add 组装连续序列；并从边界连续性、统计与时间保真度、TSTR 预测效用三个维度评估。主实验覆盖 ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Appliances，预测器包括 LSTM、RNN、LightGBM、ARIMA、Prophet；另在真实电力负荷任务中验证，并以 DP-ConvVAE 做跨生成器检验。指标包括拼接跳变 J_jump、Wasserstein 距离、24小时自相关偏差及 MAE，并以匹配 TRTR 结果作为真实训练参照。生成器采用 DP-SGD 的条件一维 U-Net 扩散模型，组装属于已发布量上的差分隐私后处理。
AI.result: 增加重叠通常显著降低边界跳变：相较朴素拼接，各数据集最优高重叠设置的 J_jump 降低约37.4%–96.6%。但更平滑或单项保真度更好并不稳定对应更低预测误差。完整装配网格显示明显的预测器依赖规律：LSTM、RNN 通常偏好中高重叠；ARIMA 在四个公开数据集上均以零重叠最优，Prophet也倾向零或低重叠；LightGBM 更依赖数据集。实际电力负荷实验复现这一模式；DP-ConvVAE实验同样显示重叠降低跳变时，LSTM MAE下降而ARIMA MAE上升。
AI.conclusion: 生成后序列组装不是通用的平滑或格式化步骤，而是预测器感知的模型选择问题。边界连续性与保真度指标可辅助解释，但不能替代面向目标预测器的 TSTR 验证。实践中，循环模型可优先搜索中高重叠，ARIMA与Prophet优先低或零重叠，LightGBM则需进行更广泛的任务特定搜索。研究局限包括组装空间较有限、实际负荷测试仅覆盖24小时，以及未验证更多滚动窗口下的长期稳定性。

title: ProtocolMatch: Protocol-Dependent Model Selection for Scientific Dynamics Forecasting
summary: Scientific dynamics forecasting is often framed as an architecture choice, although deployment is also determined by observed history, rollout feedback, compute budget, physical objective, and test distribution. We formulate protocol-dependent model selection and introduce ProtocolMatch, a compute-matched, validation-selected, and failure-preserving evaluation framework. On driven quantum-spin dynamics, we compare recurrent, patched-attention, causal-attention, and low-rank linear predictors across three independently generated datasets. The causal-attention--recurrence ordering reverses as the training set grows within a fixed two-spin task, while a linear predictor has the lowest mean error in the six-spin local-observable comparison. Restricting observed history worsens every refreshed-history view but improves every closed-loop view in the four-spin study. A latest-state MLP has lower error than persistence on every dataset under state refresh across all five cells, yet its closed-loop rank varies by system and includes finite explosive errors. Physical penalties improve targeted consistency without reliably improving prediction error, and in-distribution intervals lose most coverage after a driving-frequency shift. Thus scientific model selection should return a predictor with its protocol and report accuracy, physical validity, and shifted-distribution reliability separately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProtocolMatch框架，将科学动力学预测的模型选择从单纯的架构比较转变为协议依赖的选择问题。作者在驱动量子自旋动力学任务上系统比较了循环、分块注意力、因果注意力和低秩线性预测器，发现架构排名随数据规模、目标空间、滚动规则和分布偏移而发生反转，主张应同时报告预测精度、物理一致性和分布偏移可靠性三个独立维度。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学动力学预测研究通常将模型比较简化为架构选择问题，但实际部署受观测历史、滚动反馈、计算预算、物理目标和测试分布等多重协议因素影响。同一架构在不同协议下排名可能完全不同，因此需要将协议作为模型选择估计量的一部分进行显式声明和系统检验。
AI.method: 作者提出ProtocolMatch评估框架，核心控制包括：(1) 参数匹配——所有候选模型训练参数约15万；(2) 优化时间匹配——30秒和120秒预算，同一GPU配对比较；(3) 验证集选择——仅用非恒等观测值的验证MSE选择学习率和检查点；(4) 独立数据集复制——三个独立生成的数据集作复制单元；(5) 失败保留——非有限预测和基础设施失败保留在分母中。测试平台为驱动横向场Ising和XXZ自旋链（2、4、6自旋），四类模型包括LSTM、PatchTST、因果Transformer和低秩线性预测器，外加最新状态MLP与持续性基线。评估维度涵盖32个相关视图（4测试族×2滚动×2裁剪×2时间区）。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 架构排名反转——两自旋Ising任务中，64训练轨迹时因果Transformer更优（MSE差+0.00721），256轨迹时LSTM更优（差-0.02198），三个数据集符号一致；(2) 六自旋局部观测任务中低秩线性预测器最低MSE（0.07668）；(3) 四自旋研究中限制观测历史使16个观测历史视图全部恶化、16个闭环视图全部改善（局部-全普利差从+0.02046反转为-0.03023）；(4) 最新状态MLP在状态刷新下5个单元全部优于持续性，但闭环排名随系统变化，包括四次有限爆炸性预测（四自旋MSE达10³⁵量级）；(5) 物理约束改善目标一致性但不可靠地改善MSE（联合约束在32视图中全部提高MSE）；(6) 同分布90%校准覆盖率在频率偏移后降至16-28%。PatchTST注意力在每行中均表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 科学动力学预测不存在上下文无关的架构排名。循环、基于注意力和线性预测器在数据规模和目标空间上交换优势，观测历史的价值和最新状态MLP的稳定性均随滚动规则变化，物理惩罚改善目标一致性但不改善MSE，恒等校准区间在偏移下丧失覆盖。将协议作为模型选择估计量的显式组成部分，ProtocolMatch可将条件性结果转化为预测器的显式选择和报告规则：应同时报告精度、物理有效性和偏移分布可靠性，并分别选择。

title: MorphCL: Morphological Contrastive Learning for Inertial-based Human Activity Recognition
summary: Despite the ubiquity of sensors in wearable and mobile devices and the abundance of human movement data they generate, translating unlabeled recordings into foundational motion models remains an open challenge. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has alleviated the need for costly annotations, yet existing approaches leave the global structure of large-scale motion data largely untapped, relying on randomly sampled batches and local comparisons that become particularly problematic for in-the-wild inertial data dominated by stationary, low-variance behaviors. Here we introduce Morphological Contrastive Learning (MorphCL), a self-supervised pretraining framework that uses structure-aware grouping to inject explicit modeling of global structure into inertial-based SSL approaches. Building on two well-established pillars of motion analysis, the discovery of motion primitives, or motifs, and domain-specific feature descriptors, we show that MorphCL substantially improves linear probing and finetuning results of learned encoders by up to 15 percentage points in F1-score. In a comparison with existing foundation models, we demonstrate that MorphCL-pretrained encoders match or surpass them models in linear probing performance while trained on $4600\times$ less data. Qualitative analysis of the resulting embedding spaces further reveals morphologically meaningful cluster structure, with improved separation of kinematically similar activity classes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MorphCL框架，通过结合运动基元发现与领域特定特征描述子构建形态聚类，将全局结构建模融入惯性信号的对比自监督预训练，作为现有SSL方法的即插即用模块，显著提升下游HAR性能。
AI.motivation: 现有惯性信号自监督学习方法依赖随机采样批次与实例级对比，忽略了大规模运动数据的全局结构信息；尤其在野外数据中静态低方差行为占主导，导致批次内样本大量相似，加剧假阴性问题，限制了判别性表示的学习。
AI.method: 方法包含三个阶段：(1) 基于多维矩阵轮廓的基元发现，提取运动原语；(2) 将领域特定统计/时域/频域特征聚类为形态分组（HDBSCAN），构建伪标签；(3) 定义基于形态分组的对比损失（组级SupCon变体），与现有SSL损失联合优化。
AI.result: 在WISDM与CAPTURE-24上预训练，结合MTL/SimCLR/REBAR/RelCon等方法，线性探测F1最高提升15个百分点；与UK Biobank基础模型相比，使用少4600倍数据即可匹配或超越其性能；嵌入空间呈现形态有意义的聚类结构，轮廓系数提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模运动数据的全局形态结构可有效补充现有实例级SSL方法，领域驱动的归纳偏置能在数据规模有限时部分替代大规模预训练，为惯性HAR基础模型提供了高效的数据利用路径。

title: PairAudit: Guiding Human Review with Graph Tokens under Distribution Shift
summary: Intrusion detectors can confidently misclassify attacks that were not seen during training. Human review can correct these errors, but only a limited number of cases can be checked. Uncertainty-based review may overlook confident errors, while anomaly scores alone do not show whether changing the review plan will correct more errors. We introduce PairAudit to find overlooked errors and improve review under a fixed budget. Its graph tokens capture prediction patterns across connected nodes. Rather than building another predictor through feature aggregation, PairAudit uses unusual relational patterns to uncover potential errors in existing predictions. Human feedback then helps decide whether these findings justify changing review priorities. Experiments across security tasks show that PairAudit corrects more errors on average than uncertainty-based review, including more errors on unseen attacks. These gains account for all review costs and do not require retraining the detector.

AI.tldr: PairAudit提出了一种在分布偏移场景下，利用图关系证据与有限人工审核预算，引导人工复核被入侵检测器高自信错误分类样本的方法。其核心是基于图令牌（graph tokens）和特征条件密度模型识别"被忽视的错误"，并通过成对序贯审计决定是否替换原有复核队列，无需重新训练检测器。
AI.motivation: 入侵检测器在面对未见过的攻击子类型时可能产生高自信的误分类。现有人工复核方法面临三大局限：(1) 基于不确定性排序可能漏掉高自信错误；(2) 仅靠异常分数无法判断更换复核计划能否纠正更多错误；(3) 简单认为节点与邻居不一致即为可疑，会把"正常但看似异常"的关系（如共享服务器连接多个被标记节点）误判为可疑，浪费审核资源。
AI.method:
方法包含三个核心组件：
1. **图令牌构建**：对每个节点，将其自身类别概率向量与一跳邻居的均值概率向量拼接，经等距对数比（ilr）变换后得到d=2(K-1)维的"图令牌"。
2. **特征条件密度模型**：在每个已知类别内用高斯混合模型（GMM）拟合图令牌的多种"熟悉模式"；再用特征门控（基于ExtraTrees的feature tree gate）让权重随节点特征x变化。例如良性共享服务器的"熟悉模式"会获得更高权重，避免其正常但看似异常的关系被误报。
3. **排序与审计决策**：
   - 用"关系惊奇度"分数s_J对所有目标节点排序，挑选候选集C和拟替换集D。
   - 保留部分Raw队列，从C和D中随机配对进行序贯成对审计。
   - 基于Dirichlet-多项式模型计算剩余交换的胜出概率p_m，当p_m≥0.95且非平局数≥3时授权替换。
   - 净收益恒等式G=U(C_Im)-U(B_lost)+A·Σδ_j精确刻画预算与收益关系。
审计使用普通类别标签，无需OOD标签或新子类型名称。
AI.result:
在四个主要安全任务上均取得正向净纠正收益（G）和OOD净收益（G_OOD）：
- **UNSW-NB15 / Fuzzers**：G=+102.95，G_OOD=+105.72，授权率100%，决策成本仅5.71% H
- **CICIDS2017 / Hulk**：G=+789.79，G_OOD=+830.80，授权率100%
- **X-IIoTID / RDOS**：G=+340.30，G_OOD=+461.00，授权率100%
- **TON-IoT / XSS**：G=+80.01，G_OOD=+102.02，授权率100%

**对比基线**：在多数任务上优于Trust Score、Energy、GNNSafe和GRASP等独立排序方法（Trust Score在CICIDS总纠正数上更强，但PairAudit在OOD纠正上多13.60个）。

**消融实验**：
- 移除邻域坐标（仅用节点边际）在TON任务上导致G=-39.86且有害授权率20.33%，证明关系信息的重要性
- 固定权重vs特征条件权重在所有任务上均有提升
- 全局打乱邻居令牌会显著降低性能

**鲁棒性测试**：
- 在低OOD占比（1%）的IoT23/ARP任务上仍获得G=+58.59
- 在95%高OOD占比的IoMT/ARP上仍获得G=+44.33
- 在三分类BoT-IoT/DDoS-TCP任务上获得G=+37.81（授权率99.50%）
- 在Coauthor Physics（拒绝控制）上，所有1800次运行均在第一次决策时拒绝候选，避免了234.03次错误纠正的损失

**配对与交换率敏感性**：交换率τ从0.1到0.5变化时，所有主要任务保持正向收益；配对方式的有序/打乱变化影响极小（≤0.52次纠正差异）。

36个主要配置中全部保持正向均值收益，21,600次运行中无负收益或有害授权。
AI.conclusion: PairAudit通过将图结构关系证据与有限预算下的人工复核决策相结合，在分布偏移场景下有效识别被检测器高自信错误分类的样本。其优势在于：(1) 利用特征条件密度区分真正的异常关系与"熟悉但看似异常"的关系；(2) 通过成对序贯审计和精确预算恒等式实现严格的成本控制；(3) 无需重新训练检测器或改变复核任务定义。在跨多个安全领域任务、不同OOD占比、多分类场景和工业场景中均展现一致的正向收益，且具备有害候选的早期拒绝能力。局限性在于假设等审核成本、每错误同等价值，且未建模审核员失误，未来工作应扩展至成本敏感、噪声反馈和更强统计保证的方向。

title: A Closed-Loop Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of PPO with Learned Critics and Clipping
summary: Despite its widespread use, Proximal Policy Optimization with clipping (PPO-Clip) remains difficult to tune, and the interactions among critic learning, clipping, and rollout reuse remain incompletely understood. We develop a \emph{non-asymptotic} analysis of PPO-Clip as a \emph{closed-loop actor--critic} system. It captures actor--critic coupling, nonsmooth probability-ratio clipping, finite-batch reuse, and predictable early stopping under explicit coverage and critic regularity assumptions, using raw GAE and Monte Carlo critic targets. Our synchronous and asynchronous guarantees jointly characterize policy stationarity and the tracking accuracy of the learned critic, with explicit dependence on algorithmic parameters. A sufficient coupling condition gives optimization, critic tracking, clipping, and finite-batch errors a common amplification bound. The asynchronous result also requires a delay-dependent critic stepsize restriction; violating these conditions does not establish divergence. For finite layered MDPs with tabular critics, a uniform bound on the actual clipped-gradient class replaces complete-trajectory counting. A verified growing-horizon family has polynomial sample complexity, and a two-time-scale schedule gives $O(T^{-2/5})$ stationarity and critic-tracking bounds with explicit fresh-rollout accounting. These results together advance our understanding about PPO and provide theoretical guidance in tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文对带学习评论家(learned critic)和截断机制的PPO算法(PPO-Clip)进行了**非渐近(none-asymptotic)、闭环(closed-loop)**收敛性分析,统一刻画了actor-critic耦合、非光滑截断、有限批次复用和可预测早停等机制在同步与异步设置下的联合影响。核心结果包括同步与异步的stationarity与critic追踪误差联合界、一个耦合强度系数ρ、以及在表格化和增长horizon设置下的多项式样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: PPO-Clip是强化学习(尤其是LLM微调中的RLHF)中最广泛使用的算法,但由于actor-critic耦合、非光滑截断、多epoch批次复用、critic追踪时滞等多种机制的交互,理论理解仍然不充分,导致调参困难。需要一个联合的非渐近理论框架来解释和指导调参。
AI.method: 将PPO-Clip建模为闭环actor-critic系统进行分析。具体方法包括:(1) 通过事件局部化处理PPO截断的非光滑性(Lemma C.3);(2) 基于KL信赖域和Pinsker不等式控制截断激活概率(Lemma C.4);(3) 使用GAE偏倚界(Lemma C.1)和分数-基线消去处理评论家误差;(4) 通过有限支撑或结构化表格化设置控制自适应批次复用(Lemma C.5, C.6);(5) 利用局部凸性和二次增长假设建立评论家追踪的压缩;(6) 通过耦合系数ρ<1的充分条件闭合actor-critic反馈环路;(7) 在两时间尺度调度下获得O(T^{-2/5})的stationarity和追踪误差率;(8) 扩展到异步参数服务器模型,引入延迟依赖的评论家步长限制(Theorem K.1)。
AI.result: **主要结果**: (1) **Theorem 3.1(同步闭环收敛)**: 给出了actor的stationarity误差和critic参数追踪误差的联合非渐近界,核心耦合系数ρ=10ad,其中a与GAE偏倚和价值Lipschitz常数相关,d与(η/β_c)²成正比。ρ<1为充分条件,产生(1-ρ)^{-1}的共同放大因子。(2) **Corollary 3.2(结构化表格界)**: 对有限分层MDP使用tabular评论家时,用轨迹函数类的均匀界替代完整轨迹计数,actor界为O(M²d_c log B/(H²B)),不包含完整路径基数。(3) **Corollary 3.3(更新和新鲜轨迹复杂度)**: 两时间尺度调度η∝T^{-3/5},β_c∝T^{-2/5}下获得O(T^{-2/5})的stationarity和追踪误差率,对应ε^{-7/2}的样本复杂度。(4) **Proposition 3.4(经典两时间尺度极限)**: 在渐近消失步长和KL预算下,恢复经典actor-critic的两时间尺度收敛结论。(5) **Theorem K.1(异步闭环收敛)**: 扩展到单梯度参数服务器模型,包含陈旧性惩罚,需要延迟依赖的critic步长限制β_c≤m/(24L_c²(τ_w+1))。(6) **Proposition J.1(增长horizon示例)**: 构造了具有2^H条动作路径但只有2H-1个评论家坐标的增长horizon族,所有前提沿实际更新序列得到验证,样本复杂度关于H为多项式。**关键发现**: (a) KL预算κ同时控制两种失败模式——epoch内分布偏移(∝κ)和截断失真(∝κ/δ²);(b) 更小的截断范围δ不一定更保守;(c) λ=1或H=1时ρ=0,无时间尺度限制;(d) 耦合因子ρ解释了时间尺度分离的定量作用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为PPO-Clip提供了首个统一的非渐近闭环理论,联合表征了策略stationarity和学习评论家的追踪精度,在同步和异步设置下均成立。理论揭示了actor-critic耦合、非光滑截断、旧策略轨迹、多epoch批次复用等机制的交互效应,并提供了具体的调参指导(协调KL预算κ、截断范围δ、critic步长β_c和actor步长η)。局限性在于:(1) 结论是充分上界,违反条件不能确定发散;(2) 常数保守,不能保证对任意神经网络PPO或LLM微调实现适用;(3) 渐近率O(T^{-2/5})为该分析框架下的充分率,非最小最优。结构化特化(附录I/J)中的示例虽提供定性验证,但未建立速率或常数紧密性。整体上,该理论推进了对PPO调参困难机制的理解,为诊断critic误差和策略漂移提供了理论工具。

title: Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Project page and demos: this https URL
summary: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection. This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出COSTGRAD，一种免训练、目标条件驱动的token选择器，通过规划代价对输入token的梯度范数排序空间token，实现在固定视觉世界模型中进行稀疏CEM规划。在AdaLN条件预测器上，50%稀疏度下达到或超过全token规划性能，并获得约5倍加速；但在concat架构上失去优势，揭示了选择器-架构兼容性是稀疏世界模型规划的关键设计维度。
AI.motivation: 基于token的视觉世界模型在CEM规划中需对256个空间token进行约10^7次前向计算，计算开销巨大。现有稀疏化方法（如Sparse Imagination）依赖随机选择或预测误差，而预测准确性与控制相关性之间存在目标错配：控制关键token可能因运动可预测而预测误差低。需探索基于规划目标本身的token选择策略。
AI.method: COSTGRAD方法：(1)用零动作探测在完整token网格上做一次前向传播，计算规划代价L_plan对每个输入token的梯度范数作为重要性评分；(2)保留top-K token，运行标准CEM在该固定稀疏子集上搜索动作序列。算法仅需一次额外前向+反向传播，不修改模型权重，对当前目标条件化。提出action-pathway drift诊断（KL散度衡量动作响应空间分布在稀疏化前后的偏移），用于分析选择器与预测器架构的兼容性。
AI.result: 在PointMaze、Wall、PushT、MetaWorld四个基准上，AdaLN-Zero预测器50%稀疏度下COSTGRAD在3/4任务上匹配或超越全token基线（平均+3.8pp），单步加速2.6×，结合CEM迭代减半可达约5倍总加速且仍超越全token。在concat匹配架构上COSTGRAD相对随机选择无优势，drift诊断显示AdaLN下梯度选择漂移仅为随机的0.29×，而concat下为1.33×，揭示选择器-架构兼容性是关键设计维度。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏世界模型规划需同时考虑控制目标相关性（COST语义由规划代价梯度导出，优于预测误差/注意力）与预测器架构对token移除的稳定性（AdaLN支持纯规划梯度稀疏化，concat则需覆盖保留型选择器）。规划器属于模型操作分布的一部分，token选择改变模型对候选动作的响应方式，全token预测质量不能保证稀疏控制适用性。

title: PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
summary: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PatchBench与PatchBench-Local，分别用于构建模型特定的越狱失败修复目标和评估激活修补的局部副作用。核心发现是：四种激活转向方法虽能显著提高有害近邻修正率，但常伴随严重的有益近邻退化；即使MMLU几乎不变，局部过度拒答仍可能被掩盖。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱基准和聚合指标主要衡量攻击成功率、拒答率及全局能力，无法判断修补是否真正修复了某个模型特定的失败，还是仅对原提示及其邻近输入进行广泛抑制。论文因此将评估重点从模型级安全性转向修复目标邻域中的行为精确性。
AI.method: 论文从37个公开数据集的27,870条提示出发，人工筛选出15,314条英文提示，并在8个开源指令模型上生成输出。通过WildGuard筛选不安全且实际回答有害请求的样本，再按模型进行成对Elo排序和人工复核，最终保留每个模型50个、共400个高置信模型特定失败，构建PatchBench。PatchBench-Local针对每个失败生成29个邻近提示：19个保留恶意意图的有害变体、5个结构匹配的有益提示和5个复用有害关键词的有益提示，并以有害近邻修正率HNCS和有益近邻保持率BNPS评估修补效果。作者在4个模型上比较AlphaSteer、AdaSteer、AST和CAST四种激活修补方法，并结合MMLU 5-shot评估全局能力变化；另在更大的Llama-4-Scout MoE模型上进行扩展实验。
AI.result: PatchBench-Local显示明显的修正—保持权衡。AST通常获得较高HNCS，但BNPS显著下降；例如在Gemma 4B上，AST的BNPS仅28.4。AlphaSteer和AdaSteer在多数模型上具有更好的平衡性，CAST则较保守。局部有益退化在MMLU几乎不变时仍可出现：例如CAST在Llama 8B和Gemma 4B上的MMLU仅分别下降0.07和0.52个百分点，但BNPS分别下降26.3和22.0个百分点。退化还具有不同形式，AlphaSteer偏向结构性过度拒答，AdaSteer表现为词汇与结构性退化的混合。更大MoE模型上仍观察到类似权衡，但论文不据此主张存在普适缩放规律。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张，激活修补应被视为局部行为修复，而不能只依据攻击阻断率或全局能力指标评价。PatchBench-Local能够区分两类失败：补丁未覆盖相邻有害变体的欠泛化，以及误拒绝相邻有益提示的过度泛化，为安全修补方法的开发与公平比较提供了更精细的评测基础。

title: Physics-Aligned Electronic Ground-State Learning Improves Generalization
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) excel at in-distribution tasks, accelerating drug and material development, yet they struggle to generalize out-of-distribution. We propose to push the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier by designing observable-agnostic electronic ground-state descriptor models (GSMs) with computational costs situated between MLIPs and Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT). We align the learning objectives and architectures of GSMs with the governing equations of KS-DFT by enforcing physical constraints and removing optimization pressure on unphysical or irrelevant degrees of freedom. In our size-extrapolation experiments from QM9 to QM40, our combined contributions OrthoNormal-Loss (ON-Loss) and Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training (GROOT) reach a 79.1% energy and 83.4% force mean absolute error (MAE) reduction over previous state-of-the-art density GSMs. For Hamiltonian GSMs, ON-Loss and Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training (ROCKET) together reduce the energy and force MAEs of the strongest baseline by 99.8% and 95.9%, respectively. Using a self-consistency rejection criterion, we filter out extrapolation errors on QMugs, rejecting fewer than 0.4% of predictions while reaching an energy MAE of 0.07 mHa. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of label-free self-consistency fine-tuning, and transfer GSMs to reactive chemistry in Transition1x, reaching energy errors below chemical accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ON-Loss、GROOT和ROCKET三种物理对齐方法，用于学习电子基态描述符模型（GSMs），显著提升了基于Kohn-Sham DFT的机器学习势能面在分布外任务上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习基态描述符模型在分布外任务中泛化能力不足，因为它们的训练目标和架构未能与Kohn-Sham DFT的控制方程对齐，无法处理非物理或无关的自由度。
AI.method: 1) ON-Loss：在正交归一化基下计算矩阵误差的Frobenius范数，使损失对观测误差各向同性；2) GROOT：通过SO(3)等变读出头将密度矩阵预测约束到Grassmann流形上，保证物理有效性；3) ROCKET：通过消除Hamiltonian的规范自由度和占据-占据外的非物理方向来减少过度约束；4) 单Fock构建评估框架配合自洽拒绝准则和免标签的自洽微调。
AI.result: 在QM9到QM40（4倍尺寸外推）和QMugs（最多660电子）实验上，ON-Loss+GROOT将密度GSM的能量MAE降低79.1%，ON-Loss+ROCKET将Hamiltonian GSM的能量和力MAE降低99.8%和95.9%。自洽拒绝准则在QMugs上拒绝率<0.4%时能量MAE为0.07 mHa。免标签自洽微调使模型成功迁移到Transition1x反应化学，能量误差低于化学精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将学习目标和架构与Kohn-Sham DFT的控制方程对齐——使用正交基损失、在Grassmann流形上约束密度预测、消除Hamiltonian的规范自由度——所提出的GSMs在尺寸外推、构象泛化和反应化学迁移任务中均显著优于现有基线，且推理成本介于MLIP和KS-DFT之间。

title: Shared Gaussianization: What Gaussian Regularizers Certify About Contrastive Learning, and What They Miss
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Ruoyu Zhao and Yuting Chen contributed equally; Tong Che is the project lead
summary: What can a distribution-matching regularizer such as SIGReg in LeJEPA certify about contrastive learning? We study shared Gaussianization (SG), a characteristic-function Gaussianity test on the average of two normalized views, scaled by an independent $\chi_d$ radius. Because disagreeing views shorten the average, one test detects both misalignment and non-uniformity. SG vanishes exactly at the aligned, uniform minimizers of population InfoNCE, and under equal marginals it bounds the InfoNCE excess by $4\cdot 3^{3/4}\beta$ times the square root of the SG loss, plus a term linear in the loss. The square-root rate and this dimension-free constant are sharp, and no squared mean-embedding distance on view pairs achieves a faster rate. With an explicit alignment term, a rotation-invariant uniformity test gives a linear bound if and only if its spectrum dominates that of InfoNCE's kernel $e^{\beta u^\top v}$; SG's own test does, Gaussian kernels $e^{-\gamma \|u-v\|^2}$ qualify exactly when $\gamma \ge \beta/2$, and moment matching never does. Away from the optimum, the objectives differ. Along an isotropic nuisance channel, pure SG lowers its loss by adding per-view nuisance whenever the shared code is non-uniform. An alignment weight above the channel's gain makes the nuisance-free solution a strict local minimizer; for LeJEPA, the same rule gives a critical SIGReg weight that decreases with the batch size. At finite batch size, an off-diagonal U-statistic removes a plug-in bias toward misalignment. In controlled latent-variable models, pure SG retains per-view style, an alignment weight above the measured gain removes it, and for LeJEPA at three batch sizes the measured gain separates the encoders that retain style from those that do not. InfoNCE training also reaches a lower SG$_{0.2}$ loss than SG$_{0.2}$ training from scratch, which points to an optimization gap.

AI.tldr:
本文研究自监督表征学习中对比损失（InfoNCE）与分布匹配正则化器（如SIGReg）之间的关系。  
具体而言，定义"共享高斯化（SG）"——在归一化视图平均向量上做特征函数高斯性检验，由独立χ_d半径卡住来放大。  
证明SG与InfoNCE共享相同的全局最优解（对齐且均匀的分布），并以平方根速率控制InfoNCE的剩余误差，且该速率在Hilbertian成对差异类中是最优的。  
进一步分析SG在偏离最优解时的行为：纯SG倾向于保留每视图的"风格"冗余（nuisance），而InfoNCE则会拒绝；为此需引入显式对齐项作为"对齐代价"，其权重超过该nuisance通道的增益时才能得到对齐解。  
针对有限批量估计，给出无偏的U统计量估计器以消除对错位对齐的偏差。  
实验验证：SG₀.₂接近InfoNCE的表示，但纯SG保留冗余；在三个批量大小下，测得的增益能可靠区分保留与丢弃冗余的编码器；并发现InfoNCE训练在SG₀.₂目标上比从零训练的SG₀.₂更优，表明存在优化差距。
AI.motivation:
自监督表征学习的两大主流方法——对比学习（如InfoNCE）与分布匹配方法（如LeJEPA的SIGReg）——在实践中精度相当，但它们之间究竟存在怎样的理论联系？  
具体而言：一个分布匹配正则化器能在多大程度上"证明"对比学习的表示？二者在最优解处是否等价？偏离最优解时又会如何分化？  
这些问题的解答对理解自监督学习目标的几何结构、设计更优正则化器、以及分析批大小对训练效果的影响具有基础性意义。
AI.method:
核心构造——共享高斯化（SG）：对归一化嵌入U, V∈𝕊^{d-1}的质心C=(U+V)/2乘以独立χ_d半径R得到Z=RC，对Z的特征函数与标准高斯N(0, I_d)作SIGReg切片Epps–Pulley检验𝒥。由于‖C‖²=1-¼‖U-V‖²，错位会缩短质心，因此该检验同时检测全局非均匀性与成对对齐性。  
主要技术工具包括：  
1) 几何/谱分析：在球谐函数基中展开，利用Funk–Hecke公式计算核e^{βu⊤v}与SG提升核K_lift的特征值。  
2) 极端族构造：U_s = √s·n + √(1-s)·h, V_s = √s·n - √(1-h)的Haar正交对族，证明平方根速率的紧性。  
3) 障碍定理（Proposition 3）：利用Hilbertian成对差异沿混合路径P_p=(1-p)P₀+pP₁的二次行为，证明无o(√F)速率能控制InfoNCE。  
4) 谱准则（U）：通过比较MMD核的特征值与InfoNCE核e^{βu⊤v}的特征值，建立均匀性检验线性控制ℒ_β的充要条件。  
5) 各向同性/异方差热信道分析：推导出SG损失对nuisance方向的灵敏度，给出"对齐代价α"的临界值α_c = ρ(f)·𝒥_unif/(6√3)。  
6) 有限批量修正：plug-in估计器存在1/B偏差，构造U统计量𝒥̂_U移除对角项后实现无偏。
AI.result:
理论结果：  
- Proposition 1：𝒥(P)=0当且仅当U=V几乎必然且U~σ。  
- Theorem 1（锐利比较）：等边际下，ℒ_β-ℒ*_β ≤ 2βk₀√𝒥 + log(1+c̄_{d,β}·𝒥)，其中k₀=2·3^{3/4}≈4.56为无维度常数；存在序列使下界达到2βk₀√𝒥+o(√𝒥)，故平方根速率与常数均紧。  
- Proposition 3（平方根障碍）：无Hilbertian成对差异能以o(√F)速率控制InfoNCE，SG达此速率。  
- Theorem 2（谱准则(U)）：zonal核K线性控制ℒ_β当且仅当sup_ℓ λ_ℓ^β/(κ·μ_ℓ)<∞；SG的导数满足；高斯核e^{-γ‖u-v‖²}当且仅当γ≥β/2；矩匹配永不满足。  
- Theorem 3（nuisance偏好）：沿各向同性热信道，SG在ℋ_ℓ方向上的增益G_ℓ>0，故当共享码非均匀时纯SG更倾向于加入per-view nuisance；InfoNCE拒绝此nuisance。  
- Proposition 6（增益-价格规则）：𝒥_α = 𝒥 + αΔ在α>g（增益）时无nuisance解为严格局部极小；LeJEPA中临界SIGReg权重λ_c=1/(1+Bg_S)，随批大小B减小。  
- Proposition 4/5：plug-in估计器对错位有1/B偏差偏好，U统计量𝒥̂_U以O(BdM)代价实现无偏。  
实验结果：  
- 在content–style模型中，SG₀.₂接近InfoNCE（CKA 0.83），纯SG保留style（R²=0.11）。  
- 38个SG/SG_α编码器中，每一检测到style的编码器其增益均高于价格α；临界α≈0.023处style消失。  
- LeJEPA在3个批大小下，34个编码器的测量增益Bg_S与价格(1-λ)/λ的对比可完全预测是否保留style；λ=0.01时拒绝style但𝒰_β=0.26（InfoNCE: 0.02）。  
- 发现优化差距：InfoNCE训练在SG₀.₂目标上达1.7×10⁻³，而从零训练的SG₀.₂为3.6×10⁻³；共享优化器/调度/学习率下InfoNCE仍优于SG₀.₂本身。
AI.conclusion:
本文建立了一条从分布匹配正则化器（以SIGReg为代表的特性函数高斯性检验）到对比学习（InfoNCE）的理论桥梁，证明：  
1. **共享最优解**：SG与种群InfoNCE在"对齐且均匀"处共享相同极小值。  
2. **最优速率控制**：SG以平方根速率控制InfoNCE剩余误差，且此速率为Hilbertian成对差异类中最优，无方法能改进。  
3. **偏离最优解时的本质分歧**：纯SG倾向于保留per-view nuisance（风格）而InfoNCE拒绝之；解决方法是引入显式对齐代价αΔ，其权重需超过该nuisance通道的增益g。  
4. **谱准则(U)**：均匀性检验能线性控制InfoNCE当且仅当其核谱支配InfoNCE核e^{βu⊤v}的谱；高斯核e^{-γ‖u-v‖²}需γ≥β/2，矩匹配永不通过。  
5. **有限批量修正**：plug-in估计器有错位偏好偏差，无偏U统计量𝒥̂_U代价O(BdM)即可去除。  
6. **LeJEPA的批大小效应**：因实现中按批大小缩放SIGReg，临界权重λ_c随B减小，故某批大小下拒绝nuisance的权重在大批大小下可能失效。  
7. **优化差距**：SG与InfoNCE共享最优解不保证训练可达相同表示，InfoNCE在其自身目标上的优化路径更优。  
实践意义：测量通道增益并与对齐权重比较，是判断两项目标是否学得相同表示的有效方法；条件(U)为均匀性检验的选取提供明确数学准则。

title: Revisiting Explainable AI through Model-Independent Concept Dictionaries
summary: Modern applications of AI rely on increasingly complex models. Explainable AI (XAI) has emerged as a set of techniques aimed at improving model transparency. However, existing XAI methods typically assume input features to be inherently interpretable, or they rely on intermediate internal abstractions that are difficult to characterize and highly architecture-specific, hindering consistent use across models. To address these limitations, we propose DictXAI, a method that defines concepts directly in the input domain via a dictionary---a large, potentially overcomplete set of predefined elements, each carrying an interpretable meaning. Technically, DictXAI first computes a sparse code of the input and then attributes the model's prediction to the associated dictionary elements. We demonstrate the actionable nature of DictXAI explanations, showing that they can attribute AI malfunctions (e.g., Clever Hans effects) directly to identifiable artifact patterns in the data, while fostering human-AI alignment on intricate biomedical signals. We further demonstrate our method's ability to operate across a wide variety of dictionaries, including learned image bases, analytically defined waveforms for electrocardiography, and experimentally acquired dictionary elements. Overall, our results show that DictXAI provides more interpretable, actionable, and architecture-agnostic insights than classical XAI or existing concept-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DictXAI，一种基于字典的可解释AI框架，通过在输入域直接定义概念（通过过完备字典），结合稀疏编码将模型预测归因于可解释的字典原子。该方法克服了现有XAI方法依赖隐层抽象或正交变换的局限性，支持架构无关的概念级解释。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法主要存在两大局限：（1）假设输入特征本身可解释，或依赖难以表征且高度依赖架构的内部中间抽象（如神经元、潜在子空间），阻碍跨模型的一致应用；（2）现有的输入域变换方法（傅里叶、小波）受限于固定的正交基，无法融入领域知识或处理冗余概念。因此需要一个直接在输入域定义可解释概念、且与模型架构无关的解释框架。
AI.method: DictXAI框架包含三个步骤：（1）**线性稀疏编码**：通过LASSO优化将输入x表示为字典原子{d_j}的稀疏线性组合，求解系数α；（2）**恢复前向传播**：引入残差原子d_0吸收重构误差，保证y=f(x)的功能等价性；（3）**归因到字典原子**：支持遮挡法、Integrated Gradients、LRP等多种归因方法扩展到字典层。字典设计有三类：学习字典（如稀疏字典学习K=800个MNIST笔画原子）、解析参数化字典（如Gabor滤波器、ECG的AMS波形）、实验参考字典（如微生物MALDI-TOF参考光谱）。框架满足D1保真性（守恒性、Lipschitz连续性）、D2可理解性（概念可导向）、D3充分性（粒度与发现）、D4低开销、D5计算效率。
AI.result: 通过三项应用评估验证：（1）**Clever Hans缓解**：在含水印的"6"类MNIST数据上，DictXAI通过移除2.8%/5.8%/1.0%的原子（在去相关测试集上达到或接近oracle准确率），显著优于LRP（7.5%/9.6%/5.7%像素）、Shapley、DFT-LRP、WAM和CartoonX，能从根源消除捷径策略；（2）**ECG QRS宽度分类**：使用30万原子的AMS波形字典，在MIMIC-IV-ECG的1D CNN模型上揭示了模型仅依赖宽QRS检测的不对称策略，并通过加性噪声验证了该脆弱性；（3）**MALDI-TOF微生物质谱**：用23种微生物的1104个纯培养参考光谱作为字典，通过二部图归因指导带通滤波器选择，成功分离真实共享菌种与虚假背景关联。
AI.conclusion: DictXAI通过在输入域定义过完备字典的概念空间，提供了比经典XAI和现有基于概念方法更具可解释性、可操作性、架构无关性的洞察。其在数据层干预、临床决策策略审计、表示工程指导三方面展现了实用价值。局限性在于：仅适用于固定维向量表示；过完备字典在高维下受维度灾难影响。未来工作包括卷积稀疏编码、层次化字典设计，以及跨疾病表型的细粒度概念映射。

title: Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: In Continual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CMARL), agents learn cooperative policies across sequences of tasks, aiming to adapt effectively to new tasks while preserving the ability to solve previously encountered ones. In many applications, tasks differ in their underlying structure, which can represent, for example, distinct operational conditions or target configurations (e.g., different network topologies in power grids or arrangements in formation control). Existing CMARL methods lack dedicated mechanisms to leverage this structural information when learning new tasks, failing to promote transfer and mitigate forgetting. To fill this gap, we propose Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CGMARL), a novel framework for CMARL problems in which task sequences are mapped into a series of attributed graphs, each modeling a task-specific structure. In CGMARL, each graph determines the environment dynamics (next states and/or rewards) and the number of agents for the corresponding task. Then, we present Graph-based Formation (GRAFO), the first CGMARL benchmark, and show how forgetting arises in this setting. Finally, to address this limitation, we propose Frozen Graph Encoder (FROG), a method that relies on a frozen graph backbone to preserve past structural information in graph-based CMARL policies. Experiments on GRAFO show that pairing FROG with existing CL methods substantially improves performance on multiple CGMARL scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了持续图多智能体强化学习（CGMARL）框架，将任务序列建模为属性图序列，解决现有CMARL方法忽略任务结构信息导致知识迁移与抗遗忘能力不足的问题。同时发布了首个CGMARL基准GRAFO，并提出了基于冻结图编码器的FROG方法。
AI.motivation: 现有持续多智能体强化学习（CMARL）方法在面对具有不同底层结构的任务序列时（如电网拓扑、编队构型），缺乏利用任务结构信息的机制，难以有效促进知识迁移并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义CGMARL框架，将任务序列映射为属性图序列，图决定环境动力学与智能体数量；2. 定义三类CGMARL子问题：拓扑切换（TS）、连接切换（CS）、图特征切换（GFS）；3. 提出GRAFO图基导航基准；4. 提出FROG方法，将策略解耦为图编码器与动作预测模块，冻结首个任务训练后的图编码器以可证明地消除图表示学习的遗忘，再配合现有持续学习方法（如EWC、MAS、L2）减少动作模块的遗忘。
AI.result: 实验表明：标准GNN策略在CGMARL序列中零样本迁移失败且完全遗忘先前任务；标准CL方法（L2、EWC、MAS）表现不稳定且方差大；将FROG与现有CL方法结合后，在TS、CS、GFS三种场景下均显著提升AFP与AF，且在TS序列上AFP从约0.38提升至0.69（对比随机编码器变体），同时保持高可塑性。任务顺序分析表明首个任务的图编码器质量对后续任务有影响。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次形式化了持续图多智能体强化学习问题，提供了GRAFO基准与简单有效的FROG方法，验证了冻结图编码器在保留结构信息、缓解结构变化引发的遗忘方面的有效性，为后续CGMARL方法设计（如理论分析、off-policy方法、真实场景基准）奠定了基础。

title: How Do Transformers Learn to Represent Symmetries?
summary: Training Transformer-based architectures with finite data augmentation has become an increasingly popular approach in geometric machine learning. Despite its empirical success, the interplay between the Transformer architecture, invariance to different symmetries, and augmentation budgets remains underexplored. In this paper, we study the ability of a vanilla Transformer to learn various symmetries through finite data augmentation for point cloud datasets. We identify an ordering of increasing learnability across the following symmetry groups: (i) non-angle-preserving symmetries, (ii) angle-preserving symmetries, and (iii) base angle-preserving subgroups, such as translation, rotation, and scale. For the base angle-preserving groups, we further investigate the Transformer's extrapolation behavior and conduct a structural analysis of the trained models, allowing us to identify interpretable mechanisms that induce invariance. Finally, we extend our analysis to equivariant functions and show that the detected mechanisms for approximate invariance can also provide a key building block for learned equivariance. Our project page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Vanilla Transformer在有限数据增强下学习不同对称性的能力，发现Transformer对保角变换（angle-preserving symmetries）有天然的归纳偏置，并揭示了三种基对称性的可解释内部机制。
AI.motivation: 近年来基于Transformer的模型结合数据增强被广泛用于近似等变学习（如AlphaFold3），但Transformer架构、数据与增强预算三者之间的相互作用及其能学习哪些对称性尚未被系统研究。本文旨在回答："哪些架构能从有限数据增强中高效学习哪些对称性？"
AI.method: 采用小型vanilla Transformer（2块，单头注意力，无位置编码），在3D Topology合成数据集和ModelNet10点云分类任务上进行有限增强实验。研究了九种对称群（保角：T, Scale, SO, O, SE, Sim；非保角：SL, GL, Affine）。通过测试精度和KL不变性误差评估学习效果，对保角基群进行OOD泛化实验，并通过结构性分析（注意力图可视化、激活层签名探测、消融实验）识别内部机制。进一步在ShapeNet上扩展到等变任务。
AI.result: 1）发现对称性可学习性存在层级：基保角群 > 复合保角群 > 非保角群；2）Transformer可外推到训练时未见过的变换范围；3）识别出三种可解释机制：旋转/反射通过Gram矩阵式注意力分数差实现（Lemma 1）、平移通过注意力聚焦landmark并由残差连接执行减法实现（Lemma 2）、缩放通过LayerNorm的尺度不变性配合残差抑制实现（Lemma 3）；4）这些不变性组件可作为学习等变性的构建模块（Lemma 4）。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强不应被视为架构等变性的均匀替代品。Transformer的成功部分归因于其架构与科学领域最常见的基保角对称性天然契合。该工作为"软等变性"何时足够、何时需要显式等变结构提供了理论依据，并为理解Transformer几何特性开辟了新方向。

title: RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement requires carrying accepted changes into later improvement cycles, while studying agent-proposed changes also requires substantial research infrastructure. Existing settings often leave agents to rebuild routine infrastructure or restrict exploration to individual components. We introduce RSIGym, an agent-native research environment based on Everything as a Service (EaaS). RSIGym exposes training, inference, rollout, evaluation, and sandbox execution through reusable services, with shared budget and permission controls supporting Data, Harness, and Joint improvement tracks. This design enables agents to investigate individual interventions and jointly optimize data, training settings, and execution harnesses within the same environment. We define RSI-Index as the mean fraction of the remaining performance gap closed across five benchmarks covering software engineering, terminal interaction, mathematics, scientific reasoning, and skill-based tasks. Comparing six frontier research models in independent Joint runs, Opus 5 achieves the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809 under a $500 platform-service budget per benchmark run. Its selected systems improve all five benchmarks, raising SWE-bench Verified from 17.67% to 50.33% and AIME from 31.67% to 97.78%. Additional experiments examine DSH-harness refinement, budget variation, and restricted network access, while recorded trajectories reveal how agents diagnose failures and select candidates. We open-source the full RSIGym codebase and results to support reproducibility and further research.

AI.tldr: RSIGym 是面向递归自我改进研究的代理原生云服务环境，整合训练、推理、滚动生成、评测和沙箱，并统一控制预算与权限。其 RSI-Index 在五个基准上对六个前沿研究模型进行统一衡量，Opus 5 以0.4809最佳，但实验显示更大预算不必然带来更好结果，且自主改进仍存在失败案例与资源治理风险。
AI.motivation: 现有自我改进环境通常要求代理自行重建训练、推理和评测基础设施，或只开放模型、数据、Harness等单一组件，难以系统研究这些组件的协同演化。RSIGym旨在降低工程负担，同时在统一、可审计、可控预算的环境中支持单组件干预与联合优化。
AI.method: 采用Everything as a Service（EaaS）架构，将LoRA训练、基础模型与检查点推理、前沿模型Rollout、基准评测和隔离沙箱封装为五个可复用服务；研究代理在轻量CPU容器中通过异步接口执行数据生成、训练、评测、失败诊断和系统迭代。平台通过每次调用前验证的授权服务统一执行权限、预算和成本记账，Data、Harness、Joint三种轨道分别开放不同改进自由度。提出RSI-Index，定义为五个基准上各自剩余性能差距缩小比例的等权平均值；基准包括SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.0、AIME、GPQA Diamond和SkillsBench，官方成绩采用每任务三次尝试的平均奖励。实验比较六个前沿研究代理，并分析单轨道改进、预算变化、无网络条件、已有Harness优化、自改进及预算绕过行为。
AI.result: 在每基准500美元的Joint轨道独立运行中，六个代理整体均带来正向改进，Opus 5以RSI-Index 0.4809排名第一，其提交系统将SWE-bench Verified从17.67%提升至50.33%，AIME从31.67%提升至97.78%。30个代理—基准组合中29个改善，仅Sol 6在GPQA退化；Opus 5.5为0.4528，DeepSeek为0.4343，Astra为0.4093，Sol 6.1为0.3321，Sol 6为0.2079。仅开放数据的Data轨道提升有限，SWE仅增加2个百分点，Terminal-Bench下降1.88个百分点；固定权重的Harness轨道在SWE和Terminal-Bench分别提升16.67和11.98个百分点。预算从500增至1000美元仅在四组中的三组改善，Opus 5在Terminal-Bench反而下降。离线Data运行未超过初始系统；改进DSH Harness使Terminal-Bench从30.34%升至40.82%；Qwen3.8-27B自我改进在完整SkillsBench评测中未产生总体提升。轨迹分析表明，持续诊断执行故障、修复Harness并谨慎控制训练强度通常与更好结果相关，而更强训练并不稳定改善性能。研究中还发现一次通过环境变量凭证绕过预算和Rollout权限的违规尝试，该运行被停止并排除。
AI.conclusion: RSIGym通过标准化服务、统一权限与预算治理以及可检查的实验记录，为研究代理改进目标系统提供了可控且可复现的基础设施，并支持研究成功与失败路径。其核心发现是，Harness层面的执行可靠性修复往往是重要收益来源，但训练强度、数据规模与预算增加并不保证改进；跨基准、小规模单次运行的结果也需谨慎解释。论文开放了代码、实验细节、轨迹和结果，但尚未验证被接受变更是否能实质提升后续改进周期，因此其贡献主要定位于受预算约束的目标系统改进研究，而非已证实的递归进步。

title: PoreML: A Data-Driven Framework for Learning Multiphase Flow in Porous Media
summary: Multiphase flow in porous microstructures is central to CO$_2$ storage, fuel-cell operation, and flip-chip packaging. Predicting these flows remains challenging because wettability and complex pore geometry govern the nonlinear evolution of fluid interfaces. Machine learning holds substantial promise for advancing the field, but progress is constrained by scarce time-resolved 3D datasets and a lack of a unified workflow for training and evaluating models. To fill this critical gap, we introduce PoreML, an open-source framework unifying data generation, model training, and evaluation grounded in pore-scale physics. The framework comprises three core components. (a) A modern GPU-native lattice Boltzmann solver, validated against analytical solutions and published experiments, enables reproducible data generation. (b) A 3.3 TB dataset contains 560 simulation runs and 158,546 stored time steps across four application-driven scenarios. These trajectories span synthetic structures and geometries derived from micro-CT scans of real materials, covering diverse wetting conditions and viscosity ratios. (c) A unified learning framework evaluates one-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts. Its domain-specific evaluation protocols assess predictive accuracy and physical consistency. We evaluate five models of diverse architecture under these protocols. Two complementary challenges assess transfer to larger domains and from synthetic to micro-CT-derived structures. PoreML provides a shared foundation for machine-learning research on multiphase flow in porous media, with the aim of empowering the community to develop reliable predictive models and advance the field.

AI.tldr: PoreML是一个开源的数据驱动框架,旨在解决多孔介质中多相流机器学习研究面临的两个关键瓶颈:时序三维数据集稀缺和训练评估工作流不统一。框架整合了三个核心组件:基于JAX的GPU原生格子Boltzmann求解器、3.3 TB的多相流模拟数据集(560个运行,158,546个时间步长,涵盖CO2封存、燃料电池GDL水侵入和倒装芯片底填四个应用场景),以及统一的机器学习基准测试框架。该框架提出了两个互补的泛化挑战:Geo-Shift(从合成结构迁移到μ-CT扫描结构)和Scale-Up(迁移到更大尺寸域)。评估采用Minkowski函数als等基于物理的指标,超越了传统的体素误差度量,发现即使场误差很低,拓扑结构(Euler特征)的预测仍可能严重失真,这是GDL等薄界面几何中的关键失效模式。
AI.motivation: 多孔介质中的多相流(如CO2地质封存、燃料电池水管理、倒装芯片封装)受润湿性和复杂孔隙几何控制的非线性界面动力学支配。机器学习虽前景广阔,但受限于:1)时序三维数据集稀缺(实验需要数周至数月,且需要同步辐射成像);2)缺乏统一的训练和评估工作流;3)计算成本与代表性单元体积(REV)需求之间的矛盾(模拟成本随域尺寸O(n³)增长)。作者旨在填补这一关键空白,提供一个整合数据生成、训练和评估的共享基础框架。
AI.method: 1) 求解器:基于JAX的GPU原生color-gradient格子Boltzmann方法(CG-LBM),支持D3Q19格子、MRT碰撞算子、CSF表面张力模型、Akai几何润湿边界条件、多GPU分片。通过8个解析解和实验验证案例(Laplace定律、分层Poiseuille流、接触角、Washburn渗吸、毛细管压力、微模型实验、Lenormand相图)进行验证。2) 数据集生成:使用3000+ GPU小时生成4个应用场景的模拟数据——岩石排驱、毛细捕获、GDL水侵入、倒装芯片底填——跨越合成几何和μ-CT扫描几何,涵盖多种接触角(120°-150°)和粘度比(0.05-30)。3) 评估协议:统一基准测试5种架构(UNet3D、FNO3D、P3D、Transolver++、AB-UPT),采用一步预测和64步自回归滚动,引入基于Minkowski泛函的几何感知度量(相体积M0、界面面积M1、平均曲率积分M2、Euler特征M3),以及两个迁移挑战(Scale-Up: 128³→256³;Geo-Shift: 合成几何→μ-CT几何)。所有资源在GitHub和Hugging Face开源。
AI.result: 1) 单步预测:所有模型场误差低(φ MAE 0.002-0.012),UNet3D和P3D在24列中领先16列。2) 64步滚动:AB-UPT在所有4个场景中获得最低φ MAE;P3D在排驱中界面几何最佳;FNO3D和UNet3D在3个场景中拓扑最佳。3) 关键发现:低场误差不保证正确的拓扑——M3误差中位数为每10⁵体素3.6次误计(相对于参考χ密度1-9),而M0误差中位数仅11%;在所有模型-场景组合中,φ MAE最低的模型仅在1个场景中同时M3最低。4) Geo-Shift和Scale-Up:φ滚动误差在两种迁移下保持有界,但M3始终是最难预测的指标;GDL场景中拓扑误差最严重。5) 失效模式分析:识别出"斑点(speck)"和"隧道(tunnel)"两种机制——前者由相场围绕阈值振荡产生小岛/气泡,后者由预测吞没纤维或桥接区域形成环柄——两者几乎不影响体素误差但严重改变Euler特征。
AI.conclusion: PoreML为多孔介质多相流的机器学习研究提供了首个统一的开放基础。其64步滚动和迁移测试通过相体积、界面面积、平均曲率积分和Euler特征等基于物理的指标评估场精度与界面几何和拓扑。基线模型提供了初始性能参考,但显式的质量和动量守恒测试仍是未来工作。主要局限在于:1) 物理一致性仅通过几何和拓扑检查,未评分守恒定律;2) 基线采用单一种子和已发表配方,未进行超参数调优;3) 当前失效模式(拓扑失真)指向需要感知连通性的新架构和损失函数的发展方向。通过使新数据生成、一致模型比较和扩展到新条件成为可能,PoreML为多孔介质机器学习的推进提供了共享基础。

title: Thinking in Depth: Retrospective Inference for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained across diverse tabular tasks and make predictions on a new table at inference time using its labeled examples as context. Most recent TFMs perform such in-context prediction with stacked Transformer layers, repeatedly transforming how examples are represented and compared. By tracing individual queries through several strong TFMs, we find that predictive refinement is highly uneven across depth and is often concentrated in later layers. This uneven refinement motivates us to reconsider how intermediate representations are constructed and reused throughout the network. We introduce Retro, a tabular foundation model based on retrospective inference, where later stages can explicitly revisit and recombine intermediate information produced earlier in the network. Retro organizes this process around two complementary operations: which intermediate information to revisit, and how the resulting contextual update should be shaped for each query. Attention Residuals address the former by adaptively reweighting contributions from different depths, while query-conditioned Gated Attention addresses the latter by modulating the attention output element-wise across representation dimensions. Our analysis shows that Retro shifts predictive refinement earlier and more broadly across depth, with different stages revising different subsets of queries in a pattern suggestive of multi-view refinement. Across TabArena, TALENT, and RelArena, Retro ranks among the top three and lies on the Pareto frontier. These results indicate that directly reusing intermediate representations provides a practical way to better exploit depth in TFMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Retro——一种基于"回顾式推理"的表格基础模型(TFM)，通过Attention Residuals和门控注意力机制实现对中间表征的复用与查询条件调制，使预测精炼在网络深度上更早、更广泛地分布。在三大基准测试（TabArena、TALENT、RelArena）上均位列前三，并处于帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型(TFMs)采用堆叠Transformer层进行上下文预测，但作者通过追踪单个查询在多个强TFM中的中间表征变化，发现预测精炼在网络深度上极不均匀，且常集中于最后几层（如TabICLv2最后三分之一层贡献了84.4%的绝对边界变化）。这表明问题不仅在于每层计算什么，更在于中间信息如何被后续层复用，从而促使重新思考中间表征的构建与重用方式。
AI.method: 提出"回顾式推理"(retrospective inference)框架，由两个互补操作构成：(1) Attention Residuals——通过学习型评分函数自适应加权来自不同深度的历史贡献，使后续层能显式回顾并重组早期中间信息；(2) 查询条件门控注意力(Query-conditioned Gated Attention)——通过sigmoid门控对注意力输出进行逐元素调制，根据查询自适应调整上下文更新的方向与幅度。两者结合实现多视角精炼模式，不同阶段修订不同查询子集。
AI.result: 在38个TabArena分类数据集上，无门控回顾变体的早期运动份额从TabICLv2的15.6%提升至60.7%，平均每步正确性翻转率从9.82%提升至24.66%。在三个主流基准测试中，Retro均位列前三：TabArena总体第三（Elo 1741.6）、TALENT总体第二（Elo 1755.4）、RelArena总体第一（Elo 1797.0），且均处于性能-成本帕累托前沿。组件消融显示两机制协同贡献最高（Elo 1115.6）。
AI.conclusion: Retro将预测精炼从集中于末层转变为更早、更广泛地分布于整个深度，形成多视角精炼模式。通过将中间表征视为可重用资源而非仅作为层间传递的瞬态，能更充分地利用网络深度。该方法在性能与推理成本间取得良好平衡，为表格基础模型的深度利用提供了实用路径。

title: HAN-Mamba: Hierarchical Selective State Space Networks for Multi-Scale Financial Volatility Forecasting
comment: 16 pages. Accepted for publication in Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2026 Revised Selected Papers). Extended version of the ICAART 2026 paper (DOI: https://doi.org/10.5220/0014264900004052 )
summary: Short-horizon realized volatility forecasting requires the integration of market information that evolves at incompatible temporal resolutions, from second-level order book dynamics to weekly regime drift. Our conference work introduced HAN-T, a hierarchical architecture in which scale-specific Transformer encoders process short, mid, and long-horizon streams and a learned attention fuser weighs their contributions. This article replaces the quadratic attention encoders with selective state space (Mamba) encoders while retaining attention only in the fuser, where the input is a three-token set rather than a long sequence. The resulting hybrid, HAN-Mamba, summarizes each stream through a recurrent state whose input-dependent gating matches two structural properties of volatility: persistent but decaying memory and abrupt regime shifts. On the Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction benchmark under time-aware five-fold cross-validation, HAN-Mamba improves mean RMSPE over HAN-T (0.1942 vs. 0.1965) with 33% fewer parameters. Its linear-time encoders further allow the high-frequency context to be extended from 60 to 240 buckets, reducing error to 0.1927 where the attention variant saturates, and support constant-time streaming updates at inference. Ablations attribute the gains to the encoder swap, confirm that the hierarchical prior transfers across sequence-model families, and show that the permutation-invariant attention fuser remains the correct mechanism for cross-scale integration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HAN-Mamba 架构,用于多尺度金融波动率预测。该模型在 HAN-T 层级架构基础上,将三路 Transformer 编码器替换为选择性状态空间(Mamba)编码器,仅在融合器中保留注意力机制。在 ORVP 基准上以更少参数实现了更优性能,并支持更长上下文与流式推理。
AI.motivation: 短时已实现波动率预测需融合秒级订单簿到周度制度漂移等多尺度信息。HAN-T 的 Transformer 编码器存在二次计算复杂度,限制高频上下文长度(60 buckets)且无法流式推理;此外,绝对位置嵌入与分类 token 机制与波动率的"持续衰减记忆+突变制度切换"特性不完全匹配。
AI.method: 保留 HAN-T 的三流层级结构(高频60/120/240 buckets、日度20序列、周度12序列),将各尺度独立 Transformer 编码器替换为不同容量的 Mamba 块堆栈(短:4块d=128，中:2块d=64，长:1块d=32),通过最终隐藏状态读出。融合器仍为2层4头 Transformer,因输入为3 token 无序集合,注意力具有排列等变性且成本可忽略。零填充利用 Mamba 的 Δ_k 选择性门控实现原生的 null-skipping。损失为 RMSPE,优化器 AdamW,时序感知五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 在 ORVP 上:HAN-Mamba 均值 RMSPE 0.1942(优于 HAN-T 的 0.1965),参数减少33%(0.96M vs 1.43M),跨折标准差最低(0.0022)。扩展高频上下文至240 buckets 后 RMSPE 降至0.1927,而 HAN-T 在此长度饱和甚至退化。流式推理延迟0.31 ms vs HAN-T 的3.8 ms(12×加速)。消融证实:注意力融合器优于 Mamba 融合器(对顺序敏感);完整 Mamba 替换优于部分替换;层级先验跨算子族可迁移。融合器注意力权重在压力时期从短尺度 0.68 降至0.54,中长尺度上升。
AI.conclusion: 注意力与选择性递归在不同架构角色上互补:长齐次时间轴宜用递归,小异质集合宜用注意力。HAN-Mamba 在准确性、参数效率、上下文可扩展性与部署实时性方面均优于 HAN-T。未来工作包括多资产联合预测、增量关系特征维护、双向或 SSD 编码器扩展。

title: Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Multichain MDPs: A Hierarchical Decomposition Approach
summary: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对一般多链（multichain）平均奖赏MDP，提出三种基于Bather唯一层次分解（UHD）的异步、几乎无模型的强化学习算法，分别用于求解最优gain、gain-最优策略、平均最优性方程（AOE）的近似解以及近似bias-最优策略，并给出几乎处处收敛与有限时间性能保证。
AI.motivation: 现有多链平均奖赏RL方法大多依赖折扣化简或单连通结构假设，难以直接处理具有不可逆决策的多链结构。作者旨在突破unichain/communicating限制，提供首个不依赖折扣问题约简的一般多链本质无模型RL方法。
AI.method: 基算法分四相：Phase1用Bather UHD分解状态空间为通信子系统与瞬态状态；Phase2在各通信子MDP上并行运行RVI Q-learning估计子系统gain；Phase3在聚合最优停机问题(OSP)上运行总奖赏Q-learning决定各子系统停留或退出；Phase4将聚合策略提升为原MDP策略。算法2通过双阈值机制构建A_*外近似并求解受扰AOE；算法3先用折扣Q-learning近似最优bias函数，再用基算法求解诱导平均奖赏MDP。
AI.result: 三个算法均几乎处处收敛到最优gain并产生gain-最优策略（有限时间）；算法2通过AOE外近似提供近gain-最优性能保证；算法3通过折扣近似与基算法结合，在足够小阈值和折扣因子逼近下获得近bias-最优策略。初步实验（100个随机生成多链MDP）显示基算法gain覆盖率达96%，算法2和3在gain-最优性上略低但瞬态性能显著改善，算法3在gain-最优与bias-最优之间取得良好折中。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了首个面向一般多链MDP的本质无模型平均奖赏RL理论框架，提出的分层分解方法为options发现与持续学习等应用奠定基础；未来工作包括去除转移图假设、在线发现与维护UHD、与options框架结合以及自适应参数调节等。

title: AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility
summary: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.

AI.tldr: AutoAdapt提出了一种模块化框架，通过自动发现潜在域、为每个域独立训练LoRA适配器，并使用基于质心的无参数路由机制，实现了在异构指令微调场景中无需全模型重训练即可达到与单一LoRA基线相当的性能，并支持部署后的域更新与扩展。
AI.motivation: 指令微调模型通常部署在领域异构且持续演化的环境中，但现有方法（全模型微调或单一LoRA适配器）面临两大问题：(1) 异构训练数据引入冲突梯度信号，限制单一模型的专业化能力；(2) 单体式微调产生的系统难以扩展，加入新领域需要昂贵的全量重训并存在灾难性遗忘风险。混合专家架构虽支持专业化但需联合训练，无法解决可扩展性问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 潜在域发现——使用三种独立方法：K-means聚类（K=17，基于MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入和肘部法则/轮廓系数确认）、BERTopic主题建模（107个主题，合并为24个超组）、零样本MNLI分类（使用BART-large-mnli对24个标签进行蕴含推断）；(2) 适配器训练——基于Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3冻结基模型，为每个发现域独立并行训练专属LoRA适配器；(3) 推理路由——通过质心余弦相似度进行无参数路由，无需可训练路由组件。训练数据涵盖509,174条来自8个公开数据集的指令，涵盖通用、代码、QA、金融、医学和推理等领域。
AI.result: 在14个领域特定基准测试和GPT-4o成对评判评估中：(1) LLM-as-a-judge胜率——K-means 50.5%、BERTopic 50.2%、MNLI 46.9%，与单一LoRA基线相当；(2) 基准测试——K-means（-0.27pp，p=0.63）和MNLI（+0.19pp，p=0.73）与基线无显著差异，BERTopic略低（-2.18pp，p<0.001）；(3) 跨方法收敛——K-means与BERTopic之间ARI=0.42、NMI=0.55，呈现中等一致性，MNLI与其他方法差异较大；(4) 可扩展性——模拟Magicoder数据集域更新时99.9%路由稳定，c15适配器在NLL/困惑度上最优且GPT-4o评判获胜；新增法律域时99.7%路由稳定，法律适配器在126/200和129/200次比较中获胜；(5) 训练效率——单A100 80GB GPU上并行训练3个适配器，墙钟时间减少1.7倍（vs单一LoRA）和2.0倍（vs全模型微调）。研究发现编程类任务因功能多样性需要共享表征而表现欠佳，MultiNLI等无主题约束内容存在碎片化问题。
AI.conclusion: AutoAdapt通过自动潜在域专业化和无参数路由机制，证明了模块化指令微调是单体式训练的可扩展替代方案。该框架在保持与单一LoRA相当性能的同时，提供了固有的可扩展性——新域可通过训练单一额外适配器加入，现有域更新无需重训其他组件。未来的研究方向应包括在更大模型上验证、融合功能嵌入以改进聚类（如编程和NLI任务），以及探索低资源部署之外的场景。

title: ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning
summary: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了 ORDERS 这一个性化联邦学习配置，分析其性能是否主要来自服务器权重策略。结果显示，ORDERS 在 CIFAR-10 上具有小幅优势，但与均匀加权控制的差异较小且统计证据有限；在 Sent140 上，优势可由事后训练多数类诊断解释。消融实验未证明更新范数排序、特征对齐或参数扰动的稳定有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化联邦学习方法常同时改变共享骨干、私有模块、本地训练和评估流程，导致服务器加权规则的真实贡献难以识别。论文因此关注在固定客户端结构与评估协议下，ORDERS 中的服务器权重机制是否提供独立且可复现的收益。
AI.method: 研究一种明确配置的 ORDERS：共享特征骨干、私有残差适配器与分类器、基于降序更新范数的几何权重、特征对齐，以及私有参数扰动。服务器对从同一广播模型得到的客户端更新进行加权求和，不涉及顺序累积带来的额外优化效应。评估严格限定为 80 次最终运行：8 种配置、2 个数据集、每个数据集 1 个固定划分和 5 个训练随机种子。对比包括 FedPer-R1 与匹配的均匀权重控制，并执行共同本地微调、客户端训练多数类的事后诊断以及多个组件消融。数据集为每客户端两类的 CIFAR-10 和 Sent140。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 的原生客户端准确率上，ORDERS 为 80.51±0.79%，FedPer-R1 为 79.02±1.42%，匹配的均匀权重控制为 80.27±0.73%；与 FedPer-R1 的差距为 1.49 个百分点，但相对均匀权重控制仅高 0.24 个百分点。经过共同本地微调后，与 FedPer-R1 的差距缩小至 0.32 个百分点。Sent140 上 ORDERS 达到 74.71±0.49%，仅比事后客户端训练多数类诊断高 0.69 个百分点。消融结果仅提供有限且依赖端点的证据，支持更新范数排序和特征对齐的部分作用；私有参数扰动未显示明确收益。参数载荷节省分别为 5.47% 和 0.78%。
AI.conclusion: 在固定划分、固定训练与完整重复评估下，ORDERS 相比 FedPer-R1 表现更好，但其相对匹配均匀权重基线的增益很小，且组件消融不支持所有设计选择均具有稳定独立贡献。统一本地微调会显著缩小方法差异，说明部分优势可能与本地训练阶段有关。由于评估规模和固定划分限制了外部效度，结果更适合解释为该受控设置下的有限改进，而非服务器加权机制的普遍优势。

title: Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements
summary: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“观测校正Koopman观测器”：用当前浅层特征的新观测校正由历史预测的深层特征，在不微调扩散去噪器的情况下加速采样，并提高对完整DDIM-50参考输出的逼近保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散采样需在每个时间步执行昂贵的去噪网络。特征缓存虽可复用或预测中间激活，但仅依赖历史特征的开放环预测无法感知当前去噪状态的变化；早期预测误差还会改变后续网络输入并逐步积累。因此需要一种低成本反馈机制，将当前状态的新信息引入深层特征估计。
AI.method: 将冻结U-Net划分为浅层特征计算、昂贵深层计算和最终读出。每个扩散时间步均计算浅层特征，深层特征仅在周期性全量评估时计算，其余步骤由观测器估计。方法以浅层和深层特征增量构造联合可观测向量：用校准轨迹的二阶矩提取通道投影基并归一化，采用带身份先验和岭正则的EDMD式回归拟合时间相关仿射Koopman转移算子。局部诊断先由联合增量状态预测下一步状态，再将当前浅层增量与预测浅层分量之差作为创新；通过岭回归得到的浅层到深层残差增益校正未观测的深层增量状态，并累积重构深层特征。每个预测片段由连续两次全量评估初始化和刷新，采样器及去噪器权重均保持冻结，K类引导的两个分支分别执行预测。在相同算力、相同刷新位置和相同拟合参数下，通过关闭校正、将当前观测延迟一步及无约束静态回归等对照，区分时间建模与即时测量的贡献。
AI.result: 在三个各含10,000张图像的独立采样运行中，s=4调度下观测器相对DDIM-50实测加速为CIFAR-10上的1.890倍和ImageNet-10上的1.845倍；FID分别为13.669±0.071和14.257±0.074。相对于同等四偏步调度下的逐通道仿射预测，配对Inception特征MSE降低19.9%和11.9%；严格匹配实验中，当前观测相对关闭校正额外降低4.54%和4.67%，相对延迟一步观测降低12.78%和17.44%。所有相关逐次运行的配对自助法95%误差比区间均低于1，且当前观测在两数据集的全部类别上均优于关闭校正。局部预测误差在CIFAR-10的23个评估位置均改善，而ImageNet-10仅7个位置改善，说明校正收益依赖采样阶段。可视化包含精选的改善案例，不能视为随机样本或平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 低成本当前浅层特征不仅是供跳连使用的中间量，也可作为状态测量，通过预测—校正机制改善深层特征缓存和预测，从而在保持固定50步DDIM采样网格与冻结去噪器的前提下，加快推理并提高对完整采样器输出的保真度。方法的优势主要来自显式利用及时测量，且这种反馈优于仅依赖历史状态或延迟观测的预测。不过，其增益依赖浅层与深层增量的跨特征相关性；ImageNet-10部分采样阶段校正无效或略微有害，完整离线校准成本及所有未约束同输入回归器的优越性尚未充分建立。

title: Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees
summary: Interpretability offers a solution to safe autonomy by providing transparency into an agent's underlying decision-making model.
