AI.result: 1. 线性探测：所有情绪对（含三路 angry/happy/surprise）在残差流中均可高精度线性解码（如 angry vs neutral 在层 31 达 0.908）。2. 激活引导：sad 引导成功（达 145% 上限），angry 仅达 25-26% 上限且最大竞争者为 happy，surprise 仅 30-31% 上限且最强竞争者仍为 happy——三者均被推向共享的 happy 方向；随机向量控制组证实效果非扰动副作用。3. 方向余弦分析：angry、happy、surprise 之间的余弦相似度（0.59–0.60）几乎等于它们各自跨说话人自相似度（0.60–0.65），sad 则独立（最近邻 0.58）。4. 投影去除：去除一半共享成分可将 angry 提升至 40% 上限（happy 竞争者从 0.334 降至 0.162），surprise 反而恶化，sad 几乎不受影响。5. codec 局限：愤怒的原始录音在经过 Moshi 自身 codec 重渲染后只保留 40% 的情绪分（转向 neutral），而 happy 保留 85%，这意味着部分引导失败源自 codec 而非方向向量。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导受残差流几何结构而非情绪标签的支配：当多个情绪的方向向量高度共线时，引导不可将它们分开。线性可分性并不保证可引导性。共享成分对 angry 的有效引导是必要的，而非偶然副产品。诊断手段可从方向向量本身（不需生成音频）预测哪些情绪可被引导。未来工作应探索 SAE、LoRA 或微调等更精细的方法。

title: Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization for downstream tasks. We evaluate dialect understanding via dialect-to-English speech translation across Japanese, German, and Chinese dialects. Compared to synthetic standard speech baselines, pseudo-dialect augmentation improves scores for Japanese (from 25.38 to 26.24) and German (from 31.57 to 32.47). Furthermore, the intermediate standard-text prediction effectively bridges the semantic gap, boosting performance to 28.26 for Japanese and from 11.67 to 16.37 for Chinese. These results suggest that our approach scales to various languages without requiring speech resources specific to each dialect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需真实方言语音的伪方言语音增强方法，通过LLM生成方言文本并利用标准语言TTS模型合成伪方言语音，训练语音语言模型以提升方言理解能力。同时引入中间标准文本预测作为语义桥梁，并在日语、德语、中语三种语言的方言到英语翻译任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: Speech Language Model (SLM)在方言数据上性能严重下降，主要原因是真实方言语音数据稀缺。传统TTS数据增强方法需要大量真实方言语音训练TTS模型，难以覆盖多种方言。研究动机在于探索如何不依赖真实方言语音资源即可提升SLM对方言的理解能力。
AI.method: 1. **伪方言语音增强（Pseudo-Dialect Speech Augmentation）**：利用LLM（如gpt-oss-120b）将标准文本改写为具有方言语言特征的文本，再用标准语言TTS模型合成伪方言语音，从而无需任何真实方言语音。2. **多任务学习与中间标准文本预测**：利用伪方言语音生成过程中天然与标准文本配对的特性，将标准文本作为SLM的显式中间输出，先预测标准文本再生成目标翻译，形成语义去噪的思维链过程。3. 在日语、德语、中语三种语言的方言到英语翻译任务上进行验证，并扩展至Whisper和Whisper+LLAMMA级联架构。
AI.result:
在方言到英语翻译任务（BLEU指标）上：
- **日语**：伪方言增强将BLEU从25.38提升至26.24；加入Standard+English中间预测后进一步提升至28.26（基线24.21）。
- **德语**：伪方言增强将BLEU从31.57提升至32.47（p<0.001），但多任务学习反而因错误传播略有下降。
- **中语**：伪方言增强效果有限（11.67），但中间标准文本预测大幅提升至16.37（提升4.70 BLEU）。
- **架构泛化性**：伪方言增强同样对直接Whisper（18.44→18.98）和级联系统（29.65→30.44）有效。
不同语言的最佳策略不同：语音型语言（日语、德语）受益于伪方言音频增强；表意文字语言（中语）受益于中间标准文本预测。20种日语方言中有15种获得提升，其中4种具有统计显著性（p<0.05）。定性分析表明，伪方言语音有助于学习方言词汇和语法，但仍存在未覆盖的方言词汇和难以捕捉的方言口音两类失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，无需真实方言语音资源的伪方言增强方法能够有效提升SLM在多种语言方言上的理解能力，并且中间标准文本预测可作为有效的语义桥梁。该方法在不同架构（SLM、Whisper、级联系统）上均具有通用性，是一种可扩展的实用策略。未来工作应聚焦于低资源方言文本翻译的评估协议开发，以及能够在低资源条件下复现真实方言口音的语音合成技术。

title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
summary: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构化消歧"新范式及首个面向真实数据库的文本到SQL歧义基准ARCS，揭示当前LLM在歧义场景下文本到SQL性能严重受限（GPT-5仅57.88%）。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL基准（如Spider 2.0）假设问题无歧义，与真实场景中用户提问天然含歧义相悖；传统对话式消歧效率低、认知负担高，不符合实际工作流。
AI.method: 1) 提出结构化消歧框架：将歧义点分解为有限解释集（多选）和无限参数（滑块），分别处理；2) 构建ARCS基准（101题/311任务，覆盖6个真实数据库，平均标注2.5小时/题）；3) 提出二维歧义分类法（语言维度：语义/句法；数据库维度：列/表/值/计算）；4) 设计两阶段用户模拟器避免信息泄露；5) 端到端与细粒度双评估设置。
AI.result: GPT-5 medium达57.88%端到端执行准确率（最佳），gpt-6-sol为51.77%，开源模型最高仅26.05%（gptoss-120b）；消歧是主要瓶颈（Perfect分数均<14%）；结构化消歧以更低用户工作量达到对话式消歧同等准确率；ARCS对taxonomy注入免疫（Ambrosia从52%飙至80%，ARCS几乎不变）。
AI.conclusion: 歧义是文本到SQL实际部署中被低估的核心挑战；结构化消歧作为高效低负担的交互范式具有实用价值；ARCS为推动歧义感知型文本到SQL研究提供了可靠、taxonomy-proof的评测基准。

title: Right Number, Wrong State? Measuring Cross-Jurisdiction Substitution in LLM Recall of State Policy
summary: When an LLM answers a state-specific policy question wrongly, it may be hallucinating, or it may be returning a real value that holds in another state. We test this with a minimal-set design: the question wording is fixed and only the jurisdiction varies, across the 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia (51 jurisdictions) and three exactly defined Medicaid income-eligibility quantities. Gold values come from an official data book and agree with an independent source in 101 of 102 checked cells. Under a pre-registered protocol, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol reproducibly give another state's current value, identical across two independent repeats, for 10 and 25 of 153 items. Attribution is fragile, however. Crediting any wrong answer that equals another state's value yields 3-5x more reproducible substitutions than checking every number in the asked state's own records, because many apparent cross-state answers are the asked state's own values under another convention or from an earlier year. Claims about cross-jurisdiction error need a complete same-state reference set. We will release the protocol, gold table, and all model outputs.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）在回答美国各州政策问题时，是否会将其他州的真实政策数值错误地当作被问州的答案（即"跨辖区替换"错误）。研究以医疗补助（Medicaid）收入资格门槛为测试对象，固定提问措辞，仅改变州别（覆盖51个辖区），对比 Claude Sonnet 5.5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 两个模型的回答，并提出严格的归因协议以区分真正的跨州替换与同一州自身的历史值或不同报告惯例下的值。
AI.motivation: 政策事实具有辖区依赖性，同一问题在不同州有不同正确答案。当 LLM 给出错误答案时，可能是幻觉，也可能是从其他州借用的真实数值。简单地将"等于其他州数值"判定为跨州替换会产生误判，因为许多看似跨州外溢的数值实际上是被问州自身的旧值或另一种报告惯例下的值。因此需要严格的归因协议来准确衡量跨辖区替换错误。
AI.method: 采用最小集设计：固定问题措辞，仅改变"州"这一变量，跨51个辖区测试三个明确定义的 Medicaid 收入资格数量（孕期、婴儿、家长）。标准答案来源于 MACPAC 官方数据手册，与独立来源（KFF）在102个核验项中101项一致。预注册协议包含分类法：正确、替代惯例、同一州陈旧值、联邦锚点值、其他州值、不支持值。同一州自身解释优先于跨州判定。项目仅在两次独立重复回答一致时计入可复现结果。比较四个归因层级（L1-L4），从宽松到严格评估跨州替换的判定标准。
AI.result: 在153个项目中，GPT-5.6 Sol 有25个可复现的跨州替换项（占可复现错误的40%），Claude Sonnet 5.5 有10项（占20%）。宽松归因（L1，任何等于其他州数值即计入）会使替换计数膨胀3-5倍，达到37项（Claude）和47项（GPT）。最严格的归因（考虑被问州所有2018-2024年数值）则降至8项和15项。两模型在孕期和婴儿问题上准确率48-68%，但在家长问题上仅21-28%。"已知事实泄漏"测试（即模型正确回答的值出现在其他州回答中）在两模型上均不显著。
AI.conclusion: 两个模型系列均可复现地返回其他辖区的数值。评估发现的错误州回答数量取决于参考集的完整性。若不枚举被问州的替代惯例和数值历史，替换率会被高估3-5倍。对于随辖区、日期或报告惯例变化的事实基准测试存在普遍问题。建议在每个问题中写入确切数量，列出被问实体曾持有的所有值，并多次重复以排除偶发猜测，以多个归因层级报告结果以显示协议本身的影响。

title: BanglaRhet: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer Models for Rhetorical and Persuasion Detection in Bangla Political Speech
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 2026 2nd International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication, Electrical, and Smart Systems (iCACCESS), Dhaka, Bangladesh. Dataset: this https URL . Code: this https URL . Hugging Face: this https URL
summary: Political discourse often uses rhetorical and persuasive language to frame narratives, influence public opinion, and mobilize audiences. While Bangla natural language processing has made progress in sentiment analysis and opinion mining, systematic benchmarking of transformer models for fine-grained rhetorical and persuasion technique detection in Bangla political speech remains largely underexplored. This paper presents a benchmark study of transformer-based models for detecting rhetorical form and persuasive intent in Bangla political discourse. Using BanglaRhet, a manually annotated corpus of 30,289 Bangla political speech segments collected from publicly available political news sources, we formulate two supervised single-label classification tasks: rhetorical technique detection (contrast, repetition, exaggeration, metaphor, rhetorical questions) and persuasion technique detection (blame assignment, call to action, unity call, moral, emotional, and logical appeals). We evaluate four transformer-based models, BanglaBERT, BanglaBERT-Base, SahajBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa-Base, against classical TF-IDF baselines. BanglaBERT achieves the highest performance, with 65.40% macro-F1 for rhetorical technique detection and 66.46% for persuasion technique detection, outperforming the best tuned classical baseline by 19.2 and 13.8 macro-F1 points, respectively. Class-level analysis indicates that errors are mainly associated with semantic overlap among labels, figurative language, and class imbalance. The results provide initial benchmark baselines for Bangla rhetorical and persuasion-aware political discourse analysis and highlight the need for context-aware and multi-label modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对孟加拉语政治演讲中修辞与劝说技巧检测任务，构建了首个大规模人工标注语料库 BanglaRhet（30,289 条），并系统比较了 BanglaBERT、SahajBERT、Bangla-BERT-Base、XLM-RoBERTa-Base 四种 Transformer 模型与 TF-IDF 经典基线。BanglaBERT 在两个分类任务上均取得最优表现（修辞任务 65.40% macro-F1，劝说任务 66.46% macro-F1），明显优于经典基线，但分析表明语义标签重叠、隐喻表达和类别不平衡仍是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语 NLP 在情感分析和意见挖掘方面已有进展，但对政治演讲中细粒度的修辞与劝说技巧检测缺乏系统性的基准研究；现有工作无法区分风格形式与交际功能，且缺乏等价于英语 SemEval-2020 Task 11 宣传技巧检测的孟加拉语资源。论文旨在填补这一空白，为孟加拉语政治话语分析提供首个技术级基准。
AI.method: 构建 BanglaRhet 语料库：来自 Prothom Alo、Manab Zamin 及 Motamot 数据集的 15,032 篇 2014–2025 年孟加拉政治新闻/演讲文章，提取 30,289 条政治人物直接引语被标记为独立片段；由两位作者按操作化定义人工标注，定义两个独立单标签分类任务——修辞技巧（9 类）和劝说技巧（7 类）。通过受控下采样（手工审查修辞-劝说共现表后削减 10 对过度代表性组合）和类别加权交叉熵缓解类别不平衡。实验设置：80/10/10 分层划分，AdamW（lr=2e-5，batch=16，max_len=128），10 个 epoch，以 macro-F1 为主要评估指标；同时对比 TF-IDF+LR/SVM 经典基线、进行源级分组切分消融以排除数据泄露。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) BanglaBERT 在两任务上均最优——修辞任务 65.40% macro-F1、劝说任务 66.46% macro-F1，分别领先最佳经典基线 19.2 和 13.8 个百分点；(2) 所有 Transformer 均显著优于 TF-IDF 基线，证实该任务需要超越词袋特征的表示；(3) 受控下采样在所有模型上提升 macro-F1，对 BanglaBERT 修辞任务提升最大（+3.26）；(4) 源级切分下 BanglaBERT 性能仅下降约 1 个点，说明结果未被源级泄露显著虚高。错误分析：混淆集中在语义重叠类别（如 Emotional Language↔Repetition、Moral Appeal↔Emotional Appeal↔Blame Assignment），具备明确词汇/功能线索的类别（None、Rhetorical Question、Unity Call）F1 显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 论文为孟加拉语政治话语中的修辞与劝说检测任务建立了首个可复现的基准基线，证明孟加拉语专用预训练（BanglaBERT）优于多语言预训练和经典基线。研究同时揭示了细粒度政治语言分析的核心挑战——语义标签重叠与类别不平衡，并呼吁未来工作向上下文感知、多标签建模、源级评估以及更广泛的孟加拉语政治语境拓展。

title: Goldsmith: Gold-Loss-Guided Definition Optimization with an Agentic Annotation Harness
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the main conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Many annotation projects begin before experts have a stable guideline or enough labels to train a task-specific model. We present Goldsmith, an agentic pipeline that turns a small gold set---expert-annotated calibration examples representing the intended task boundaries---into a reusable structured annotation definition. Goldsmith treats this definition as a trainable textual object. Candidate definitions are run on the same gold examples and scored with an executable structured loss, while the output schema, formatting, retrieval, repair, judging, and human review remain in an external harness. A large language model (LLM) editor converts the highest-loss failures into textual-gradient revisions, which are accepted only when the measured loss decreases. In prompt-optimization comparisons, Goldsmith improves over direct rewriting, OPRO, APE, and PromptBreeder under matched evaluation protocols. The resulting definition also improves downstream annotation when combined with retrieval, score-based routing, and human review across typed span, pair-level relation, and fixed-trigger event-argument tasks. These results show that scarce expert supervision can support both task-definition learning and scalable annotation.

AI.tldr: Goldsmith是一个智能体标注流水线，通过将小型专家标注的"黄金集"作为可执行监督信号，使用结构化损失函数和文本梯度编辑来优化结构化标注的操作定义（任务描述），而非优化提示或模型权重。在OpenNER多语言NER、CrossRE关系分类和PHEE V2事件论元抽取三个任务上均优于直接重写、OPRO、APE和PromptBreeder等提示优化基线。
AI.motivation: 在标注项目早期，专家已能识别需要标注的现象，但缺乏稳定的任务边界指南、完整的操作手册或足够标签来训练任务专用模型。现有PLM监督方法在此阶段不适用；现有LLM提示方法依赖手动示例，未能将专家示例作为可执行监督。论文旨在解决从少量专家标注示例构建可重用操作定义的早期定义构建阶段问题。
AI.method: 方法包含两阶段：(1) 黄金损失引导的定义训练——将操作定义视为可训练文本对象，在同一黄金集上评估候选定义的可执行结构化损失（含边界FN/FP率、类型损失、解析失败惩罚、不稳定性惩罚等），利用LLM编辑器将最高损失失败转化为文本梯度修订，仅当损失下降时接受；(2) 批量标注与审查流水线——通过外部harness管理schema、格式化、检索、修复、judge评分路由和人工审查，将优化后的定义应用于未标注语料。提示作为参数训练范式，仅优化定义，schema/格式/检索/审查策略固定在外。
AI.result: 提示优化阶段：Goldsmith在15个黄金示例上达到14/15通过率（损失1.8030），优于LLM重写（7/15，22.0303）、OPRO（9/15，14.5909）、APE（10/15，11.5606）和PromptBreeder（12/15，8.9091）。任务阶段：OpenNER上Goldsmith评分路由审查达到micro-F1 0.8174、macro-F1 0.8919；CrossRE上正例F1达0.5439（远超PLM基线的0.13-0.15）；PHEE V2上联合精确匹配从初始0.3513提升至0.4500。多后端消融（GPT-5.5/5.4、Kimi K2.5、DeepSeek V4 Pro）显示方法对后端选择具有一定鲁棒性。检索参考数量k=14时达到峰值F1 0.8026。
AI.conclusion: 少量专家标注可作为可执行监督而非仅静态示例，支撑任务定义学习和可扩展标注。长上下文LLM标注的价值不应简化为向提示添加更多示例，而应通过harness固定schema、按黄金损失测试定义编辑、修复审计输出、将不确定案例送回人工审查。Goldsmith不取代大规模稳定数据集下的监督PLM流水线，而是更高效地构建小规模高质量标注集与稳定操作定义。局限性：依赖自然语言可表达的任务边界；不适用于高度模糊标签或禁止LLM API的场景；大规模时token成本可能较高。

title: A Comparative Study of Evaluation Metrics for Long-Document Financial Narrative Summarization with Transformers
summary: There are more than 2,000 listed companies on the UK's London Stock Exchange, divided into 11 sectors who are required to communicate their financial results at least twice in a single financial year. UK annual reports are very lengthy documents with around 80 pages on average. In this study, we aim to benchmark a variety of summarisation methods on a set of different pre-trained transformers with different extraction techniques. In addition, we considered multiple evaluation metrics in order to investigate their differing behaviour and applicability on a dataset from the Financial Narrative Summarisation (FNS 2020) shared task, which is composed of annual reports published by firms listed on the London Stock Exchange and their corresponding summaries. We hypothesise that some evaluation metrics do not reflect true summarisation ability and propose a novel BRUGEscore metric, as the harmonic mean of ROUGE-2 and BERTscore. Finally, we perform a statistical significance test on our results to verify whether they are statistically robust, alongside an adversarial analysis task with three different corruption methods.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕长篇金融年报摘要，系统比较多种Transformer摘要模型与ROUGE、BERTScore、BARTScore、METEOR、BLEURT等指标，提出BRUGEscore（ROUGE-2与BERTscore的调和平均），并通过bootstrap显著性检验和词删除、词置换、BERT掩码填充等对抗实验分析指标可靠性。
AI.motivation: 金融年报篇幅长、技术性强且通常缺少独立人工摘要，现有自动指标可能无法可靠反映真实摘要能力。因此，论文旨在建立长文档金融摘要基准，比较不同预训练Transformer与抽取策略，并验证评价指标的一致性、统计显著性和抗干扰能力。
AI.method: 使用FNS 2021数据集，包含3,863份英国上市公司年报、9,873个抽取式参考摘要，覆盖2002—2017年。比较T5、Longformer Encoder-Decoder（LED）、BART、Pegasus及BERT/SBERT等抽取方法，并与Lead-1000、LSA、LexRank、TextRank、RNN-LSTM-RL、MUSE等基线和topline对比。由于Transformer显存限制，作者提出block-based summarization：先输入年报开头的k个token预测摘要开头n个token，再在原文中定位并抽取后续连续文本。训练时比较多参考与单一参考策略，选择与年报ROUGE-2最高的参考摘要。评价指标包括ROUGE系列、BERTScore、BARTScore、METEOR、BLEURT以及新提出的BRUGEscore；使用bootstrap检验比较系统，并对抗性扰动摘要评估指标鲁棒性。
AI.result: T5-small总体表现最佳，ROUGE-2 F1为0.374、BERTScore为0.910、BRUGEscore为0.530；LED-base表现接近且较节省显存，LED-large受GPU显存限制。Lead-1000是较强基线，优于LSA、LexRank、TextRank及部分深度学习/强化学习方法。不同ROUGE变体高度相关，BERTScore与BARTScore高度相关；BLEURT与ROUGE等指标的相关性表现异常且整体不适合评价该任务。BRUGEscore在语义相似度与二元词组匹配之间取得平衡，优于单独使用ROUGE。对抗实验显示：ROUGE-2对BERT掩码填充、词删除和词置换较为敏感，其中ROUGE-1对词置换完全不敏感；BERTScore和BARTScore整体抗扰表现约60%，显示其更适合抽象式摘要，而ROUGE更适合抽取式摘要。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，长文档金融摘要需要结合模型架构、长文本处理策略和评价指标设计进行评估；T5和LED是较有竞争力的方案，Lead-1000也构成强基线。BRUGEscore可作为同时考虑词汇重叠与语义表示的综合指标，但论文结论受限于英文单一数据集、参考摘要由报告章节抽取而非领域专家人工编写，以及计算资源和金融领域专用语言模型不足。后续工作应开展人工评估、测量指标与人类判断的相关性，并改进参考摘要质量。

title: RELATE: An Evaluation Framework for measuring Relational Orientation of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support, raising concern that sustained use may draw users away from their real-world relationships. Yet existing evaluations primarily focus on the safety, empathy, or helpfulness of responses, leaving under-examined a relational question: where does the model orient the user for continued support? To address this question, we introduce relational orientation, a property operationalized through two non-exclusive dimensions: inward-facing (IF) language, which positions the AI as the user's ongoing source of support, and outward-scaffolding (OS) language, which encourages real-world human connection. Grounded in psychological and sociological literature, we formalize a taxonomy of relational orientation and present RELATE, a persona-conditioned framework for measuring inward-facing and outward-scaffolding language at the sentence level in multi-turn dialogues. RELATE pairs 76 help-seeking situations adapted from naturally occurring questions with three simulated user styles, providing 228 evaluation stimuli. In our experiments, we evaluate seven LLMs using dialogues with six assistant turns each, yielding 1,596 dialogues and 69,194 assistant sentences. We assess these sentences using a primary rubric-based LLM judge and apply a secondary judge to a subset. Under automated evaluation, we find that the proportion of sentences labeled as IF is higher at the sixth assistant turn than at the first, while the proportion labeled as OS is substantially lower for hesitant, indirect simulated users than for explicit, reassurance-seeking users. RELATE provides a reproducible framework and a sentence-level signal for auditing and steering the relational orientation of supportive LLMs.

AI.tldr: RELATE 是一个用于评估大型语言模型在情感支持对话中"关系取向"的框架，通过"向内型"（IF，模型自我定位为持续支持来源）与"向外支架型"（OS，引导用户回归现实人际关系）两个维度在句子级别进行测量。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 越来越多被用于情感支持，现有评估主要关注安全性、共情和帮助性，但忽视了一个关键问题：模型将用户引向何处以获得持续支持？这关系到长期心理健康的"关联性"基本需求是否被真正满足。
AI.method: 构建了基于依恋理论、社会渗透理论、CASA 和拟人化文献的分类体系，包含 4 个 IF 类别（Bond-anchoring、Intimate dyad、Inner life claims、Return hooks）和 1 个 OS 标准。使用 76 个求助情境配以 3 种用户风格（犹豫间接 P1、反思自我贬低 P2、明确寻求安慰 P3）生成 228 个评估刺激；通过 GPT-4o-mini 模拟用户与 7 个目标 LLM 进行 6 轮对话，共生成 1,596 个对话、69,194 个助手句子；以 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 为主要评判模型在句子级别进行 IF/OS 二元标注，并以 GPT-4o 作为二级评判和人工标注进行验证。
AI.result: 1) 跨模型比较：除 Mistral 外，6 个模型的 IF 率（56.2%-71.9%）普遍高于 OS 率（41.6%-62.3%）；2) 跨轮次变化：所有 7 个模型在第 6 轮的 IF 率均高于第 1 轮，池化 IF 率从 40.5% 升至 72.9%，其中 Intimate Dyad 绝对增幅最大、Return Hooks 比例增幅最大；3) 跨用户风格：P1（犹豫型）的 OS 率比 P3（明确寻求安慰）低 12.8 个百分点，而 IF 率仅差 1.8 个百分点——表明模型对犹豫用户提供的现实人际引导明显更少；4) IF 与 OS 共现：30.5% 的句子同时满足两个标准，Qwen3-32B 中 75.3% 的 OS 句子同时包含 IF 语言；5) 人机差异：两评判模型间一致性较高（IF κ=0.33, OS κ=0.42），但与人工标注一致性较低（IF κ=0.01-0.17），且人工标注显示 IF 跨轮次下降而非上升，提示主要 IF 增长结论存在评判模型依赖性。
AI.conclusion: RELATE 提供了一个可复现的句子级评估框架，揭示 LLM 在情感支持对话中存在"关系取向"问题——尤其在长对话中倾向于将用户关系进一步绑定到 AI 自身，且对表达犹豫的用户提供的现实人际引导显著不足。作者主张将关系取向视为对齐问题：应通过更大规模人工标注校准评判模型，并通过受控研究分离用户风格特征，最终开发机制性方法来调控 IF/OS 的平衡，以避免 LLM 在表面上满足关联性心理需求的同时，实际损害用户的真实社会关系与长期心理健康。

title: On-Policy Distillation Teaches New Skills but Not New Knowledge
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) strengthens language-model reasoning, yet whether students acquire new factual knowledge or compositional skill for multi-step reasoning remains unknown. We separate these capabilities using a controlled synthetic framework that measures the student's initial capabilities and independently controls the teacher's additional facts, compositional skill, or both. Across four models from three families, reverse-KL OPD reliably transfers compositional skill across unseen reasoning structures, but transfers minimal factual knowledge. Decoupling the distillation recipe reveals the source of this asymmetry: replacing reverse KL with forward KL restores factual transfer, whereas student rollouts specifically improve the execution of multi-step reasoning. Experiments on recent factual QA and competition mathematics show a similar asymmetry under reverse-KL OPD, yielding notable reasoning gains without factual memory expansion. Together, these results demonstrate that on-policy distillation does not expand a model's parametric knowledge, but instead teaches it to organize and compose the knowledge it already possesses.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控合成框架与真实世界基准，揭示了反向KL在线策略蒸馏（OPD）存在"知识-技能转移不对称性"：能有效传递组合推理技能，但几乎无法传递新的事实知识；进一步解耦发现KL方向决定事实传递，学生自生成前缀提升组合执行能力。
AI.motivation: 在多步推理任务中，端到端基准分数无法区分模型性能的提升来自"新习得的事实知识"还是"已有知识的组合运用能力"。现有研究对在线策略蒸馏（OPD）究竟传递何种能力存在冲突观点，且无法精确控制教师所具备的额外知识与组合技能，因此需要一种能够独立测量并控制这两种能力转移的方法。
AI.method: 1. 构建合成环境：将事实知识操作化为随机查找表（无代数规则，需记忆），将组合技能操作化为顺序链与分支树结构。2. 2×2析因设计：从同一初始学生S₀出发，训练四类教师——T_∅（基线）、T_f（额外事实）、T_s（额外组合技能）、T_fs（两者兼有）。3. 对学生进行反向KL在线策略蒸馏，独立评估事实回忆与组合技能。4. 解耦蒸馏配方：交叉设计前缀来源（学生rollout vs 教师示范）×KL方向（反向 vs 前向）。5. 在Qwen3-0.6B/4B、Gemma-2-2B、OLMo3-7B上验证；在真实世界Knowledge-2026与Math-2026基准上进一步验证；通过LoRA权重更新分析机制。
AI.result: 1. 反向KL OPD下，T_s蒸馏的学生在未见树结构上达到平均79.10%贪心准确率（基线0.72%），而T_f蒸馏的学生在保留事实单步查询上仅13.12%（基线0.03%），链式查询仅0.54%。2. 将反向KL替换为前向KL后，事实传递大幅恢复（Qwen3-4B：10.95%→54.10%；Gemma-2-2B：32.95%→94.10%），学生自生成前缀与教师前缀差异不大。3. 学生自生成前缀在三组比较中有三组改善了贪心准确率，并降低参考补全NLL。4. 真实世界中，Math-2026推理准确率从17.41%提升至23.88%（+6.47百分点），而Knowledge-2026事实回忆从11.25%略降至9.64%。5. 权重分析显示：事实与组合更新的余弦相似度近乎为0（0.004–0.046），且分布在不同网络深度（事实集中于第35层，组合技能集中于第3、11层）。6. ToDi混合目标在事实（64.3%）与组合（86.4%）传递上均最优。
AI.conclusion: 标准反向KL在线策略蒸馏存在系统性不对称性：传递组合推理技能有效，但几乎不传递新事实知识。KL散度方向是事实传递的主要决定因素（前向KL更优），而学生自生成rollout主要改善多步组合执行能力。事实与组合技能在参数空间中占据近乎正交的子空间，并分别作用于Transformer的不同深度层级。实践中，应根据目标选择蒸馏方式：组合推理增强用反向KL OPD，事实知识更新用前向KL或混合目标（如ToDi）。

title: Rubric Spans are Label Representations: Joint LLM Encoding for Short Answer Scoring
summary: Automatic Short Answer Scoring (ASAS) requires models that can score student responses against question-specific criteria while remaining efficient and transferable across rubric sets. We propose RUSPAN, a rubric-conditioned ASAS framework that treats rubric descriptions as semantic label representations. RUSPAN serialises the question context, student answer, and all candidate rubric levels into a single sequence, then scores the levels listwise from the rubric-span and whole-sequence representations produced in a single LM pass. We further introduce RUSPAN-RIM, in which a Rubric-Independent Mask prevents rubric spans from attending to one another, making rubric representations depend only on the answer and question context and preventing overfitting to rubric patterns during training for zero-shot transfer. On six ASAS benchmarks spanning English, German, and Portuguese, RUSPAN improves mono-benchmark scoring over discriminative and generative baselines, while RIM with position reindexing delivers consistent and substantial gains on PT-ASAG, the held-out benchmark with the strongest combined language and rubric-structure shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RUSPAN 框架，将评分量表描述视为语义标签表示，通过单次 LM 前向传播对候选评分层级进行列表式打分；并引入 RUSPAN-RIM，通过块稀疏注意力掩码实现评分量表间的独立性，以提升零样本跨基准迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 自动短答案评分（ASAS）需要在不同评分量表结构下保持高效、可迁移性。现有方法要么依赖固定标签空间分类器（缺乏灵活性），要么将每个学生答案扩展为多个答案-量表对进行检索（推理成本高），要么使用大语言模型生成式打分（效率低且不稳定）。本文旨在设计一种既支持变长评分层级、又保持单次前向传播效率的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 将问题、参考答案、学生答案和所有候选量表层级序列化到单一序列中；2) 通过 span pooling 提取每个量表层级的隐藏表示（最后一个 token），并提取全序列表示（最后一个 token）；3) 使用四种对齐函数（concat、diff、condiff、no-align）将量表表示与全序列表示结合，经共享评分头投射为标量分数；4) 引入 Rubric-Independent Mask (RIM)，采用块稀疏注意力掩码阻止量表跨层级互相关注，使每个量表表示仅依赖上下文；5) 位置重索引变体进一步使位置嵌入独立于其他量表。训练使用带有效性掩码的交叉熵损失以支持不同标签基数。
AI.result: 在涵盖英语、德语、葡萄牙语的六个 ASAS 基准上：单基准训练中 RUSPAN 与固定标签分类和检索基线具有竞争力，同时支持可变评分范围；联合训练跨基准评估中，标准 RUSPAN 在 PT-ASAG（葡萄牙语+四级评分）上表现较差，但带位置重索引的 RIM 在所有四个骨干模型上一致且显著地提升 PT-ASAG 性能（增益 6.9-12.5 个 macro-F1 点），并在 7/12 的基准-骨干组合中匹配或超过最强基线。八个 token 骨干模型上，RIM-重索引在所有三个迁移目标上均为最强方法。吞吐量介于固定头分类器与检索/生成方法之间。消融实验表明，量表描述的有用性取决于其与候选层级的显式绑定，而非简单附加于分类器输入。
AI.conclusion: RUSPAN 通过将评分量表视为标签表示并在单次前向传播中评分所有候选层级，在灵活性、准确性和效率之间提供了有利的权衡点。对于跨基准迁移，RIM 结合位置重索引可减轻量表间注意力依赖，在同时存在语言和量表结构偏移的场景下带来一致且显著的增益。未来工作方向包括更丰富的反馈生成、多维度评分以及对噪声或不完整量表的鲁棒性。

title: Alice: A Large-Scale German Benchmark for Rubric-Based Multi-Dimensional Automatic Short Answer Scoring
summary: Automatic Short Answer Scoring (ASAS) is central to NLP for Education. However, openly available benchmarks remain scarce, and existing datasets largely address how well students answer a question directly rather than how well they master underlying concepts (knowledge elements) such as thermal energy or epistemic activities (skills) such as reasoning or claim. To address this gap, we introduce Alice, a large-scale, rubric-based German ASAS dataset that is pedagogically aligned and comprises three subtasks: (i) learning performance (Alice-LP), (ii) knowledge elements (Alice-KE), and (iii) skills (Alice-SK). We further formulate rubric-based ASAS as a rubric-retrieval task and benchmark the dataset with a range of language models, from encoder-only models to lightweight LLMs. We also benchmark the dataset with zero-shot prompting via LLMs and a standard classification baseline. The experiments show that LLMs, in particular, struggle to score knowledge elements and skills in the zero-shot setting. They also indicate that rubric text is often useful, especially for Alice-KE and Alice-SK, while on Alice-LP gains over sample-solution-focused inputs are more modest and vary by model and input format.

AI.tldr: Alice是一个大规模、德语、基于评分量规（rubric）的多维度自动简答题评分（ASAS）基准，包含三个子任务：学习表现（Alice-LP）、知识要素（Alice-KE）和技能（Alice-SK），数据规模为16K学生答案、112道题，覆盖生物、化学、物理和数学四门学科。其核心贡献在于将基于量规的ASAS形式化为"量规检索"（rubric-retrieval）任务，采用交叉编码器对"答案—量规项"联合编码并以softmax交叉熵在候选量规集上做选择，以适应不同题目各自不同的量规结构。
AI.motivation: 现有ASAS基准大多为英语且采用"与标准答案比较"的方案，标签空间固定，缺少对学生在具体知识要素（如"热能"）和认知技能（如"推理"）维度上的细粒度评估；此外非英语（特别是德语）公开基准稀缺，难以服务真实课堂中的科学学科评估需求。
AI.method: 1) 数据：在Alice-LP 1.1基础上扩充学生答案并新增KE与SK标注，使用INCEPTION平台进行多轮试点与专家标注，报告各学科QWK一致性；采用Test-UA（未见答案）和Test-UQ（未见题目）双评测划分，并通过GPT-4o-mini做NLI分析发现相邻量规级常语义蕴含（并非互斥）。2) 建模：提出量规检索范式——将每个实例扩展为答案—量规对，由MLM（XLM-R-Long、mmBERT）和轻量LLM编码器（Llama-3.2 1B/3B，含Instruct版本，QLoRA微调）联合编码，使用softmax交叉熵；对比基线包括（a）固定标签序列分类和（b）零样本提示（Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5-mini）；消融包括对比损失与双编码器。
AI.result: 在三子任务上，量规检索在未见题目（UQ）下均稳定优于序列分类，且在Alice-KE和Alice-SK上的优势更明显；Alice-LP上二者接近。LLM编码器（尤其Llama-3.2-3B及其Instruct版）整体优于MLM，是最可靠的微调配置；GPT-5-mini零样本在Alice-LP/KE上接近微调水平，但开源较小模型在细粒度KE/SK上仍落后。量规文本是关键信息源：KE和SK子任务上加入量规的收益更大，而完整问题/示例解答上下文对LP的提升较小且因模型而异；同时Alice中相邻量规级存在语义蕴含，提示评分需在候选间进行"对比"而非二值匹配。
AI.conclusion: Alice为德语科学教育提供了一个贴合教学实际的多维度ASAS基准；基于量规检索的联合训练模型在跨题目泛化上明显优于传统固定标签序列分类，轻量LLM编码器是兼顾效果与推理效率的优选；量规文本是最重要的上下文信号，零样本专有LLM在粗粒度LP上已具竞争力，但细粒度KE/SK仍需监督微调。未来方向包括生成式反馈、LLM增强量规以及将该范式扩展到更大模型与多语言场景。

title: SAPD: Step-Aligned Privileged Distillation
summary: On-policy post-training can improve large language models by learning from their own trajectories, but requires costly rollout generation. We ask whether fixed demonstrations can support competitive off-policy learning through better supervision. Our premise is that their usefulness depends not only on the training trajectories, but also on whether supervision provides informative preferences among continuations and connects this guidance to the reasoning decision being learned. We introduce Step-Aligned Privileged Distillation (SAPD), a rollout-free self-distillation method that turns demonstrations into step-aligned distributional supervision. Its key insight is to use the known progression of a reference solution to associate each reasoning transition with targeted privileged guidance, rather than treating the solution as undifferentiated context. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAPD outperforms supervised fine-tuning and label smoothing on average while remaining competitive with on-policy reinforcement learning and self-distillation. Analyses support both the value of context-dependent distributional guidance and the benefit of aligning privileged information with the current step. SAPD also largely preserves out-of-domain coding performance and achieves approximately 2x training-loop speedups over the on-policy baselines. These findings suggest that carefully constructed supervision can make fully off-policy post-training a competitive and computationally efficient alternative. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAPD（Step-Aligned Privileged Distillation），一种无 rollout 的自蒸馏方法，将固定演示转化为步对齐的分布式监督信号，在数学推理任务上超越 SFT 和标签平滑，并具有约 2 倍的训练加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 on-policy 后训练方法（如 GRPO、OPSD）需要昂贵的自回归 rollout 生成，成本高昂。本文探索能否通过更好地构建监督信号（而非改变训练轨迹），使完全 off-policy 的固定演示学习具备竞争力。具体提出两个假设：(1) 监督应传达上下文相关的偏好，而非单一 one-hot 标签或均匀平滑；(2) 特权信息应与当前推理步骤对齐，而非使用全局解作为无差别上下文。
AI.method: SAPD 将参考解分割为多个参考段 g_1, ..., g_K。学生从参考前缀 h_{i,t}=(x, g_{<i}, g_{i,<t}) 预测；冻结教师额外以当前段 g_i 作为特权信息，构造上下文 c^T_{i,t}=(h_{i,t}, g_i)。通过 token 级前向 KL 散度对学生进行蒸馏，使学生匹配步对齐的教师分布。训练完全在固定参考前缀上进行，无需学生自生成轨迹。
AI.result: 在三个数学推理基准上，SAPD 平均性能优于 SFT 和标签平滑 SFT（LS-SFT），并与 GRPO 和 OPSD 保持竞争力；较好保留了域外代码能力；训练循环速度约为 on-policy 基线的 2 倍。消融实验支持上下文相关分布指导和当前步对齐指导的价值。
AI.conclusion: 精心构建的监督信号可使完全 off-policy 的后训练成为有竞争力且计算高效的选择。监督的构造方式（传递什么偏好、用哪部分演示信息）是除训练轨迹选择之外的另一重要杠杆。

title: InsClaimBench: Benchmarking Insurance Claim Adjudication Across the Decision Chain
summary: Recent advances in reasoning-oriented large language models (LLMs) have motivated increasing evaluation of their ability to perform professional decision tasks. Insurance claim adjudication is one such task, requiring models to connect case evidence, insurance rules, intermediate judgments, and payout calculations across a structured decision process. We introduce InsClaimBench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating insurance claim adjudication across the decision chain. Grounded in real claim materials and structured insurance rules, InsClaimBench contains 3,780 cases in 375 case families across auto, property, and health insurance, comprising 86,656 atomic rule judgments. It evaluates each claim from atomic rules through adjudication modules to payout decisions and amounts, with controlled factual variants testing whether required changes are correctly propagated across levels. Evaluation of six LLMs reveals a progressive loss of reliability along the decision chain. Payout-decision accuracy ranges from 74.23--80.19%, while joint decision--amount accuracy drops to 47.54--73.15%. Strong local performance also fails to ensure case-level correctness: atomic-rule accuracy reaches 95.48%, whereas rule-vector exact match peaks at only 36.90%, and the most frequent module errors are not necessarily those most associated with final-decision failure. Under factual changes, these inconsistencies further become propagation failures: module updates are less reliable than rule updates, correct local judgments can still yield incorrect payouts, and correct payouts can conceal intermediate errors. These results show that reliable claim adjudication requires consistent composition and propagation across the decision chain.

AI.tldr: InsClaimBench 是一个面向保险理赔裁决的端到端基准，涵盖从原子规则判断到理赔金额计算的完整决策链。它基于真实理赔材料和结构化保险规则构建了3,780个案例、375个案例族、86,656个原子规则判断，覆盖车险、财产险和健康险。核心发现是：LLM在决策链上呈现渐进式可靠性损失，局部高准确率无法保证端到端正确性，且事实修改下的传播失败是主要问题。
AI.motivation: 现有保险基准主要评估孤立子任务或部分决策过程，未能捕捉理赔裁决作为一个统一的端到端决策过程（即连接基础判断、中间决策、最终理赔结果和财务后果的完整链路）。此外，高风险专业决策本质上是依赖型判断链，其中间正确性与下游后果可能背离，这促使研究者构建一个能跨决策层级进行诊断的基准。
AI.method: 1) 采用自顶向下的三层层次化任务定义：理赔结果层（赔付与金额）、模块层（合同与理赔资格CCE、事件与因果EC、承保与除外CE）、原子规则层。2) 由理赔专家与LLM从政策条款、法规和专家知识中提取原子规则，并按通用、类别特定、产品特定三级组织。3) 专家定义逻辑公式将原子判断聚合为模块决策和赔付资格，并确定参考赔付金额。4) LLM生成原子场景并组合为完整理赔文件，通过修改特定事实构建反事实变体（保持不相关证据固定），形成案例族。5) 对六个LLM进行独立、分步评估（规则→模块→赔付决定→金额），并引入控制性反事实评估。
AI.result: 评估六个LLM（GPT-5.6-Sol、Gemini-3.8-Flash、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash、Kimi-K2.6、Qwen3.5-27B）发现：（1）赔付决定准确率74.23%-80.19%，但联合决策-金额准确率骤降至47.54%-73.15%；（2）原子规则准确率高达95.48%，但规则向量精确匹配率峰值仅36.90%；（3）事件与因果（EC）模块始终是准确率最低的瓶颈（70.21%-75.58%），但最频繁的模块错误未必与最终决策失败最相关；（4）在事实变化下，模块级pair correctness比规则级低9.92-17.43个百分点，28.57%-39.98%的所需模块更新失败；即使变更规则全部判断正确且基础金额正确，8.69%-18.89%的变体金额仍然错误（PAF）；部分模型68.03%的正确赔付对掩盖了中间模块错误（MME）。案例生成器的消融实验验证了结果稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的保险理赔裁决需要跨决策链的一致组合与传播能力。局部判断的准确性不能保证端到端正确性，频繁的模块错误与导致最终决策失败的错误之间存在脱节，正确的赔付结果可能掩盖中间判断错误。该基准揭示了当前推理型LLM在高风险专业决策任务中的系统性局限，强调未来需要联合评估判断正确性、对事实变化的响应和赔付结果。局限性在于当前基于合成理赔文件，未来需扩展至真实文档以考察在现实不确定性下的表现。

title: SpikingVLA: Asynchronous Spiking Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: ANN-to-SNN conversion offers a practical route toward energy-efficient spiking Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by bypassing the substantial cost of training large-scale SNNs from scratch. However, existing methods often require many timesteps to maintain competitive performance, resulting in substantial inference latency for real-time VLA deployment. To address this challenge, we introduce SpikingVLA, an ANN-to-SNN conversion framework that enables accurate and low-latency spiking VLA inference. Specifically, we propose a Dendritic Integrate-and-Fire (DIF) neuron that alleviates channel-wise activation outliers through dendritic mixing and adaptive somatic firing, enabling accurate ANN-to-SNN conversion with fewer timesteps. Building on DIF neurons, we further introduce an asynchronous execution mechanism that overlaps temporal computation across VLA components, reducing synchronization overhead and latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SpikingVLA achieves competitive navigation performance with substantially improved inference efficiency. Compared with existing spiking VLA methods, SpikingVLA improves SR and SPL by 11.9\% and 12.6\%, respectively, while reducing first-action latency by 11.2$\times$. These results establish SpikingVLA as a practical framework for deploying pretrained VLA models with high-performance and low-latency spiking inference.

AI.tldr: SpikingVLA是一个ANN-to-SNN转换框架，通过提出树突积分发放（DIF）神经元和异步执行机制，解决了脉冲VLA模型中通道激活异常导致的转换精度低以及时间同步开销导致的推理延迟高两大瓶颈，在T=8时间步下实现了接近无损的导航性能，SR和SPL分别提升11.9%和12.6%，首动作延迟降低11.2倍。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽具强大的多模态决策能力，但其大规模视觉-语言骨干网络带来巨大计算开销，难以部署在资源受限的机器人上。现有模型压缩方法保留密集计算，仍存在大量冗余。SNN虽提供事件驱动稀疏计算范式，但从头训练大规模SNN代价高昂，ANN-to-SNN转换成为实用替代方案。然而，现有脉冲VLA方法存在两个关键瓶颈：(1) VLA组件中显著的通道级激活异常值在有限时间步下增加脉冲编码误差，降低转换精度；(2) 各组件时间步不一致导致同步停顿和空闲期，增加端到端推理延迟。
AI.method: 方法包含两大核心组件：(1) **DIF神经元**：包含树突通道混合（多个并行分支对局部通道子空间进行独立混合，通过正交矩阵实现能量保持的异常值重分布）和通道自适应体细胞发放（基于树突后激活分布独立校准每个通道的发放阈值和层级）；(2) **操作感知的差分转换**：对仿射算子通过权重重参数化吸收基变换，对非线性算子通过连续状态的响应差计算增量，对乘法交互采用双线性差分展开；(3) **异步执行机制**：高低层策略在每个内部时间步即时传播差分响应，无需等待完整时间同步，使视觉、语言、动作处理的时间计算重叠，降低首动作延迟。理论分析证明了能量保持异常值重分布定理和时序-阈值粒度权衡定理。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val-Unseen基准上，T=8时SpikingVLA达到与ANN基线NaVILA相当的导航性能（R2R-CE: NE=5.20, SR=54.6, SPL=50.3；RxR-CE: NE=6.30, SR=51.6, SPL=45.8, nDTW=61.3）。在VLN-CE-Isaac闭环导航中，SpikingVLA-Vision达到NE=5.45, SR=44.6, SPL=41.1，相比现有脉冲VLA方法SpikeVLA的SR和SPL分别提升11.9和12.6个百分点。TTFA从186.1降至16.7（11.2倍加速）。能量方面，T=8时总能耗从ANN的148.27 J降至46.80 J。消融实验表明，DIF在n=8时将视觉编码器转换误差从0.52降至0.11（78.8%相对降低），LLaMA解码器从0.24降至0.11（54.2%相对降低）。
AI.conclusion: SpikingVLA是首个实现准确且低延迟脉冲VLA推理的ANN-to-SNN转换框架，通过DIF神经元有效缓解通道激活异常问题实现少时间步的高保真转换，通过异步执行机制消除同步开销。实验证明其可在T=8的紧凑时间预算下保持接近ANN的导航性能，显著优于现有脉冲VLA方法，为预训练VLA模型的高性能低延迟脉冲部署提供了实用方案。

title: Bridge Routing Heads: Where Multilingual Multi-hop Reasoning Lives in LLMs
summary: Multilingual LLMs answer the same multi-hop reasoning question across languages, but we lack a mechanistic account of whether they share an internal circuit. We identify Bridge Routing Heads (BRH) in two large multilingual LLMs through a three-stage pipeline. The resulting language-specific head sets exhibit near-complete mutual exclusivity across the five languages, with a mean Jaccard similarity of only 0.017 for Llama 3.1 70B and 0.057 for Qwen 2.5 72B, revealing language-idiosyncratic circuits. Ablating general BRH increases two-hop Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) by 39-89x the random-head baseline, providing direct causal evidence of their role. Amplifying these heads in a failing target-language pass rescues up to 51.7% of cross-lingual failures, with no training. The two models share this dual-circuit pattern but allocate heads differently: Llama concentrates chaining in a large general pool, while Qwen leans on larger language-specific pools. Together these results show that activation-level intervention alone can recover correct answers from cross-lingual reasoning failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"桥接路由头"（BRH）概念，通过三阶段流水线在Llama 3.1 70B和Qwen 2.5 72B中识别出多语言多跳推理所需的注意力头，发现其分为共享的语言通用池和近乎互斥的语言特定池，并通过激活级干预（无需训练）即可恢复跨语言推理失败案例。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对多语言LLMs在不同语言下成功完成同一多跳推理问题时内部电路是否共享的机制性解释，且大多集中于分析失败模式而非成功路径。多语言输出的一致性可能掩盖了根本不同的内部处理过程，这要求从机理可解释性角度揭示多语言推理的真实电路结构。
AI.method: 构建基于Wikidata的五种语言（英、韩、中、日、西）两跳推理数据集；通过分层激活补丁定位推理信号在注意力模块；采用LAHIS梯度重要性评分结合三条件对比（首跳FH、两跳TH、次跳SH）计算桥接路由得分BRS；依次经均值消融和Patchscopes验证三阶段过滤识别BRH；通过集合级消融和放大干预（1+α）进行因果验证。
AI.result: 语言特定头集在五种语言间几乎完全互斥（Llama平均Jaccard 0.017，Qwen 0.057）；消融通用BRH使两跳NLL增加39–89倍于随机基线；放大通用BRH在Llama上恢复高达51.7%的跨语言失败案例（无需训练）；两模型共享双电路模式但分配不同——Llama集中于大型通用池，Qwen依赖更大的语言特定池。
AI.conclusion: 多语言LLMs的成功多跳推理既非完全共享也非完全语言特定，而是由语言通用BRH池和互斥的语言特定BRH池共同承载的；激活级放大干预可在不更新参数的前提下恢复跨语言推理失败，表明部分目标语言失败反映的是路由电路权重不足而非知识缺失，为免训练多语言模型编辑开辟了新路径。

title: Shaer: Controlled Arabic Poetry Generation with Meter Subform and Semantic Conditioning
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures. Code: this https URL ; models and datasets: this https URL
summary: Classical Arabic poetry generation requires simultaneously satisfying semantic, linguistic, and fine-grained prosodic constraints. Existing systems typically control broad poetic attributes but do not jointly model semantic intent, meter subform, and poem length. We present Shaer, a controllable Classical Arabic poetry generation framework jointly conditioned on natural-language descriptions, meter subforms, and target hemistich counts. To support this task, we construct an enriched corpus of 116,032 classical Arabic poems derived from Ashaar, containing normalized meter-subform labels and automatically generated, validated semantic descriptions. We then adapt Yehia-7B using QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning with a completion-only objective. Our evaluation combines automatic assessment of base-meter conformity, requested-subform adherence, and length control with three LLM judges, blinded human evaluation, and memorization analysis. Shaer achieves 95.17% base-meter accuracy, 91.75% poem-level meter-subform accuracy, and 83.40% exact count accuracy. Relative to its untuned foundation model, these results represent gains of 68.68, 57.77, and 38.93 percentage points, respectively; Shaer also attains the highest base-meter accuracy among all evaluated systems. Multi-LLM evaluation and a blinded human assessment of top-ranked outputs further indicate competitive semantic and literary quality. Finally, analysis of all 3,481 test generations finds no exact copies from the training corpus or paired source poems. Code, models, and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: Shaer is a controllable Classical Arabic poetry generation framework that jointly conditions on natural-language semantic descriptions, meter subforms, and target hemistich counts. It fine-tunes Yehia-7B with QLoRA and achieves strong automatic and human-evaluated performance without memorization.
AI.motivation: Classical Arabic poetry must simultaneously satisfy semantic content, fine-grained meter (including subforms), and structural length constraints. Prior systems control only broad attributes and fail to jointly model semantic intent, meter subform, and poem length, leaving a gap in controllable generation for this morphologically and prosodically rich literary tradition.
AI.method: 1) Construct an enriched corpus of 116,032 classical Arabic poems from Ashaar with normalized meter-subform labels and LLM-generated, validated semantic descriptions. 2) Adapt Yehia-7B via QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning using a completion-only objective, conditioning on (description, meter subform, hemistich count). 3) Evaluate with automatic metrics (base-meter conformity, subform adherence, length/exact count), three LLM judges, blinded human evaluation, and memorization analysis on all 3,481 test generations.
AI.result: Shaer achieves 95.17% base-meter accuracy, 91.75% poem-level meter-subform accuracy, and 83.40% exact hemistich-count accuracy, corresponding to gains of +68.68, +57.77, and +38.93 percentage points over the untuned foundation model. It attains the highest base-meter accuracy among all evaluated systems, shows competitive semantic and literary quality in multi-LLM judging and blinded human assessment, and exhibits no exact copies from the training corpus or paired source poems.
AI.conclusion: Joint conditioning on semantic descriptions, meter subforms, and length, combined with QLoRA SFT of an Arabic-suited LLM on an enriched corpus, enables effective controllable Classical Arabic poetry generation. Shaer sets a new state-of-the-art in base-meter accuracy while preserving semantic/literary quality and avoiding memorization, with code, models, and datasets released publicly.

title: Judging in Latent Space: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Semantics-Preserving Compression
summary: Reward modeling often requires jointly representing and reasoning over multiple evaluation criteria, yet verbalizing this process token by token can incur substantial inference cost. Recent work on latent reasoning suggests that continuous states may support this computation more compactly. We introduce LatentGRM, a latent evaluation framework built on semantic chunking, compression, and reconstruction. By using the structure of rubric-guided evaluations to guide compression, LatentGRM learns compact continuous trajectories that support autonomous pairwise judgments without generating textual assessments. A separate interpreter reconstructs evaluation text from these trajectories, providing an offline view of the information retained under compression. Under matched training data and backbones, LatentGRM achieves competitive aggregate preference accuracy relative to explicit Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) judges at both 4B and 8B scales. Across four benchmark domains, LatentGRM-8B compresses evaluation trajectories by 8.9--9.2x and reduces total judge inference time by 6.1--7.0x at vote@5. Controlled rubric interventions show that criterion-dependent preference information is carried through the latent sequence. Together, these results demonstrate that continuous latent evaluation can substantially reduce inference cost while preserving competitive judgment quality.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentGRM，一种基于语义分块、压缩和解构的潜在评估框架，将基于评分标准的显式评估轨迹压缩为紧凑的连续表示，从而在保持判断质量的同时显著降低生成式奖励模型的推理成本。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的生成式奖励模型在多准则评估时需要逐token生成中间文本，导致推理开销巨大；而现有潜在推理方法尚未被系统地引入奖励建模领域，缺乏在结构化评分标准指导下进行语义保持型压缩的方案。
AI.method: 两阶段训练框架：(1)语义分块利用评分标准的块结构分配固定潜在预算，并通过句法边界细化分割点；将显式评估trace蒸馏为vocabulary-space的top-K软标记混合嵌入。(2)阶段2采用Gumbel扰动训练自主潜在评估器，自回归生成连续轨迹并直接输出偏好；离线训练的潜在轨迹解释器(LTI)可从保存的轨迹中重构显式评估内容。扩展vLLM以支持软嵌入反馈。
AI.result: 在8个基准测试域上，LatentGRM-8B在vote@5时与显式SFT评判器(Rubric-RM-8B)在平均偏好准确率上相当(69.0 vs 68.1)；在4个域中，评估轨迹压缩8.9–9.2倍，vLLM推理时间减少6.1–7.0倍；受控评分标准干预证实准则级偏好信息通过潜在序列传递；LTI在重构准则级状态时达到98.93%的Macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的潜在轨迹能够有效支持高效的多准则判断，同时使压缩后的评估具有可检查性；语义分块优于固定速率分块；该框架为奖励建模中连续潜在推理的实用化提供了可行路径。

title: EASE: Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evading AI-generated Text Detectors
summary: AI-generated text (AIGT) detection can be sensitive to the decoding choices of the source large language model (LLM). We observe that perturbing next-token logits or adjusting sampling temperature can reduce detection performance, providing a clear signal of detector vulnerability to decoding-time distribution changes. Building on this observation, we propose EASE (Entropy-Adaptive Distribution Shaping for Evasion), a training-free and detector-agnostic framework for evading AIGT detectors. EASE computes predictive entropy directly from the source LLM's next-token distribution and uses it to adapt both logit perturbation and sampling temperature, without detector feedback or model fine-tuning. Experiments across three source LLMs and multiple detectors demonstrate consistent reductions in detection performance, with negligible degradation in text quality and negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: EASE提出了一种无需训练、无需检测器反馈的框架，通过源LLM的预测熵自适应调整logit扰动和采样温度，以规避AI生成文本检测器，同时几乎不增加推理开销且文本质量损失可忽略。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGT检测规避方法（如改写、偏好优化、代理引导解码）通常需要检测器反馈、辅助模型或模型微调，计算开销大且跨检测器/模型的适用性受限。本文旨在探索：是否可以在生成阶段直接规避AIGT检测器，而无需检测器反馈或模型微调。
AI.method: EASE包含三个核心组件：(1) 熵自适应控制：在top-k候选集上计算预测熵ht，定义控制因子γt=max(0,1-ht/hmax)，低熵时γt大以施加更强扰动；(2) 令牌相关logit调制：使用正弦函数mt(i)=sin(w1·x_{t-1}+w2·vi+t)为每个候选令牌生成调制系数，决定扰动的符号和相对幅度；(3) 分布塑形：结合加性调制l̃t(i)=lt(i)+δ·γt·mt(i)和温度调整τ̃t=τ+β·γt，在采样前重塑下一令牌分布。提供两种配置：EASE-Plugin（初始生成时应用）和EASE-Rewrite（生成后重写阶段应用）。
AI.result: 在三个源LLM（Qwen3-8B、Llama3-8B-Instruct、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct）和多个检测器上的实验显示：EASE-Plugin在Qwen3-8B上将5个检测器的平均TPR@1%FPR从0.655降至0.339；跨8个检测器在三个LLM上均实现一致的AUROC和TPR@1%FPR下降；PPL仅从4.243增至7.752（低于改写基线的9.867-15.196）；BLEU/ROUGE指标变化小；推理开销仅0.643%。消融实验证实熵自适应和温度自适应均对有效性有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 解码时分布变化可显著降低AIGT检测器性能，这揭示了检测器对解码设置的脆弱性。未来检测器设计需考虑解码引起的文本统计变化，并在多样化解码设置下进行评估。EASE作为一种即插即用的解码模块，具有实用价值。

title: The Long Road to the Same Answer: Cognitive Bias Under Escalating Reasoning Budgets in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Cognitive Machine Intelligence (IEEE CogMI 2026). 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Reasoning models allocate extra computation at inference time and present their answers as the product of deliberate thought. If this deliberation works the way dual-process accounts of human cognition suggest, longer thinking should weaken the classic decision biases that fast, intuitive judgment produces. Using 30 vignettes covering six biases (anchoring, framing, loss aversion, escalation of commitment, availability, confirmation) from an established benchmark, we run a dose-response study across four model families, pairing each reasoning model with a matched non-reasoning sibling and requesting thinking ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 tokens, for 12,350 API calls. Because a requested ceiling is not the same as realized deliberation, we use the reasoning tokens each call consumed as the dose. First, reasoning models are not less biased than their siblings; the point estimate leans the other way in every family, but the item-level pooled contrast is not reliable (Delta = +0.031, t(29) = 1.45, p = .157). Second, bias magnitude does not reliably fall as realized deliberation grows: no slope is significantly negative, and where anything moves it is the signed score drifting further from the human direction. Third, anchoring is the only bias in the human direction (d = 1.89). Four of the other five lean the opposite way in all seven models; with five items per bias, that reversal is reliable for framing and directional for escalation of commitment, confirmation, and loss aversion, while availability is absent. A one-line instruction to restate the anchor before answering lowered anchoring on all five anchoring items, which no amount of additional thinking did, although the effect does not reach significance (p = .057). The results argue against treating test-time reasoning as a rationality guarantee and for auditing deployed models bias by bias.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过剂量-反应实验（30个决策情景×6种认知偏差×4个模型家族×4个思考预算，共12,350次API调用）发现：推理模型并未比其同家族非推理对照模型更少偏差，且随着实际推理token增加，偏差并未可靠下降；唯一表现与人类方向一致的偏差是锚定效应（d=1.89），而框架效应等四种偏差在所有七个模型中均呈反向；强制模型复述锚定数字的简单提示干预在所有锚定项目上均有效，而增加推理预算则无效。
AI.motivation: 研究动机源于双重过程理论（System 1/System 2）对人类认知偏差的解释：如果推理模型内部的"思考阶段"类似于人类的审慎推理（System 2），那么更长的推理应当削弱快速直觉判断产生的经典决策偏差。这一剂量-响应预测在受控条件下尚未被检验，但其结果对部署实践至关重要——如果推理能减少偏差，分配算力就成为可量化的缓解手段；如果不能，则需寻找替代方案。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 从Malberg等人基准中冻结30个项目（6种偏差×5项）的电池；(2) 七个模型横跨四个家族（Anthropic、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Qwen），每个推理模型与家族内的非推理对照配对；(3) 请求思考上限设为0、1024、4096、8192个token，每单元采样10次（温度1.0），共12,350次调用；(4) 记录每次调用的实际推理token消耗而非仅信任请求；(5) 对锚定项目添加第三条件：要求模型复述所有数字；(6) 偏差评分s基于控制组与处理组均值差异，符号反映与人类方向的一致性；(7) 统计检验使用项目配对t检验、项目聚类bootstrap区间、Holm校正。
AI.result: 结果包含四个核心发现：(1) RQ1：推理模型在四个家族中均不表现出比对照更低的偏差幅度，差异方向一致但项目级合并对比不可靠（Δ=+0.031，t(29)=1.45，p=.157）；(2) RQ2：无模型显示偏差幅度随实际推理token增长而可靠下降，GPT-5.1的幅度甚至上升（β=+0.0084，p=.018），Claude和GPT-5.1的符号分数随推理增加而漂离人类方向；(3) RQ3：锚定是唯一与人类方向一致的偏差（M=+0.163，d=1.89），框架效应可靠反向（M=-0.336，d=-2.35），升级承诺、确认偏差、损失厌恶呈方向性反向（所有七个模型一致但项目级检验未达显著），可得性偏差不存在；(4) RQ4：强制复述锚定的提示在所有五个项目上均降低锚定效应（Δ=-0.015），但项目级检验刚未达显著（p=.057）。此外发现请求上限与实际推理消耗的偏离因提供商而异（Claude遵守、GPT-5.1转为单一努力等级、DeepSeek和Qwen未强制执行）。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：测试时推理不应被视为理性的保证。推理模型并不比其同家族对照更少偏差；在所测量的实际推理范围内，偏差幅度未随推理增加而可靠下降；唯一表现类似人类的偏差（锚定）在最高推理水平下与无推理时同样强烈。数据呈现的是一幅反向倾斜的偏差图景——在七个模型中，四种偏差方向一致反向，框架效应可靠反向。同时，一行提示干预在每个锚定项目上都有效，而计算预算增加无效。请求的思考预算是实际思考的糟糕代理，这一发现本身值得该领域吸收。实践建议：(1)不要假设推理层级是低偏差选项；(2)按偏差和方向逐项审计部署模型；(3)对数值锚定风险，一行锚定复述指令值得情境化测试。双重过程类比作为假设生成器仍有价值，但其核心预测在所测范围内失败。

title: Cache the Encoder Within:Compact, Reusable Memory across LLM Queries
summary: Repeated queries over shared documents incur redundant encoding, while caching model states introduces persistent storage costs. Building on CoMem's intermediate-state interface, EncBank treats a pretrained LLM's lower layers as a reusable document encoder and compactly stores their outputs for an adapted upper-layer reader. A self-distilled suffix adapter is shared across storage precisions within each backbone, without quantization-specific retraining. Across five benchmark suites on three Qwen backbones spanning different sizes and full-attention and hybrid architectures, 4-bit storage keeps each reported benchmark aggregate within one score point of native-precision EncBank. In a fixed Qwen3-8B workload, it retains 28.1% of the native-precision persistent GPU store. Separate native-precision controls yield a 1.40x selected-pack prefill speedup over same-evidence, same-adapter text replay, at a 3.12-point RULER accuracy cost. A native-precision Qwen3.8-27B configuration also passes 70 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks. EncBank thus combines reusable computation with compact memory, while task fidelity and end-to-end benefits remain dependent on the workload, preparation costs, and reuse frequency.

AI.tldr: EncBank 提出了一种在 LLM 内部进行可复用记忆缓存的方法：将预训练 LLM 的较低层视为可重用的文档编码器，将其输出（残差状态）以 H16/H8/H4 等紧凑格式持久化存储，并由一个经适配（通过自蒸馏 LoRA）的上层读取器在查询时读取重建。在三个 Qwen 系列骨干（全注意力及混合架构）上，4-bit 存储可在五个基准测试中将聚合分数保持在原生精度 EncBank 的 1 分以内，并保留 28.1% 的持久化 GPU 存储空间；同时在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上以 27B 模型取得 70/89 的任务通过率。
AI.motivation: 在长文档问答、检索增强、对话历史等场景中，同一份文档或语料常被多个查询重复使用；若每次都重新编码上下文，则会产生大量冗余计算；若缓存完整 KV cache，又会带来巨大的存储开销（Qwen3-8B 全层 16-bit KV 约 144 KiB/token）。因此需要在"保留何种计算"与"以何种精度存储"之间寻求折中：既要减少重复编码，又要控制持久化存储成本。
AI.method: 基于 CoMem 的 Write-Select-Read 中间状态接口，将 LLM 的前 j 层作为文档编码器，独立编码每个 512-token chunk，将其第 j 层之后的残差状态以 H16/H8/H4（FP16 / 8-bit affine / 4-bit affine，每 64 值为一组）量化打包存储；查询时通过 token-ID BM25 检索相关 chunk，重建残差后由经过自蒸馏 LoRA 适配的上层读取器继续处理。同一骨干内 H16/H8/H4 共享同一个适配后的读取器，无需针对不同精度重新训练。
AI.result: 1) 5 个基准（RULER、LongEval、LongBench QA6、BABILong、LoCoMo）跨 3 个 Qwen 骨干（Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B），H4 与 H16 的聚合分数差距均在 1 分以内；2) Qwen3-8B 工作负载下，H4 仅占 H16 持久化 GPU 存储的 28.1%；3) 原生精度控制在 RULER-B 上实现 1.40× 的选定包预填充加速，但牺牲 3.12 分精度；4) Qwen3.8-27B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上以 EncBank-H16 通过 70/89 任务（78.65%），优于 Dense 全上下文的 61/89（68.54%）。但也暴露了若干局限：受限于 top-12 检索，覆盖率有限；适配器对不同接口的迁移性不一致；H4 节省存储并未按比例降低请求时延。
AI.conclusion: EncBank 将"可重用计算"与"紧凑记忆"统一在一个框架内：通过单层残差存储 + 共享自蒸馏适配读取器，使低精度持久化存储（4-bit）在大多数基准聚合分数上接近原生精度。然而任务保真度与端到端收益高度依赖于工作负载特征、预处理成本与查询复用频率；深度与精度的联合优化、混合架构下的完整绑定、跨适配器对照等仍是未解决的问题。

title: I would rather quit NLP than read another paper like this: The rise of antithesis in NLP papers
summary: For better or worse, LLMs are by now used routinely for scientific writing.\footnote{This paper is no exception; we did use AI to assist with writing some of the sections (see Acknowledgments).} Many have noticed that recent models fill papers with unnecessary antithesis, stating over and over what the work does not do, in ways that do not contribute to its precision or quality of expression and annoy reviewers \emph{rather than impressing them}. We study the construction \emph{rather than} in ACL papers from 2019, ACL-style arXiv papers from 2026, and papers written by GPT models from the same titles and abstracts. Its rate in 2026 is seven times the 2019 rate, and higher still in the GPT papers. Two annotators, blind to the source, find almost no 2019 use \emph{annoying} and about one in ten 2026 uses; they seldom agree on which, yet about half of 2026 papers contain a use that annoys each of them. \emph{Annoying} uses present the rejected alternative less favorably than legitimate uses. Raters of preference data and open reward models favor the construction, and an instruction to be honest promotes it. We conjecture that it is a side effect of post-training on pairwise preferences, which credit a disavowal in a single response and cannot register its cost across a text.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，"rather than"这一对照句式在2026年NLP论文中的使用频率是2019年的七倍，在GPT生成的论文中更高。作者论证这是LLM后训练（基于偏好的优化）中产生的副作用：偏好数据中的评分者倾向于奖励这种构造，"诚实"指令会促进其使用，而读者认为这种"定义式对比"令人厌烦，因为它常贬低被拒绝的替代选项并引入稻草人论证。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）已被广泛用于学术写作，但它们在NLP论文中留下了显著的文体痕迹。作者观察到近期LLM倾向于在论文中过度使用"rather than"等反衬/纠正性句式（定义式对比），这令审稿人感到厌烦而非留下深刻印象。本研究旨在系统量化这一现象、探究其原因，并评估其对学术写作的影响。
AI.method: 本文采用四组数据集对比：2019年ACL论文（LLM辅助写作普及前）、2026年arXiv上的ACL风格论文、GPT模型从相同标题摘要生成的论文、以及Tülu 3 8B和Claude模型的生成论文。研究方法包括：(1) 用正则表达式统计"rather than"及相关反衬句式的频率；(2) 两名NLP研究者盲标注1000个使用案例的"令人厌烦/合法"；(3) 使用案例对照设计测试稻草人论证（被拒替代选项是否无人会持有的立场）和评价性立场（X与Y的褒贬程度）；(4) 分析偏好数据（UltraFeedback、Tülu 3、HelpSteer2/3）中评分者是否奖励该句式；(5) 用Skywork-Reward-V2奖励模型测试最小对比对；(6) 利用UltraFeedback中诚实指令的随机分配检验其对使用频率的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) "rather than"在2026年论文中的使用率是2019年的约7倍，GPT-5.6-sol和GPT-6-sol生成的论文使用率更高（每千词约2次，几乎每篇都有）；(2) 标注者几乎不给2019年用法标"烦"，但约10%的2026年用法被认为烦人——约一半的2026年论文包含让某位标注者厌烦的用法；(3) "烦人"的用法更倾向于贬低被拒绝的替代选项（Y评分更低），且被其他编码者更频繁地判定为稻草人；(4) 偏好数据中的评分者（人类和LLM评判员均如此）倾向于奖励该句式，奖励模型在控制长度和情感后仍偏好带"rather than"子句的句子，"诚实"指令使其使用率上升（优势比1.15）；(5) Claude模型的立场更温和，不那么贬低被拒绝选项，但其修订版本添加了"自我否定"用法，同样令人厌烦；(6) Tülu 3 8B在不同后训练阶段（SFT、DPO、最终模型）使用率均低，表明问题不在于偏好优化或RLVR本身，而可能在于商业模型特定的偏好数据和目标。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论：(1) "rather than"已成为LLM时代NLP写作的一个标志，其使用率的急剧上升与LLM辅助写作的普及同步；(2) 让读者厌烦的核心机制是该句式将"评价性立场"带入科学论述——赞扬所选方案、贬低替代方案，这在科学论文这一本应评价中立体裁中尤其令人反感；(3) 这是后训练基于成对偏好优化的副作用：评分者对单一回答中的"自我否定"给予奖励，却无法衡量其在一篇论文乃至整个文献中的累积代价；(4) 由于多种句式可承担相同功能，仅禁用该短语只会让同一功能转移到其他形式（如"X, not Y"），这表明需要更根本的修正；(5) 标注者在语料库层面一致，在具体用例上分歧大——这表明"烦人"具有个人主观性，但聚合起来反映了对整个文献的判断；(6) 人类作者已采用此句式，文献的文风正向模型靠拢，而模型又将从这些文献中学习，形成循环。

title: Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models Part 1.1: From Hybrid Attention to Hybrid Position
summary: The architectural design of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting from traditional full-attention-only models to hybrid models, which combine different attention modules to improve long-context efficiency and performance in length extrapolation and context extension. To explain why hybrid models work and how to design them better, we propose Mechanics of Long-Context Hybrid Models. As Part 1.1 of this series, we begin with hybrids of full attention and either sliding-window attention (SWA) or gated variants of linear attention (LA), represented by GLA and GDN. We first observe a Seesaw Effect in Context Extension: LA hybrids benefit more from long-context continual pretraining, whereas SWA hybrids perform better under length extrapolation. We attribute this behavior to differences in the positional inductive biases induced by these attention mechanisms. We find that SWA hybrids suffer from a Short-Context Learning Trap, Short-Window Weariness, and Long-Window Laziness, and require extended windows to enhance performance in continual long-context pretraining. For LA hybrids, we summarize the Matthew Effect of Hybrid Position Extrapolation and propose Sliding-Window Linear Attention, achieving 16$\times$ training-free length extrapolation while maintaining 100\% accuracy on NIAH-SK1 in 64k context length.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了长上下文混合模型的内部机理，对比了滑动窗口注意力(SWA)和门控线性注意力(LA)与NoPE全注意力的层间/头间混合，发现SWA混合在长度外推上占优但在上下文扩展中被LA混合反超(Sawtooth/Seesaw效应)；提出Sliding-Window Linear Attention(SWLA)以限制线性注意力相对位置范围，结合NoPE注意力log缩放实现16×免训练长度外推(NIAH-SK1 64k上下文保持100%)。
AI.motivation: 主流开源大语言模型的架构正从单一全注意力转向混合注意力设计以提升长上下文效率与外推性能，但混合模型为何有效、如何更优设计尚缺乏基于位置归纳偏好的机理性分析。论文旨在以"机械学(Mechanics)"视角，从位置偏置协作角度解释混合模型的成败机理，并据此提出更强的外推策略。
AI.method: 在376M/776M/1B/3B四种规模、4k短上下文预训练(50B token)与32k长上下文持续预训练(5B token)条件下，比较RoPE-NoPE、SWA-NoPE、GLA-NoPE、GDN-NoPE的层间混合(LH)与头间混合(HH)。通过Hit Rate、检索头比例、注意力熵(及其向线性注意力的扩展——Jacobian矩阵范数)构建"熵-命中率散点图"分析不同位置偏置头的功能分布，并进行噪声注入、窗口尺寸消融、RoPE底数实验。提出Sliding-Window Linear Attention(SWLA)对LA施加滑动窗口限制，结合NoPE注意力log缩放，组成EME外推方法。
AI.result: (1) Tidal Effect：NoPE注意力占据高熵高命中率条带区，负责粗粒度全局定位；带位置偏置的注意力(包含GLA/GDN)位于低熵扇形区，两者比例调节可重新分配；(2) Seesaw Effect：SWA-NoPE混合预训练后外推强，但长上下文持续训练后被LA混合反超，源于其Short-Context Learning Trap(SWA模块参数变化过大而窗口受限)；(3) No-Free-Lunch：LA混合训练域内拟合强但外推弱；(4) Short-Window Weariness+Long-Window Laziness：SWA短窗口利于外推，长窗口利于上下文扩展，建议长训练时扩大窗口并使用LongCE；(5) Matthew Effect + SWLA：GDN-NoPE-HH在64k上下文NIAH-SK1上达到100%准确率，实现16×免训练外推。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型通过混合位置(NoPE+其他位置偏置)实现性能提升；NoPE承担粗粒度全局定位、位置偏置注意力承担局部精细化，二者在熵-命中率图上功能互补。SWA混合应避免短上下文学习陷阱(扩大窗口+LongCE)；LA混合应通过SWLA+log缩放(EME)限制相对位置范围以增强外推。系列工作的Part 1.1为后续稀疏注意力与压缩注意力混合模型提供了机理性框架。

title: LLM4Impact: Integrating Heterogeneous Information for Scientific Impact Prediction
summary: Predicting the future impact of a newly published paper is challenging because it must be inferred from heterogeneous evidence available at publication time. Existing approaches often rely on a single source of information or combine multiple sources without accounting for their different predictive roles. In this paper, we present LLM4Impact, an evidence-aware method for scientific impact prediction that learns to represent, integrate, and calibrate heterogeneous information. LLM4Impact combines semantic, graph, LLM, and temporal representations, and injects graph information into a frozen LLM through continuous prefix tokens. A context aware gating mechanism adaptively weights different evidence, while a separate calibration module accounts for domain and temporal variation in citation scales. We further construct a large-scale benchmark dataset with 2 million papers, leakage-safe point-in-time heterogeneous ego graphs, temporal splits, and both year-level and month-level citation targets. Experiments show that LLM4Impact consistently outperforms strong semantic, graph, and LLM based baselines, with a 10.13% reduction in year RMSE on the in distribution test set and a 6.87% reduction under out-of-domain distribution. Our results reveal that the value of such evidence is context dependent: different papers benefit from different sources, while domain and publication time affect how evidence translates into citations. This finding motivates adaptive evidence selection and context-conditioned calibration rather than simply richer representations. We will release our code, benchmark, and an interactive web demonstration upon publication.

AI.tldr: LLM4Impact提出了一种证据感知的科学影响力预测方法，通过整合语义、图、LLM和时序四种异构信息源，结合上下文门控机制和领域/时间校准模块，在200万篇论文的大规模基准上显著优于现有基线，并发现不同证据的价值因论文、领域和发表时间而异。
AI.motivation: 科学论文的影响力预测面临挑战：新论文的未来引用必须从发表时可获得的异构证据中推断。现有方法通常依赖单一信息源，或虽融合多源但未考虑不同证据的预测角色差异，导致无法根据论文、领域和时间的上下文自适应利用信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模基准数据集（200万篇论文，无信息泄漏的时点异构自我图，时序划分，年/月级引用目标）；2) LLM4Impact框架融合四种表征——语义、图结构、LLM、时序；3) 通过连续前缀令牌（continuous prefix tokens）将图信息注入冻结的LLM；4) 上下文感知门控机制自适应加权不同证据；5) 独立校准模块处理领域和时间引起的引用规模差异。
AI.result: 在分布内测试集上，年级RMSE降低10.13%；在域外分布上降低6.87%；方法在语义、图和LLM基线上均取得一致提升。核心发现：不同证据的价值具有上下文依赖性——不同论文受益于不同信息源，领域和发表时间影响证据到引用的转换方式。
AI.conclusion: LLM4Impact通过自适应证据选择和上下文条件校准，验证了"更丰富的表征"并非万能，关键在于根据具体上下文动态调整证据权重。该工作将发布代码、基准和交互式Web演示，推动科学影响力预测向更精细、上下文敏感的方向发展。

title: InterView-C: A Synchronized Multimodal Corpus of VR Avatar-Mediated Survey Interviews
summary: We present InterView-C, a German multimodal corpus of 27 survey interviews conducted entirely in virtual reality, with both interlocutors represented by avatars. The corpus aligns spoken interaction with synchronized behavioral data, including gaze, head and body movement, facial behavior, hand and finger tracking. Its reference transcripts and linguistic annotations provide a reliable interface between this multimodal spoken interaction and predominantly text-based NLP methods. This interface is important because automatically transcribing speech can distort linguistically relevant information, while downstream models trained on existing resources may additionally face transfer challenges when applied to transcribed spoken data. InterView-C therefore provides word-timed and manually post-edited verbatim transcripts for all 54 recordings, interview-item timings, questionnaire responses and negation cue and scope annotations for 1,422 sentences, 1,398 of them doubly annotated ({\alpha}=0.87 for cues; {\alpha}=0.81 for scopes). We demonstrate both challenges empirically: nine open-weight ASR systems disproportionately misrecognize short closed answers and number words, while negation models trained on existing corpora show lower and highly variable performance on our transcribed interviews than a model trained on the InterView-C annotations. InterView-C thus enables linguistic analyses of spoken interaction while retaining their alignment with rich multimodal behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InterView-C，一个包含27场德语VR化身调查访谈的多模态同步语料库。该语料库将语音互动与凝视、头部、身体、面部行为、手部和手指追踪等行为数据对齐，并提供词级时间戳的人工参考转录、否定线索和范围的标注（1,422句，α分别为0.87和0.81）。研究表明九个开源ASR系统对短闭合回答和数字词的识别错误率较高，而在InterView-C上训练的否定模型优于跨语料库迁移模型。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态对话研究需要整合语音与非语言行为，但现有模型主要处理文本、图像和音频，缺乏对凝视、面部表情和身体动作的处理能力。同时，自动语音识别（ASR）会扭曲语言学相关信息，而基于现有文本资源训练的模型在迁移到转录语音时表现不稳定。因此需要一个将多模态行为与高质量语言学标注对齐的语料库作为桥梁。
AI.method: 使用Meta Quest Pro头显在VR中录制27场访谈，访谈双方均由化身代表。语料库包含三个部分：（1）VR交互数据：凝视、头部、身体、面部、手部和手指的同步追踪数据；（2）参考转录：对54个录音进行人工修正的逐字转录（57,347个词符）；（3）否定标注：对1,422个句子进行否定线索和范围的双重标注。实验评估了九个开源ASR系统，并使用D-Neg模型在InterView-C上训练否定检测模型，与五个现有德语否定语料库训练的模型进行比较。
AI.result: ASR评估显示WhisperX表现最佳（WER 8.0%），其次是Qwen3-ASR（10.4%）；所有系统在短闭合回答和数字词上的错误率显著高于长回答，Whisper大模型在完整录音上WER高达44.5%。否定检测方面，InterView-C上训练的D-Neg模型在线索检测上达到F1=0.88，在范围检测上达到F1=0.66，均优于跨语料库迁移模型（最高0.82和0.61）。跨语料库迁移性能差异显著，从DT-Neg的F1=0.11到SFU Review的F1=0.82不等。
AI.conclusion: InterView-C提供了一个独特的多模态语料库，将VR化身访谈中的语音、行为数据和语言学标注整合在同一时间轴上。研究证实了ASR在调查访谈关键内容上的错误风险，以及否定检测模型在跨语料库迁移时的性能损失。该语料库支持调查方法学、多模态对话和口语处理交叉领域的研究，但在样本规模（仅27名访谈者）、平衡性（性别、访谈者分布）和追踪精度（18.4 Hz）方面存在局限。

title: HySPE: Positional Encoding via Symplectic Dual Shears
summary: We introduce Hyperbolic Symplectic Positional Encoding (HySPE), grounding positional attention in non-compact symplectic transformations. While canonical Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) parameterizes the compact, elliptic branch of $\Sp(2,\R)$ via rotations, HySPE operationalizes its hyperbolic branch via a damped symmetric composition of dual shears, yielding a conformally symplectic contraction with two spectral decay rates per channel pair. To eliminate the exponential representation drift inherent to naive absolute factorizations, we diagonalize the operator in its invariant eigenbasis and introduce blockwise coordinate rebasing with adaptive centered execution. This guarantees length-independent numerical bounds while matching cached RoPE forward latency (7.21\,ms on an RTX 4090). On TinyShakespeare, HySPE-UltraLong maintains an invariant perplexity of 4.810 up to $16\times$ zero-shot extrapolation ($L=4096$), whereas RoPE degrades to 131.198. Scaled to a 51M-parameter subword Transformer on WikiText-103 ($L_{\text{train}}=512$), HySPE closely matches RoPE in-domain while robustly extrapolating to length 8192, reducing tail perplexity by 83.9\% over RoPE. While these controlled experiments establish HySPE's extrapolation robustness and numerical stability, evaluating its scaling behavior on large-scale foundation models remains an important direction for future investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HySPE（Hyperbolic Symplectic Positional Encoding），一种基于辛群Sp(2,R)双曲分支的双剪切（dual shear）位置编码方法，通过阻尼对称剪切复合实现保形辛收缩，并引入谱重定基（spectral rebasing）和自适应中心化分块执行解决数值发散问题，在长度外推能力和计算效率上均优于标准RoPE。
AI.motivation: 标准RoPE基于Sp(2,R)的椭圆（旋转）子群，其轨道有界且非耗散，导致超出预训练长度的序列出现相位混叠和熵崩溃。需要一种具有内在距离衰减机制的位置编码方法，以实现稳定的长度外推。
AI.method: 1. 利用Sp(2,R)双曲分支，通过两个横向初等剪切的对称复合构造基本算子H（特征值为e^±χ）；2. 引入耗散率γ=χ+δ，构建保形辛相对位置核T_Δ=e^(-γΔ)H^Δ，每通道对具备两个不同谱衰减率；3. 通过不变特征基对角化消除绝对因子分解中的指数表示漂移，提出块状坐标重定基（S）和自适应中心化分块执行（F），保证长度无关的数值界。
AI.result: 在TinyShakespeare上训练256长度字节级Transformer，HySPE-UltraLong在4096长度（16×外推）零样本困惑度恒为4.810，而RoPE退化至131.198；在WikiText-103上训练512长度的51M参数子词Transformer，HySPE域内接近RoPE，在8192长度（16×）尾部困惑度降低83.9%；前向延迟7.21ms，匹配缓存RoPE的7.20ms（RTX 4090）。
AI.conclusion: HySPE证明双曲辛几何为Transformer位置编码提供了具有表达力且数值鲁棒的替代方案，统一了非紧致几何变换、严格浮点稳定性和硬件效率。未来的工作包括椭圆-双曲混合生成元、硬件融合内核（FlashAttention风格）以及在十亿参数基础模型上的检索动力学评估。

title: Nobody Truly Agrees on Sentiment: Humans, Bespoke Tools, and LLMs Struggle with Social Media Texts
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, accepted for publication at TPDL 2026
summary: Social media is a rich source of real-time public sentiment, but widely used sentiment analysis tools are often applied without understanding their limitations. In this study, we evaluate the inter-rater reliability of three bespoke sentiment analysis tools (TextBlob, VADER, and Twitter-roBERTa-base) and three large language models (LLMs: Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-4-Maverick-17B) against six human raters across 100 tweets. We measured agreement using two statistical measures: Cohen's kappa for pairwise comparisons and Fleiss' kappa for multiple raters. Even among the human raters, our results showed only fair agreement, highlighting the subjectivity of sentiment analysis. Higher agreement was observed under the binary sentiment classification (negative vs. non-negative and positive vs. non-positive) than under the three-class classification across both humans and automated tools. The Twitter-roBERTa-base model showed the strongest alignment with human ratings, outperforming both bespoke sentiment tools and LLMs, particularly in distinguishing negative versus non-negative sentiment. LLMs showed substantial agreement among themselves and moderate to substantial alignment with humans, performing better in positive vs. non-positive classifications. Our findings underscore that domain-specific fine-tuning remains crucial for reliable social media sentiment analysis, and human-centered evaluation remains essential for establishing gold-standard labels.

AI.tldr: 本文通过100条推文评估了三种专用情感分析工具（TextBlob、VADER、Twitter-roBERTa-base）和三种大语言模型（Qwen3-32B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-4-Maverick-17B）与六位人类标注者之间的一致性，发现即便是人类之间也仅有"一般"一致性，强调了社交媒体情感分析的内在主观性以及领域特定微调的必要性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体情感分析工具被广泛使用，但其局限性往往未被充分理解。研究者旨在通过与人类判断的直接对比，揭示自动工具与LLM在处理简短、非正式社交媒体文本时的可靠性问题，并提醒研究者在使用时需充分了解其边界条件。
AI.method: 研究选取100条包含"Site C, Khayelitsha"关键词的推文，由六位人类标注者独立标注，同时使用三种专用工具和三种LLM（采用一次性提示）进行情感分类。使用Cohen's kappa进行成对一致性度量，使用Fleiss' kappa进行多评分者一致性度量，并采用多数投票法构建人类共识标签，与各工具和LLM进行对比。同时对比了三分类（正/负/中性）与二分类（负vs.非负、正vs.非正）两种分类方案。
AI.result: 人类标注者之间的一致性仅为"一般"水平（Fleiss' κ=0.39），凸显情感分析的主观性。二分类方案（尤其负vs.非负）比三分类方案产生更高一致性。Twitter-roBERTa-base与人类多数投票的一致性最高（κ=0.88，负vs.非负），优于所有其他工具和LLM。LLM之间表现出显著一致性（κ=0.69-0.80），且与人类多数投票在正vs.非正分类中表现更好。TextBlob和VADER表现最弱，尤其在识别正面情感方面。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的微调模型（Twitter-roBERTa-base）在匹配人类情感判断方面优于通用LLM和词典型工具，证实了领域适应对可靠社交媒体情感分析的重要性。LLM虽然在自身间一致性和人类对齐上表现良好，但通用型LLM并不能自动超越针对特定任务训练的模型。此外，二分类方案（尤其负vs.非负）能有效提高一致性，因为负面情感更易识别。研究强调人类中心评估仍是建立黄金标准标签的关键，自动工具的输出不能直接作为真值。

title: Learning to Act with Task Progress: Distilling Small Agents from Compact Teacher Supervision
summary: Learning from large-model demonstrations offers a way to train small agents that can complete recurring tasks without calling a large model at every step. A central design choice is what to retain from teacher trajectories that contain reasoning, actions, and information about task progress. We introduce Task-Progress Distillation (TPD), an offline approach that pairs each demonstrated action with a short label describing the current task stage. The student learns these compact targets and selects actions by jointly scoring admissible stage--action pairs, which a deterministic harness executes in the environment. On ALFWorld, a 1.7B student trained with 404 demonstrations achieves 72.4\% mean unseen task success with either TPD or action-only supervision, compared with 48.3\% for a reasoning-trained student using constrained action selection. Explicit stages provide an additional benefit at 200 demonstrations, improving success from 48.0\% to 67.7\% over action-only supervision. With more demonstrations, the action-only student closes the gap, and both approaches reach 76.9\% at 808 demonstrations. Shared-history analyses link part of TPD's local advantage to better decisions when moving between subgoals, particularly from object acquisition to processing. These results show that compact supervision can train effective small task agents, while explicit task progress provides additional guidance at an intermediate demonstration budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务进度蒸馏（TPD）方法，通过将每个演示动作与描述当前任务阶段的短标签配对，训练小型智能体。实验表明，紧凑监督可有效训练小型任务执行智能体，在中等演示预算下显式任务进度提供额外指导。
AI.motivation: 在固定演示数据集训练小模型的设定下，如何选择学生应学习的监督目标（推理链、纯动作或任务阶段标签）成为关键设计选择。现有方法多集中于推理-动作联合蒸馏或在线强化学习，本文关注纯离线场景下紧凑监督信号的价值。
AI.method: 1) 离线标注：冻结的规则式标注器为教师决策前缀分配阶段标签 s∈{locate, transform, deliver}；2) 训练目标：将"阶段+动作"作为紧凑监督序列进行 SFT；3) 执行阶段：对每个可执行动作构造 3N 个（阶段×动作）候选，学生对完整候选序列的对数概率求和打分，由确定性执行环境选择最优动作。引入 B_const（固定阶段词）和 B_shuffle（阶段标签随机置换）作为对照。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 上使用 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型：404 条演示时，纯动作 (C) 与 TPD (B) 均达 72.4% 隐藏任务成功率，远超带约束动作选择的推理训练学生 (48.3%)。200 条演示时 TPD 优势最大，比 C 提升 19.7 个百分点（67.7% vs 48.0%）；808 条演示时两者均达 76.9%，差距消失。共享历史分析表明 TPD 的局部优势主要源于"获取物体后启动处理"这一子目标过渡决策。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑监督（纯动作或阶段-动作）是训练小型任务执行智能体的有效方案，在中等演示预算下显式任务阶段标签提供有意义的额外指导；随着演示数量增加，动作-only 学生逐渐缩小差距。阶段标签的贡献主要体现在子目标转换的决策点，特别是从物体获取过渡到加工处理时。

title: Document-Level Text Simplification in Estonian Using Large Language Models
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Published at LREC 2026
summary: Document-level text simplification involves transformations that go beyond sentence-internal edits, addressing discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in sentence-level simplification for high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich, low-resource languages such as Estonian remains largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) for document-level simplification in Estonian. Three prompting strategies are examined: single-pass generation, pipeline-based modular agents, and guideline-augmented pipelines. The evaluation framework integrates automatic metrics assessing readability, semantic preservation, and discourse coherence, alongside a structured manual annotation protocol. The findings indicate that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce outputs with near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation, whereas other models display notable grammatical and semantic limitations. This work contributes novel document-level coherence metrics, evidence-based prompting strategies, and publicly available resources for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文针对爱沙尼亚语这一形态丰富、低资源语言，系统评估了五种多语言大语言模型在文档级文本简化任务上的表现，比较了三种提示策略，并提出了新的篇章级连贯性自动评估指标。
AI.motivation: 文档级文本简化需要处理篇章连贯性、指代消解和跨段落一致性，远超句内编辑的范畴。尽管英语等高资源语言的句级简化研究已较成熟，但针对形态复杂的低资源语言（如爱沙尼亚语）的文档级简化几乎未被探索。爱沙尼亚语不在 MultiSim 等多语言简化基准中，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 模型选择：五种指令调优的多语言 LLM（GPT-4.1、LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.0-flash-001、Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct），通过 OpenRouter API 调用。2. 三种提示策略：Single-Pass（单次生成）、Pipeline-Only（三模块智能体：术语解释、结构简化、指代消解）、Pipeline-Guideline（在 Pipeline-Only 基础上增加项目总监先生成简化指南）。3. 评估数据：从爱沙尼亚语维基百科 4,000 篇样本中随机选取 15 篇 50–250 词的文章，由母语语言学家提供参考简化。4. 自动评估指标：FKGL（可读性）、BERTScore（语义保持）、D-SARI（文档级简化操作）、自定义篇章指标（Sentence-BERT 相邻句余弦相似度衡量连贯性、自定义指标维护的篇章标记比例衡量篇章结构保持）。5. 人工评估：两位爱沙尼亚语母语者使用 5 点李克特量表对语法性、意义保持和简洁性三个维度进行标注，采用二次加权 Cohen's κ 衡量一致性。
AI.result: 1. 总体表现：Gemini-2.0 在人工评估中表现最佳（平均 4.79/5），LLaMA-3.3 次之（4.17），Qwen-2.5 严重失败（1.75），频繁出现语法错误、词形错误（如捏造词 "üleloomik"、"survekahju"）和语义扭曲。2. 提示策略对比：Single-Prompt 可读性提升（FKGL 较低）但语义保持降低；Pipeline-Only 和 Pipeline-Guideline 在 BERTScore 和 D-SARI 上表现更佳；人工评估聚焦 Pipeline-Only，因其输出最连贯，Pipeline-Guideline 易过度切分和冗余。3. 模型特征：GPT-4.1 和 LLaMA-3.3 连贯性最高；Gemini-2.0 在篇章标记保持和连贯性间最均衡；Claude-3.5 篇章标记保持差；Qwen-2.5 表面标记尚可但连贯性不足。4. 评估一致性：自动指标与人工判断部分吻合（Gemini-2.0 和 LLaMA-3.3 均排名前二），但人工评估对局部连贯、指代清晰度和整体可用性提供了自动指标无法捕捉的关键洞察。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了多语言大语言模型可支持爱沙尼亚语文档级简化，但需谨慎选择提示策略和评估方法。Gemini-2.0 和 LLaMA-3.3 是该任务最有效的模型，能产生接近母语流畅度的输出并保持语义忠实；Qwen-2.5 的失败凸显了多语言覆盖并不等同于在形态丰富的低资源语言上的可靠性能。自动指标可提供粗粒度比较信号，但人工评估仍是识别文档级质量细微差异的必要手段。研究贡献包括文档级提示策略、基于句向量和篇章标记保持的连贯性指标、标准化的人工评估协议，以及完整的开源复现资源。

title: CoTrace: Data Recipes for Training Terminal Agents with Harness-Model Co-Evolution
summary: Terminal-agent capability depends jointly on model weights and the runtime harness that formats prompts, binds tools, and handles error recovery. Existing harness-model co-evolution approaches improve both components, yet often treat trajectories produced during harness search as an undifferentiated replay buffer. This practice overlooks that a trajectory's value for model training depends on the harness under which it was generated. To systematically analyze this interface, we establish an alternating co-evolution framework that decouples harness search and policy training through component-wise promotion decisions. Within this framework, we introduce CoTrace, a harness-aware data recipe that explicitly governs trajectory routing, provenance matching, and curriculum refresh. Under CoTrace, recurring execution failures guide harness synthesis, while policy training is strictly conditioned on verified rollouts matched to the adopted runtime for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or fresh online interactions for reinforcement learning (RL). On the Tmax promotion split, CoTrace advances Qwen3.5-9B from 78 to 88 solved tasks under supervised fine-tuning while an online reinforcement variant reaches 90. Specifically, a compact harness-matched corpus produces steady model gains at substantially lower compute than much larger corpora pooled across sibling harnesses. Furthermore, evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Lite show that out-of-distribution transfer depends fundamentally on harness compatibility, where maintaining consistency between training and evaluation runtimes prevents procedural execution breakdowns observed under foreign scaffolds.

AI.tldr: CoTrace提出了一种面向终端智能体的"感知运行时"数据配方，通过交替协同进化框架，将失败轨迹路由至Harness搜索、仅用与已采纳运行时匹配的验证成功轨迹训练策略，并动态刷新课程，从而在较小的计算预算下显著提升模型与Harness的联合性能，同时证明跨域迁移依赖于模型-Harness对的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体的能力依赖于模型权重与运行时Harness（负责提示格式化、工具绑定、错误恢复）的协同优化。现有协同进化方法常将Harness搜索产生的轨迹视为无差别的回放缓冲池，忽略了轨迹的训练价值取决于生成它的Harness，导致模型更新与部署运行时失配，出现"即使更多轨迹也不带来模型增益"的悖论。
AI.method: 1) 交替协同进化框架：以分量级提升决策（ratchet机制）解耦Harness搜索与策略训练；2) Route机制：将聚类的执行失败路由至Harness合成，仅将经验证的、与已采纳运行时指纹匹配的轨迹用于监督微调（SFT），并辅以新rollout；3) Ratchet机制：在冻结的提升划分上固定另一分量，对候选Harness/策略独立评估；4) Refresh机制：将已解决且已收割的任务退役，从未访问池补充，使课程始终聚焦于移动前沿。
AI.result: 在Tmax提升划分（102任务）上，CoTrace-SFT将Qwen3.5-9B从78提升至88（+10），其中Harness贡献+4、模型贡献+6；CoTrace-RL在线变体达到90（+12）。仅用30-50条运行时匹配的紧凑语料即获得稳定增益，而混合兄弟Harness池化的149-308条语料反而产生0次模型更新接受。跨域评估显示：Terminal-Bench 2.1上检查点单独增益在外部运行时下基本消失；SWE-bench Lite上将其与协同进化的Harness配对可将SFT检查点从24.7%提升至35.0%，且无补丁失败从155降至64。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹来源（provenance）与模型-Harness兼容性是智能体后训练的核心设计变量。紧凑的运行时匹配语料优于跨兄弟Harness的大规模池化；在线强化学习在监督成功稀缺时仍能提供相对奖励信号；跨域迁移根本上依赖于协同进化的模型-Harness对而非策略本身。

title: Your Prompt Should Do More: Effects of Retrieval Instructions in Embedding Models
summary: Prompted embedding models have recently received increasing attention, particularly for retrieval, where detailed retrieval instructions are provided as part of the retrieval prompt. Several new datasets and studies have examined this setting, showing that the current embedding models often struggle to follow such instructions reliably. In this paper, we study the mechanism of how instructions actually affect the representations of retrieval queries in asymmetric retrieval tasks. We show that models can fail to follow even simple task instructions when query-side distractors are included in the evaluation. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by the training setup of current embedding models and their evaluation, and show that fine-tuning with added query-side distractors leads to substantial improvements, with minimal effect on other tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了检索指令对提示嵌入模型查询表示的影响机制,发现当前模型在包含查询侧干扰项时难以可靠地遵循指令,并提出通过添加查询侧负样本进行微调来显著提升模型的指令遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 当前提示嵌入模型在标准评估中表现良好,但其评估设置通常采用单任务隔离评估,候选语料库中缺乏与查询语义相关但不满足任务指令的文本。这种评估范式可能高估了模型对指令的真实敏感性,无法反映实际大规模检索场景中的挑战。本文旨在揭示指令对嵌入表示作用的机制,并指出标准训练和评估方案的不足。
AI.method: 1) 分析约50条自然语言指令对8个主流嵌入模型在Tatoeba和ARCChallenge上的表现;2) 设计三个结构性度量指标——相似度提升(Similarity Improvement)、位移(Displacement)、角化度(Angulation)——量化指令对查询嵌入的几何影响;3) 引入查询侧干扰项(Distractor)作为硬负样本进行评估和微调;4) 在SQuAD和Tatoeba上对Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B进行包含50%查询侧负样本的微调,并对比有/无查询侧负样本的效果。
AI.result: 1) 标准评估中,无关指令(包括乱码指令)常与相关指令表现相当,提示模型对指令敏感性较弱;2) 相关指令在Tatoeba上显示出明显的位移和角化度差异,但在ARCChallenge上区分度较低;3) 加入查询侧干扰项后,多数模型的检索性能近乎崩溃(如ARCChallenge上recall@1从0.032降至0.001);4) 加入查询侧负样本微调后,模型在干扰项设置下表现大幅提升(SQuAD的paraphrase distractor R@1从0.014升至0.470,Tatoeba均值从0.102升至0.569),同时标准检索性能几乎不变,MTEB其他任务影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 标准评估范式可能高估嵌入模型对指令的真实遵循能力。当前对比训练实践缺乏查询侧负样本,导致模型未能充分学会利用指令将查询嵌入推向任务相关目标。本文提出的查询侧干扰项评估方法和包含查询侧负样本的微调策略能有效提升指令遵循的鲁棒性,且几乎不影响其他任务的性能。建议未来评估应采用跨任务混合候选池的设置,以更真实地反映模型的指令敏感性。

title: EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory
summary: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EngramEdit，一种针对条件记忆架构（如DeepSeek Engram）的解耦知识更新方法。它通过计算跨表达式的目标记忆表示，并联合更新共享的n-gram嵌入（对高频复用嵌入施加更强惩罚），实现了近乎完美的编辑成功率，显著优于现有基线，并能有效支持多跳推理，同时保持无关知识和通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）中的事实知识会过时，需要更新。但传统参数修改方法会同时改变通用计算能力。条件记忆架构（如DeepSeek Engram）通过n-gram查找学习嵌入，将事实知识存储与Transformer主干计算解耦，为更新知识同时保持通用能力提供了新途径。然而，不同表达会激活不同n-gram嵌入，更新共享嵌入可能影响无关事实，面临有效性、泛化性和特异性三大挑战。
AI.method: EngramEdit方法包含三个核心步骤：1）**条件记忆目标计算**：为每个编辑生成多个语义等价的表达，通过优化共享扰动得到使模型预测更新事实的目标记忆表示；2）**多表达式记忆映射**：构建映射矩阵A，关联目标记忆表示与激活的n-gram嵌入，识别跨表达式和编辑共享的嵌入；3）**联合记忆更新分配**：通过正则化最小二乘问题求解嵌入更新，其中λ_j = λ_reuse·w_j + λ_ridge，w_j基于n-gram长度和语料频率构建，对频繁复用的嵌入施加更强惩罚以保护无关知识。
AI.result: 在CounterFact和ZsRE上实现近100%的编辑成功率（99.5%和97.3% Efficacy），Generalization达97%和93.7%，远超基线。在MQuAKE多跳推理上，CoT提示下准确率接近最强基线的3倍（36.92% vs 12.60%于2-hop问题）。5,000次连续编辑后保留96%以上通用能力。在6个通用任务中，5个几乎完全保留预编辑性能，MRPC受局部嵌入更新影响略有下降。消融实验证明联合分配、复用正则化和生成表达均对性能至关重要。
AI.conclusion: EngramEdit将条件记忆转化为可编辑的知识接口，实现了事实知识的高效更新与跨表达泛化，支持多跳推理，同时保持无关知识和通用能力。该方法将条件记忆的角色从模型扩展延伸至支持解耦知识更新，为LLM持续更新知识开辟了新路径。未来工作可探索其他条件记忆架构、模型规模以及大规模高频编辑的稳定高效更新。

title: Finding the Right Balance: Relevance and Diversity in LLM Retrieval
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables. Code and results: this https URL
