summary: Retrieval diversification is widely available in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, yet prior studies disagree on whether it improves retrieval and answer quality. We show that its effectiveness varies primarily with candidate-pool redundancy, in a pattern consistent with the number of distinct evidence pieces a query requires. Using controlled near-duplicate injection and production-style overlapping chunking, we find that diversification harms relevance, evidence coverage and answer quality on clean pools, but becomes beneficial on multi-evidence tasks when redundancy causes nearest-neighbor retrieval to select repeated passages. We therefore introduce a query-adaptive rule that diversifies only when the effective number of distinct documents in the nearest-neighbor top-$k$ selection falls below the query's evidence requirement. Computed from existing embeddings, the rule captures most of the achievable gain, transfers across datasets and encoders and automatically reduces to nearest-neighbor retrieval for single-evidence queries. We also introduce RNG-Score, a geometric reranker with an exact nearest-neighbor fallback whose margin indicates duplicate structure. Overall, we conclude that diversification should be used selectively, based on observable redundancy and evidence requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RAG检索阶段的多样化策略，提出基于候选池冗余度的查询自适应决策规则：当最近邻选择中有效文档数低于查询所需的证据数量时才启用多样化。引入RNG-Score几何重排序器，其边界处可精确退化为k-NN。结果表明，在干净池上多样化损害相关性，在冗余池上则有益。
AI.motivation: RAG检索中是否应启用多样化（如MMR）存在矛盾结论：部分研究报告增益，部分研究则发现无显著改善甚至有害。本文旨在厘清这一分歧，确定多样化策略何时有效。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于相对邻域图的RNG-Score几何重排序器，其边界处可精确退化为k-NN；2) 定义池级冗余度诊断（近重复对比例）和查询级冗余度诊断（top-k选择的Vendi分数）；3) 提出决策规则：当T(q)<min{h,k}时触发后备多样化器；4) 使用受控近重复注入和重叠分块两种协议操纵冗余度；5) 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、NQ-Open及BEIR任务上以bge-m3、Qwen3-Embedding-4B、all-MiniLM-L6-v2三种编码器进行种子复现实验。
AI.result: 干净池上（测量冗余度<10⁻³），所有固定压力多样化器损害相关性和证据覆盖（S-Recall@5损失0.7-33.0点），全方法每查询上界仅约6%查询可获益。冗余池上，决策规则在多证据任务中可获得高达+22.5 S-Recall点的显著增益。规则在清洁池成本控制在1分容差内，跨编码器、数据集和k值无需重调即可迁移，能捕获全方法oracle 60%的提升和每层级调优91%的增益。RNG-Score的下行风险仅3.9点，是唯一在双侧边界均可精确退化为k-NN的方法。
AI.conclusion: 多样化应在选择性条件下使用，基于可观测的冗余度和证据需求。关键发现包括：(1) 反注释无关多样性与意图感知多样性指标在干净池上系统性背离；(2) 决策规则由现有嵌入即可计算，无需相关性标签；(3) 跨域交叉点位置变化但存在性稳定；(4) 应将几何扩散视为描述性统计而非优化目标。RNG-Score的可达回退应作为多样化器的设计要求。

title: Towards Explaining Query Expansion Performance in Information Retrieval
summary: Query Expansion (QE) techniques have long been widely used in Information Retrieval (IR) to address the vocabulary mismatch problem. They remain relevant in modern retrieval systems, including those based on large language models (LLMs). However, no single QE method consistently outperforms others across all queries. This work seeks to explain the variation in QE performance through two complementary perspectives. The first is the concept of an Ideal Expanded Query (IEQ)--a hypothetical query that maximizes retrieval effectiveness with a downstream BM25 retrieval model. The second is a separability perspective, which quantifies how distinctly relevant and non-relevant documents are scored for a given expanded query using Cohen's (d). We develop a separability measure and practical formulations to approximate the IEQ and investigate how these factors relate to retrieval effectiveness. Extensive experiments on the TREC Robust collection, TREC DL 2019-2022 passage collections, and TREC DL 2019-2020 document collections reveal several interesting patterns. In particular, we find that expanded queries that are closer to the ideal expanded query tend to achieve higher retrieval effectiveness. We further show that the separability of relevant and non-relevant documents provides a complementary perspective for understanding QE performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种事后解释框架，通过构建"理想扩展查询(IEQ)"和衡量得分可分离性(Cohen's d)两个互补视角，解释查询扩展(QE)技术在信息检索中的性能差异。研究在TREC Robust和TREC DL 2019-2022等多个基准上进行了广泛实验，验证了扩展查询与IEQ的相似度与其检索效果之间存在正相关，且能有效区分相关与非相关文档的扩展查询倾向于获得更高的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 查询扩展(QE)技术在平均效果上往往带来显著提升，但不同QE方法在不同查询上的表现差异很大，且对于相当数量的查询，QE反而会导致效果退化。先前研究主要关注提升QE的整体效果，而对方法间和查询间性能差异的理解相对缺乏。该研究旨在为IR研究者和开发者提供可操作的解释工具，帮助诊断QE方法为何对特定查询有效或失效。
AI.method: 论文提出一个包含三个组件的事后分析框架：(1) 使用Dynamic Feedback Optimization(DFO)或最小二乘(LS)代理目标构建近似理想扩展查询(IEQ)；IEQ是一种在词汇空间中能针对下游BM25检索模型产生近乎完美平均精度(AP)的查询向量表示。(2) 通过余弦相似度衡量扩展查询与IEQ的接近程度，并分析该相似度与AP之间的相关性。(3) 使用Cohen's d量化扩展查询对相关和非相关文档BM25得分的可分离性。研究在TREC Robust、TREC DL 2019-2020段落/文档集及TREC DL 2021-2022段落集上，使用RM3、KL散度、Bo1、CEQE、HyDE等五种QE方法（每查询生成90个变体）进行实验。
AI.result: 实验得出以下关键发现：(1) IEQ构建方面，DFO和LS方法均能产生高MAP的理想查询（最佳MAP在Robust04和DL19-20段落集上接近完美），但不同构建方法产生的IEQ差异显著，表明IEQ并非唯一。(2) 合成查询实验显示，相似度与AP存在强相关（Pearson ρ最高达0.8834）；真实扩展查询的相关性虽较弱但仍为正相关（ρ在0.41-0.68范围）。(3) 可分离性与AP的相关性强于IEQ相似度（Robust集上ρ=0.7849）。(4) 真实EQ间的角度扩展范围较窄（平均3.75°-11.15°），而AP变化范围较宽（0.175-0.285），导致相关性测量对小数值波动敏感。(5) 查询间方差远大于方法间方差（BQV/WQV比值高达17.74），表明查询特性对性能差异的贡献远超QE方法的选择。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了IEQ相似度视角和得分可分离性视角是解释QE性能差异的有效互补工具。近似IEQ可作为QE性能分析的有效参考点，帮助研究者识别QE方法未能选中的有用扩展词或赋予不当权重的扩展词。然而相关性有时仅为中等程度，主要归因于两点：(1) 理想扩展查询并非唯一，词汇空间中可能存在多个相互分离的理想区域；(2) 余弦相似度产生的数值范围过窄。未来工作方向包括探索能产生更广数值范围的相似度衡量方法、从训练数据中以监督方式学习IEQ表示，以及刻画具有多个理想区域的查询特性。

title: Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices
summary: Prevailing multi-vector visual document retrievers store each page as about a thousand patch vectors, often in vector databases run by a third party. Since no one can read a page from its vectors, this index is easily treated as less sensitive than the page. However, because the index keeps one vector per patch in raster order, and each vector is computed by a vision-language model pre-trained to read documents, we hypothesize that whoever runs or breaches the store can reproduce a page from its index alone. We frame inversion as conditional document image generation and infer from the vectors what the attack needs: the encoder, the page shape and, for shuffled vectors, their order. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open. To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline. Multi-vector visual document retrievers are therefore vulnerable to inversion through their stored index, which should be protected like the documents it encodes.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地证明了多向量视觉文档检索器（如ColPali/ColQwen）所存储的patch级向量索引在零侧信息条件下可被攻击者重建出原始文档页面内容，揭示了向量存储的安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 当前多向量视觉文档检索将每页文档编码为约1000个patch向量（按栅格顺序存储于第三方向量数据库），普遍被认为"不可读"从而敏感性低于原文档。然而，由于每个向量由专门预训练用于文档阅读的VLM生成，并保留了patch的位置结构，作者质疑该索引是否足够保护原始页面内容。
AI.method: 1) **编码器识别**：通过维度/单位范数/向量计数等结构特征从13个公开多向量检索器中识别目标编码器；2) **页面形状恢复**：利用向量间余弦相似度的周期性或集合分类器推断页面n_h×n_w；3) **条件流匹配反演器**：基于Qwen-Image的双流MMDiT，将存储索引替换文本流，通过修正流路径学习条件分布p(I|C)，训练有序和集合两种变体以处理不同存储配置；4) **位置模型**：置换等变Transformer为洗牌索引恢复向量顺序（用匈牙利算法匹配）。
AI.result: **主编码器E_A（Tomoro-ColQwen3-8B）原始索引**：词召回率47.4%，敏感词（数字/专有名词/缩写）召回率45.0%，在19,252页中98.4%将源页排第一（独立判断器97.7%）。**池化（×3,×9）**：词召回降至约8%，反演失败。**洗牌**：无位置模型时top-1仅3.8%，使用位置模型恢复顺序后升至93.5%。**泛化编码器E_B（ColQwen3.5-4.5B）**：原始索引top-1仍达70.2%，但词召回低于kNN基线。
AI.conclusion: 多向量视觉文档检索器的存储索引存在严重反演漏洞：原始索引应被视为与原文档同等敏感的数据来保护；洗牌不能作为可靠保护措施（位置模型可还原顺序）；池化在本文方法下可抵抗反演，但该结论仅限于作者尝试的攻击方法。索引应至少与文档本身受同等保护。

title: Beyond Score Accuracy: Examining the Diagnostic Quality of LLM-Generated Structured Assessment in Higher Education
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted for automated grading and feedback in higher education, their structured outputs, including multi-dimensional rubric scores, detailed feedback comments, and improvement suggestions, create an appearance of thorough analytic evaluation. This study examines whether these outputs deliver what they appear to offer. Using the JorGPT dataset of 3,041 student responses to 50 open-ended computer science questions, scored by both human instructors and three commercial LLMs, we identify three systematic discrepancies between the apparent and actual quality of LLM-generated grading and feedback. The sub-dimension scores are highly correlated (r = 0.82-0.99, VIF up to 45), providing redundant rather than independent diagnostic information. The textual feedback rarely detects student misconceptions (5-7% vs. 15-31% for teachers), functioning as a coverage checklist rather than a diagnostic instrument. The feedback tone remains uniformly positive regardless of response quality, lacking the severity modulation observed in human feedback. Additionally, grading accuracy varies significantly by knowledge domain, with procedural topics most reliable. These findings provide empirically grounded guidance on which aspects of LLM-generated grading and feedback can be relied upon and which require continued human oversight.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大语言模型（LLMs）在高等教育自动评分与反馈中的实际质量与表面质量的差距。通过对3,041份计算机科学开放性问题的学生回答进行对比分析，揭示了LLM评分与反馈在子维度独立性、误区诊断能力、语气调节和学科可靠性四个方面的系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛应用于高等教育自动评分与反馈，其结构化输出（多维度评分、详细反馈、改进建议）表面上呈现出深度分析评估的特征。然而，这些输出是否真正提供其所呈现的分析价值尚未得到充分实证检验。该研究旨在揭示LLM生成评分与反馈的表面质量与实际质量之间的系统性差距。
AI.method: 研究使用JorGPT数据集，包含3,041份学生对50个计算机科学开放性问题的回答，由人类教师和三个商业LLM同时进行评分。通过对比分析，考察四个维度：(1)子维度评分的相关性与冗余度（采用Pearson相关系数和方差膨胀因子VIF）；(2)文本反馈对学生误区的识别能力；(3)反馈语气随回答质量的调节变化；(4)评分准确性在不同知识领域（程序性、概念性等）间的差异。
AI.result: 研究发现三类系统性偏差：(1)子维度评分高度相关（r = 0.82–0.99，VIF高达45），提供的是冗余信息而非独立诊断；(2)文本反馈很少检测学生误区（5–7% vs. 教师15–31%），仅充当覆盖性清单；(3)反馈语气对所有质量水平的回答均保持一致积极，缺乏人类反馈中观察到的严重程度调节。此外，评分准确性在不同知识领域差异显著，程序性主题最为可靠。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM生成评分与反馈的可靠性提供了实证依据：LLM输出在形式上具有分析性外观，但在诊断准确性、反馈区分度和子维度独立性方面存在系统性局限。研究明确指出了哪些方面可信赖、哪些方面仍需人类监督，对教育技术实践具有重要指导意义。

title: What Transfers from a VLM Teacher? Comparing Supervision Signals for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Visual document retrievers are trained contrastively: each query is matched to one page labelled relevant - the positive - and pushed away from negatives, pages presumed irrelevant. Recent methods distil a vision-language model (VLM) teacher into the retriever by enriching that positive, transferring the teacher's attention over it or a description of it. We ask whether the teacher is better spent on the other side, judging the candidates the retriever mines as negatives, which the label says nothing about. With student, data, optimizer and evaluation fixed, teacher-judged hard negatives and score distillation raise ViDoRe v2 nDCG@5 from 55.2 to 62.6 and 63.0; description alignment, as adapted here, gains 2.6 points and attention grounding nothing measurable. Against teacher-free rules that select four candidates from the same mined pool at identical training compute, the best of which is the positive-aware threshold current systems use, the teacher's judgement adds 4.1 points on v2 and 1.7 on v3. This is consistent with how incomplete the labels are. Annotators judge about two of a query's four top-ranked mined candidates relevant, none of them labelled, so training pushes the retriever away from relevant pages treated as negatives. What reaches the student is coarse: under a greedily decoded 0-100 rating prompt, 82% of the teacher's ratings come back at one end of the scale or the other, and a relevant/irrelevant partition keeps most of the distillation gain. A ten-annotator audit places the teacher within the range of variation among human annotators, and finds it reliable where a query has a single determinate answer. We release the code, the teacher's 3.3M judgements and page descriptions, the mined pools, the human audit and the trained adapters at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文在严格受控的实验设置下，比较了四种利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）教师来训练视觉文档检索器的方式：候选级信号（教师评判的难负例N、分数蒸馏S）与正例级信号（注意力锚定A、描述对齐D）。核心发现是：将教师用于评判挖掘出的负候选（未被标注的相关页面）比用于增强已标注正例更有效，在ViDoRe v2上N和S分别带来+7.4和+7.8 nDCG@5的提升，而D仅+2.6，A几乎无效果。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉文档检索器采用对比学习训练，每个查询只与一个被标注为相关的页面（正例）匹配，并远离其他负例。但标准训练语料的标注是严重不完整的：审计显示约2.04/4的顶部挖掘候选实际上与查询相关但未被标注。现有方法（如AGREE的注意力、ReAlign的描述）都把教师用于增强正例，而本文质疑这种做法是否最优，提出应将教师用于评判未被标注的负候选。
AI.method: 学生模型为ColQwen2.5-3B（晚期交互架构），教师为Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct（注意力信号用7B）。训练数据为ColPali训练集（118,195对）。四种信号：N（教师评分<0.5的顶部候选作为难负例加入InfoNCE分母）、S（KL散度蒸馏教师对4个候选的评分分布）、A（教师注意力图与学生patch相似性的余弦对齐）、D（教师生成的页面描述与查询编码间的KL对齐）。教师无关基线包括固定排名窗口和TopK-PercPos自适应阈值。所有实验固定学生、数据、优化器，种子匹配，3个epoch（11,079步）。评估指标为ViDoRe v1/v2/v3和jina VDR的nDCG@5。
AI.result: N在ViDoRe v2/v3上分别+7.4/+4.5 nDCG@5，S分别+7.8/+5.3，D分别+2.6/+1.1，A无显著效果。教师评判相比最佳教师无关规则（TopK-PercPos α=0.95）在v2上额外贡献+4.1、在v3上+1.7。审计显示：教师评分为相关的候选中有71%被人工标注为相关；在有确定答案的查询上83%相关，在宽泛查询上仅42%。82%的教师评分是0或1（近二元）。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出三个核心结论：(1) 教师应优先用于评判挖掘出的负候选而非增强已标注正例；(2) 标注不完整是普遍问题，挖掘的顶部候选约2/4实际相关，导致训练将相关页面当作负例推开；(3) 实际传递给学生的是粗粒度的相关/不相关二分信号，分数蒸馏的精度贡献很小。实践建议：不要将顶部排名候选用作负例；使用教师时检查常数目标行的影响。预期在标注更好的语料上教师优势会缩小。

title: Reading Position Is the Baseline to Beat: A Time-Ordered Evaluation of Personalised Highlight Prediction
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Ancillary files include the specifications, the results write-ups, the analysis scripts, and the aggregate artifacts every reported number is generated from
summary: A reader's first highlights on a page are the cheapest personal signal a reading product has. The natural plan is to suggest what similar earlier readers marked, and to judge the result against popularity. We argue that the baseline to beat is reading position. In a time-ordered evaluation on one social highlighting platform (7,343 reader-page pairs on 1,511 pages after one highlight), ranking the sentences just below a reader's first highlight, with no other reader's data, puts the next highlight in the top five 47% of the time, against 26% for popularity and 29% for the better of two similarity methods. The baseline depends on the target: over all later highlights that ranking loses to popularity, while popularity discounted by distance from the latest highlight, at the scale with the best average precision of three tried, beats popularity and both similarity methods on both targets. In a comparison specified in advance, neither similarity method shows a gain over popularity in average precision over all later highlights, from one to five highlights, and a gain of +0.01 is excluded. Nor would a gain by itself show that a method has found a reader's preferences: synthetic readers who share one set of preferences produce one, and an evaluation out of time order shows a method where the reader went. The position results are exploratory and unconfirmed. Personalisation inside a document should be evaluated in time order and against reading position.

AI.tldr: 本文论证在文档内个性化高亮预测评估中，应将"阅读位置"（而非仅流行度）作为基线。基于一个社交高亮平台的时间有序评估数据（7,343个读者-页面对），发现仅依据读者最近一次高亮位置排序的简单规则，在预测下一个高亮时比流行度基线（47% vs 26%）和两种相似度方法（29%）表现好得多；而两种标准相似度方法在所有后续高亮上并未超过流行度，+0.01的增益被排除。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在评估文档内个性化高亮推荐时，普遍将"流行度"作为基线。但读者的首次高亮不仅揭示了偏好（preference），还揭示了阅读位置（position）这一强信号。位置信息一直被忽略，导致相似度方法的表面增益可能来自位置而非偏好，评估结论可能失真。
AI.method: 1. 时间有序评估协议：在读者做出第m个高亮的时刻（cut），评分器只能看到该读者的前m个高亮（reveal）和cut之前其他读者的所有高亮；2. 数据：来自Glasp平台2026-10-04的只读提取，1,511个页面、7,343个单位（m=1时）；3. 评分器：流行度（POP）、KNN（k=3）、UBCF，以及位置基线AHEAD和PROXPOP(τ)（流行度按距离衰减）；4. 指标：平均精度（AP）和Hit@5；5. 注册分析（11个检验，Holm校正，10,000重采样）与探索性分析区分；6. 合成页面反例实验验证增益不必然代表偏好；7. 时间顺序对比实验。
AI.result: 核心结果：1. 注册分析：两种相似度方法在m=1-5的所有后续高亮上AP均不超过流行度，最大上界不超过+0.0037，+0.01增益被排除；2. 下一高亮目标：AHEAD在m=1时Hit@5比流行度高+0.2147（0.4712 vs 0.2565），比UBCF高+0.1850；3. 所有后续高亮目标：位置单独的AHEAD落后于流行度，但PROXPOP(40)在两个目标上都超过流行度和两种相似度方法；4. 合成页面反例：当所有读者共享同一偏好时相似度方法能产生增益，但当存在不同类型读者时则不会；5. 乱序评估：随机揭示高亮（而非按时间顺序）会将UBCF在m=5时的损失转为增益；6. 相似度融入位置基线仅带来约0.002的AP提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出四点评估建议：先命名预测目标；将阅读位置纳入对比；按时间顺序揭示高亮；不要将增益单独视为偏好发现的证据。文档内个性化应在时间顺序下、针对阅读位置基线进行评估。位置结果是探索性的，尚未在新记录上得到确认。

title: The Impact of Backbone Evolution on LLM-Based Relevance Assessments
summary: LLMs are evolving rapidly, with newer models offering stronger capabilities. This suggests that in LLM-based relevance judging, more capable models will achieve higher agreement with human judgements under the same prompt. We challenge this understanding by investigating the behavior of LLM-based relevance judges under backbone evolution. Keeping the prompts fixed, we evaluate a representative single-prompt (UMBRELA) and a rubric-based prompt (EXAM) across sequential model versions of commercial (Gemini, GPT) and open-weight (Qwen, Llama) models. Overall, we find no consistent evidence that newer versions lead to better relevance judges. Crucially, similar or improved aggregate performance does not imply judgment stability: correct judgements made by an earlier version of an LLM backbone are not necessarily preserved by later versions. We investigate the potential drivers of these regressions. Our findings caution against the assumption that judging prompts designed and validated for one backbone version will perform equivalently or better when the model is updated, even within the same family.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了LLM相关判断器在主干模型版本演进过程中的稳定性，发现新版本模型未必是更好的判断器，提示词需随模型更新重新验证。
AI.motivation: LLM快速迭代，通常假设新版本能力更强、可以"即插即用"替换旧版本而保持或提升相关判断效果。然而，关于同一模型家族内版本演进对基于LLM的相关性判断影响的实证研究匮乏，提示词与模型的强耦合性在版本更新中的稳定性未知。
AI.method: 固定提示词（UMBRELA零样本提示和EXAM基于评分标准的提示），在TREC DL 2019和2020数据集上，对四个LLM家族（Gemini、GPT、Qwen、Llama）的连续版本进行评估。采用Exact Match、MAE和Pearson相关系数衡量聚合性能，并定义实例级回归（基线正确而新版本错误）。在Gemini Flash家族上使用元评估方法分析推理轨迹以识别回归驱动因素。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）无一致证据表明更新版本产生更好的相关性判断器，部分家族性能波动剧烈；2）聚合性能提升掩盖了严重的实例级不稳定性——即使整体指标改善，仍有显著比例的先前正确判断被新版本推翻；3）GPT-4o Mini升级到GPT-5 Mini导致28%的UMBRELA回归，Qwen 2.5到3.0产生22.6%回归；4）EXAM评分标准提示在轻微更新时放大波动，但在严重代际降级时提供缓冲；5）回归驱动因素具有提示词特异性：UMBRELA主要表现为语义过度聚焦（31.3%）和严格解释（13.9%），EXAM主要表现为分数/推理不一致（18.3%）和过度严格相关性阈值（33.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调IR评估流程不能"一劳永逸"，每次主干模型更新都需要基于人类基线重新验证提示词与模型的匹配性。回归具有不对称性，使用旧版折扣模型作为低成本替代方案会不成比例地牺牲判断能力。未来工作应探索回归感知的提示词优化方法。

title: Analysis of the two-for-one swap heuristic for approximating the maximum independent set in a k-polymatroid
summary: Let f:2^N --> \cZ^+ be a polymatroid (an integer-valued non-decreasing submodular set function with f(emptyset) = 0). A k-polymatroid satisfies that f(e) <= k for all e in N. We call a subset S of N independent if f(S) equals the sum of f(e) over the elements e of S and f(e) > 0 for all e in S. Finding a maximum-size independent set in a 2-polymatroid has been studied and polynomial-time algorithms are known for linear polymatroids. For k >= 3, the problem is NP-hard, and an approximation algorithm with ratio approaching 2/k is known and is obtained by swapping as long as possible a "large" subset from the current solution by a set with one more element. Here we give a simple analysis of the more particular two-for-one repeated swapping heuristic, obtaining a (weaker) 2/(k+1)-approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 k-多拟阵最大独立集问题（MISkP），研究了一种简单的"二换一"局部搜索启发式算法（即从当前解中移除1个元素并加入2个元素），并证明该启发式能够获得紧的 2/(k+1) 近似比。相比 Lee、Sviridenko 和 Vondrák 的更强结果 ((2/k)−ε)-近似，本文方法更简单，且通过 k-超图匹配的紧界实例证明了近似比的紧性。
AI.motivation: MISkP 是经典组合优化问题，当 k≥3 时为 NP-hard。先前 Lee-Sviridenko-Vondrák (2009) 通过反复移除 j 个元素加入 j+1 个元素的局部搜索获得了 ((2/k)−ε)-近似，但所需 j 值是 1/ε 的指数函数。本文动机是研究最简单的局部搜索变体（j=1，即"二换一"启发式），能否以更简洁的分析获得（虽然更弱但有意义的）近似比，并揭示该紧的近似比。
AI.method:
方法基于 Greene-Magnanti (1976) 的基交换定理（定理 2.1）以及 Hurkens-Schrijver (1989) 对 k-超图匹配的 Case 2 分析。具体构造为：
1. 使用 Helgason-McDiarmid-Lovász 定理将多拟阵 f 表示为等价的拟阵 M，其中每个元素 h 对应独立集 M_h；
2. 在 M 中取最大独立集 Ī ⊇ Ā，并定义 B̄′ = Ī\Ā；
3. 收缩 B̄′ 得到拟阵 M′，在其中 Ā 是基；
4. 应用定理 2.1（基交换定理）将 C̄ 按 Ā 分区得 Y_1,...,Y_a；
5. 构造二部图 G（A 与 B 两侧，A∩B 中元素复制），边表示 M_{e_j}∩Y_i≠∅；
6. 利用两条关键不等式：k|A|≥|E(G)|≥|S|+2|D| 和 |A|≥|S|，相加得 (k+1)|A|≥2|B|；
7. 紧性由 k-集包装实例（k+1 个不相交集加两个交集）构造得出。
AI.result: 证明"二换一"重复交换启发式给出 MISkP 的紧 2/(k+1) 近似。具体地，当启发式停止时，无法进行可行添加或二换一交换，由此推出 |A|≥(2/(k+1))|B|。紧性通过构造 k-集包装实例证明：存在实例使得启发式输出大小为 2 的解而最优解大小为 k+1，从而近似比恰好为 2/(k+1)。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了"二换一"局部搜索启发式对 MISkP 问题的紧 2/(k+1) 近似证明。虽然该结果弱于 Lee-Sviridenko-Vondrák 的 ((2/k)−ε)-近似，但分析更简单，且方法可能推广至强基可排序拟阵以获得更好的依赖关系。作者指出该二部图构造方法难以推广到更大的交换规模和一般拟阵，但在强基可排序拟阵上可行。文末承认局限并讨论了未来可能的研究方向。

title: Efficient Algorithms for Online Subadditive Combinatorial Allocations
summary: For the online combinatorial allocation problem with subadditive valuations, Correa and Cristi (STOC 2023) proved the existence of a $6$-competitive online algorithm, improving on the previous best $O(\log\!\log m)$-competitive online algorithm due to Dütting, Kesselheim, and Lucier (FOCS 2020), where $m$ is the number of items. However, Correa and Cristi's result is existential, and it was left open whether a constant competitive ratio is attainable via an efficient online algorithm that uses a polynomial number of demand oracle queries. In this work, we answer this affirmatively, giving an expected-polynomial-time $(6 + \epsilon)$-competitive online algorithm for any constant $\epsilon > 0$. Our techniques also recover, in the offline setting, the $(2 + \epsilon)$-approximation result of Feige (STOC, 2006). Finally, when the buyers' valuations are drawn from identical distributions, we exploit symmetry to obtain an improved $(60/11+\epsilon)$-competitive algorithm. Starting with the natural configuration LP relaxation for the problem, our main technical contribution is a recursive Bundle Score Generator (BSG) that resolves item conflicts by assigning correlated scores to the items requested by each buyer. Unlike the Random Score Generator whose existence is shown by Correa and Cristi, our BSG is efficiently computable in expected polynomial time. Moreover, it satisfies a stochastic dominance property that is sufficient to recover both Feige's offline result and Correa and Cristi's online result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个多项式时间常数竞争的在线次可加组合分配算法，基于一种新的递归束评分生成器（BSG），将Correa-Cristi的存在性6-竞争算法转化为高效算法，同时在i.i.d.分布下获得改进的60/11竞争比。
AI.motivation: Correa和Cristi（STOC 2023）证明了在线次可加组合分配问题存在6-竞争的在线算法，但其结果基于Kakutani不动点定理的存在性证明，无法在多项式时间内构造。此前Dütting等人的最优多项式时间算法仅能保证O(log log m)竞争比，与离线问题中Feige已知的(2+ε)-近似形成鲜明对比，因此存在一个关键的算法开放性问题。
AI.method: 主要技术贡献是递归束评分生成器（BSG），称为RecHeight。该构造通过递归过程为每个买家的暂定束生成相关联的物品分数向量，分数等于物品在递归树中所属交集链的长度。关键性质是分数向量b严格随机占优于其他买家的最大分数p（即存在耦合使得b_j > p'_j对所有j∈A同时成立）。这一性质保证了"对称覆盖"结构，可通过子可加性获得2的近似因子。在线算法中，先对所有买家采样独立阈值分数，然后到达的买家使用RecHeight生成自身分数，仅获得分数超过阈值的物品。分析通过将实际历史补全为完整阈值（"最末买家"比较），结合三个i.i.d.阈值的对称性获得1/6因子。I.I.D.情形利用前一半买家的"中点比较"获得1/5因子，结合后一半的1/6因子，平均得到11/60。
AI.result: 1. 主要结果：对于任意ε>0，存在期望多项式时间的(6+ε)-竞争在线算法（给定需求预言机访问），匹配Correa-Cristi的竞争比。2. 离线结果：在离线设置中恢复了(2+ε)-近似，匹配Feige（2006）的结果。3. I.I.D.设置：当买家估值来自相同分布时，存在(60/11+ε)-竞争的多项式时间算法。4. 所有运行时间为n、n.m、(1-α)⁻¹的多项式。5. 证明5是组合覆盖论证下最佳常数（Lemma 6.3）。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过递归束评分生成器（BSG）解决了在线次可加组合分配问题中多项式时间常数竞争算法这一长期开放性问题，将Correa-Cristi的存在性结果转化为高效算法。技术核心是分数向量的严格随机占优性质与对称覆盖结构。I.I.D.设置下的60/11改进源自"中点比较"与5-循环覆盖的精妙组合，并证明该组合方法在此分析框架下是最优的。此外，附录展示了该方法在MMS问题中的应用潜力。

title: Massively Parallel Algorithms for Huffman Coding
summary: Huffman coding is one of the oldest and most fundamental problems in computer science. Given a string of length $\TextLength$ over a general alphabet, the goal is to assign a binary codeword to each character so that no codeword is a prefix of another and the total encoded length of the string is minimized. Huffman coding is widely used in practical compression systems, including file compression. As modern datasets continue to grow, it is natural to study whether a Huffman code can be constructed efficiently in the massively parallel computation (\MPC) model. The celebrated Huffman coding algorithm admits two straightforward \MPC implementations: for any constant $\epsilon\in(0,1)$, one uses $O(\TextLength^\epsilon)$ memory per machine but requires $\Theta(\log \TextLength)$ rounds, while the other runs in $O(1)$ rounds but requires $\Theta(\sqrt{\TextLength})$ memory per machine. We give the first nontrivial \MPC algorithm for Huffman coding that bypasses both limitations. For every constant $\epsilon>0$, our algorithm uses $O_\epsilon(\log\log \TextLength)$ rounds and $\softO(\TextLength^\epsilon)$ memory per machine, while its total memory and total computation are $\softO(\TextLength)$. This provides a rare example in which an exact solution to a problem whose classical algorithm is sequential in nature can be obtained in a sublogarithmic number of \MPC rounds.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大规模并行计算（MPC）模型下的经典霍夫曼编码问题，提出了首个非平凡的MPC算法。对于任意常数ε>0，该算法仅使用 Õ(n^ε) 的单机内存和 Õ(n) 的总内存/总计算量，就在 O_ε(log log n) 轮内完成了霍夫曼编码的精确求解，打破了现有两种平凡MPC实现（要么需要Θ(log n)轮，要么需要Θ(√n)单机内存）的根本性瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 霍夫曼编码是最经典的数据压缩算法之一，经典顺序算法可在线性时间内完成。然而在大规模并行计算（MPC）模型下，霍夫曼编码面临根本性的效率困境：现有的两种直接并行化方法都无法同时实现低轮数和低单机内存，要么需要 Ω(log n) 轮数配合 Õ(n^ε) 单机内存，要么需要 Õ(1) 轮但单机内存高达 Ω(√n)。论文旨在打破这一权衡，为霍夫曼编码（以及更广泛的"顺序本质但可并行化"组合问题）设计首个同时具备次对数轮数和亚线性单机内存的精确MPC算法。
AI.method:
算法结合了霍夫曼编码的两种等价视角——自底向上的迭代合并视角和基于 Kraft-McMillan 不等式的最优化视角，并将问题分解为两个子任务交替迭代求解：
1. **有界比率霍夫曼编码（Bounded-Ratio Huffman Coding）**：当频率比率 f_m/f_2 ≤ λ 时，利用 Fibonacci 增长性质证明最优深度范围 [ℓ,u] 有界（u−ℓ ≤ 2⌈log_φ λ⌉），将 Kraft 约束转化为整数预算约束，按 φ 比率分块后通过预算分配递推 μ(A₁⊎A₂, b) = min_{b₁+b₂=b} {μ(A₁,b₁)+μ(A₂,b₂)} 自底向上合并。其中**分层凸性（layered convexity）** 是关键技术贡献：通过证明 G_b(x) = μ(A₁,x) + μ(A₂,b−x) 在模 d=2^{u−ℓ−1} 的每个剩余类上凸，可在每个凸层内通过并行二元搜索快速求最优分配，无需穷举所有预算分割对。
2. **迭代状态重构（Iterative-State Reconstruction）**：给定最优深度向量和阈值 τ，不实际运行迭代算法而直接重构出合并到 τ 前的活跃权重集合。利用 Package-Merge 方法（[9] Larmore-Hirschberg）将节点频率恢复问题转化为带 Kraft 约束的最小频率子集选取问题 P(r) = min{Σf_i : Σ2^{−h_i} = r·2^{−h^*}}。通过分数松弛（fractional knapsack 贪心解）与整数最优解的差异有界性（Lemma 6.4 证明每个深度组内差异至多 2^{Δ+1}−2 个叶节点），将每个 P(r) 归约为可在单机上由 Package-Merge 线性求解的小规模残差实例。
主算法通过预处理阶段（用阈值 ⌈n^ε⌉ 先合并所有小权重，仅保留一个或全为大权重，将活跃权重数降至 O(n^{1−ε})），然后迭代执行：取满足有界比率条件的前缀 → 调有界比率霍夫曼编码 → 调迭代状态重构 → 更新运行代价。每轮次小权重至少增长 λ = n^{Θ(ε)} 倍，迭代次数仅 O_ε(1)。
AI.result: 核心定理（Theorem 3.1）：对任意常数 ε>0，存在 MPC 算法在 O_ε(log log n) 轮内、使用 Õ(n^ε) 单机内存、Õ(n) 总内存和总计算量，精确计算霍夫曼编码的最优编码长度 μ(T) 与对应最优码字。该结果是首个打破"Θ(log n) 轮"与"Θ(√n) 单机内存"二元困境的非平凡 MPC 实现，且可在同样的渐近资源下重构出完整的最优码字树（通过自顶向下追踪预算分裂和指针倍增，需额外 O(log log n) 轮）。这代表了组合优化问题中一类"经典算法本质为顺序，但可在次对数轮 MPC 内获得精确解"的稀有范例。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是为顺序经典问题——霍夫曼编码——设计了首个同时具备次对数轮复杂度（O_ε(log log n)）和亚线性单机内存（Õ(n^ε)）的精确 MPC 算法，彻底解决了两种平凡并行化方案的根本权衡。其技术贡献包括：（1）分层凸性（layered convexity）的发现与证明——合并代价函数 G_b 在模最大物品宽度的每个剩余类内凸但整体非凸，这一弱凸性已足够支撑并行二元搜索；（2）将 Package-Merge 算法与分数松弛论证结合，从最优深度向量高效重构迭代合并状态，无需真正顺序执行 Huffman 算法；（3）将有界比率实例的预算分配问题通过 φ-分块与自底向上合并高效求解。这些技术为 MPC 模型下其他"顺序本质"组合问题（如 LIS、编辑距离、LCS）的进一步研究提供了新的方法论范例。

title: Generating cyclic pivot Gray codes for well-ordered $k$-degenerate graphs in constant amortized time
summary: A graph $G$ is $k$-degenerate if there exists an ordering $v_1, v_2, \dots, v_n$ of its vertices such that each vertex $v_i$ has at most $k$ neighbors $v_j$ in $G$ with $j < i$. A well-ordered $k$-degenerate graph is a labeled graph on the vertex set $\{1, 2, \dots, n\}$ in which every vertex $i$ has at most $k$ neighbors among $1, 2, \dots, i-1$. We present the first simple algorithms that generate, rank, and unrank cyclic pivot Gray codes for well-ordered $k$-degenerate graphs, where consecutive graphs differ by the addition, removal, or pivoting of a single edge. Our algorithm generates each well-ordered $k$-degenerate graph in constant amortized time per graph, using $O(n^2)$ space, while ranking and unranking take $O(n^2)$ time and $O(n^2)$ space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于良序 k-退化图的循环枢轴格雷码生成、排序与反排序的简单算法，其中连续图通过单条边的添加、删除或枢轴操作进行转换。生成算法达到常数摊还时间，使用 O(n²) 空间；排序与反排序算法时间与空间均为 O(n²)。同时给出了良序 k-退化图计数的闭合公式。
AI.motivation: 良序 k-退化图是一类重要的图族，包含森林（k=1）、外平面图和串并联图（k=2）等。Bauer 等人虽已研究了其枚举问题，但仅给出了递归形式的枚举公式，不具备格雷码的规整性。现有的枢轴格雷码研究主要集中在生成树等狭义图族，尚不清楚能否推广到更一般的图族。本文旨在填补这一空白，将枢轴格雷码从生成树推广到整个良序 k-退化图类，并提供简单高效的生成、排序与反排序算法。
AI.method: 方法核心是将"剪枝二元反射格雷码（pruned BRGC）"与递归构造相结合。首先，定义长度 n、权重至多为 k 的二元串的剪枝 BRGC（利用 Williams 的局部递归），得到 2-格雷码；然后，利用自然双射，在 {1,…,n−1} 的子集族上获得一个格雷码，使得连续子集通过添加、删除或替换单个元素相连。基于此，对于良序 k-退化图，递归地为每个顶点 n 选取至多 k 个邻居子集（按格雷码序），交替使用正/反向枚举方向以保证循环性。排序/反排序算法基于分解索引为基准图索引与邻居子集索引，递归地调用二元串的排序/反排序。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 首个良序 k-退化图的循环枢轴格雷码生成算法 GenWOD，常数摊还时间、O(n²) 空间（定理 6）；(2) 精确计数闭合公式 λ(n,k) = ∏_{v=1}^{n} Σ_{i=0}^{k} C(v−1,i)（定理 7）；(3) 二元串排序/反排序算法，O(n) 时间（含 O(nk) 预处理）（定理 9、11）；(4) 图排序/反排序算法 GraphRanking/GraphUnranking，时间与空间均为 O(n²)（定理 13、16）。附录给出了完整的 Python 实现。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将枢轴格雷码构造从生成树推广到良序 k-退化图这一更广泛的图族。所提算法简单（仅依赖剪枝 BRGC 的递归枚举）、高效（常数摊还时间生成、O(n²) 排序/反排序），并给出了计数的闭合公式。该工作将 Bauer 等人关于良序 k-退化图的研究从递归枚举推进到具有格雷码规整性的枚举，并为该图族的进一步研究（如算法枚举、随机生成）奠定了基础。

title: Packing Diverse Shortest Cycles
summary: Bentert, Fomin, Golovach, Korhonen, Lochet, Panolan, Ramanujan, Saurabh, and Simonov (SODA 2025) initiated the parameterized study of Edge-Disjoint Shortest Cycle Packing: given a weighted graph $G$ and an integer $k$, decide whether $G$ contains $k$ edge-disjoint cycles of minimum weight. They showed that the problem admits an algorithm running in time $n^{O(k^6)}$ and asked whether it is fixed-parameter tractable or $W[1]$-hard parameterized by $k$. We resolve this question by proving that Edge-Disjoint Shortest Cycle Packing is $W[1]$-hard parameterized by $k$, even on unweighted subcubic graphs. The same lower bound also applies to the vertex-disjoint variant. For planar graphs, they provides a construction of a kernel with $O(k^2)$ vertices and an algorithm running in time $k^{O(k)} \cdot n^{O(1)}$, and explicitly asked whether the problem admits a single-exponential algorithm of running time $2^{O(k)} \cdot n^{O(1)}$. Rather than addressing this question in isolation, we introduce a more general framework, Diverse Shortest Cycle Coverage, which asks for $k$ shortest cycles that may overlap in a controlled way while maximizing the total weight of covered edges. This framework simultaneously captures edge-disjoint shortest cycle packing, the problem of finding diverse shortest cycles, and the problem of maximizing edge coverage by shortest cycles. Our main algorithmic result shows that Diverse Shortest Cycle Coverage can be solved on planar graphs in time $2^{O(k)} \cdot n^{O(1)}$, thereby giving a single-exponential algorithm for Edge-Disjoint Shortest Cycle Packing as a special case. The key idea of our algorithm is a structural analysis of the Laminar Shortest Cycles Tree, a tree-like decomposition that reveals a laminar interaction pattern among shortest cycles in planar graphs and enables an efficient dynamic programming algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文解决最短环打包问题的两个参数化复杂度问题：一般图上边不相交最短环打包在参数 k 下是 W[1]-难，即使限制为无权次三叉图；平面上则给出统一框架 Diverse Shortest Cycle Coverage 的 2^{O(k)}·n^{O(1)} FPT 算法，从而改进此前 k^{O(k)}·n^{O(1)} 的结果。
AI.motivation: 此前已有多项式核与 k^{O(k)} 算法，但一般图上最短环打包的 FPT 与否未知，且平面图上是否存在单指数 FPT 算法也未解决。本文将边不相交打包推广为允许受控重叠、同时优化边覆盖的多样最短环覆盖问题，以统一处理打包、多样最短环和最大边覆盖三类任务。
AI.method: 硬度部分从 Multicolored Clique 出发，设计顶点选择与边选择 gadget，并利用精确计数把团的选择与指定数量 k=2h+4·C(h,2) 的边不相交最短环打包对应起来。算法部分基于平面上最短环的 Laminar Shortest Cycles Tree：非树环通过 O(k) 条纵向路径编码，树环通过代表元、交互区间、辅助路径/环结构以及两层动态规划处理；结合对偶稀疏性和乘积界，将总复杂度控制在单指数参数因子内。
AI.result: 证明 Edge-Disjoint Shortest Cycle Packing 在无向无权最大度不超过 3 的图上参数化为 W[1]-难，因而一般图上排除 FPT（除非 FPT=W[1]）；同一结论推出顶点不相交变体也 W[1]-难。在平面图上，Diverse Shortest Cycle Coverage 可在 2^{O(k)}·n^{O(1)} 时间解决，作为特例得到边不相交最短环打包的单指数算法；这是多样化最短环与最短环最大边覆盖的首个 FPT 算法。作者还指出无覆盖约束的多样最短环具有 O(k^2) 顶点核，但覆盖版本的多项式核仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: 本文明确回答了最短环打包的 FPT/W[1]-难分类问题，并在平面图上实现了单指数算法。开放问题包括：Diverse Shortest Cycle Coverage 是否存在多项式 k-核，尤其覆盖版本；是否能获得 ETH 下排除 2^{o(k)} 的下界或子指数算法；在 H- minors-free 等特殊稀疏图类上能否证明 FPT。

title: Simulated annealing and Weak Poincaré inequalities with inverse-polynomial accuracy for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model
summary: We study sampling from the Gibbs distribution of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) model with Glauber dynamics. For every fixed inverse temperature $0\leq\beta<1$ and every fixed $M,D>0$, we give a polynomial-time simulated annealing algorithm whose output distribution is within $n^{-M}$ total-variation distance of the Gibbs distribution, with probability at least $1-n^{-D}$ over the interaction matrix. The algorithm starts from uniform product spins and uses Glauber dynamics along an increasing inverse-temperature schedule. The same approach also yields partition-function estimates with relative error $n^{-M}$. The key ingredient is a quantitative weak Poincaré inequality. Building on the stochastic-localization approach to weak Poincaré inequalities [Davies, Lee, Sandhu, and Shi, arXiv:2607.08160 , 2026], we use Gaussian isoperimetry to directly compare exact stochastic localization paths. Our comparison tolerates failures of local Lipschitz continuity of the posterior mean by controlling their accumulated cost. The local Lipschitzness comes from approximating the posterior means by stationary points of the Thouless-Anderson-Palmer (TAP) free energy in locally strongly convex regions located by approximate message passing, a paradigm introduced by algorithmic stochastic localization [El Alaoui, Montanari, and Sellke, 2025; Celentano, 2024]. The approximation errors are roughly characterized by the validity of the TAP gradient equations, but in a different coordinate. To show that the errors rarely accumulate too much, we need a strong concentration control. A direct argument would require solving a variant of an open problem by Talagrand [2010, Research Problem 1.7.9]. We bypass this open problem with an intermediate conditioning step and transfer the control back by establishing the stability of the TAP gradient under deletion of coordinates.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Sherrington–Kirkpatrick (SK) 模型的高温相（0≤β<1），构造了多项式时间模拟退火算法：以 Glauber 动力学沿升温逆温度路径从均匀乘积自旋出发，输出分布与 Gibbs 分布在总变差距离上达到逆多项式精度 n^{-M}，失败概率 n^{-D}；同一方法亦可用于配分函数的逆多项式相对误差估计。核心技术贡献是一个定量的弱 Poincaré 不等式（WPI），其缺陷 ε 的依赖为多项式 n^{7+BΓ}ε^{-Γ}。
AI.motivation: SK 模型采样是连接平衡结构与计算效率的核心问题。已知 Glauber 动力学在 β<1/2+c（c 为绝对常数）内有多项式混合，但整个 replica 对称相 β<1 是否可高效采样仍是公开挑战：现有工作要么用 ASL 在 2-Wasserstein 距离得到结果，要么在 β<1/2 内通过弱 Poincaré 不等式但不足以支持简单模拟退火。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 建立定量弱 Poincaré 不等式的关键创新：(1) 基于 [Davies-Lee-Sandhu-Shi] 弱 Poincaré 不等式框架，使用 Gaussian 等周性直接比较精确随机局部化路径，并通过控制累积代价容忍后验均值局部 Lipschitz 性的失效。(2) 局部 Lipschitz 性来源于：在 AMP 通过近似消息传递定位的局部强凸区域中，用 TAP 自由能的驻点近似后验均值；近似误差由后验均值处的 TAP 梯度残差控制。(3) 在 planted 模型中通过空腔插值和 Gaussian 等周性分析，在删除一个坐标的随机积分表示上建立残差的 L^p 稳定性，结合残差的次高斯性获得 O(log n) 控制与逆多项式失败概率。(4) 借助 [Bandeira-El Alaoui-Rödder] 的强场 Poincaré 不等式处理末端后验方差。(5) 从 WPI 通过 [Huang-Mohanty-Rajaraman-Wu] 的模拟退火框架推出采样与计数算法。
AI.result: 主要定理：对任意 0≤β<1、M,D>0，存在多项式时间模拟退火算法，从均匀乘积自旋出发沿 Glauber 动力学升温路径，其输出与 μ_A 在总变差距离内达到 n^{-M}，失败概率至多 n^{-D}（Theorem 1.2）。配分函数 Z_A(0) 可在多项式时间内达到逆多项式相对误差 n^{-M}（Corollary 1.3）。核心是逆多项式精度的弱 Poincaré 不等式：Var[f] ≤ Cn^{7+BΓ}ε^{-Γ}E(f,f) + ε·osc(f)^2，对 ε∈[n^{-M_0},1/2] 和所有 f 成立，矩阵事件概率 1-n^{-D}（Theorem 1.1）。
AI.conclusion: 本文将 SK 模型采样从 β<1/2 推进到整个高温相 β<1，获得了逆多项式总变差精度而非 o(1) 误差，并附带配分函数估计。关键贡献是建立了支持简单模拟退火的强定量弱 Poincaré 不等式，绕开了 Talagrand 公开问题中亚高斯浓度的困难，并填补了 [Davies-Lee-Sandhu-Shi] 弱 Poincaré 不等式不能直接支持退火的空白。方法具有模块性（Gaussian 等周性、TAP 几何、cavity 稳定性），有望推广到其他自旋玻璃与结构化分布。

title: An $n^{0.3+\varepsilon}$-Approximation for Steiner $k$-Forest
summary: We give an $n^{0.3+\varepsilon}$-approximation algorithm for the Steiner $k$-Forest problem, for any constant $\varepsilon>0$. As a function of $n$, this improves over the $O(\min\{\sqrt{n},\sqrt{k}\})$-approximation of Gupta et al. [ESA'07, TALG'10] which has stood for nearly two decades for the general case, as well as the later $n^{0.448}$-approximation of Dinitz et. al [APPROX-RANDOM'14, TALG'17] for the uniform weight case. On the other hand, we show that, due to lower bounds on the Densest $k$-Subgraph problem, the $O(\sqrt k)$-approximation for Steiner $k$-Forest likely cannot be improved. Specifically, we show that for any sufficiently small $\varepsilon>0$, an $O(k^{1/2-\varepsilon})$-approximation for Steiner $k$-Forest would surpass known degree-$n^{\Omega(\varepsilon^2)}$ Sum-of-Squares integrality gaps for Densest k-Subgraph and refute the corresponding dense-versus-random conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Steiner k-Forest问题提出了首个突破O(√n)近20年瓶颈的近似算法，达到n^{0.3+ε}的近似比，并证明了O(√k)近似比在Densest k-Subgraph的稠密vs随机猜想下难以突破。
AI.motivation: Steiner k-Forest问题自Gupta等人(ESA'07)以来，一般情形的最佳近似比停留在O(min{√n, √k})，未在将近二十年内有实质性进展。单位权情形下Dinitz等人的n^{0.448}近似也是十余年未有改进。论文旨在突破这一长期停滞，并明确√k近似的条件硬度。
AI.method: 方法采用一系列精细化技术：(1) FRT树嵌入将问题归约到树度量；(2) 高度约简嵌入(Lemma 2.2)将树深度压至O(1/ε)，代价n^ε；(3) 正则化引理(Lemma 2.3)使输入树分层近似正则；(4) 通用子采样算法(Algorithm 1)将期望连通性转化为高概率保证；(5) 广义贪心算法(Algorithm 2)将star情形下的贪心推广到任意深度正则树；(6) 新增"购买终端t的P'-邻域"算法(Lemma 5.1)；(7) 将MR_kT归约到Steiner k-Forest。最终通过多算法权衡得到Õ(n^{3/10})=n^{0.3+ε}近似。条件硬度方面，将Smallest k-Edge Subgraph归约到Steiner k-Forest，再利用Jones等人关于Densest k-Subgraph的SoS积分间隙及稠密vs随机猜想，证明O(k^{1/2-ε})近似将否定该猜想。
AI.result: 主要定理：对任意常数ε>0，存在随机多项式时间n^{0.3+ε}-近似算法解决Steiner k-Forest问题。改进了一般情形的O(√n)和单位权情形的n^{0.448}近似比。条件硬度结果：对任意充分小ε>0，O(k^{1/2-ε})-近似Steiner k-Forest将超越Densest k-Subgraph上已知的n^{Ω(ε²)度SoS积分间隙并否定稠密vs随机猜想。此外，作为副产品得到Dial-a-Ride问题的n^{0.3+ε}-近似。
AI.conclusion: 该工作显著推进了Steiner k-Forest问题的近似边界，是近二十年来首个打破O(√n)屏障的实质性改进。同时从条件硬度角度说明O(√k)近似比在稠密vs随机猜想下本质上是紧的，刻画了问题的完整近似景观。技术核心在于树嵌入下的层采样与正则化分析，以及多个近似保证的精细权衡(最终在定理5.2证明中以1/7、4/7、2/7的指数加权组合四种算法)。

title: A deterministic algorithm for signing bipartite graphs at the Ramanujan bound
summary: We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for the Bilu--Linial signing problem on bipartite graphs. For every finite simple bipartite graph of maximum degree at most an integer $\Delta\ge3$, the algorithm assigns signs to its edges so that the signed adjacency matrix has operator norm strictly less than $2\sqrt{\Delta-1}$. Our algorithm builds on the randomized recursive repair framework of Jadbabaie, Saberi, and Sra~\cite{JSS26}, with deterministic rules for sign selection and vertex deletion.

AI.tldr: 本文给出二部图 Bilu–Linial 符号问题的确定性多项式时间算法：对最大度不超过 Δ≥3 的有限简单二部图，可在确定性多项式时间内为每条边赋值，使符号邻接矩阵的算子范数严格小于 2√(Δ−1)。更新次数少于130n³，总位复杂度为 O(n¹⁰(log(n+1)+log(Δ+1))²)。
AI.motivation: Bilu–Linial 符号问题的存在性结果不直接给出对任意给定二部图的可计算签名；此前递归修复算法依赖随机化。本文旨在将该随机递归修复框架去随机化，得到适用于不连通、非正则简单二部图的确定性算法。
AI.method: 在临时活动顶点集上维护签名与矩阵 Q_K=I−A_K/ρ₀、ρ₀=2√(Δ−1)，以正定性作为可容许条件。利用删除/插入的 Schur补数行列式恒等式、贪心符号选择规则和基于递归深度的有界权重，构造带势函数的递归插入算法，并用精确有理运算完成所有判定与符号计算。
AI.result: 算法从空活动集出发逐个插入顶点；若邻点的逆对角元超过深度相关阈值，则确定性地删除该邻点并递归恢复，否则按贪心规则给新边定号。势函数每次更新至少按因子 1/γ₀ 下降，更新次数少于130n³，故调用必终止。结束时活动集为全部顶点且 Q_V 正定；二部图对称谱性遂给出 ||A_σ||<2√(Δ−1)。总位复杂度为 O(n¹⁰(log(n+1)+log(Δ+1))²)。
AI.conclusion: 本文确定性实现了二部图在 Ramanujan 界处的符号化，并给出了严格谱界、终止性证明、调用栈结构、更新次数界及显式位复杂度。算法无需连通性、正则性或签名存在性预言机，方法是对 Jadbabaie–Saberi–Sra 随机递归修复框架的有效去随机化。

title: Breaking the $\sqrt{3}$ Barrier for Maximum Weighted $3$-Set Packing
summary: We give a deterministic polynomial-time $1.6908$-approximation for Maximum Weighted $3$-Set Packing, breaking the $\sqrt3$ locality-gap barrier of squared-weight local search. The approximation ratio for this problem progressed from Berman's $2$ [Ber00] to Neuwohner's $2-\frac{1}{63{,}700{,}992}+\epsilon$ [Neu21]. Thiery and Ward then obtained $1.786$ [TW23], while Thiery subsequently improved the bound to $1.761+\epsilon$ and finally to $\sqrt3 \approx 1.732051$ through a layered exchange analysis [Thi23]. Thiery also proved that $\sqrt3$ is a locality-gap lower bound for the squared-weight objective even with exchanges of arbitrary size. Our algorithm performs in two phases and combines two objectives. Phase~I computes a bounded-exchange local optimum for the squared-weight potential and analyzes it through Thiery's layered framework, while strengthening the terminal analysis by preserving internal tree-edge slack for nonsingleton components and exploiting the incidence structure of $3$-sets for final singletons. This yields an augmented structural inequality with residual positive claw gain under the original objective. Phase~II switches to the original objective and recovers sufficient residual gain through an auxiliary weighted $9$-Set Packing instance. A covering argument transfers the structural bound through the high-girth lift used only in the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种确定多项式时间的1.6908-近似算法，用于求解最大加权3-集包装问题，打破了Thiery证明的平方权重局部搜索在√3处的局部性差距障碍。算法分两阶段：阶段I使用平方权重势函数的有界交换局部最优结合分层分析；阶段II切换到原始线性目标，通过辅助加权9-集包装实例恢复残余收益。
AI.motivation: 加权3-集包装问题的近似比从Berman的2改进到Neuwohner的2-1/63,700,992+ε，再到Thiery和Ward的1.786，最终Thiery达到√3≈1.732051。然而Thiery同时证明了√3是平方权重局部搜索的局部性差距下限，即使允许任意大小的交换。要突破这一障碍，必须利用平方权重势函数局部最优性之外的信息。
AI.method: 两阶段算法：阶段I计算平方权重势函数的有界交换局部最优解，通过Thiery的分层框架分析，保留非单例分量的内部树边松弛，并利用3-集的入射结构处理最终单例，得到增强的结构不等式2w(O)≤(4-c)w(A)+a·𝒢(A,O)；阶段II切换到原始线性目标，将正爪收益𝒢转化为辅助加权9-集包装实例，使用Berman的5-近似算法（缩放后为5.5）恢复足够收益。两阶段通过关键不等式5.5a < 4-c耦合，吸收缩放因子膨胀。
AI.result: 对于每个具有正有理权重的加权3-集包装实例，存在确定多项式时间算法返回包装A⁺，满足w(O)≤1.6908·w(A⁺)，其中O是最优解。具体数值：a=0.5433, c=0.6184, 4-c=3.3816, 5.5a=2.98815, 吸收裕度0.39345。该结果改进了加权3-维匹配、无限制最大权重三角填充、最大权重3-路径填充和单目标赢家确定等多个特例的最佳已知保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过将平方权重与线性权重两个目标结合，首次突破加权3-集包装的√3障碍。核心洞察是平方权重势函数与原始目标之间的差异可被系统识别和恢复。当前瓶颈在于阶段I结构界中的χ₁⁽⁷⁾、ν₁和最终单例证书均略高于阈值c=0.6184。未来方向包括强化阶段I证书、丰富残余结构与修复、推广到加权k-集包装以及缩小交换邻域。

title: 3SUM Is Really Hard: A Real-to-Integer Reduction
summary: We show that if the 3SUM problem on integer-valued inputs can be solved in truly subquadratic time, then it can also be solved in truly subquadratic time on real-valued inputs. This answers an open problem posed by Chan, Vassilevska Williams, and Xu [STOC 2022], and constitutes the first such tight real-to-integer self-reduction in fine-grained complexity. Our proof relies on a surprising combination of the Frank--Tardos theorem from optimization with Freiman-type theorems from additive combinatorics.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了 3SUM 问题的实数到整数自归约：若 Integer 3SUM 存在真正次二次算法，则 Real 3SUM 亦然。证明结合了 Frank–Tardos 定理（优化）与 Freiman 型定理（加法组合学），并通过两个中间步骤（Real Convolution 3SUM、规模分离、流行度分解等）完成。这是精细化复杂度中首个紧的实数到整数自归约。
AI.motivation: 精细化复杂度中长期未解决问题：是否 Real 3SUM 困难蕴含 Integer 3SUM 困难？由于 Real 3SUM 算法依赖线性判定树而 Integer 3SUM 算法可使用哈希与位打包技巧，二者技术差异显著，统一二者关系将影响所有基于 3SUM 的条件性下界。
AI.method: 核心四步：(1) 利用 Frank–Tardos 定理将实数映射为整数（保持子集和顺序）；(2) 引入子集和覆盖（subset sum cover）概念，借助 Borůvka 式算法证明弱版 Freiman 定理；(3) 通过取整（rounding）强制引入加法结构，并利用流行度/非流行度分解控制假阳性数量；(4) 经由 Real Convolution 3SUM 中介，分离不同尺度的元素完成归约。整个证明在现实的比较-加法模型（realistic comparison-addition model）下实现。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 若 Integer 3SUM 可在 $O(n^{2-\epsilon})$ 时间内求解，则 Real 3SUM 可在 $O(n^{2-\Omega(\epsilon^4)})$ 时间内求解（在比较-加法模型下）；(2) Integer 3SUM 与 Real 3SUM 在现实比较-加法模型下的真正次二次可解性等价；(3) Real Exact Triangle 也可被归约至 Real 3SUM，时间为 $O(n^{2-\Omega(\epsilon^2)})$。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了精细化复杂度中首个紧的实数到整数自归约，统一了 Integer 3SUM 与 Real 3SUM 的难度假设。由此，所有已知的 Integer 3SUM 难度结果也适用于 Real 3SUM。证明展示了 Frank–Tardos 定理与加法组合学的非平凡结合可有效处理实数输入场景，为后续实数输入问题的精细化研究开辟了道路。

title: Polynomial Kernels for Interval Completion
summary: An interval graph is the intersection graph of a family of intervals on the real line. \textsc{Interval Completion} asks whether a given graph can be transformed into an interval graph by adding at most $k$ edges. Although the problem is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by $k$, whether it admits a polynomial kernel has long been an open question. We resolve this question by giving the first polynomial kernel for \textsc{Interval Completion}. Our main contribution is a parameter-preserving polynomial-time reduction from \textsc{Interval Completion} to \textsc{Odd Cycle Transversal} (OCT). Combining this reduction with the known randomized and deterministic polynomial kernels for OCT and a polynomial-time reduction back to \textsc{Interval Completion}, we obtain a randomized kernel with $\widetilde O(k^{18})$ vertices and $\widetilde O(k^{36})$ edges, and a deterministic kernel with $O(k^{36})$ vertices and $O(k^{72})$ edges. Here, $\widetilde O$ suppresses polylogarithmic factors in $k$.

AI.tldr: 论文首次为 Interval Completion 给出多项式核，核心是将其参数保持地归约为 Odd Cycle Transversal（OCT），再利用已有 OCT 核并反向转换回来。所得确定性核有 O(k^36) 个顶点、O(k^72) 条边；随机化核有 Õ(k^18) 个顶点、Õ(k^36) 条边，失败概率至多 2^{-Ω(n)}，且仅可能产生假阴性。
AI.motivation: Interval Completion 虽已被证明是固定参数可解，但其是否具有关于参数 k 的多项式核长期悬而未决。本文旨在解决这一核心核化开放问题，并为 Interval Edge Deletion、Interval Edge Editing 等相关问题奠定基础。
AI.method: 核心是构造从 Interval Completion 到 Odd Cycle Transversal（OCT）的确定性、参数保持的多项式时间归约。对原图每条非边建立一个变量顶点，用二染色记录两个端点区间的左右分离方向；通过普通边编码异色约束，通过长度为 2 的路径编码同色约束，并加入辅助顶点。证明构造满足 ic(G)=oct(Ĝ)，归约图 Ĝ 的顶点数和边数均为 O(n^4)。随后使用已有 OCT 多项式核，并通过反向归约把 OCT 实例转回 Interval Completion 实例。反向构造使用两份 OCT 图的拷贝、冗余顶点以及两个团 P、Q，将最大独立集大小编码为区间补全代价，从而保留答案并把输出参数控制为关于输入规模的固定多项式。
AI.result: 证明了一个参数保持的确定性多项式时间归约：Interval Completion (G,k) 等价于 OCT (Ĝ,k)，且 |V(Ĝ)|、|E(Ĝ)|≤O(n^4)。结合 Kratsch–Wahlström 的随机 OCT 核，得到 Õ(k^18) 顶点、Õ(k^36) 边的随机核；结合 Koana–Kumabe 的确定性 OCT 核，得到 O(k^36) 顶点、O(k^72) 边的确定性核。随机核的失败概率为 2^{-Ω(n)}，且只会将 Yes 实例误判为 No 实例。该论文解决了 Interval Completion 是否存在多项式核这一长期开放问题。
AI.conclusion: Interval Completion 具有多项式核，论文给出了首个确定性及随机化多项式核。其关键方法是把每个未填充非边的区间左右顺序编码为 OCT 中的二染色变量和约束，从而建立严格的参数保持等价关系。论文同时指出，Interval Edge Deletion 与 Interval Edge Editing 的多项式核问题仍未解决，值得进一步研究。

title: Min-Plus Convolution Lower Bounds via a Higher-Order BSG Theorem
summary: Min-Plus Convolution is a central problem in fine-grained complexity, and the associated Min-Plus Convolution Hypothesis forms the basis for a wide range of conditional lower bounds for fundamental problems. It is closely connected to the APSP and 3SUM Hypotheses, and in fact implies both, making it a unifying hypothesis for two of the main pillars of the area. In this work we establish several strong results related to Min-Plus Convolution. We design a universe reduction, showing, under a plausible additive combinatorics assumption, that the Min-Plus Convolution Hypothesis is equivalent to the Strong Min-Plus Convolution Hypothesis. We also obtain tight conditional lower bounds for multiple long-standing problems, including Min-Max Convolution and Bounded Monotone Min-Plus Convolution. Our approach is inspired by Fischer's recent equivalence between several variants of APSP [STOC '26], but extending that technique to the arithmetic setting requires overcoming deep obstacles. To this end, we develop a novel additive structure theorem that can be viewed as a higher-order substitute of the Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers (BSG) theorem, allowing us to extract strong additive structure even from weakly structured sets. Building on this structural result, we show that certain structured 3SUM instances (namely, sets with low rank) can be solved in truly subquadratic time. This algorithm forms the main algorithmic ingredient in our reductions. Besides, it generalizes all previously known truly subquadratic-time special cases of 3SUM, and is therefore of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究细粒度复杂性中的核心问题——最小加法卷积（Min-Plus Convolution）。主要贡献包括：(1) 设计宇宙约简，证明在可接受的加法组合假设下，Min-Plus卷积假设与其强变体等价；(2) 获得多个长期悬而未决问题的紧条件性下界，如Min-Max卷积和有界单调Min-Plus卷积；(3) 开发一种新的加法结构定理，可视为Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers (BSG) 定理的高阶替代方案；(4) 基于此结构定理，证明低秩3SUM可在真正次二次时间内求解，统一并推广了所有已知的真正次二次时间的3SUM特例。
AI.motivation: Min-Plus卷积假设是细粒度复杂性的核心假设之一，统一了3SUM和APSP两大假设。然而，从大宇宙到小宇宙的约简以及多个"中间"复杂度卷积问题的紧下界一直缺失。Fischer [STOC '26] 已在矩阵情形（APSP）取得突破，但序列情形存在根本性技术障碍，亟需新的加法组合工具。
AI.method: 方法受Fischer的结构-随机性范式启发，分三步：(1) 开发高阶BSG定理，证明对充分大的k，Pop^k(A;p)的存在意味着存在覆盖A大部分的低倍增集H（|H|≤K|A|^{1+c}，|H+H|≤K|H|，K=|A|^ε可控）；(2) 定义集合的"秩"为使A⊆X+X的最小|X|，证明当某集合秩为O(n^{1-ε})时3SUM可在O(n^{2-ε'})时间内求解——通过迭代放大结构（meet-in-the-middle枚举解+非对称BSG定理），将低秩结构逐步转化为低倍增容器；(3) 将Min-Plus卷积约简到3SUM，再利用低秩3SUM算法获得强条件性下界。宇宙约简分为小宇宙（[n]→[n^γ]）和大宇宙（[n^c]→[n]，依赖假设1.7）两部分。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 宇宙约简：MPConv(n|u≤n) = Õ(n^ε·MPConvList(n,n^{1-γ}|u≤n^γ) + 3SUM(n|r≤n^{1-ε/2}))；(2) 大宇宙约简（依赖Hypothesis 1.7）：Min-Plus卷积假设与其强变体等价；(3) 紧条件性下界：Min-Max卷积、Min-Equality卷积、有界单调Min-Plus卷积均不能以O(n^{3/2-ε})时间求解，Min-Witness卷积不能以O(n^{4/3-ε})时间求解；(4) 低秩3SUM的统一算法：推广了所有已知真正次二次时间的3SUM特例（小宇宙、低倍增、聚类等）。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过开发高阶BSG定理和低秩3SUM算法，成功将Fischer的APSP宇宙约简技术扩展到序列情形，建立了Min-Plus卷积假设的完整图景。主要技术贡献——高阶加法结构定理和首个真正次二次时间的低秩3SUM算法——具有独立价值，可能在更广泛的细粒度复杂性研究中找到应用。大宇宙约简仍依赖于PFR猜想相关的加法组合假设（Hypothesis 1.7）。

title: Color Coding for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick Model
summary: We give a polynomial-time algorithm for approximating the partition function of mean-field mixed $p$-spin models to arbitrarily high accuracy throughout the second-moment regime. This improves the quasipolynomial-time algorithm of Bencs, Huang, Lee, Liu, and Regts ( arXiv:2507.15616 ) and answers their open question. In particular, our result covers the entire replica-symmetric regime of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick model. The algorithm is deterministic, runs in time polynomial in $n$ and $1/\varepsilon$, and succeeds for every typical realization of the disorder. Our main technical contribution is a new algorithmic application of color coding to the classical high-temperature expansion introduced by Aizenman, Lebowitz, and Ruelle in their study of fluctuations of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick partition function. We combine this approach with the zero-freeness established by Bencs et al. ( arXiv:2507.15616 ) to convert additive approximations into multiplicative ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多项式时间确定性算法，用于在整个二阶矩区间内以任意精度近似均值场混合 p-自旋模型的配分函数，回答了 Bencs 等人提出的开放性问题，并将他们的拟多项式时间算法改进为多项式时间。该算法完全覆盖 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型的整个副本对称区间。其核心技术贡献是将着色编码（color coding）技术应用于 Aizenman-Lebowitz-Ruelle 经典高温展开，并结合 Bencs 等人的零点自由性定理将加性近似转化为乘性近似。
AI.motivation: 均值场自旋玻璃模型配分函数的近似计算是统计物理、高维推断与平均情形复杂性的核心计算问题。Bencs 等人（2025）此前给出了二阶矩区间内的拟多项式时间确定性算法，并明确提出了一个开放性问题：能否将其改进为多项式时间？特别地，Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型在整个高温相 β < 1 内的多项式时间计数是该领域的核心挑战，且与计算复杂度与物理相变之间的深层联系密切相关。
AI.method: 方法的核心分为四个步骤：（1）将配分函数归一化为显式前因子与图展开 P(t) 的乘积，其中 P(t) 遍历所有偶子图的权重和，源自 Aizenman-Lebowitz-Ruelle 高温展开；（2）通过截断策略，仅保留边数至多 K=O(log n) 且分叉顶点数少于 b=O(1) 的偶子图，将 P 近似为 P_{K,b}，并利用二阶矩估计在加权范数下控制截断误差至 n^{-D}；（3）应用 Alon-Yuster-Zwick 的着色编码方法，结合条件期望法进行去随机化，对每个平衡着色 h 构造无偏估计量 V_h 并通过动态规划在 poly(n)e^{O(K)} 时间内精确求值（利用非终端顶点度恰为 2 的结构，将图分解为路径与环的组合）；（4）结合 Bencs 等人的零点自由性定理，通过 Markov 不等式与 Harnack 不等式将加性误差估计转化为乘性误差保证，从而在 |β|≤β_* 上实现乘性 ε-近似。算法对所有典型无序实现均以高概率成功。
AI.result: 主要定理（定理 1.1）：对于任意固定的混合函数 ξ(q)=∑γ_p²q^p 和 0<β_*<β_{2nd}，存在确定性多项式时间算法，以高概率输出配分函数的乘性 ε-近似，运行时间为 (n/(εδ))^O(1)。对 SK 模型，β_{2nd}=1，故覆盖整个高温相 β<1。这将 Bencs 等人的拟多项式时间 n^{O(log n)} 改进为严格多项式时间。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将着色编码应用于 Aizenman-Lebowitz-Ruelle 高温展开（而非 Bencs 等人使用的 Taylor 展开），成功将混合 p-自旋模型配分函数近似的运行时间从拟多项式降至多项式，完整回答了 Bencs 等人的开放性问题。该方法对纯 SK 模型以及包含二次与高阶相互作用的有限混合均适用。同期 Schmidhuber-Zlokapa 独立地利用相关图展开与着色编码技术得到了相同结果，但其对不含二次相互作用的混合使用了腔方法。本文的计数方法是确定性的、直接评估高温展开，与基于抽样和退火的途径形成互补。此外，作者在致谢中指出核心论证思路由 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 发现。

title: Subset Sum via Partial Match
summary: We show that the subset sum problem can be solved in time $O(2^{0.499999n})$, breaking the $2^{n/2}$ meet-in-the-middle barrier. Our approach builds on the representation technique framework of Randolph and Węgrzycki (STOC 2026). We choose a representation for which testing the compatibility of pairs of partial solution vectors is exactly the partial match problem. To beat exponent $1/2$ for subset sum, it then suffices to give a nontrivial partial match algorithm in a certain parameter regime. We achieve this by designing a depth-2 linear circuit for the partial match matrix, which yields an efficient algorithm via the framework of Alman and Li (FOCS 2025).

AI.tldr: 本文将子集和问题在时间复杂度上从经典的中点相遇算法 2^{n/2} 改进到 2^{0.499999n}，首次打破了半个多世纪以来未能突破的 2^{n/2} 屏障。其核心思想是利用表示技术（representation technique）将子集和的相容性测试归结为部分匹配（partial match）问题，再通过构造部分匹配矩阵的深度-2 线性电路实现超越中点相遇的算法。
AI.motivation: 子集和问题是精确算法领域的核心问题之一，Horowitz 和 Sahni 在 1970 年代给出的 2^{n/2} 时间中点相遇算法长期未被超越。Howgrave-Graham–Joux 在平均情况下通过表示技术打破该屏障，但最坏情况下该屏障始终未能被打破。近期 Randolph–Węgrzycki 通过表示技术与相容性测试的结合，对广义子集和（GSS）问题实现了超越中点相遇的改进，但普通子集和问题（即系数向量 ∈{0,1}^n）仍未解决。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 方法主要包括三个层面：(1) 表示选择：将系数向量 c∈{0,1}^n 分解为 a∈{0,1}^{n/3} 与 b∈{-1,0,1}^{n/3} 的和，其相容性矩阵恰好是部分匹配矩阵 P_1；(2) 相容性测试算法：通过为部分匹配矩阵 P_{n,1/2} 构造 EXACT_Z 类型的深度-2 线性电路，利用颜色体积（colored volume）的数值再平衡与"补集展开"技术，将左度数指数 δ_L 与右度数指数 δ_R 之和控制在 1/2 - 2ξ 以下（ξ > 0.00002）；(3) 整体框架：结合"少独立和"与"多独立和"两种情形，配合哈希筛选与混合二分（mixing dichotomy），并取 s=1/2 处为最难点。最终选取特定有理参数 a≈0.00038、b≈0.99095 完成数值验证。
AI.result: 主要结果（定理 1.1/4.1）：子集和问题存在最坏情况下的随机算法，运行时间为 O(2^{0.4999977...n}) = O(2^{(1/2 - 1/450000)n})，成功概率至少 99%，且不会返回错误解。这是首次在最坏情况下严格打破 2^{n/2} 的中点相遇屏障。具体数值：δ_L ≈ 0.00728，δ_R ≈ 0.49268，二者平均值约为 0.24998 < 1/4，从而 ξ ≈ 0.00002 > 0，导出 1/2 - ξ/9 ≈ 0.49999777。文中还通过有理区间算术（精度 10^{-160}）对所有数值进行严格验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将子集和的表示技术归约为部分匹配问题，并构造非平凡的 EXACT_Z 深度-2 线性电路，第一次在最坏情况下将子集和时间复杂度降至 2^{n/2} 以下。作者指出深度-2 线性电路是刻画相容性测试及其可归约问题（包括 OV、GSS、子集和等）进展的正确框架，并展望了对 Equal Partition 和 [±2]-GSS 的条件归约以及进一步的电路改进空间。声明中提到 OpenAI 同期独立发布了 O(2^{0.49n}) 的结果，本文使用了不同方法独立得出。

title: Fast Almost-Uniform Sampling of Random $k$-SAT Solutions
summary: We study approximately uniform sampling of satisfying assignments from random $k$-SAT formulas. For every sufficiently large $k$ and density $0 < \alpha \le 2^k/k^{16}$, we prove that, with high probability over the formula, there is a sampler whose output distribution is within total variation distance $\varepsilon$ of the uniform distribution on satisfying assignments and whose expected running time is at most $(nk(\alpha+1)/\varepsilon)^C$, for a universal constant $C$. Our algorithm improves the counting and sampling algorithms obtained by Chen, Lonkar, Wang, Yang, and Yin (STOC 2025) at the density $2^k/\operatorname{poly}(k)$ with running time $(n/\varepsilon)^{\operatorname{poly}(k,\alpha)}$. Our result achieves this density region for sampling with a polynomial degree independent of both the width and the density. Our algorithm separates a high-degree core from the remaining variables, and combines a recursive sampler for the residual formulas with approximate block heat-bath updates on the core. We adapt the recursive insertion-chain framework of Jain, Mizgerd, and Pham (2026) from $2$-trees to ordinary connected violation sets. Expansion and random literal signs yield uniform moment bounds for the resulting correlated lists across all residual formulas, allowing the signed-flow analysis to give a universal polynomial running-time degree. A polymer expansion and an exploration bound establish a polynomial spectral gap for the core dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了随机k-SAT解的近似均匀采样，在密度高达 α ≤ 2^k/k^16 的范围内，存在运行时间为 (nk(α+1)/ε)^C 的采样器，其输出分布与均匀分布在全变差距离 ε 内，达到了Chen等人（STOC 2025）的密度范围，但多项式次数独立于宽度k和密度α。
AI.motivation: 现有的随机k-SAT采样算法虽然在密度2^k/poly(k)下能达到多项式时间，但其多项式次数依赖于参数k和α。作者希望证明存在一个通用多项式次数的采样器，从而在参数变化时仍保持高效的运行时间。
AI.method: 算法将高自由度变量作为"核"，其余变量作为"残差公式"。对残差变量使用递归插入链采样器（改编自Jain等人），对核变量使用块热浴更新。通过有符号流分析控制残差采样成本，并通过聚合物展开和探索界限证明核动力学的多项式谱隙。
AI.result: 定理1.1证明了对足够大的k和密度0<α≤2^k/k^16，存在运行时间为(nk(α+1)/ε)^C的全变差距离ε近似均匀采样器，C为通用常数。核热浴链的谱隙至少为1/(sn)≥n^(-2)，保证多项式混合时间。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地在密度2^k/poly(k)范围内实现了通用多项式次数的随机k-SAT近似均匀采样，核心贡献包括：将Jain等人的递归插入链从2-树推广到普通连通违反集、扩张性和随机文字符号的统一矩估计、以及通过聚合物展开证明核动力学的快速混合。

title: Rectangular matrix multiplication from shared-leg entropy
summary: In this note, we extend the analysis underlying a recent matrix-multiplication result by OpenAI to rectangular products and prove that $\omega(1,k,1)\le 2$ for $0\le k\le \frac{1}{2}$ and $\omega(1,k,1)\le 1+k+\frac{1}{4k}$ for $k\ge \frac{1}{2}$. In particular, $\omega(1,\frac{1}{2},1)=2$ and the dual exponent satisfies $\alpha\ge \frac{1}{2}$. We use the shared-leg entropy inequality and polynomial-multiplication degenerations from that work, retaining two-leg symmetry and the orientation of each sector. Logarithmic averaging produces homogeneous auxiliary profiles. Their powered versions have a common asymptotic slope, and bounding their intercepts gives the spectral constraint $b\le 4a(1-a)$. This yields the rectangular curve by tensor-spectrum duality. As an application, Zwick's algorithm for all-pairs shortest paths in directed unweighted graphs runs in $O(n^{2.5})$ time. Combining the rectangular bound with the $(\min,+)$-product improvement of Alman and Vassilevska Williams further gives $O(n^{2.4999})$ running time.

AI.tldr: 本文将OpenAI近期关于矩阵乘法的分析（基于shared-leg entropy和多项式乘法退化）扩展到矩形矩阵乘积ω(1,k,1)。核心结果是一个抛物线型的特征约束 b₀ ≤ 4a₀(1−a₀)，由此推导出 ω(k) 的完整上界曲线，并应用于APSP、Hamming距离、LCA等多个图算法问题。
AI.motivation: 矩阵乘法是算法设计中的基础工具，矩形矩阵乘法（特别是 ω(1,k,1) 形状）在全对最短路径、Hamming距离、最近公共祖先等问题中有广泛应用。对矩形情形的细致分析可以解锁比单纯依赖 ω(2) 更优的算法复杂度，且这些算法层面的改进与OpenAI近期在方阵情形取得的突破直接相关。作者的目标是将该分析统一推广到矩形乘积。
AI.method: 技术路线：(1) 沿用OpenAI近期工作中的shared-leg entropy不等式与多项式乘法张量的行列式退化构造，但保留两腿对称性（X/Y交换），不进行完全对称化。(2) 引入几何平均函数 M(T) = √(λ(T)λ(T^τ)) 以平均化参数，定义离散轮廓 V_d(r,s) 和 U_d(r,s)。(3) 通过对数齐次化（logarithmic homogenization），利用Arzelà–Ascoli紧性论证构造连续齐次辅助轮廓 V, U（度为 δ）。(4) 定义归一化参数 a = a₀/δ, b = b₀/δ 后，分析两个幂次轮廓 P = V^{1/a}, Q = U^{1/a} 在无穷远处的公共斜率 L 和截距 C_P, C_Q。(5) 利用Euler齐次恒等式和耦合三倍不等式得到参数不等式 b ≤ 4a(1−a)。(6) 最后通过张量谱对偶性将参数约束转化为矩形指数上界。
AI.result: 主定理 (Theorem 1.1)：对所有固定 k ≥ 0，ω(1,k,1) ≤ 2（当 0 ≤ k ≤ 1/2 时），ω(1,k,1) ≤ 1 + k + 1/(4k)（当 k ≥ 1/2 时）。特别地 ω(1/2) = 2，对偶指数 α ≥ 1/2，以及 ω(2) ≤ 3.125。还得到三维不等形推广 ω(a,b,c) 的上界公式 (Corollary 6.1)。具体值：ω(0.6) ≤ 2.0166..., ω(0.8) ≤ 2.1125, ω(1) ≤ 2.25, ω(1.5) ≤ 2.6666..., ω(2) ≤ 3.125。算法应用包括：(1) Zwick算法APSP运行 O(n^{2.5})，结合Alman-Vassilevska Williams的(min,+)乘积进一步得到 O(n^{2.4999})；(2) DAG中逐对LCA时间 O(n^{(3+√3)/2}) ≈ O(n^{2.366})；(3) 精确全对Hamming距离 O(n^{2.5886})；(4) 最小/最大见证 O(n^{2.5})；(5) 稀疏矩阵乘法在 m ≤ n^{1.25} 时达到 O(n²)；(6) 动态矩阵求逆与可达性达到 O(n^{1.31125}) 每操作复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将OpenAI近期矩阵乘法结果的分析框架推广到矩形矩阵乘积，核心创新在于保留定向信息的部分对称化处理和对两个耦合齐次轮廓的公共斜率-截距分析，由此得到紧的抛物线型特征约束 b ≤ 4a(1−a)。这直接解锁了多个图算法问题中对数级的时间复杂度改进（如APSP从 2.5 降至 2.4999）。所有复杂度约定中指数忽略 +o(1) 项。该工作主要继承了原方阵工作中的张量构造和熵不等式，其新增贡献在于矩形参数界和耦合轮廓分析。

title: Taxonomic Classification with Complete Tag Arrays
comment: Preliminary version: The ideas in this paper are the authors'; the code, the experiments and the text were developed by Claude Opus 5.5, an AI model by Anthropic, under their direction. We are in the process of verifying the results, including running a comparison with Cliffy, which we cannot build on the commodity machine we are currently using
summary: Taxonomic classifiers such as Kraken assign each $k$-mer of a reference database to the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of the genomes containing it, but this works less well as databases grow, because more and more $k$-mers are shared across species. Cliffy (Ahmed, Boucher and Langmead, 2025) instead uses variable-length exact matches found with an r-index, and can list approximately the genera containing each match; on 16S rRNA it is more accurate than Kraken~2, but its index is large and expensive to build. We present KATKA, which finds the maximal exact matches (MEMs) of at least a given length in each read with Boyer--Moore--Li on a run-length compressed suffix array, counts the occurrences of each MEM in each genus exactly with a complete, run-length compressed tag array, and gives each genus credit in proportion to those counts. On the SILVA 16S rRNA database, KATKA's default index takes 1.44\,GB and can be built in minutes on a desktop computer; it classifies a read in 66\,$\mu$s with one thread and reaches 93.8\% genus-level accuracy, close to what Cliffy reports for its 9\,GB index. Grammar-compressing the runs of the tag array shrinks the index to 1.04\,GB, at 75\,$\mu$s per read. On the same machine and reads, it is more accurate than Kraken~2 (79.3\%) and Tagger (81.7 to 92.8\%, depending on how mates that disagree are scored). Indexing minimizer digests instead of the sequences makes the index three times smaller and classification 1.7 times faster, at a cost of 1.3 points of accuracy. KATKA is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为KATKA的16S rRNA宏基因组分类工具，通过使用Boyer-Moore-Li算法在游程压缩后缀数组上寻找最大精确匹配（MEM），并利用完整的、游程压缩的标签数组精确计数每个MEM在各属中的出现次数，从而以比现有工具更小的索引实现接近最优的分类精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于k-mer的分类器（如Kraken 2）随着参考数据库的不断扩大，越来越多k-mer被多个物种共享，导致物种级别的分类精度下降；而基于MEM的方法（如Cliffy）虽然精度更高，但索引体积大（9 GB）、构建耗时长且需要大量临时磁盘空间（TB级），难以普及应用。
AI.method: KATKA的核心方法包含四个部分：(1) 使用游程压缩后缀数组（RLCSA）索引参考序列及其反向互补序列，并附带10-mer查找表加速后向搜索；(2) 使用Boyer-Moore-Li（BML）算法在read中仅查找长度≥L（默认30）的MEM，跳过短MEM；(3) 使用完整的、游程压缩的标签数组（记录每个BWT位置对应的属）精确计数MEM在各属中的出现次数；(4) 按比例加权（proportional credit），即每个属的权重正比于MEM在该属中的出现次数占总出现次数的比例。
AI.result: 在SILVA 16S rRNA数据库上，KATKA默认索引仅需1.44 GB，可在桌面级电脑上数分钟内构建完成；单线程分类速度为66 μs/read，属级精度达93.8%（strict accuracy 93.77%），接近Cliffy使用其9 GB索引所报告的精度。使用语法压缩（grammar compression）标签数组的run可将索引进一步压缩至1.04 GB，速度为75 μs/read。同等条件下，KATKA精度优于Kraken 2（79.3%）和Tagger（81.7%-92.8%）。索引最小化子（minimizer）摘要可使索引缩小至1/3、分类速度提升1.7倍，仅损失1.3个百分点的精度。
AI.conclusion: 长MEM的BML查找、完整的游程压缩标签数组精确计数、以及按出现次数比例加权，三者结合构成了一个精度接近Cliffy、但索引小数倍且可在普通电脑上快速构建的分类器KATKA。索引最小化子摘要提供了空间与精度间的有效权衡。未来工作包括：与Cliffy在同机同reads上做直接比较、测试GTDB全基因组和数据库缺失物种的场景、将LCA推广到考虑横向基因转移的系统发育网络等。

title: Barely Monotone (min,+)-Convolution in Truly Subquadratic Time
summary: The (min,+)-convolution of two sequences A and B of length n is the sequence C with C[k] = min_{i+j=k} (A[i]+B[j]). For bounded inputs, whose entries are integers in {0,...,O(n)}, prior work computes it in truly subquadratic time when the inputs are monotone; the algorithm of Chi, Duan, Xie, and Zhang (STOC 2022) takes expected O~(n^{1.5}) time. We introduce a monotonicity measure ranging from 0 (monotone) to 1/2 (entirely non-monotone): a sequence has monotonicity alpha if it can be partitioned into O(n^alpha) monotone subsequences, and by the Erdos-Szekeres theorem every sequence has monotonicity at most 1/2. We show that truly subquadratic time is achievable even when just one input is barely monotone, that is, has monotonicity 1/2 - Omega(1): if A has monotonicity alpha, we compute the convolution in expected time O~(n^{5/3+2alpha/3}) for every bounded B. If B has monotonicity beta as well, the expected time improves to O~(n^{(3+alpha+beta)/2}), which matches the monotone case for alpha = beta = 0; this algorithm also allows infinite entries placed arbitrarily. We complement these algorithms with fine-grained reductions. Bounded (min,+)-convolution reduces to bounded monotone (min,+)-convolution of length N = O(n^{1.5}), so an O(N^{4/3-eps})-time algorithm for monotone inputs would give an O(n^{2-3eps/2})-time algorithm for bounded inputs. Similarly, entries bounded by n reduce to entries bounded by N^x on sequences of length N = Theta(n^{2/(1+x)}). We also show that if only A has entries in {0,...,M}, we can compute the convolution in O~(n(M+1)) time, and in O~(n^{1.5} sqrt(M)) time if A may also contain +infinity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有界(min,+)-卷积问题，针对输入序列具有不同单调性程度的情形设计高效算法。核心贡献是引入"单调性度量"概念，并证明即使输入序列"几乎非单调"（单调性数接近1/2），仍可获得真正次二次时间算法。
AI.motivation: (min,+)-卷积是APSP（所有顶点对最短路径）的one-dimensional类比，与APSP问题等价（次立方规约）。先前最优算法（CDXZ, STOC 2022）仅对**完全单调**的有界输入达到真正次二次时间Õ(n^{1.5})。本文的核心问题是：**究竟需要多少单调性才能获得快速算法？** 通过引入基于Erdős-Szekeres定理的单调性度量（将序列划分为最少的单调子序列数），本文系统地填补了"完全单调"与"完全非单调"之间的算法空间。
AI.method: 方法体系分三大部分：1)**稀疏单调分区框架**：基于CDXZ的粗值框架（coarse-value framework），利用随机素数p对值进行分裂。对bound (a)，使用逐位细化（bit-by-bit refinement），将p本身作为分层尺度D，通过"填充序列"（filled sequences）和"别名过滤器"（aliasing filter）处理多部分交错问题。2)**分组与报告结构**：对bound (b)，利用最小二乘报告结构按组枚举错误对，将A的每个部分组与B的每个条目匹配。3)**精细规约**：通过添加线性偏移将任意序列变为单调（长度-值范围权衡）；通过值分层将大值域问题归约为小值域问题。所有算法均为Las Vegas型（蒙特卡洛预期时间），使用word RAM模型。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：1)**Theorem 1.1(a)**：当A的单调性数为n^α、B的单调性数为n^β时，有界(min,+)-卷积可在期望时间Õ(n^{(3+α+β)/2})内计算（α=β=0时退化为Õ(n^{1.5})，匹配CDXZ）。2)**Theorem 1.1(b)**：若仅A具有单调性α，B任意有界，则期望时间为Õ(n^{5/3+2α/3})；当A仅有常数个单调部分时为Õ(n^{5/3})。3)**Theorem 1.2-1.3**：一端有界结果——若A∈{0,...,M}^n而B任意，确定性Õ(n(M+1))；允许A含+∞后为Õ(n^{1.5}√M)。4)**Theorem 1.4 + Corollary 1.5**：有界(min,+)-卷积可规约为长度N=Õ(n^{1.5})的有界单调实例；若单调实例有O(N^{4/3-ε})算法则一般有界问题可达O(n^{2-3ε/2})。5)**Proposition 3.9**：mono(A)≤2的改进可传递到一般有界情况。所有结果汇总于Table 1。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了(min,+)-卷积算法的完整单调性谱系：完全非单调（α=1/2）退化为二次时间，但任何严格小于1/2的单调性都足以获得真正次二次时间。技术上，通过"填充序列"思想处理多单调部分交错问题，以及通过"别名过滤"技术避免昂贵的范围受限卷积计数，是两个关键创新点。规约结果（Corollary 1.5、1.7）将单调性、值域大小与长度三个轴上的最优指数相互联系起来，为后续研究提供了清晰的技术路线图。注意：本工作与Alman-Vassilevska Williams近期打破APSP次立方障碍的工作并行，对结构化特殊情形仍有独立价值。

title: Symmetric Submodular Minimization from Comparisons
summary: Given value-oracle access to a symmetric submodular function $f:2^V\to\mathbb{R}$ with $|V|=n$, a nontrivial minimizer can be found using $O(n^3)$ value queries. We study the weaker comparison model, in which a query on $S,T\subseteq V$ reveals only whether $f(S)$ is smaller than, equal to, or larger than $f(T)$. We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that finds a nontrivial minimizer of any symmetric submodular function using $O(n^3)$ comparisons, matching the best-known deterministic value-oracle bound despite not knowing the function values. More generally, the same $O(n^3)$-comparison bound holds for minimization over the nonempty members of any downward-closed family. Our algorithm combines the minimum-capacity ordering recently introduced by Iwata and Konno with the contraction framework of Goemans and Soto. Applying this result to weighted graph cut functions resolves the main open question of Cohen-Addad et al., who gave an $\widetilde{O}(n^3)$-comparison algorithm that runs in exponential time and asked whether a weighted minimum cut can be found in polynomial time using comparisons. For graphs with $m$ edges of integer weight at most $B$, we also give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that finds a minimum cut using \[ \widetilde{O}\!\left(n^2+\min\!\left\{mB,\,nB^2\right\}\right) \] comparisons, improving on the $O(n^3)$ bound when $B$ is small. Finally, we show that every randomized algorithm that outputs a minimum cut with probability at least $2/3$ makes $\Omega(n \log n)$ expected comparisons in the worst case. Under the stronger assumption that all edge weights are polynomially bounded integers, we obtain an $\Omega(n \log \log n)$ expected comparison lower bound. These bounds contrast with the value-oracle model, where no $\omega(n)$ lower bound is known even for deterministic algorithms.
